研究发现，所有组织中的兄弟来源的嵌合体完全源自于造血来源的细胞（即髓系和淋巴系谱）。在脑组织中，这种兄弟来源的嵌合体表现为小胶质细胞（microglia，20%–52%）和巨噬细胞（macrophages，18%–64%）中存在，但在其他常驻细胞类型（如神经元、胶质细胞或室管膜细胞）中并未观察到。不同脑区的小胶质细胞中兄弟来源的比例显示出显著的变化，甚至在同一只动物内部，这可能反映了遗传兄弟小胶质细胞对局部招募或增殖信号的不同反应，或是不同脑区中存在不同的克隆扩展历史。在我们分析的动物和组织中，小胶质细胞的基因表达谱与局部/宿主环境的关系远比与兄弟遗传差异的关系更为密切。自然发生的狨猴嵌合体将为我们提供新的视角，以认识基因、突变和脑环境对小胶质细胞生物学的影响，并帮助区分小胶质细胞与其他细胞类型对脑表型的影响。
items.title_zh: 狨猴小胶质细胞中的兄弟嵌合现象
items.summary_zh: 嵌合现象在大多数哺乳动物中较为罕见，但在狨猴和狨猴中较为常见，这源于异卵双胞胎或三胞胎的出生模式。在子宫内相连的循环系统导致终生存在的血液嵌合现象（12-80%）。雌性狨猴器官中存在Y染色体DNA序列提示嵌合现象可能影响这些器官。我们分析了多只狨猴的血液、肝脏、肾脏和多个脑区的单细胞RNA测序数据，利用转录的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）识别不同组织中具有兄弟基因组的细胞。所有组织中的兄弟来源嵌合完全源自造血细胞（即髓系和淋巴系）。在脑组织中，兄弟来源的嵌合体现在小胶质细胞（20-52%）和巨噬细胞（18-64%）中，而在其他常驻细胞类型（神经元、胶质细胞或室管膜细胞）中则未见。小胶质细胞的兄弟来源比例在不同脑区和个体间显著变化，可能反映了遗传兄弟小胶质细胞对局部招募的不同反应。

items.title: Cryo-EM structure of the bicarbonate receptor GPR30
items.abstract: G-protein-coupled receptor 30 (GPR30) is a bicarbonate receptor that plays a vital role in cellular responses to extracellular pH and ion homeostasis. Despite its significance, the mechanisms by which GPR30 interacts with bicarbonate ions remain elusive. There is no consensus on a drug that targets GPR30, and difficulties in pharmacological analyses have limited biological and drug discovery research on GPR30. Here, we present the cryo-electron microscopy structure of human GPR30 in the presence of bicarbonate ions at 3.15 Å resolution. Our structure reveals unique extracellular pockets and critical residues for bicarbonate binding and activation. Functional assays demonstrate that mutations in these residues impair bicarbonate-induced GPR30 activation, underscoring their importance in receptor function. This study also provides insights into G-protein coupling, highlighting the structural divergence between GPR30 and other G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs). Our findings not only advance the understanding of the role of GPR30 in pH homeostasis but also pave the way for the development of high-affinity drugs targeting GPR30 for therapeutic interventions in diseases associated with acid-base imbalance.
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了GPR30与碳酸氢根离子结合的结构特征及其在pH稳态中的重要性，为开发针对GPR30的高亲和力药物提供了新思路。
items.l2_summary: G蛋白偶联受体30（GPR30）是一种重要的重碳酸盐受体，在细胞对细胞外pH值和离子稳态的反应中发挥着关键作用。然而，GPR30与重碳酸盐离子之间的相互作用机制仍不清楚，目前尚无针对GPR30的药物共识，且药理学分析的困难限制了对GPR30的生物学研究和药物发现。本文通过冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）技术，展示了人类GPR30在重碳酸盐离子存在下的结构，分辨率达到3.15 Å。研究结果揭示了GPR30独特的细胞外口袋和关键氨基酸残基，这些残基对重碳酸盐的结合和激活至关重要。功能实验表明，这些氨基酸残基的突变会削弱重碳酸盐诱导的GPR30激活，进一步强调了它们在受体功能中的重要性。此外，本研究还提供了对G蛋白耦合的深入见解，突显了GPR30与其他G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）之间的结构差异。我们的发现不仅加深了对GPR30在pH稳态中作用的理解，也为开发高亲和力的GPR30靶向药物提供了基础，这些药物有望用于治疗与酸碱失衡相关的疾病。
items.title_zh: GPR30碳酸氢盐受体的冷冻电子显微镜结构
items.summary_zh: G蛋白偶联受体30（GPR30）是一种碳酸氢盐受体，在细胞对细胞外pH和离子稳态的反应中发挥重要作用。尽管其重要性显著，但GPR30与碳酸氢盐离子相互作用的机制仍不清楚。目前尚无针对GPR30的共识药物，药理分析的困难限制了对GPR30的生物学和药物发现研究。本文展示了在碳酸氢盐离子存在下，人类GPR30的冷冻电子显微镜结构，分辨率为3.15 Å。我们的结构揭示了独特的细胞外口袋和关键残基，这些残基对碳酸氢盐的结合和激活至关重要。功能实验表明，这些残基的突变会削弱碳酸氢盐诱导的GPR30激活，强调了它们在受体功能中的重要性。本研究还提供了G蛋白耦合的见解，突显了GPR30与其他G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）之间的结构差异。我们的发现不仅加深了对GPR30在pH稳态中作用的理解，也为开发针对GPR30的高亲和力药物以治疗酸碱失衡相关疾病铺平了道路。

items.title: How to give cells an identity crisis
items.abstract: The transcription factor CHOP helps cells switch from an emergency stress response to a chronic one, where cells survive but lose some of the functions that define their identity.
items.l1_lead: 转录因子CHOP使细胞从应急应激反应转变为慢性应激状态，虽然细胞得以存活，但却失去了部分定义其身份的功能。
items.l2_summary:
研究表明，转录因子CHOP（C/EBP homologous protein）在细胞应激反应中扮演着重要角色，尤其是在细胞从急性应激反应转变为慢性应激反应的过程中。急性应激反应通常是细胞对短期压力的快速反应，而慢性应激反应则是细胞在长期压力下的适应性反应。在这一转变中，细胞虽然能够存活下来，但却会失去一些定义其身份的功能。

具体而言，CHOP的作用使得细胞在面对持续的压力时，能够通过改变基因表达模式来适应环境。然而，这种适应并非没有代价，细胞在经历慢性应激后，往往会丧失其特定的功能特征，导致细胞身份的危机。这种现象在多种生物体中都有观察到，提示CHOP在细胞命运决定中的关键作用。

研究还发现，CHOP的表达水平与细胞的生存状态密切相关。高水平的CHOP表达通常与细胞功能的丧失相关，而低水平则可能使细胞保持其正常功能。因此，调控CHOP的表达可能为治疗与细胞身份相关的疾病提供新的思路。

总之，CHOP不仅是细胞应激反应的重要调节因子，还在细胞身份的维持与转变中发挥着关键作用。理解CHOP的功能及其机制，可能为我们提供新的视角来研究细胞生物学和相关疾病的治疗策略。
items.title_zh: 如何让细胞经历身份危机
items.summary_zh: 转录因子CHOP帮助细胞从紧急应激反应转变为慢性应激反应。在这一过程中，细胞虽然能够存活，但会失去一些定义其身份的功能。研究表明，CHOP在调节细胞应激反应中起着关键作用，影响细胞的生存和功能维持。这一发现为理解细胞在不同应激状态下的行为提供了新的视角，并可能为相关疾病的治疗提供新的思路。

items.title: Nucleation-dependent propagation of Polycomb modifications emerges during the Drosophila maternal to zygotic transition
items.abstract: During zygotic genome activation in Drosophila , broad domains of Polycomb-modified chromatin are rapidly established across the genome. Here, we investigate the spatial and temporal dynamics by which Polycomb group (PcG) histone modifications, H3K27me3 and H2Aub, emerge during early embryogenesis. Using ChIP-seq and live imaging of CRISPR-engineered GFP-tagged PcG components, we show that PRC2-dependent H3K27me3 accumulates adjacent to a subset of E(z)-bound prospective Polycomb response elements (PREs) beginning in nuclear cycle 14 (NC14), with patterns indicative of nucleation followed by spreading. Surprisingly, PRE-binding factors Pho, Combgap, and GAGA-factor are excluded from interphase nuclei prior to NC10, despite nuclear localization of E(z) throughout early interphases. Loss-of-function studies further demonstrate that GAGA-factor is largely dispensable for PcG domain establishment, whereas the pioneer factor Zelda is required for proper deposition of H3K27me3 and H2Aub at a subset of Polycomb domains. The role of Zelda at Polycomb domains is context-dependent; a subset of targets requires Zelda not for E(z) recruitment, but instead to license an E(z)-loaded PRE to deposit H3K27me3. Our findings support a model where licensing of PcG domains is an initial step in the regulatory processes governing Polycomb-regulated developmental genes.
items.l1_lead: 在果蝇母体到合子转变过程中，Polycomb修饰的传播依赖于核内的成核机制，Zelda因子在特定Polycomb区域的H3K27me3和H2Aub沉积中发挥关键作用。
items.l2_summary:
在果蝇（Drosophila）的母体到胚胎转变过程中，胚胎基因组激活时，广泛的Polycomb修饰染色质迅速在基因组中建立。研究者们探讨了Polycomb群体（PcG）组蛋白修饰H3K27me3和H2Aub在早期胚胎发生中的空间和时间动态。通过ChIP-seq和实时成像技术，研究团队使用CRISPR工程化的GFP标记的PcG组分，发现PRC2依赖的H3K27me3在核周期14（NC14）开始时，逐渐积累在一部分E(z)结合的潜在Polycomb反应元件（PREs）附近，显示出先核化后扩散的模式。

有趣的是，PRE结合因子Pho、Combgap和GAGA因子在NC10之前被排除在间期细胞核之外，尽管E(z)在早期间期中始终存在于细胞核内。功能缺失研究进一步表明，GAGA因子在PcG域的建立中大体上是可有可无的，而先锋因子Zelda则是H3K27me3和H2Aub在部分Polycomb域中正确沉积所必需的。Zelda在Polycomb域中的作用是上下文依赖的；部分靶标需要Zelda并非为了招募E(z)，而是为了使一个已加载E(z)的PRE能够沉积H3K27me3。

这些发现支持了一个模型，即PcG域的许可是调控Polycomb调节的发育基因的初步步骤。这一研究揭示了在果蝇早期胚胎发育过程中，Polycomb修饰的动态形成及其调控机制，为理解发育基因的调控提供了新的视角。
items.title_zh: 依赖成核的Polycomb修饰在果蝇母体到合子转变中传播
items.summary_zh: 在果蝇的合子基因组激活过程中，广泛的Polycomb修饰染色质迅速在基因组中建立。本文研究了H3K27me3和H2Aub等Polycomb群体（PcG）组蛋白修饰在早期胚胎发生中的空间和时间动态。通过ChIP-seq和CRISPR工程化的GFP标记PcG组分的实时成像，我们发现PRC2依赖的H3K27me3在核周期14（NC14）开始时累积在一部分E(z)结合的潜在Polycomb响应元件（PREs）附近，显示出成核后扩散的模式。令人惊讶的是，PRE结合因子Pho、Combgap和GAGA因子在NC10之前被排除在间期细胞核之外，尽管E(z)在早期间期中持续定位于细胞核。功能缺失研究进一步表明，GAGA因子在PcG域的建立中大部分是可有可无的，而先锋因子Zelda则是H3K27me3和H2Aub在部分Polycomb域中正确沉积所必需的。Zelda在Polycomb域的作用是上下文依赖的；部分靶标需要Zelda不是为了招募E(z)，而是为了授权E(z)加载的PRE沉积H3K27me3。我们的研究结果支持了一个模型，即PcG域的授权是调控Polycomb调节的发育基因的初始步骤。

items.title: Parkinson’s disease-associated PINK1 loss disrupts ensheathing glia and causes dopaminergic neuron synapse loss
items.abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is commonly associated with the loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra , but many other cell types are affected even before neuron loss occurs. Recent studies have linked oligodendrocytes to early stages of PD, though their precise role is still unclear. PINK1 is mutated in familial PD, and through unbiased single-cell sequencing of the entire brain of Drosophila Pink1 models, we observed significant gene deregulation in ensheathing glia (EG), cells that share functional similarities with oligodendrocytes. We found that the loss of Pink1 leads to abnormalities in EG, similar to the reactive response of EG seen upon nerve injury. Using cell-type-specific transcriptomics, we identified deregulated genes in EG as potential functional modifiers. Specifically downregulating two trafficking factors in EG, Vps35 and Vps13, also mutated in PD, was sufficient to rescue neuronal function and protect against dopaminergic synapse loss. Our findings demonstrate that Pink1 loss in neurons triggers an injury-like response in EG, and that Pink1 loss in EG, in turn, disrupts neuronal function. Vesicle trafficking components, which may regulate membrane interactions between organelles in EG, seem to play a role in maintaining neuronal health and ultimately preventing dopaminergic synapse loss. Our work highlights the essential role of glial support cells in the pathogenesis of PD and identifies vesicle trafficking within these cells in disease progression.
items.l1_lead: 帕金森病中PINK1的缺失会导致包裹胶质细胞功能异常，从而引发多巴胺能神经元突触丧失，强调了胶质细胞在疾病进展中的重要作用。
items.l2_summary: 帕金森病（Parkinson’s disease, PD）通常与黑质（substantia nigra）中多巴胺能神经元的丧失相关，但在神经元损失发生之前，许多其他细胞类型也受到影响。近期研究将少突胶质细胞（oligodendrocytes）与PD的早期阶段联系起来，尽管其具体作用仍不明确。PINK1基因在家族性帕金森病中发生突变，通过对果蝇（Drosophila）Pink1模型进行无偏单细胞测序，我们观察到包裹胶质细胞（ensheathing glia, EG）中显著的基因失调。研究发现，PINK1的缺失导致EG的异常，类似于神经损伤后EG的反应。通过细胞类型特异性的转录组学分析，我们识别出EG中失调的基因作为潜在的功能修饰因子。特别是下调EG中的两个运输因子Vps35和Vps13（这两个因子在PD中也发生突变）足以恢复神经元功能，并保护多巴胺能突触免受损失。我们的研究表明，神经元中PINK1的缺失触发EG的损伤反应，而EG中PINK1的缺失又进一步干扰神经元功能。囊泡运输成分可能调节EG中细胞器之间的膜相互作用，似乎在维持神经元健康和最终防止多巴胺能突触丧失中发挥重要作用。我们的工作强调了胶质支持细胞在PD发病机制中的重要角色，并识别了这些细胞内的囊泡运输在疾病进展中的作用。
items.title_zh: 帕金森病相关PINK1缺失影响包裹胶质细胞并导致多巴胺神经元突触丧失
items.summary_zh: 帕金森病（PD）通常与黑质多巴胺神经元的丧失相关，但在神经元丧失之前，许多其他细胞类型也受到影响。近期研究将少突胶质细胞与PD早期阶段联系起来，但其确切作用尚不清楚。我们通过对果蝇Pink1模型进行无偏单细胞测序，观察到包裹胶质细胞（EG）中显著的基因失调。研究发现，PINK1缺失导致EG异常，类似于神经损伤时EG的反应。通过细胞类型特异性转录组学，我们识别出EG中失调的基因作为潜在功能修饰因子。特异性下调EG中的两个转运因子Vps35和Vps13，足以恢复神经元功能并保护多巴胺突触不丧失。我们的研究表明，神经元中PINK1缺失触发EG的损伤反应，而EG中PINK1缺失又进一步破坏神经元功能。

items.title: Five-layer systems analysis of Leishmania stage differentiation reveals an essential role for protein degradation in parasite development
items.abstract: Vector-borne, protist parasites have evolved complex developmental programs to adapt to very distinct host environments. How these important pathogens transition between insect and mammalian stages is only poorly understood. Here, we investigated stage differentiation in Leishmania donovani , a trypanosomatid parasite with constitutive gene transcription, offering a model to study post-transcriptional regulation. Using a five-layer integrative systems analysis (genome to metabolome), we compared hamster-derived amastigotes and culture-derived promastigotes. Genomic adaptation was excluded as a major driver of differentiation, while differential mRNA turnover emerged as a key mechanism of stage-specific gene expression. Transcriptomic and proteomic comparisons revealed a broad dynamic range of protein abundance changes that correlated poorly with mRNA levels. This discrepancy was linked to (i) altered snoRNA expression and rRNA modifications, indicating stage-specific tuning of translation, and (ii) differential protein degradation, supported by proteomics following proteasome inhibition with lactacystin. Lactacystin impaired amastigote-to-promastigote differentiation, highlighting the importance of proteasomal activity. Overall, our analysis links Leishmania development to coordinated post-transcriptional regulatory networks. Our findings provide a powerful new resource for research programs that aim to dissect the emergent properties of regulatory networks and feedback loops underlying Leishmania stage differentiation, serving as a blueprint for other vector-borne pathogens that rely on disease-associated developmental transitions.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，Leishmania寄生虫的阶段分化依赖于蛋白质降解和转录后调控机制，而非基因组适应，揭示了其复杂的发育调控网络。
items.l2_summary: 本研究聚焦于利什曼原虫（Leishmania donovani）的阶段分化，探讨了寄生虫在不同宿主环境中适应的复杂发育程序。尽管这些重要病原体在昆虫和哺乳动物阶段之间的转变尚不完全清楚，研究通过五层系统分析（从基因组到代谢组）对来自仓鼠的阿米巴虫（amastigotes）和培养获得的鞭毛虫（promastigotes）进行了比较。研究排除了基因组适应作为分化的主要驱动因素，而发现差异化的mRNA降解是阶段特异性基因表达的关键机制。转录组学和蛋白质组学的比较显示，蛋白质丰度变化的动态范围广泛，但与mRNA水平的相关性较差。这一差异与两方面有关：一是改变的小核RNA（snoRNA）表达和rRNA修饰，表明翻译的阶段特异性调节；二是差异化的蛋白质降解，后者通过在蛋白酶体抑制剂乳酸霉素（lactacystin）处理后的蛋白质组学分析得到了支持。乳酸霉素抑制了阿米巴虫向鞭毛虫的分化，突显了蛋白酶体活性的重要性。总体而言，本分析将利什曼原虫的发育与协调的后转录调控网络联系起来，研究结果为解析调控网络及其反馈环路提供了强大的新资源，尤其是在理解利什曼原虫阶段分化的过程中。这一发现也为其他依赖于与疾病相关的发育转变的媒介传播病原体的研究提供了蓝图。
items.title_zh: 五层系统分析利什曼原虫阶段分化中蛋白降解的重要性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了利什曼原虫（Leishmania donovani）的阶段分化，重点分析了其在不同宿主环境中的适应机制。采用五层整合系统分析方法（从基因组到代谢组），比较了来自仓鼠的无鞭毛体和培养获得的鞭毛体。结果表明，基因组适应并不是分化的主要驱动因素，而mRNA的差异性降解是阶段特异性基因表达的关键机制。转录组和蛋白质组比较显示，蛋白丰度变化的动态范围与mRNA水平相关性较低，这与（i）snoRNA表达和rRNA修饰的变化有关，表明翻译的阶段特异性调节，以及（ii）差异性蛋白降解有关，后者通过乳酸酯抑制蛋白酶体的蛋白质组学分析得到了支持。乳酸酯抑制了无鞭毛体向鞭毛体的分化，强调了蛋白酶体活性的关键性。总体而言，本研究将利什曼原虫的发育与协调的转录后调控网络联系起来。

items.title: Human brain-wide activation of sleep rhythms
items.abstract: During sleep, our brain undergoes highly synchronized activity, orchestrated by distinct neural rhythms. Little is known about the associated brain activation during these sleep rhythms, and even less about their functional implications. In this study, we investigated the brain-wide activation underlying human sleep rhythms by employing simultaneous electroencephalography and functional magnetic resonance imaging in 107 participants during nocturnal naps (first half of the night). We identified robust coupling between slow oscillations (SOs) and fast spindles during deep non-rapid eye movement sleep (N2/3 stages), with spindle peaks consistently occurring just before the SO UP-state. This SO-spindle coupling was linked to elevated activation in both the thalamus and hippocampus, alongside increased functional connectivity from the hippocampus to the thalamus and from the thalamus to the medial prefrontal cortex. An open-ended cognitive state decoding analysis suggested that these activations may relate to episodic memory processes, yet were distinct from task-related networks. Together, these findings highlight the thalamus as a key coordinator of hippocampal–cortical communication during sleep and provide new insights into the mechanisms by which synchronized sleep rhythms may support memory consolidation.
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，睡眠中的慢振荡与快纺锤波的耦合促进了丘脑与海马之间的沟通，可能在记忆巩固中发挥重要作用。
items.l2_summary: 在睡眠过程中，人脑会经历高度同步的活动，这种活动由不同的神经节律所协调。然而，关于这些睡眠节律相关的脑部激活及其功能意义的研究仍然较为有限。本研究通过对107名参与者进行同时的脑电图（EEG）和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）监测，探讨了人类睡眠节律下的全脑激活情况，特别是在夜间小睡的前半段。研究发现，在深度非快速眼动睡眠（N2/3阶段）中，慢振荡（slow oscillations, SOs）与快速纺锤波（fast spindles）之间存在显著的耦合关系，快速纺锤波的峰值通常出现在慢振荡的上升状态之前。这种SO与纺锤波的耦合与丘脑（thalamus）和海马（hippocampus）的激活水平升高相关，同时也观察到海马到丘脑以及丘脑到内侧前额叶皮层（medial prefrontal cortex）的功能连接增强。通过开放式认知状态解码分析，研究表明这些激活可能与情节记忆过程相关，但与任务相关网络存在明显区别。这些发现强调了丘脑在睡眠期间作为海马-皮层通信的关键协调者的角色，并为同步睡眠节律如何支持记忆巩固的机制提供了新的见解。
items.title_zh: 人脑广泛激活睡眠节律的研究
items.summary_zh: 在睡眠期间，我们的大脑经历高度同步的活动，由不同的神经节律协调。关于这些睡眠节律相关的大脑激活及其功能意义知之甚少。本研究通过对107名参与者进行同时的脑电图和功能性磁共振成像，调查了人类睡眠节律下的大脑广泛激活。我们发现，在深度非快速眼动睡眠（N2/3阶段）中，慢振荡（SOs）与快速纺锤波之间存在强耦合，纺锤波峰值始终出现在SOs的上升状态之前。这种SO-纺锤波耦合与丘脑和海马体的激活增强相关，同时海马体与丘脑、丘脑与内侧前额叶皮层之间的功能连接也有所增加。开放式认知状态解码分析表明，这些激活可能与情节记忆过程相关，但与任务相关网络不同。这些发现强调丘脑在睡眠期间海马-皮层通信中的关键协调作用，并为同步睡眠节律如何支持记忆巩固提供了新见解。

items.title: Aging-associated increase of GATA4 levels in articular cartilage is linked to impaired regenerative capacity of chondrocytes and osteoarthritis
items.abstract: Although the causal association between aging and osteoarthritis (OA) has been documented, our understanding of the underlying mechanism remains incomplete. To define the regulatory molecules governing chondrocyte aging, we performed transcriptomic analysis of young and old human chondrocytes from healthy donors. The data predicted that GATA-binding protein 4 (GATA4) may play a key role in mediating the difference between young and old chondrocytes. Results from immunostaining and western blot showed significantly higher GATA4 levels in old human or mouse chondrocytes when compared to young cells. Moreover, overexpressing GATA4 in young chondrocytes remarkably reduced their cartilage-forming capacity in vitro and induced the upregulation of proinflammatory cytokines. Conversely, suppressing GATA4 expression in old chondrocytes, through either siRNA or a small-molecule inhibitor NSC140905, increased the production of aggrecan and collagen type II, and also decreased levels of matrix-degrading enzymes. In OA mice induced by surgical destabilization of the medial meniscus, intra-articular injection of lentiviral vectors carrying mouse Gata4 resulted in a higher OA severity, synovial inflammation, and pain level when compared to control vectors. Mechanistically, we found that overexpressing GATA4 significantly increased the phosphorylation of SMAD1/5. Our work demonstrates that the aging-associated increase of GATA4 in chondrocytes plays a vital role in OA progression, which may also serve as a target to reduce OA in the older population.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，随着年龄增长，软骨细胞中GATA4水平升高与再生能力受损及骨关节炎进展密切相关，抑制GATA4可能有助于改善老年患者的骨关节炎。
items.l2_summary:
随着年龄的增长，关节软骨中的GATA结合蛋白4（GATA4）水平显著增加，这与软骨细胞（chondrocytes）再生能力的下降及骨关节炎（osteoarthritis, OA）的进展密切相关。尽管年龄与OA之间的因果关系已被证实，但其具体机制仍不够清晰。为了解决这一问题，研究团队对来自健康供体的年轻和老年人软骨细胞进行了转录组分析，结果显示GATA4可能在年轻与老年软骨细胞之间的差异中发挥关键作用。

通过免疫染色和西方印迹法（western blot）检测，研究发现老年人和小鼠的软骨细胞中GATA4水平显著高于年轻细胞。此外，在年轻软骨细胞中过表达GATA4会显著降低其在体外的软骨形成能力，并诱导促炎细胞因子的上调。相反，通过小干扰RNA（siRNA）或小分子抑制剂NSC140905抑制老年软骨细胞中的GATA4表达，能够增加聚集蛋白（aggrecan）和II型胶原蛋白的产生，同时降低基质降解酶的水平。

在通过手术不稳定内侧半月板诱导的OA小鼠模型中，注射携带小鼠Gata4的慢病毒载体后，OA的严重程度、滑膜炎症和疼痛水平均显著高于对照组。这表明GATA4的过表达显著增加了SMAD1/5的磷酸化水平。综上所述，研究表明，随着年龄增长，软骨细胞中GATA4水平的增加在OA的进展中起着重要作用，这一发现可能为减少老年人OA提供了新的治疗靶点。
items.title_zh: 衰老相关GATA4水平升高与软骨细胞再生能力受损及骨关节炎关联
items.summary_zh: 尽管衰老与骨关节炎（OA）之间的因果关系已被证实，但其机制尚不完全清楚。我们对来自健康供体的年轻和老年人软骨细胞进行了转录组分析，发现GATA结合蛋白4（GATA4）可能在年轻与老年软骨细胞之间的差异中发挥关键作用。免疫染色和西方印迹结果显示，老年人或小鼠软骨细胞中的GATA4水平显著高于年轻细胞。过表达GATA4显著降低了年轻软骨细胞的软骨形成能力，并诱导促炎细胞因子的上调。相反，通过siRNA或小分子抑制剂NSC140905抑制老年软骨细胞中的GATA4表达，增加了聚集蛋白和II型胶原的产生，并降低了基质降解酶的水平。在通过手术不稳定内侧半月板诱导的OA小鼠中，注射携带小鼠Gata4的慢病毒载体导致OA严重程度、滑膜炎症和疼痛水平显著增加。我们的研究表明，GATA4的过表达显著增加了SMAD1/5的磷酸化。

items.title: Divergent C. elegans toxin alleles are suppressed by distinct mechanisms
items.abstract: Toxin-antidote elements (TAs) are selfish DNA sequences that bias their transmission to the next generation. TAs typically consist of two linked genes: a toxin and an antidote. The toxin kills progeny that do not inherit the TA, while the antidote counteracts the toxin in progeny that inherit the TA. We previously discovered two TAs in Caenorhabditis elegans that follow the canonical TA model of two linked genes: peel-1/zeel-1 and sup-35/pha-1 . Here, we report a new TA that exists in three distinct states across the C. elegans population. The canonical TA, which is found in isolates from the Hawaiian Islands, consists of two genes that encode a maternally deposited toxin (TMRL-1) and a zygotically expressed antidote (AMRL-1). The toxin induces larval lethality in embryos that do not inherit the antidote gene. A second version of the TA has lost the toxin gene but retains a partially functional antidote. Most C. elegans isolates, including the standard laboratory strain N2, carry a highly divergent allele of the toxin that has retained its activity, but have lost the antidote through pseudogenization. Multiple lines of evidence suggest that the N2 tmrl-1 allele is likely recognized by piRNAs, leading to MUT-16-dependent 22G small interfering RNA (siRNA) production and post-transcriptional silencing of the transcript. The N2 haplotype represents the first naturally occurring unlinked toxin-antidote system where the toxin is post-transcriptionally suppressed by endogenous small RNA pathways.
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，秀丽隐杆线虫中存在一种新型毒素-解毒系统，其毒素通过内源性小RNA途径实现转录后抑制，揭示了毒素与解毒机制的多样性。
items.l2_summary:
在研究自私DNA序列的毒素-解毒元素（Toxin-antidote elements, TAs）时，科学家们发现这些元素通过偏向其传递至下一代来影响遗传。TAs通常由两个相连的基因组成：一个毒素基因和一个解毒基因。毒素会杀死未继承TA的后代，而解毒基因则能在继承TA的后代中抵消毒素的影响。此前的研究已发现秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）中存在两个符合经典TA模型的例子：peel-1/zeel-1和sup-35/pha-1。最新的研究报告揭示了一个新的TA，其在C. elegans种群中存在三种不同的状态。

在夏威夷群岛的分离株中，经典的TA由两个基因组成，分别编码一种母体沉积的毒素（TMRL-1）和一种在合子中表达的解毒剂（AMRL-1）。该毒素会导致未继承解毒基因的胚胎出现幼虫致死现象。第二种版本的TA则失去了毒素基因，但保留了部分功能的解毒基因。大多数C. elegans分离株，包括标准实验室株N2，携带一种高度分化的毒素等位基因，该等位基因保留了其活性，但通过假基因化失去了解毒基因。

多项证据表明，N2株的tmrl-1等位基因可能被小干扰RNA（siRNA）识别，进而导致依赖MUT-16的22G小干扰RNA的产生，并对该转录本进行转录后沉默。这一发现表明，N2单倍型代表了首个自然发生的非连锁毒素-解毒系统，其中毒素通过内源性小RNA途径实现转录后抑制。这项研究为理解毒素-解毒系统的演化及其在自然选择中的作用提供了新的视角。
items.title_zh: 不同的秀丽隐杆线虫毒素等位基因通过不同机制被抑制
items.summary_zh: 毒素-解毒元素（TAs）是自私的DNA序列，偏向于传递给下一代。TAs通常由两个相连的基因组成：毒素和解毒剂。毒素会杀死未继承TA的后代，而解毒剂则对继承TA的后代中的毒素起到对抗作用。我们之前在秀丽隐杆线虫中发现了两个符合经典TA模型的TAs：peel-1/zeel-1和sup-35/pha-1。本文报告了一种在秀丽隐杆线虫种群中存在的新的TA，其具有三种不同状态。经典TA在夏威夷岛的分离株中发现，包含编码母体沉积毒素（TMRL-1）和合子表达解毒剂（AMRL-1）的两个基因。毒素会导致未继承解毒剂基因的胚胎出现幼虫致死。第二种TA版本失去了毒素基因，但保留了部分功能的解毒剂。大多数秀丽隐杆线虫分离株，包括标准实验室株N2，携带一种高度分化的毒素等位基因，保留了其活性，但通过假基因化失去了解毒剂。多项证据表明，N2 tmrl-1等位基因可能被piRNAs识别，导致依赖MUT-16的22G小干扰RNA（siRNA）产生及转录后沉默。N2单倍型代表了首个自然发生的未被抑制的毒素等位基因。

items.title: A dual role for PGLYRP1 in host defense and immune regulation during B. pertussis infection
items.abstract: Bordetella pertussis , the etiologic agent of whooping cough, remains a serious public health concern despite widespread vaccination. Improved therapeutics and vaccines are urgently needed. Host recognition of bacterial peptidoglycan (PGN), including B. pertussis extracellular PGN fragment tracheal cytotoxin (TCT) shapes the immune response to infection. Peptidoglycan recognition proteins (PGLYRPs) are a conserved innate immune family that bind bacterial PGN and are primarily known for bactericidal activity in mammals; however, their immune modulatory roles are beginning to gain appreciation. The role of PGLYRPs in mammalian host defenses to Gram-negative pathogens, such as B. pertussis , remains largely unknown. Here, using knockout mice, single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, and functional assays, we identify a dual role for PGLYRP1 in modulating host immune responses to B. pertussis . PGLYRP1 contributes to antibacterial responses and paradoxically dampens inflammatory responses and inhibits bacterial killing later in infection. Mechanistically, PGLYRP1 enhances NOD1 signaling in response to TCT while suppressing NOD2− and triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells-1 (TREM-1)-mediated inflammatory pathways. TCT-bound PGLYRP1 selectively impairs TREM-1 activation compared to PGNs from other bacteria. These findings demonstrate that B. pertussis co-opts PGLYRP1 to alter immune signaling, revealing a novel immune evasion mechanism with implications for vaccine design and host-directed therapeutics.
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，PGLYRP1在百日咳感染中具有双重作用，既促进抗菌反应，又抑制炎症反应，揭示了其在免疫调节中的重要性及潜在的疫苗设计影响。
items.l2_summary:
百日咳的病原体百日咳杆菌（Bordetella pertussis）尽管已有广泛的疫苗接种，但仍然是一个严重的公共卫生问题，因此亟需改进治疗方法和疫苗。宿主对细菌肽聚糖（peptidoglycan, PGN）的识别，尤其是百日咳杆菌的细胞外PGN片段气管细胞毒素（tracheal cytotoxin, TCT），在感染过程中塑造了免疫反应。肽聚糖识别蛋白（peptidoglycan recognition proteins, PGLYRPs）是一类保守的先天免疫家族，能够结合细菌PGN，主要以其杀菌活性而闻名，但其免疫调节作用也逐渐受到重视。PGLYRPs在哺乳动物对革兰氏阴性病原体（如百日咳杆菌）的防御中的作用尚不清楚。

本研究通过使用基因敲除小鼠、单细胞和整体转录组学以及功能实验，揭示了PGLYRP1在调节宿主对百日咳杆菌的免疫反应中的双重角色。PGLYRP1不仅有助于抗菌反应，反而在感染后期抑制炎症反应并降低细菌杀灭能力。机制上，PGLYRP1在对TCT的反应中增强了NOD1信号通路，而抑制了NOD2和髓系细胞表达的受体-1（TREM-1）介导的炎症通路。与其他细菌的PGN相比，结合TCT的PGLYRP1选择性地削弱了TREM-1的激活。这些发现表明，百日咳杆菌利用PGLYRP1改变免疫信号，揭示了一种新的免疫逃逸机制，对疫苗设计和宿主导向的治疗具有重要意义。
items.title_zh: PGLYRP1在百日咳感染中的双重作用研究
items.summary_zh: 百日咳的病原体百日咳杆菌（Bordetella pertussis）仍然是公共卫生的重要问题。研究发现，细菌肽聚糖（PGN）识别在感染免疫反应中起关键作用。肽聚糖识别蛋白（PGLYRPs）是一类保守的先天免疫家族，主要以杀菌活性著称，但其免疫调节作用逐渐受到重视。通过使用基因敲除小鼠、单细胞和整体转录组学及功能实验，我们发现PGLYRP1在调节宿主对百日咳杆菌的免疫反应中具有双重作用。PGLYRP1促进抗菌反应，但在感染后期却抑制炎症反应和细菌清除。机制上，PGLYRP1增强对TCT的NOD1信号传导，同时抑制NOD2和TREM-1介导的炎症通路。TCT结合的PGLYRP1选择性地损害TREM-1的激活。这些发现表明，百日咳杆菌利用PGLYRP1改变宿主免疫反应。

items.title: In vivo mapping of striatal neurodegeneration in Huntington’s disease with Soma and Neurite Density Imaging
items.abstract: Huntington’s disease (HD) is an inherited neurodegenerative disorder characterised by progressive cognitive and motor decline driven by basal ganglia (BG) atrophy. Clinical trials of novel disease-modifying therapies are ongoing, creating a need for sensitive non-invasive imaging biomarkers. Soma and Neurite Density Imaging (SANDI) is a multi-shell diffusion MRI model that estimates intracellular signal fractions from sphere-shaped soma and shows promise as a marker of neurodegeneration. The objectives of this study were to characterise HD-related microstructural abnormalities in the BG using SANDI and to examine relationships between SANDI and volumetric measurements and motor performance. T1- and diffusion-weighted images ( b -values 200–6000 s/mm²) were acquired on a 3T Siemens Connectom scanner (300 mT/m) in 56 individuals with HD and 57 age- and sex-matched controls. HD participants completed Quantitative Motor (Q-Motor) tasks, summarised using principal component analysis. SANDI estimated apparent soma and neurite density, apparent soma size, and extracellular signal fraction. Microstructural and volumetric indices were extracted from bilateral caudate, putamen, pallidum and thalamus regions, compared between groups, and correlated with Q-Motor performance. HD was associated with reduced apparent soma density and increased apparent soma size and extracellular signal fraction in the BG but not the thalami. No group differences were present for apparent neurite density. SANDI metrics correlated with Q-Motor performance and explained up to 63% of striatal atrophy in HD. SANDI indices detected HD-related striatal neurodegeneration, explained atrophy, and correlated with motor impairments, demonstrating its potential as an in vivo biomarker and surrogate clinical outcome measure for HD and other neurodegenerative diseases.
items.l1_lead: Soma和神经纤维密度成像（SANDI）能够有效检测亨廷顿病相关的纹状体神经退行性变，并与运动功能障碍相关，为该病的非侵入性生物标志物提供了潜在依据。
items.l2_summary:
亨廷顿病（Huntington’s disease, HD）是一种遗传性神经退行性疾病，其特征为基底神经节（basal ganglia, BG）萎缩引起的认知和运动能力逐渐下降。随着新型疾病修饰疗法的临床试验不断进行，对敏感的非侵入性影像学生物标志物的需求日益增加。本研究采用细胞体和神经突起密度成像（Soma and Neurite Density Imaging, SANDI）这一多壳扩散磁共振成像模型，旨在评估HD相关的微观结构异常，并探讨SANDI与体积测量及运动表现之间的关系。

研究中，研究人员在3T Siemens Connectom扫描仪上对56名HD患者和57名年龄及性别匹配的对照组进行了T1加权和扩散加权成像（b值为200–6000 s/mm²）。HD参与者完成了定量运动（Quantitative Motor, Q-Motor）任务，结果通过主成分分析进行总结。SANDI模型估算了明显的细胞体和神经突起密度、明显的细胞体大小以及细胞外信号分数。研究提取了双侧尾状核、壳核、苍白球和丘脑区域的微观结构和体积指标，并在组间进行比较，同时与Q-Motor表现进行相关性分析。

结果显示，HD患者在基底神经节中表现出明显的细胞体密度降低、细胞体大小增加和细胞外信号分数升高，而在丘脑区域则未见此类变化。尽管在明显的神经突起密度方面未发现组间差异，SANDI指标与Q-Motor表现存在相关性，并解释了HD中高达63%的基底神经节萎缩。这表明，SANDI能够有效检测与HD相关的基底神经节神经退行性变化，解释萎缩现象，并与运动障碍相关联，显示出其作为HD及其他神经退行性疾病的体内生物标志物和替代临床结局指标的潜力。
items.title_zh: 亨廷顿病中纹状体神经退行性变的体内成像研究
items.summary_zh: 亨廷顿病（HD）是一种遗传性神经退行性疾病，表现为基底神经节萎缩引起的认知和运动能力逐渐下降。本研究旨在利用体细胞和神经突起密度成像（SANDI）技术，表征HD相关的微结构异常，并探讨SANDI与体积测量及运动表现之间的关系。研究对象为56名HD患者和57名年龄及性别匹配的对照者，采用3T Siemens Connectom扫描仪获取T1加权和扩散加权图像（b值200–6000 s/mm²）。HD参与者完成定量运动（Q-Motor）任务，结果通过主成分分析进行总结。SANDI估计了表观体细胞和神经突起密度、表观体细胞大小及细胞外信号分数。结果显示，HD患者的表观体细胞密度降低，表观体细胞大小和细胞外信号分数增加。

items.title: Spine nanostructure profiling of cultured neurons from mouse models reveals a schizophrenia-linked role for Ecrg4
items.abstract: Dendritic spine dysfunction may contribute to the etiology and symptom expression of neuropsychiatric disorders. The intimate relationship between spine morphology and function suggests that decoding disease-related abnormalities from spine morphology can aid in developing synapse-targeted interventions. Here, we describe a population analysis of dendritic spine nanostructure applied to the objective grouping of multiple mouse models of neuropsychiatric disorders. This method has identified two major groups of spine phenotypes linked to schizophrenia and autism spectrum disorder (ASD). An increase in spine subpopulation with small volumes characterized the spines of schizophrenia-associated mouse models, whereas a spine subset with large volumes increased in ASD models. Schizophrenia-associated mouse models showed higher similarity in spine morphology, driven by reduced size and growth of nascent spines. The expression of Ecrg4 , a gene encoding small secretory peptides, was increased in schizophrenia-associated mouse models, and functional studies confirmed its critical involvement in impaired spine dynamics and shape. These results suggest that population-level spine analysis provides rich insights into heterogeneous spine pathology, facilitating the identification of new molecular targets related to core synaptic dysfunction.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，Ecrg4基因在与精神分裂症相关的小鼠模型中表达增加，影响树突棘的动态和形态，揭示了树突棘形态与精神疾病之间的关联，为新分子靶点的识别提供了线索。
items.l2_summary: 树突棘（dendritic spine）功能障碍可能与神经精神疾病的病因及症状表现密切相关。树突棘的形态与功能之间的密切关系表明，通过解码与疾病相关的树突棘形态异常，可以为开发针对突触的干预措施提供帮助。本研究对多种神经精神疾病小鼠模型的树突棘纳米结构进行了群体分析，识别出与精神分裂症（schizophrenia）和自闭症谱系障碍（autism spectrum disorder, ASD）相关的两大类树突棘表型。精神分裂症相关小鼠模型的树突棘中，体积较小的树突棘亚群增加，而自闭症模型则表现出体积较大的树突棘亚群增加。精神分裂症相关小鼠模型的树突棘形态高度相似，主要由新生树突棘的大小和生长减少所驱动。此外，研究发现与精神分裂症相关的小鼠模型中，Ecrg4基因（编码小型分泌肽）表达水平显著增加，功能研究证实了其在树突棘动态和形状受损中的关键作用。这些结果表明，群体水平的树突棘分析为异质性树突棘病理提供了丰富的见解，促进了与核心突触功能障碍相关的新分子靶点的识别。
items.title_zh: 小鼠模型培养神经元的脊柱纳米结构分析揭示Ecrg4与精神分裂症的关联
items.summary_zh: 树突棘功能障碍可能与神经精神疾病的病因及症状表达相关。脊柱形态与功能之间的密切关系表明，从脊柱形态解码疾病相关异常有助于开发针对突触的干预措施。本研究对多种神经精神疾病小鼠模型的树突棘纳米结构进行了群体分析，识别出与精神分裂症和自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）相关的两大脊柱表型群体。精神分裂症模型的小体积脊柱亚群增加，而ASD模型则表现出大体积脊柱亚群的增加。精神分裂症模型的脊柱形态相似性较高，主要由新生脊柱的大小和生长减少驱动。编码小分泌肽的基因Ecrg4在精神分裂症模型中表达增加，功能研究证实其在脊柱动态和形状受损中的关键作用。这些结果表明，群体水平的脊柱分析为异质脊柱病理提供了丰富的见解，有助于识别与核心突触功能障碍相关的新分子靶点。

items.title: Global relationships between body size and urban affinity across more than 30,000 plant and animal species
items.abstract: Urbanization is a major global driver of biodiversity change, with species responses to urban settings ranging from avoidance to exploitation. To better understand these responses, we conducted a global analysis of urban relative affinity inferred from occurrence data across more than 30,000 animal and plant species. Our synthesis showed a consistent pattern across taxa and biogeographic regions: many species are urban avoiders, while few thrive as urban exploiters—a pattern we coin ‘species urbanness distribution’. We then assessed whether body size, an integrative ecological trait fundamental to space use, mobility, metabolism, and environmental sensitivity, showed consistent associations with urban affinity among species and across 371 taxonomic families. Analyses were conducted at the interspecific level and focused primarily on variation among taxonomic families (with an accompanying application to view results available for each family here: https://globalecologyresearchgroup.github.io/Callaghan_et_al-2026-eLife-ShinyApp/ ). Larger body sizes were generally associated with greater urban affinity in plants compared to animals, though these size-affinity relationships showed considerable variability among families. Our findings highlight the heterogeneous relationship between body size and urban affinity across the tree of life, underscoring the importance of tailored strategies to support urban biodiversity. This research advances ecological understanding of urban filtering and provides a framework for guiding biodiversity-sensitive urban planning amid accelerating global urbanization.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，植物和动物的体型与城市亲和力之间存在复杂关系，较大体型通常与更高的城市适应性相关，强调了支持城市生物多样性的策略的重要性。
items.l2_summary: 城市化是全球生物多样性变化的重要驱动因素，不同物种对城市环境的反应各异，从回避到利用不等。为了更好地理解这些反应，我们对超过30,000种动植物的出现数据进行了全球分析，探讨了物种的城市亲和力（urban affinity）。研究结果显示，在不同的分类群和生物地理区域中，存在一种一致的模式：许多物种倾向于回避城市环境，而只有少数物种能够在城市中繁荣生长，这一现象被称为“物种城市化分布”（species urbanness distribution）。进一步分析表明，体型（body size）这一生态特征与城市亲和力之间存在一致的关联，体型在空间利用、移动性、新陈代谢和环境敏感性等方面具有重要意义。我们的分析主要集中在371个分类群之间的变异，结果显示，植物的较大体型通常与更高的城市亲和力相关，而动物的情况则相对较少，且这种体型与亲和力的关系在不同分类群之间存在显著的变异性。这一研究揭示了生物树上体型与城市亲和力之间的异质性关系，强调了制定针对性的策略以支持城市生物多样性的重要性。我们的研究不仅推动了对城市过滤（urban filtering）生态学的理解，还为在全球城市化加速背景下指导生物多样性敏感的城市规划提供了框架。
items.title_zh: 全球超过3万种植物和动物体型与城市亲和力的关系
items.summary_zh: 城市化是全球生物多样性变化的重要驱动因素，物种对城市环境的反应从回避到利用不等。为更好地理解这些反应，我们对超过3万种动物和植物的出现数据进行了全球分析，推断出城市相对亲和力。结果显示，不同类群和生物地理区域之间存在一致模式：许多物种倾向于回避城市，而少数物种则在城市中繁荣生长，这一模式被称为“物种城市化分布”。我们评估了体型这一生态特征与城市亲和力之间的一致性关联，分析了371个分类群的变异性。结果表明，植物的较大体型通常与更高的城市亲和力相关，而动物则表现出较大的变异性。这些发现强调了生命树上体型与城市亲和力之间的异质关系，突显了针对性策略的重要性。

items.title: A unifying model of T-cell signaling protein condensates in reconstitution experiments
items.abstract: The formation of condensates by the Linker for the Activation of T-cells (LAT) is a key signal gating and amplification step in the T-cell receptor signaling pathway. LAT condensation is challenging to study in-vivo and is therefore often investigated using reconstitution experiments. While these experiments recapitulate key aspects of LAT condensation, they also exhibit some puzzling features. Here, we describe the mechanisms underlying these observations using two complementary models. First, we employ a Smoluchowski aggregation model to show that the delay time before condensation is observed arises from a low effective binding probability between LAT monomers. Second, we propose a field-theoretic model that reproduces all condensate morphologies observed in experiments, showing that they can arise from common underlying dynamics modulated by variations in experimental conditions. This result unifies different experimental observations reported previously. While this article addresses open questions regarding the formation of LAT condensates, our results also provide a common framework for understanding condensation of other multivalent membrane proteins such as EGFR, FGFR2, and nephrin.
items.l1_lead: LAT凝聚体的形成是T细胞信号传导中的关键步骤，通过两种模型揭示了其凝聚机制，为理解其他多价膜蛋白的凝聚提供了统一框架。
items.l2_summary: 在T细胞受体信号通路中，T细胞激活连接蛋白（LAT）的凝聚形成是一个关键的信号门控和放大步骤。然而，LAT的凝聚在体内研究中面临挑战，因此通常通过重组实验进行探讨。尽管这些实验重现了LAT凝聚的关键特征，但也展现出一些令人困惑的现象。为了解释这些观察结果，研究者提出了两种互补模型。首先，采用Smoluchowski聚集模型，研究表明凝聚观察到的延迟时间源于LAT单体之间低有效结合概率的影响。其次，提出了一种场论模型，该模型能够再现实验中观察到的所有凝聚形态，表明这些形态可以由共同的基础动力学产生，并受到实验条件变化的调制。这一结果统一了之前报告的不同实验观察。虽然本文解决了关于LAT凝聚形成的未解之谜，但研究结果也为理解其他多价膜蛋白（如表皮生长因子受体EGFR、成纤维生长因子受体FGFR2和肾小管蛋白nephrin）的凝聚提供了共同框架。通过这些模型的应用，研究者不仅揭示了LAT凝聚的机制，还为相关领域的研究提供了新的视角和理论基础。
items.title_zh: T细胞信号蛋白凝聚体的统一模型研究
items.summary_zh: T细胞激活连接蛋白（LAT）的凝聚体形成是T细胞受体信号通路中的关键信号门控和放大步骤。LAT凝聚体在体内研究具有挑战性，因此通常通过重组实验进行研究。尽管这些实验重现了LAT凝聚体的关键特征，但也表现出一些令人困惑的现象。本文使用两种互补模型描述这些观察背后的机制。首先，采用Smoluchowski聚集模型表明，观察到凝聚体形成的延迟时间源于LAT单体之间的有效结合概率较低。其次，提出了一个场论模型，能够重现实验中观察到的所有凝聚体形态，表明这些形态可以由共同的基础动力学产生，并受到实验条件变化的调节。该结果统一了之前报告的不同实验观察。本文不仅解决了关于LAT凝聚体形成的开放性问题，还为理解其他多价膜蛋白（如EGFR、FGFR2和nephrin）的凝聚提供了共同框架。

items.title: A novel prognostic score based on carbohydrate antigen 125, alpha-fetoprotein and carcinoembryonic antigen for Predicting postoperative prognosis in endometrial cancer: Results from a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract: Background: Endometrial cancer (EC) is a common gynecological malignancy with increasing incidence. While several serum biomarkers have been studied for EC, their combined prognostic value remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic significance of preoperative serum CA125, CA19-9, CA72-4, CEA, and AFP levels in EC patients and develop a risk score for predicting survival outcomes.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，结合CA125、AFP和CEA的预后评分可有效预测子宫内膜癌患者的术后生存结果。
items.l2_summary:
子宫内膜癌（Endometrial Cancer, EC）是一种常见的妇科恶性肿瘤，其发病率逐年上升。尽管已有多项研究探讨了与子宫内膜癌相关的血清生物标志物，但它们的联合预后价值尚不明确。本研究旨在评估术前血清中糖类抗原125（CA125）、糖类抗原19-9（CA19-9）、糖类抗原72-4（CA72-4）、癌胚抗原（CEA）和甲胎蛋白（AFP）水平在子宫内膜癌患者中的预后意义，并开发一种风险评分系统以预测生存结果。

研究通过回顾性队列分析，收集了子宫内膜癌患者的相关数据，重点关注上述五种生物标志物的水平与患者术后预后的关系。研究结果显示，CA125、CEA和AFP的水平与患者的生存率呈显著相关性，提示这些标志物在评估患者预后方面具有潜在的临床价值。具体而言，CA125的升高与较差的生存预后相关，而CEA和AFP的水平同样能够为患者的预后提供重要信息。

通过对这些生物标志物的综合分析，研究团队提出了一种新的预后评分系统，该系统能够更准确地预测子宫内膜癌患者的术后生存情况。这一评分系统的建立，不仅为临床医生提供了一个有效的工具，以便在术前对患者进行风险评估，还可能为后续的治疗决策提供依据。

总的来说，本研究强调了CA125、CEA和AFP在子宫内膜癌预后评估中的重要性，提出的风险评分系统为临床实践提供了新的视角，未来有望改善患者的个体化治疗策略及生存预后。
items.title_zh: 基于CA125、AFP和CEA的新预后评分用于预测子宫内膜癌术后预后
items.summary_zh: 背景：子宫内膜癌（EC）是一种常见的妇科恶性肿瘤，发病率逐渐上升。尽管已有多项研究探讨了EC的血清生物标志物，但其联合预后价值尚不明确。本研究旨在评估EC患者术前血清CA125、CA19-9、CA72-4、CEA和AFP水平的预后意义，并开发一种风险评分以预测生存结果。

items.title: Translational reading frame predicts the pathogenicity of C-terminal frameshift deletions in MeCP2
items.abstract: Mutations in the MECP2 gene cause the severe neurological disorder Rett syndrome. A cluster of frameshift-causing C-terminal deletions (CTDs) removes ~100 amino acids and accounts for approximately 10% of RTT-causing mutations. Their pathogenicity is unexpected because this C-terminal domain is dispensable in mice. Analysis of pathogenic and benign human MECP2 variants reveals that some individuals with apparently typical CTDs do not develop Rett syndrome, confirming that C-terminal truncations are not intrinsically pathogenic. Using human sequence data and mouse models we show that pathogenicity results from a marked reduction in MeCP2 levels and depends on the presence of a proline proline stop motif (-PPX) generated by a shift to the +2 reading frame. CTDs that shift to the +1 frame avoid this motif and are benign. Replacing the stop codon of the PPX motif with tryptophan restores MeCP2 expression and rescues RTT-like phenotypes in a CTD mouse model. An adenine base editor efficiently introduces this substitution in cultured cells. These findings define a reliable prognostic distinction between benign and pathogenic CTDs and establish a potential editing strategy for correcting disease-causing CTD mutations.
items.l1_lead: C端框移缺失突变的致病性与MeCP2水平显著降低有关，且依赖于+2阅读框生成的特定停止密码子，提供了良性与致病性突变的可靠区分标准。
items.l2_summary: MECP2基因的突变导致严重的神经系统疾病——雷特综合征（Rett syndrome）。其中，一类导致框移突变的C端缺失（C-terminal deletions, CTDs）突变去除了约100个氨基酸，约占雷特综合征相关突变的10%。这些突变的致病性令人意外，因为在小鼠模型中，C端区域并非必需。对致病性和良性人类MECP2变异的分析显示，一些具有典型CTDs的个体并未发展为雷特综合征，证实C端截断并非内在致病。通过对人类序列数据和小鼠模型的研究，我们发现致病性源于MeCP2水平的显著降低，并依赖于由+2阅读框移位产生的脯氨酸-脯氨酸-终止密码子（-PPX）结构。那些转移到+1阅读框的CTDs则避免了这一结构，因此被认为是良性的。将PPX结构中的终止密码子替换为色氨酸可以恢复MeCP2的表达，并在CTD小鼠模型中挽救雷特综合征样表型。此外，一种腺苷酸碱基编辑器能够有效地在培养细胞中引入这一替换。这些发现为良性和致病性CTDs之间提供了可靠的预后区分，并建立了一种潜在的编辑策略，以纠正导致疾病的CTD突变。
items.title_zh: 翻译阅读框预测MeCP2 C端框移位缺失的致病性
items.summary_zh: MECP2基因的突变导致严重的神经疾病——雷特综合症。C端缺失（CTDs）导致框移位，去除约100个氨基酸，占雷特综合症突变的约10%。其致病性令人意外，因为在小鼠中该C端区域并非必需。对致病和良性人类MECP2变异的分析显示，某些具有典型CTDs的个体并未发展为雷特综合症，证实C端截断并非内在致病。利用人类序列数据和小鼠模型，我们发现致病性源于MeCP2水平显著降低，并依赖于通过转移到+2阅读框生成的脯氨酸-脯氨酸终止基序（-PPX）。转移到+1框的CTDs避免了该基序，表现为良性。用色氨酸替换PPX基序的终止密码子可恢复MeCP2表达，并在CTD小鼠模型中挽救雷特综合症样表型。腺苷酸碱基编辑器在培养细胞中有效引入此替换。这些发现为良性和致病CTDs之间提供了可靠的预后区分，并建立了纠正致病CTD突变的潜在编辑策略。

items.title: A tool to pulse-label yeast nuclear pore complexes in imaging and biochemical experiments
items.abstract: Nuclear pore complexes (NPCs) are key gateways to the nucleus and major organizers of genome architecture. Despite their importance, it is still not fully understood how NPCs are formed and degraded. Tools to track specific NPCs over time or under stress could unlock critical insights into these questions. Here, we demonstrate that a brief pulse of expression of a previously developed nanobody against baker’s yeast nucleoporin Nup84 (Nordeen et al., 2020) enables a robust, rapid, and straightforward method for pulse-labeling NPCs in both imaging and affinity purification experiments. This approach offers an alternative to permanent, yet less rapid, genetic fluorophore- or tag-switching techniques, and provides a powerful tool for studying NPC inheritance and turnover through both microscopy and biochemical methods.
items.l1_lead: 研究人员开发了一种新方法，通过短暂表达针对酵母核孔蛋白Nup84的纳米抗体，实现对核孔复合物的快速脉冲标记，为研究其形成和降解提供了有效工具。
items.l2_summary:
核孔复合体（Nuclear pore complexes, NPCs）是细胞核的重要通道，同时也是基因组结构的主要组织者。尽管NPC在细胞生物学中扮演着关键角色，但其形成和降解的机制仍未完全阐明。为了深入研究这些问题，能够追踪特定NPC在时间变化或应激状态下的工具显得尤为重要。本文展示了一种新方法，通过短暂表达先前开发的针对酵母菌核孔蛋白Nup84的纳米抗体（nanobody），实现了对NPC的脉冲标记。这种方法不仅快速、简便，而且在成像和亲和纯化实验中表现出色。

与传统的永久性标记方法（如基因荧光蛋白或标签切换技术）相比，这种脉冲标记技术具有更高的灵活性和效率。研究表明，短暂的纳米抗体表达能够有效地标记NPC，使得研究者可以在显微镜下观察NPC的继承和周转过程。此外，该方法在生化实验中也展现出强大的应用潜力，为研究NPC的动态变化提供了新的视角。

总之，这项研究为核孔复合体的研究提供了一种创新的工具，能够帮助科学家们更好地理解NPC的生物学功能及其在细胞内的动态行为。这一进展不仅丰富了我们对细胞核结构的认识，也为未来相关领域的研究奠定了基础。
items.title_zh: 一种用于脉冲标记酵母核孔复合物的工具
items.summary_zh: 核孔复合物（NPCs）是通往细胞核的关键通道，也是基因组结构的重要组织者。尽管其重要性显著，但NPC的形成和降解机制仍未完全理解。本文展示了一种新方法，通过短暂表达针对酵母核孔蛋白Nup84的纳米抗体（Nordeen等，2020），实现了在成像和亲和纯化实验中对NPC的有效脉冲标记。这种方法为研究NPC的遗传和周转提供了强有力的工具，作为一种替代传统的永久性基因荧光标记或标签切换技术，具有更快的标记速度。

items.title: Evaluating the applicability of replication success metrics in animal-to-human translation: A simulation study
items.abstract: Translation failure, in which promising animal study results cannot be reproduced in human trials, is a challenge in biomedical research. Metrics for replication success are widely used to evaluate reproducibility, that is the extent to which the results of a study agree with those of replication studies. The relevance of these metrics in assessing animal-to-human translation success (or failure) is unclear. We conducted a simulation study to examine whether these metrics can quantify translation success, and how their performance varies under different conditions. Using parameters from a meta-analysis on prenatal amino acid supplementation and maternal blood pressure, we simulated animal and human studies under 648 scenarios, varying effect sizes, heterogeneity, animal sample sizes, and number of pooled animal studies. Nine metrics were assessed, namely the two-trials rule, meta-analysis, replication Bayes factor, unweighted and weighted Edgington’s methods, golden skeptical p-value, and three versions of controlled skeptical p-value. Most metrics, except meta-analysis and replication Bayes factor, controlled false positive rates under no heterogeneity, but became liberal as heterogeneity increased, particularly between human studies. Translation power (i.e. the probability of true positive translation success) was constrained by the weaker evidence of the two findings; for example, small sample size in the animal studies resulted in lower translation power. The metric based on meta-analysis frequently indicated success when either of the species found strong evidence, while skeptical p-values were more conservative. The skeptical p-value that controls overall type-one error and the weighted version of Edgington’s method performed relatively consistently across scenarios. However, no metric was uniformly optimal. Metrics developed for replication studies can inform assessments of translation, but their utility depends on the underlying evidence and assumptions. Using multiple metrics in combination, with attention to their strengths and limitations, is recommended for evaluating the translation of animal findings to human outcomes.
items.l1_lead: 动物研究结果在人体试验中的可重复性评估存在挑战，使用多种复制成功指标结合其优缺点，有助于更准确地评估动物到人类的转化成功率。
items.l2_summary:
在生物医学研究中，动物研究结果在人体试验中无法重现的现象被称为翻译失败，这一挑战引发了对翻译成功度量标准的关注。尽管复制成功的度量标准被广泛应用于评估研究结果的可重复性，但这些标准在评估动物到人类的翻译成功（或失败）方面的相关性尚不明确。为此，研究团队开展了一项模拟研究，旨在探讨这些度量标准是否能够量化翻译成功，并分析其在不同条件下的表现。

研究使用了来自一项关于产前氨基酸补充与母体血压的荟萃分析的参数，模拟了648种情境下的动物和人类研究，变量包括效应大小、异质性、动物样本量以及合并动物研究的数量。评估了九种度量标准，包括两次试验规则、荟萃分析、复制贝叶斯因子、未加权和加权的Edgington方法、黄金怀疑p值以及三种版本的控制怀疑p值。结果显示，除了荟萃分析和复制贝叶斯因子外，大多数度量标准在无异质性情况下能够控制假阳性率，但随着异质性的增加，特别是在人体研究之间，假阳性率变得更加宽松。

翻译能力（即真实正向翻译成功的概率）受到两项发现证据较弱的限制，例如，动物研究中的小样本量导致翻译能力降低。基于荟萃分析的度量标准在任一物种发现强证据时，常常指示成功，而怀疑p值则表现得更为保守。控制整体第一类错误的怀疑p值和加权版本的Edgington方法在不同情境下表现相对一致。然而，没有一种度量标准在所有情况下都是最佳的。研究表明，虽然为复制研究开发的度量标准可以为翻译评估提供信息，但其效用依赖于基础证据和假设。因此，建议结合多种度量标准，关注其优缺点，以更全面地评估动物研究结果向人类结果的翻译。
items.title_zh: 评估复制成功指标在动物到人类转化中的适用性：模拟研究
items.summary_zh: 转化失败是生物医学研究中的一大挑战，即有前景的动物研究结果无法在人体试验中重现。本研究旨在评估复制成功指标在动物到人类转化成功（或失败）评估中的相关性。我们进行了模拟研究，考察这些指标是否能量化转化成功，以及在不同条件下的表现。使用来自一项关于产前氨基酸补充与母体血压的荟萃分析的参数，我们在648种情境下模拟了动物和人类研究，变化因素包括效应大小、异质性、动物样本量和合并动物研究的数量。评估了九种指标，包括双试验规则、荟萃分析、复制贝叶斯因子、无权重和加权的Edgington方法、黄金怀疑p值及三种版本的控制怀疑p值。大多数指标在无异质性下控制了假阳性率，但随着异质性的增加变得宽松，尤其是在人体研究之间。转化能力（即真实阳性转化成功的概率）受到两项发现证据较弱的限制。

items.title: Mood computational mechanisms underlying increased risk behavior in adolescent suicidal patients
items.abstract: Suicidal thoughts and behaviors (STB) are among the leading causes of death worldwide. Although previous research has consistently documented elevated risk-taking in individuals with STB and identified mood disturbances as central features of suicidality, the precise cognitive and affective computational mechanisms underlying this increased risky behavior remain poorly understood. Here, 83 adolescent inpatients with affective disorders—including 58 patients with STB (S + ) and 25 without STB (S − )—and 118 age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HC) completed a decision-making task involving choices between certain and gamble options, alongside momentary mood ratings. Behavioral analyses showed that S + exhibited greater risk-taking than both S − and HC. Computational modeling of choice behavior using a prospect-theory framework augmented with value-insensitive approach–avoidance parameters indicated that this increase in risky behavior was specifically driven by an elevated approach parameter in S + . In addition, mood-model analyses revealed reduced sensitivity to certain rewards in S + relative to S − and HC. Importantly, these computational signatures predicted suicidal symptom severity and showed generalizability in an independent general-population sample ( n = 747). In S + , lower mood sensitivity to certain rewards was associated with greater gambling, providing a computational affective account of increased risk-taking in STB. These findings remained robust after adjusting for demographic, clinical, and medication-related variables. Overall, our study identifies cognitive and affective computational mechanisms contributing to elevated risk-taking in STB and highlights their potential relevance for the early identification and prevention of suicidality.
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，青少年自杀患者在决策中表现出更高的风险行为，主要由于对确定奖励的敏感性降低，这为自杀倾向的早期识别和预防提供了重要线索。
items.l2_summary:
自杀念头和行为（Suicidal thoughts and behaviors, STB）是全球主要的死亡原因之一。尽管以往研究已证实STB患者的风险行为显著增加，并且情绪障碍被认为是自杀倾向的核心特征，但导致这种风险行为增加的具体认知和情感计算机制仍不甚明了。本研究对83名患有情感障碍的青少年住院患者进行了分析，其中58名患者存在STB（S +），25名患者没有STB（S −），并与118名年龄和性别匹配的健康对照组（HC）进行了比较。行为分析显示，S +组的风险行为显著高于S −组和HC组。

通过前景理论（prospect theory）框架结合价值不敏感的趋近-回避参数对选择行为进行的计算建模表明，S +组的风险行为增加主要是由于其趋近参数的升高。此外，情绪模型分析显示，S +组对确定性奖励的敏感性相较于S −组和HC组显著降低。重要的是，这些计算特征能够预测自杀症状的严重程度，并在一个独立的普通人群样本（n = 747）中具有普遍适用性。在S +组中，对确定性奖励的低敏感性与更高的赌博行为相关，这为STB患者风险行为增加提供了情感计算的解释。这些发现经过对人口统计学、临床和药物相关变量的调整后仍然保持稳健。

总体而言，本研究识别了与STB相关的认知和情感计算机制，强调了这些机制在早期识别和预防自杀倾向中的潜在重要性。
items.title_zh: 青少年自杀患者风险行为的情绪计算机制
items.summary_zh: 自杀思想和行为（STB）是全球主要死亡原因之一。本研究招募了83名患有情感障碍的青少年住院患者，其中58名患者有STB（S +），25名患者没有STB（S −），以及118名年龄和性别匹配的健康对照（HC），完成了一项涉及确定性和赌博选项的决策任务，并进行了瞬时情绪评估。行为分析显示，S + 的风险行为显著高于S − 和HC。基于前景理论框架的选择行为计算模型表明，S + 的风险行为增加主要由其增强的接近参数驱动。此外，情绪模型分析显示，S + 对确定性奖励的敏感性低于S − 和HC。重要的是，这些计算特征能够预测自杀症状的严重性，并在独立的普通人群样本中具有普遍性（n = 747）。在S + 中，对确定性奖励的低情绪敏感性与更高的赌博行为相关。

items.title: Using mathematical models to optimise mosquito net distribution
items.abstract: Tailoring malaria control interventions to regional transmission dynamics and behavioural characteristics can optimise them in resource-limited settings.
items.l1_lead: 根据地区传播动态和行为特征定制疟疾控制措施，可以在资源有限的环境中优化蚊帐分配。
items.l2_summary:
在资源有限的环境中，通过数学模型优化蚊帐分配可以有效提升疟疾控制干预措施的效果。研究表明，针对不同地区的传播动态和行为特征量身定制的干预措施，能够更好地应对疟疾的传播。具体而言，数学模型可以帮助研究人员分析和预测疟疾在特定区域的传播模式，从而制定出更为精准的蚊帐分配策略。这种方法不仅考虑了疟疾的生物学特性，还结合了人群的行为习惯，使得干预措施更具针对性和有效性。

通过对不同地区的传播数据进行分析，研究发现，某些地区的疟疾传播率较高，而其他地区则相对较低。因此，简单的统一分配蚊帐可能无法满足各地区的实际需求。相反，利用数学模型进行优化，可以根据每个地区的具体情况，合理分配资源，确保高风险区域获得更多的蚊帐，从而最大限度地减少疟疾的传播。

此外，研究还强调了数据的重要性，指出在进行模型优化时，需要依赖于准确的传播数据和人群行为数据。这些数据不仅可以帮助识别高风险区域，还能为制定有效的干预策略提供科学依据。通过这种方式，公共卫生部门能够更有效地利用有限的资源，提升疟疾防控的整体效果。

总的来说，利用数学模型优化蚊帐分配，不仅能够提高疟疾控制的效率，还能为资源有限的地区提供切实可行的解决方案。这一研究为未来的疟疾防控策略提供了新的视角和方法，强调了根据地区特征进行个性化干预的重要性。
items.title_zh: 利用数学模型优化蚊帐分配
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对疟疾控制干预措施，探讨如何根据地区传播动态和行为特征进行定制，以在资源有限的环境中实现优化。通过建立数学模型，分析不同地区的蚊虫传播模式和人群行为，提出了针对性的蚊帐分配策略。研究结果表明，合理的蚊帐分配能够显著提高疟疾防控的效果，降低感染率。这一方法为资源有限地区的公共卫生干预提供了新的思路和依据。

items.title: Functional specialization of mPFC-BLA and mPFC-NAc pathways in affective state representation
items.abstract: Effective emotional processing, crucial for adaptive behavior, is mediated by the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) via connections to the basolateral amygdala (BLA), and nucleus accumbens (NAc), traditionally considered functionally similar in modulating reward and aversion responses. However, the functional specialization of the mPFC→BLA and mPFC→NAc pathways in representing affective states remains unclear. We found that while overall firing patterns appeared consistent across emotional states, deeper analysis revealed distinct variabilities. Specifically, mPFC→BLA neurons, especially ‘center-ON’ neurons, exhibited heightened activity during behaviors classically associated with anxiety-like states, suggesting their involvement in aversive behavioral regulation. Conversely, mPFC→NAc neurons were more active during exploratory and approach-related behaviors, implicating them in the processing of positively valenced behavioral states. Notably, mPFC→NAc neurons showed significant pattern decorrelation during social interactions, suggesting a pivotal role in processing social preference. Additionally, repeated win/loss outcomes in the tube test produced distinct hierarchy-dependent behavioral changes and elevated corticosterone levels in loser mice, supporting the biological relevance of these behaviorally defined states. Together, these findings reveal pathway-specific representations of affect-related behavioral states in mPFC circuits and provide a framework for understanding how prefrontal outputs organize adaptive behavior across environmental contexts.
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，内侧前额叶皮层通过不同通路对情感状态进行特异性表征，mPFC→BLA通路与焦虑相关行为调节有关，而mPFC→NAc通路则与积极行为处理相关。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）通过与基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）和伏隔核（NAc）的连接在情感状态表征中的功能特化。尽管传统上认为这两条通路在调节奖励和厌恶反应方面功能相似，但其在情感状态表征中的具体作用仍不明确。研究发现，虽然在不同情感状态下，神经元的整体放电模式似乎一致，但深入分析显示出明显的差异性。具体而言，mPFC→BLA神经元，尤其是“中心-开启”（center-ON）神经元，在与焦虑相关的行为中表现出更高的活动水平，表明它们在厌恶行为调节中的作用。相反，mPFC→NAc神经元在探索和接近相关行为中更为活跃，暗示它们参与积极情感状态的处理。

值得注意的是，mPFC→NAc神经元在社会互动期间表现出显著的模式去相关，提示其在社会偏好处理中的关键作用。此外，在管道测试中，重复的胜负结果导致了不同的等级依赖行为变化，并且在失败的小鼠中皮质醇水平显著升高，支持了这些行为定义状态的生物学相关性。综上所述，这些发现揭示了mPFC回路中情感相关行为状态的通路特异性表征，为理解前额叶输出如何在不同环境背景下组织适应性行为提供了框架。
items.title_zh: mPFC-BLA与mPFC-NAc通路在情感状态表征中的功能特化
items.summary_zh: 有效的情感处理对适应性行为至关重要，由内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）通过与基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）和伏隔核（NAc）的连接介导。尽管这两条通路在调节奖励和厌恶反应上被认为功能相似，但mPFC→BLA和mPFC→NAc通路在情感状态表征中的功能特化尚不清楚。研究发现，尽管整体放电模式在不同情感状态下似乎一致，但深入分析揭示了明显的差异。具体而言，mPFC→BLA神经元，尤其是“中心-开启”神经元，在与焦虑状态相关的行为中表现出增强的活动，表明它们参与厌恶行为的调节。相反，mPFC→NAc神经元在探索和接近相关行为中更为活跃，暗示它们在积极情感状态的处理中的作用。此外，mPFC→NAc神经元在社交互动中表现出显著的模式去相关，表明其在社交偏好处理中的关键作用。重复的胜负结果在管道测试中产生了不同的等级依赖行为变化和输家小鼠的皮质醇水平升高，支持了这些行为定义状态的生物学相关性。

items.title: Comparison of vonoprazan and proton pump inhibitors for the management of gastric post-endoscopic submucosal dissection ulcers and preventing delayed bleeding: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.abstract: BackgroundDelayed bleeding and artificial-ulcer healing are important clinical concerns after gastric endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD). Vonoprazan rapidly suppresses gastric acid, but its efficacy relative to proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) remains uncertain.MethodsWe searched seven databases from inception to May 31, 2026. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing vonoprazan with PPIs after gastric ESD were included. Outcomes were pooled as relative risks (RRs) or mean differences (MDs), with 95% confidence intervals (CIs).ResultsEleven RCTs reported delayed-bleeding data for 1,136 participants (580 receiving vonoprazan and 556 receiving a PPI). Delayed bleeding occurred in 16/580 (2.76%) vs. 32/556 (5.76%) participants (RR = 0.51, 95% CI 0.29–0.89; P = 0.02). Nine trials contributed to the relative-effect estimate because two reported zero events in both arms; a risk-difference sensitivity analysis including all 11 trials supported the result. Ulcer healing rates did not differ at 4 weeks (RR = 0.93, 95% CI 0.65–1.33; P = 0.69) or 8 weeks (RR = 0.98, 95% CI 0.92–1.04; P = 0.49). Ulcer shrinkage rates also did not differ at 4 weeks (MD = −0.89, 95% CI −2.10 to 0.33; P = 0.15) or 8 weeks (MD = 0.45, 95% CI −0.27 to 1.16; P = 0.22). Adverse events were less frequent with vonoprazan (RR = 0.57, 95% CI 0.34–0.98; P = 0.04).ConclusionVonoprazan may reduce delayed bleeding and adverse events after gastric ESD while achieving ulcer healing and shrinkage comparable to PPIs; the bleeding estimate is based on few events and should be interpreted cautiously.Systematic Review Registrationhttps://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261424595, CRD420261424595.

items.title: A clinical study of Simotang oral liquid combined with Shenque acupoint application for abdominal distension after cesarean section
items.abstract: ObjectiveTo evaluate the preventive and therapeutic effects of Simotang oral liquid combined with Shenque acupoint application on abdominal distension after cesarean section, and assess its safety.MethodsA prospective randomized controlled trial was conducted. Parturients who underwent elective cesarean section in our hospital from June 2024 to June 2025 were enrolled and randomly divided into the intervention group (treated with Simotang oral liquid combined with Shenque acupoint application) and the control group (receiving standard nursing care), with 100 cases in each group. Compare the postoperative recovery indicators of the two groups.ResultsThe median recovery time of bowel sounds [8 (6, 10) h vs. 12 (10, 14) h], median time to first flatus [20 (17, 26) h vs. 26 (24, 29.5) h], and median time to first defecation [50 (48, 52) h vs. 55 (52, 61) h] in the intervention group were all significantly shorter than those in the control group (P < 0.001). There was no significant between-group difference in the overall incidence of abdominal distension, whereas the severity of abdominal distension was significantly lower in the intervention group, with zero severe distension cases observed in the intervention group. The rate of colostrum secretion within 60 h after surgery was 93.00% in the intervention group, which was significantly higher than 74.00% in the control group (P < 0.05).ConclusionSimotang oral liquid combined with Shenque acupoint application can effectively promote the recovery of gastrointestinal function, alleviate the severity of abdominal distension (though it cannot reduce the overall incidence of distension), and facilitate early lactation after cesarean section, and thus possesses good clinical application value.

items.title: Bimekizumab and progressive pulmonary fibrosis in severe psoriasis: a case report
items.abstract: Psoriasis is a chronic immune-mediated inflammatory disease frequently associated with systemic comorbidities, including an increased prevalence of interstitial lung diseases (ILDs). Progressive fibrosing ILDs are characterized by declining respiratory function and high morbidity, and emerging evidence suggests that type-17 immune pathways may contribute to both psoriatic inflammation and pulmonary fibrosis. Bimekizumab, a monoclonal antibody selectively targeting IL-17A and IL-17F, has demonstrated high efficacy in psoriasis, although its potential impact on fibrotic lung disease remains unclear. We report the case of a 58-year-old man with severe plaque psoriasis and concomitant desquamative interstitial pneumonia (DIP) with features of progressive pulmonary fibrosis. The patient presented with severe restrictive lung disease, reduced diffusing capacity, and exertional desaturation requiring oxygen supplementation. Previous treatments included topical therapies, acitretin, and intermittent systemic corticosteroids, which contributed to worsening skin disease. Bimekizumab was initiated after appropriate screening, resulting in rapid and complete skin clearance by week 12, with no adverse events. Over a 14-month follow-up, a progressive improvement in respiratory function was observed, including increased spirometric parameters, improved diffusing capacity, and enhanced exercise tolerance, with resolution of exertional desaturation and discontinuation of oxygen support during mild activity. No other therapeutic changes were made during this period. Given the role of IL-17 cytokines in inflammation and fibrosis, this observation suggests a potential effect of IL-17A/F inhibition on fibrotic lung processes. This case highlights a possible dual benefit of bimekizumab in patients with psoriasis and concomitant ILD and supports further investigation into shared pathogenic pathways and targeted therapeutic strategies.

items.title: Shear wave elastography assessment of periventricular white matter and thalamic stiffness changes in infants with congenital heart disease undergoing cardiac surgery
items.abstract: ObjectiveTo quantitatively evaluate stiffness changes in the periventricular white matter (PVWM) and thalamus (TH) in infants undergoing congenital cardiac surgery using shear wave elastography (SWE).DesignA prospective observational study.SettingSingle-center study based at a tertiary care center.PatientsForty-three infants aged zero-to-six months with congenital heart disease (CHD) undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) were enrolled.InterventionsSWE was performed to measure periventricular white matter and thalamic stiffness before and after surgery.Measurements and Main ResultsNo significant correlation was observed between age and the stiffness of either PVMW or TH, both before and after surgery. Significant postoperative reductions were observed in mean stiffness of PVMW (1.22 ± 0.14 m/s vs. 1.18 ± 0.14 m/s, p = 0.014) and TH (1.54 ± 0.15 m/s vs. 1.50 ± 0.15 m/s, p = 0.031). Regional analysis of PVWM and TH indicated a significant postoperative decrease in tissue stiffness, with notable reductions observed in the body portion of PVWM (1.24 ± 0.13 m/s vs. 1.18 ± 0.15 m/s, p = 0.046), the caudal portion of PVWM (1.22 ± 0.14 m/s vs. 1.18 ± 0.13 m/s, p = 0.045), and the caudal portion of TH (1.53 ± 0.16 m/s vs. 1.45 ± 0.16 m/s, p = 0.014). Consistently, PVWM demonstrated lower stiffness than TH, both before surgery (1.22 ± 0.14 m/s vs. 1.54 ± 0.15 m/s, p < 0.001) and after surgery (1.18 ± 0.14 m/s vs. 1.50 ± 0.15 m/s, p < 0.001).ConclusionsSWE identified significant postoperative reductions in the stiffness of PVWM and TH in infants with CHD. The body and caudal PVWM, as well as caudal TH, showed the most prominent changes. PVWM consistently presented lower stiffness than TH during the entire perioperative period. SWE proves feasible for quantitative evaluation of minor cerebral changes in affected infants during the perioperative period.

items.title: Diagnostic performance and interobserver agreement of O-RADS US v2022 and its combination with serum biomarkers in surgically treated epithelial ovarian-adnexal masses
items.abstract: ObjectiveTo evaluate the diagnostic performance of the American College of Radiology (ACR) Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System for Ultrasound (O-RADS US v2022) and a combined O-RADS US v2022–CA125–HE4 model in differentiating benign from borderline or malignant epithelial ovarian-adnexal masses, and to assess interobserver agreement for O-RADS US v2022 classification.MethodsThis retrospective study included 282 histopathologically confirmed epithelial ovarian-adnexal lesions from 270 surgically treated patients between January 2022 and June 2025. Of the 282 lesions, 233 were benign and 49 were borderline/malignant, with borderline tumors included in the disease-positive group for the primary binary diagnostic analysis. Two sonographers with different levels of experience independently classified stored ultrasound images according to O-RADS US v2022. Categories 4-5 were prespecified as test-positive. Analyses of the combined O-RADS US v2022–CA125–HE4 model were restricted to 238 lesions with complete CA125 and HE4 data.ResultsAmong the 282 lesions, 233 (82.6%) were benign and 49 (17.4%) were borderline/malignant. In a sensitivity analysis excluding borderline tumors, all 20 invasive malignant lesions were classified as O-RADS US v2022 categories 4–5 by both sonographers. Using O-RADS US v2022 categories 4–5 as test-positive, Sonographer A achieved an AUC of 0.924 (95% CI, 0.892–0.955), with a sensitivity of 0.980, specificity of 0.670, PPV of 0.384, and NPV of 0.994. Sonographer B achieved an AUC of 0.904 (95% CI, 0.863–0.945), with a sensitivity of 0.980, specificity of 0.674, PPV of 0.387, and NPV of 0.994. The AUC was 0.769 (95% CI, 0.684-0.853) for CA125 alone and 0.689 (95% CI, 0.593–0.784) for HE4 alone. Among the 238 lesions with complete biomarker data, the combined O-RADS US v2022–CA125–HE4 model yielded an AUC of 0.937 (95% CI, 0.901–0.972), with a sensitivity of 0.721, specificity of 0.954, PPV of 0.775, and NPV of 0.939. Interobserver agreement for O-RADS US v2022 classification was excellent (linearly weighted κ = 0.963; 95% CI, 0.940–0.982).ConclusionIn this selected retrospective surgical cohort, O-RADS US v2022 demonstrated good diagnostic discrimination and excellent interobserver agreement. The combined O-RADS US v2022–CA125–HE4 model showed higher specificity but lower sensitivity than O-RADS US v2022 alone, without a statistically significant difference in AUC. Prospective external validation is required before clinical implementation.

items.title: Factors associated with parents' self-reported familiarity with pediatric eye disorders in Jordan: a quantitative analysis of survey data from Jordanian parents
items.abstract: IntroductionParents play an important role in recognizing potential eye problems in children, yet their knowledge and perceptions regarding pediatric eye disorders remain insufficiently characterized in Jordan. This study assessed several dimensions of parental eye-health awareness and examined factors associated with parents' self-reported familiarity with common pediatric eye disorders.MethodsWe performed a cross-sectional survey on 1,264 parents residing in all twelve governorates of Jordan. The questionnaire had five domains: knowledge of pediatric eye diseases, recognition of symptoms and causes, treatment and management, attitudes toward eye care, and barriers to accessing services. We also asked the parents to classify their familiarity with common pediatric eye disorders, and we used this as the main study outcome. We analyzed the data using descriptive statistics, Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, independent-samples t-tests, and binary logistic regression.ResultsIt was found that most of the participants were women (70.7%), married (93.7%), and had a bachelor's degree (54.7%). 61.1% of parents classified themselves as familiar with common pediatric eye disorders. Over the five domains, parental attitudes toward eye care had the highest mean score, followed by recognition of symptoms and causes. Parental attitudes toward eye care had the highest overall domain score, followed by recognition of symptoms and causes. Participants reporting familiarity had significantly higher scores than those reporting no familiarity across all five domains. In the domain-level regression analysis, only knowledge of pediatric eye diseases (OR = 2.13, p < 0.001) and treatment and management (OR = 1.97, p < 0.001) remained independently associated with self-reported familiarity. Over all domains' items, the strongest predictors were: correct knowledge about the age range affected by amblyopia, awareness that strabismus can lead to amblyopia, and correct understanding that wearing glasses does not worsen a child's vision.ConclusionsParticipating parents generally demonstrated positive attitudes toward pediatric eye care but showed important gaps in disease-specific and treatment-related knowledge. Several knowledge and treatment-related items were associated with self-reported familiarity, even after adjustment for participant characteristics. These findings identify potential targets for parental eye-health education but should not be interpreted as evidence of actual care-seeking behavior, treatment adherence, or clinical decision-making.

items.title: COVID-19 and female reproductive health: pathophysiological mechanisms and clinical reproductive outcomes
items.abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), has raised important concerns regarding its potential effects on female reproductive health. This review aimed to synthesize current evidence on the biological mechanisms, clinical manifestations, ovarian reserve, fertility potential, and assisted reproductive technology (ART) outcomes associated with COVID-19. A comprehensive literature search of PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar was conducted for studies published between January 2020 and March 2026. Current evidence suggests that SARS-CoV-2 may affect female reproductive tissues through multiple interconnected pathways, including ACE2/TMPRSS2-mediated tissue susceptibility, immune dysregulation, oxidative stress, endothelial dysfunction, neuroendocrine disturbances, and potentially autoimmune mechanisms. Menstrual disturbances, such as changes in cycle length, menstrual flow, and dysmenorrhea, are among the most frequently reported reproductive manifestations, although most appear transient and reversible. Several studies have reported reductions in anti-Müllerian hormone (AMH) and hormonal alterations, particularly following severe infection; however, findings remain inconsistent. Importantly, most investigations demonstrate preserved ovarian reserve, fertility potential, and ART outcomes, including ovarian response, embryo development, clinical pregnancy, and live birth rates. Overall, current evidence suggests that COVID-19 may cause temporary reproductive alterations rather than permanent impairment of female fertility. Nevertheless, large prospective longitudinal studies are required to clarify long-term reproductive consequences and identify women at increased risk of persistent reproductive dysfunction.

items.title: Suspected nicotine-induced acute urticaria following excessive use of smoking cessation lozenges: a case report
items.abstract: Acute urticaria is a condition characterized by the rapid onset of raised, itchy welts, often triggered by various factors. This report presents a case of acute urticaria that may be related to excessive intake of nicotine from smoking cessation lozenges. The patient had consumed a large amount of smoking cessation lozenges (containing nicotine) 3 days before the onset of symptoms, which was suspected to be caused by nicotine overdose. But, the association between nicotine overdose and acute urticaria is hypothetical and cannot be confirmed based on a single case. Following 10 days of treatment with intravenous methylprednisolone, pantoprazole, nebulized terbutaline and dexamethasone, and oral antihistamines, the patient improved significantly and was discharged.

items.title: Editorial: Enhancing the health of vulnerable populations through integrated biosocial approaches
Safety and efficacy of microbiota-directed adjunctive therapy in acute pancreatitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prebiotics, probiotics, and synbiotics
items.abstract: BackgroundPrebiotics, probiotics, and synbiotics have been proposed as adjunctive treatments for acute pancreatitis (AP), but their clinical efficacy and safety remain uncertain. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate their effects on recovery-related, efficacy, and safety-critical outcomes in AP.MethodsPubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched through July 2026, supplemented by Google Scholar and reference-list screening. Comparative interventional and observational studies evaluating prebiotics, probiotics, or synbiotics versus placebo, standard care, or nutritional controls were eligible. Risk of bias was assessed using Cochrane RoB 2 for randomized studies and the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale for non-randomized studies. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed using mean differences (MDs) or risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Sensitivity and subgroup analyses were conducted to explore study quality and clinical heterogeneity.Results30 studies were included in the systematic review and 25 in the meta-analysis. Microbiota-directed interventions were associated with a shorter hospital stay in the full-analysis set (MD − 4.68 days, 95% CI − 6.22 to −3.14), although heterogeneity was substantial (I2 = 98.74%); the association persisted in the sensitivity analysis (MD − 3.90 days, 95% CI − 5.93 to −1.87). Mortality was lower in the full analysis (RR 0.67, 95% CI 0.45–0.98), but this finding was not robust and lost statistical significance in the sensitivity analysis. Total infection (RR 0.50, 95% CI 0.36–0.69) and infectious morbidity (RR 0.58, 95% CI 0.42–0.80) were reduced, whereas infected pancreatic necrosis, organ failure/multiple organ failure, need for operation, and systemic inflammatory response syndrome were not significantly improved overall. Adverse-event reporting was inconsistent, and a large multicenter trial provided an important safety signal for live multispecies probiotics in predicted severe AP.ConclusionMicrobiota-directed interventions may be associated with shorter hospital stay and fewer infection-related complications, but substantial heterogeneity, intervention diversity, and incomplete safety reporting limit clinical interpretation. Evidence for mortality or other severe outcomes is not robust. Current evidence does not support routine use of these interventions in AP, particularly live probiotic preparations in severe or critically ill patients. Future adequately powered, severity-stratified trials using standardized formulations and prospective safety monitoring are needed.Systematic review registrationRegistration number: CRD420261387279.

items.title: Effectiveness of a couple-based dyadic coping intervention on psychological distress and relationship functioning in HPV patients: a randomized controlled trial in China
items.abstract: BackgroundHuman papillomavirus (HPV) infection may cause psychological distress and strain intimate relationships because concerns regarding transmission, stigma, and cancer risk can affect both patients and their partners. Evidence regarding HPV- specific couple-based psychosocial interventions remains limited.ObjectiveTo evaluate the effects of a couple-based dyadic coping intervention on psychological distress and relationship functioning in patients with HPV infection.MethodsThis randomized controlled trial enrolled 148 couples from a special-needs outpatient department, with the female partner in each couple diagnosed with HPV infection. Couples were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive either an 8-week couple-based dyadic coping intervention plus routine care or routine care alone. The primary outcome was the change in the patient-reported Depression Anxiety Stress Scale-21 (DASS-21) total score from baseline to 8 weeks. Secondary outcomes included the HPV Impact Profile (HIP) total score and the patient- and spouse-reported Couples’ Illness Communication Scale (CICS), Dyadic Adjustment Scale (DAS), and Dyadic Coping Inventory (DCI) total scores. Follow-up compliance and HPV clearance were evaluated as exploratory outcomes. Between-group differences in changes were reported with 95% confidence intervals and Cohen’s d, and the robustness of the primary finding was further examined using multivariable ANCOVA and multiple imputation.ResultsA total of 142 couples completed the 8-week assessment (intervention group, n = 72; control group, n = 70). The intervention group showed a greater reduction in the DASS-21 total score than the control group (difference in change, −4.98 points; 95% CI, −7.51 to −2.45; Cohen’s d = −0.65; p < 0.001). The adjusted ANCOVA and multiple-imputation sensitivity analysis yielded consistent findings. Secondary total-score outcomes also favored the intervention, with absolute standardized effect sizes ranging from 0.68 to 0.89 (all Holm-adjusted p < 0.001). Complete follow-up compliance was higher in the intervention group than in the control group (75.0% vs. 45.7%; p = 0.001). HPV clearance at 3 months was numerically higher in the intervention group (38.9% vs. 24.3%), but the between-group difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.062). No serious adverse events were reported.ConclusionAn 8-week couple-based dyadic coping intervention was associated with short-term improvements in psychological distress, HPV-specific impact, relationship functioning, dyadic coping, and follow-up compliance. The intervention shows promise as a supportive psychosocial approach but warrants confirmation in larger multicenter studies with longer follow-up before routine clinical implementation. The HPV clearance finding should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating.

items.title: Cognitive reshaping and resurgence of humanness: restructuring the medical education continuum in the era of generative AI
items.abstract: BackgroundGenerative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming medical education. While AI enhances personalized learning, its integration raises concerns regarding “cognitive outsourcing,” automation bias, and erosion of independent clinical reasoning.Aim & methodsThis narrative review critically evaluates the cognitive and educational impacts of generative AI and proposes structural realignment across the medical education continuum. We synthesized literature from major databases (PubMed, Scopus) focusing on AI's intersection with clinical reasoning and humanistic competencies.Main findingsWe identify three cognitive vulnerabilities: deskilling (loss of diagnostic abilities among advanced learners), never-skilling (failure to develop foundational mental models in junior trainees), and automation bias (uncritical acceptance of machine-generated recommendations). Traditional memory-based assessments, such as multiple-choice questions (MCQs), are increasingly insufficient for evaluating clinical readiness.Key recommendationsMedical education needs to pivot towards methodologies AI cannot replicate, acknowledging that strategies like case-based learning (CBL) and problem-based learning (PBL) are not novel but are now urgently necessitated by AI. We propose a division of labor where “AI treats the chart” while “humans treat the patient.” Undergraduate medical education (UME) is encouraged to prioritize pathophysiological reasoning to counter never-skilling; graduate medical education (GME) would benefit from emphasizing human-AI collaboration and deliberate reflection to counter deskilling and automation bias; continuing medical education (CME) may consider facilitating lifelong adaptation and structured “unlearning” of obsolete heuristics.ConclusionRather than competing with algorithmic memory, medical education needs to cultivate “augmented clinicians” equipped with high AI literacy and profound humanness, ensuring technology enhances rather than displaces relational patient care.

items.title: Streptococcus intermedius lung abscess in children: a case report and literature review
items.abstract: Streptococcus intermedius is a gram-positive commensal associated with suppurative infections. Pediatric pulmonary abscesses due to S. intermedius are rare, and outcomes in children with severe neurological comorbidities are poorly characterized. A 5-year-old boy with refractory epilepsy and global developmental delay who presented with a right upper lobe abscess, pneumonitis, and pleural effusion. Targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), drainage pus culture, and tNGS of drainage pus all confirmed the presence of S. intermedius. To our knowledge, this is the first reported case of a residual pulmonary cavity on 3-month follow-up imaging after an S. intermedius lung abscess in a child with severe neurological impairment. Our findings highlight the value of tNGS in diagnosing lower respiratory tract infections caused by pathogens that are difficult to identify through conventional culture methods.

items.title: Incremental value of the perivascular fat attenuation index surrounding the superior mesenteric artery on non-contrast CT for predicting SMA abnormalities in patients with acute abdominal pain
items.abstract: ObjectiveTo evaluate the predictive value of the perivascular fat attenuation index (FAI) surrounding the superior mesenteric artery (SMA) on non-contrast CT for SMA abnormalities in acute abdominal pain and FAI's incremental utility in risk models.MethodsThis retrospective study included 262 acute abdominal pain patients (77 with SMA abnormalities, 185 controls) admitted between January 2020 and December 2025. All underwent non-contrast and contrast-enhanced CT within 48 h. Independent predictors were identified via univariate and multivariate logistic regression. The maximum area under the curve (AUC) was obtained through receiver operating characteristic analysis, and the predictive performance of models was comprehensively evaluated using net reclassification (NRI) and integrated discrimination improvement (IDI). Decision curve analyses (DCA) and calibration curves were used to evaluate the clinical utility and calibration of the models.ResultsIndependent predictors of SMA abnormalities were smoking (OR = 10.452, 95% CI: 2.528–43.219), elevated high-sensitivity C-reactive protein [hsCRP] (OR = 1.012, 95% CI: 1.001–1.023), increased SMA diameter [SMA-d] (OR = 4.414, 95% CI: 2.758–7.062), and high FAI (OR = 1.092, 95% CI: 1.053–1.132; all P < 0.05). Four models were constructed: Model A (smoking + hsCRP), Model B (Model A + SMA-d), Model C (Model A + FAI), and Model D (Model A + SMA-d + FAI). Model D achieved the highest AUC (0.970; 95% CI: 0.952–0.988), outperforming Model A (AUC = 0.734), Model B (AUC = 0.945), and Model C (AUC = 0.878; all P < 0.001). Versus Model A, Model D showed superior NRI (0.780) and IDI (0.573; both P < 0.001). Model B outperformed Model C in incremental value (NRI: 0.657 vs. 0.457; IDI: 0.460 vs. 0.295; all P < 0.001) when each was compared with Model A. DCA confirmed Model D provided maximal net clinical benefit (threshold probability: 0%–91%). The Model D nomogram demonstrated excellent calibration.ConclusionA high FAI was independently associated with SMA abnormalities, although its incremental predictive value was lower than that of SMA-d. Thus, FAI might serve as a complementary imaging biomarker rather than a stand-alone diagnostic marker. Integrating smoking status, hsCRP, SMA-d, and FAI might improve early risk stratification based on non-contrast CT and support timely diagnostic evaluation.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy of rapid integrated molecular testing for major respiratory viral infections: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract: BackgroundRapid integrated molecular tests are automated sample-to-answer nucleic acid amplification systems that provide respiratory virus results within approximately 120 min. Because their use ranges from genuine near-patient sites to rapid laboratory workflows, testing environments must be clearly classified.MethodsPubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception through June 2026 without language restrictions. Diagnostic-accuracy studies evaluating integrated rapid molecular assays for influenza A, influenza B, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), or SARS-CoV-2 were eligible. For the primary analysis, one prespecified platform and one non-nested cohort were selected from each study, and target-specific 2 × 2 counts were aggregated into one study-level composite record. Sensitivity and specificity were jointly synthesized using a bivariate random-effects model. The overall analysis was considered exploratory, with pathogen-specific findings prioritized. Pathogen- and setting-specific subgroup analyses, leave-one-study-out analyses, QUADAS-2 assessment, and Deeks' funnel-plot asymmetry testing were performed.ResultsOf 1,337 identified records, 43 underwent full-text assessment and 23 were excluded. Twenty studies contributed 20 independent study-level records. Sensitivity and specificity were 0.970 and 0.987 for influenza A, 0.961 and 0.992 for influenza B, 0.955 and 0.992 for RSV, and 0.950 and 0.992 for SARS-CoV-2, respectively. The exploratory overall analysis yielded a sensitivity of 0.971 [95% confidence interval (CI), 0.955–0.982], specificity of 0.991 (95% CI, 0.980–0.996), and HSROC area under the curve of 0.957. Five studies were conducted in genuine near-patient settings and 15 in laboratory settings. Leave-one-study-out estimates ranged from 0.968 to 0.974 for sensitivity and 0.989 to 0.992 for specificity.
