Deeks' test showed no statistically significant funnel-plot asymmetry (P = 0.269).ConclusionsPathogen-specific analyses indicated high diagnostic accuracy for rapid integrated molecular testing of influenza A, influenza B, RSV, and SARS-CoV-2. Because platforms, specimens, populations, settings, designs, and reference methods varied, the overall estimates and HSROC area should be interpreted only as exploratory summaries. Most studies were laboratory based, and direct clinical or economic benefits were not established.

items.title: Inflammatory phenotypes after total knee arthroplasty: a testable framework for biomarker-stratified enhanced recovery and precision rehabilitation
items.abstract: Recovery after total knee arthroplasty (TKA) remains heterogeneous despite mature surgical techniques and standardized enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) pathways. Perioperative inflammation offers an unusually actionable basis for stratification because it can be measured before surgery, tracked during recovery, linked to pain, swelling, and quadriceps dysfunction, and modified by available interventions. We advance a three-axis inflammatory phenotype comprising preoperative inflammatory tone, acute response magnitude, and resolution kinetics. Preoperative systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), conventionally calculated from a CBC obtained at a prespecified time point, can contribute to Axis 1, and serial SII may be evaluated as a candidate trajectory; the modified frailty index (mFI) summarizes preoperative deficit burden. The framework tests whether their information is complemented by the joint temporal response to surgical perturbation and the coordination of systemic, local, and functional recovery. The three axes are primarily continuous dimensions; any latent classes are exploratory and require reproducibility across sites. Serial interleukin-6, C-reactive protein, fibrinogen, cytokine-panel, swelling, and temperature studies support these complementary dimensions. Prognostic cohorts connect inflammatory profiles with pain, function, complications, and recovery trajectories, while randomized trials demonstrate that the acute response can be pharmacologically shifted. The framework integrates accessible C-reactive protein and complete blood count-derived ratios with targeted cytokines and local swelling or temperature. Each signal is paired with mechanism-aligned outcomes such as voluntary activation, quadriceps strength, Timed Up and Go performance, and Knee injury and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score domains. The model organizes prospective, safety-gated tests of phenotype-adapted ERAS and rehabilitation, including protocol- or trial-based anti-inflammatory strategies, compression, neuromuscular electrical stimulation, nutritional support, progressive resistance training, and extended supervised rehabilitation. Five prospective predictions link each phenotype axis to a distinct recovery mechanism and intervention response. Multicenter trajectory cohorts can derive and validate the phenotype, followed by biomarker-stratified factorial trials powered for treatment-by-phenotype interaction. This framework converts perioperative inflammation from an isolated laboratory signal into a dynamic recovery phenotype and proposes a testable blueprint for prospective evaluation of adaptive ERAS and precision rehabilitation after TKA. Incremental utility relative to existing indices remains a prospective hypothesis.

items.title: Integrated TCM and Western medicine rehabilitation program after breast cancer surgery: a best evidence summary
items.abstract: ObjectiveTo systematically identify, critically appraise, and synthesize the best available evidence on integrated TCM and Western medicine rehabilitation program after breast cancer surgery, with the aim of providing evidence-based references to support clinical nursing practice.MethodsThis study was conducted and reported in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines where applicable and the evidence summary development process proposed by the Fudan University Center for Evidence-based Nursing. Guided by the “5S” evidence pyramid model, a top-down systematic search was conducted across decision-support systems, guideline websites, professional organization websites, and major databases. The search period spanned from database inception to December 2025. Two reviewers independently performed literature screening, critical appraisal, and evidence extraction.ResultsA total of 29 articles were included, comprising three clinical decisions, three guidelines, eleven expert consensuses, one evidence summary, seven systematic reviews, and four randomized controlled trials. The synthesized evidence generated seven thematic domains: comprehensive assessment, postoperative functional exercise, manual lymphatic drainage, exercise prescriptions, precautions for exercise in special circumstances, appropriate traditional Chinese medicine techniques, and medical supervision and incentive strategies during exercise, yielding 27 evidence-based recommendations.ConclusionsThe 27 evidence-based recommendations across seven domains provide clinically meaningful guidance for integrated TCM and Western medicine rehabilitation program after breast cancer surgery. These recommendations offer an evidence-based framework for improving clinical practice. Healthcare professionals may apply the available evidence to clinical practice tailored to individual conditions, with the aim of improving patients’ postoperative quality of life.RegistrationThe study protocol was registered with the Fudan University Center for Evidence-based Nursing (http://ebn.nursing.fudan.edu.cn/home). Registration number ES20259118Systematic Review Registrationhttp://ebn.nursing.fudan.edu.cn/home, ES20259118.

items.title: Toward visualized pathophenotyping: a multimodal imaging-guided conceptual framework for chronic low back pain
items.abstract: Chronic low back pain (CLBP) remains a leading cause of disability, yet many current interventions are limited by operator dependence and an inability to target deep pathophysiological drivers. This Perspective proposes Visualized Pathophenotyping, a conceptual precision paradigm that integrates multimodal imaging to characterize patient-specific deep structural and perfusion abnormalities and guide targeted interventions. The framework comprises three pillars: (1) precise assessment using shear wave elastography and infrared thermography or laser Doppler flowmetry to define mechanical and ischemic phenotypes; (2) ultrasound-guided deep mechanical stimulation for accurate targeting of fascial adhesions and myofascial trigger points; and (3) phenotype-specific intelligent monitoring with virtual/augmented reality and wearable AI to sustain tissue remodeling and prevent recurrence. Emerging evidence from randomized trials and meta-analyses suggests that visualization-guided approaches yield superior short-term pain relief and functional improvement compared with blind techniques. Digital therapeutics may enhance adherence and some functional outcomes, although broader biopsychosocial effects remain to be confirmed. By shifting CLBP management from operator-dependent procedures toward objective, data-driven care, this hypothesis-generating framework may reduce recurrence, minimize opioid reliance, and improve scalability, pending validation through prospective multicenter trials of diagnostic accuracy, clinical utility, and cost-effectiveness.

items.title: Intraoperative hypotension burden and early postoperative recovery after uniportal video-assisted thoracoscopic lung resection: a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract: ObjectiveIntraoperative hypotension is common during general anesthesia and has been associated with postoperative organ injury. Its relationship with early postoperative analgesic requirement after uniportal video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate whether cumulative intraoperative hypotension, defined primarily as duration of mean arterial pressure (MAP) <65 mmHg, is associated with postoperative analgesic consumption and early recovery outcomes after elective uniportal VATS lung resection.MethodsThis single-center retrospective observational cohort study included 420 adult patients who had undergone elective uniportal VATS lung resection with standardized total intravenous anesthesia, thoracic paravertebral block, and postoperative intravenous patient-controlled analgesia (PCA). The primary exposure was cumulative duration of MAP < 65 mmHg, modeled per 10-min increase. The primary outcome was cumulative opioid consumption within 24 h postoperatively, standardized to intravenous morphine milligram equivalents. Secondary outcomes included resting pain, successful PCA dose deliveries, postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV), and rescue analgesia. Multivariable regression models were used to evaluate adjusted associations.ResultsOf 420 patients, 134 (31.9%) experienced at least one episode of MAP <65 mmHg. After full adjustment, each 10-min increase in MAP <65 mmHg duration was associated with higher 24-h opioid consumption [β = 1.513 mg; 95% confidence interval (CI), 0.877–2.149; P < 0.001], more successful PCA dose deliveries (β = 0.230; 95% CI, 0.124–0.336; P < 0.001), increased odds of PONV (OR, 1.63; 95% CI, 1.33–2.00; P < 0.001), and increased odds of rescue analgesic use (OR, 1.31; 95% CI, 1.10–1.58; P = 0.003). No significant association was observed with 24-h resting pain score.ConclusionGreater cumulative duration of intraoperative MAP <65 mmHg was associated with higher early postoperative opioid requirement, greater analgesic demand, and increased PONV after uniportal VATS lung resection. These findings identify prolonged intraoperative hypotension as a potential marker of less favorable early recovery. Prospective studies are needed to determine whether the associations are causal and whether blood pressure-targeted interventions improve recovery.

items.title: Influence of stress and knowledge on self-medication practices among pharmacy students: a cross-sectional study
items.abstract: BackgroundSelf-medication with over-the-counter (OTC) medicines is common among university students, particularly pharmacy students, despite the associated risks. Pharmacy students receive comprehensive education in pharmacology and medication safety. However, it remains unclear whether medication-related knowledge alone is sufficient to promote responsible self-medication practices or whether psychological factors, such as stress-related attitudes, also influence these behaviors. Addressing this gap is important, as pharmacy students are expected to promote the rational use of medicines in their future professional practice. Therefore, this study aimed to assess self-medication practices and associated factors among pharmacy students at Umm Al-Qura University in Makkah, Saudi Arabia.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted among full-time Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D.) students at Umm Al-Qura University in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, between November and December 2025. Data were collected using a convenience sampling method through an electronic questionnaire developed by pharmacology faculty members. The questionnaire underwent review for face and content validity and was pilot-tested before administration. It assessed demographic characteristics, self-medication practices, medication-related knowledge, and stress-related attitudes. Descriptive statistics, chi-square tests or Fisher's exact tests, and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests were employed to analyze the study variables. Multivariable logistic regression was used to examine associations of demographic characteristics, medication-related knowledge, and stress-related attitudes with frequent self-medication. Statistical significance was defined as p < 0.05.ResultsA total of 244 pharmacy students participated, including 161 (66.0%) females and 83 (34.0%) males. 230 students (94.3%) reported practicing self-medication. Among them, the most frequently used categories were painkillers (189, 82.2%), topical preparations (154, 67.0%), and cough syrups (106, 46.1%). Male students were more likely than females to report self-medication for financial and time-saving reasons and were also more likely to use cough syrup. In contrast, female students reported greater use of sleeping aids. Higher medication-related knowledge (OR=1.21, 95% CI: 1.12–1.32; p < 0.001) and stress-related attitudes (OR=1.11, 95% CI: 1.04–1.19; p = 0.004) were independently associated with frequent self-medication.ConclusionMedication-related knowledge and stress-related attitudes emerged as significant independent predictors of frequent self-medication among pharmacy students. These findings indicate the importance of integrating medication safety education with stress management strategies in pharmacy curricula to promote responsible self-medication practices among future pharmacists. Implementing such interventions may facilitate the rational use of OTC medicines, enhance patient safety, and improve public health outcomes.

items.title: Neural tracking of surprisal and semantic distance in naturalistic movie viewing
items.abstract: Understanding speech requires listeners to integrate incoming input with prior linguistic and thematic knowledge to access meaning, a task greatly aided by prediction. Surprisal and related phenomena (e.g., next word prediction) tend to be associated with broad activation of language regions during listening. A major challenge for interpreting the neural correlates of surprisal is that lexical expectancies are constrained both by syntactic and semantic information. In contrast, semantic distance yields more of a pure metric of relatedness between one language constituent (e.g., word, phrase, n-gram) and another within a high-dimensional semantic space. We contrasted surprisal and semantic distance in running discourse during naturalistic audiovisual language comprehension. We analyzed fMRI scans from 20 English-speaking adults who viewed the full-length film 500 Days of Summer. Our focus was on brain sensitivity to either surprisal or semantic distance as language unfolded word-by-word. To this end, we implemented a series of hierarchical voxelwise encoding models. After accounting for low-level auditory and visual features, the addition of either surprisal or semantic distance improved prediction in bilateral superior temporal gyrus (STG), left inferior frontal gyrus, and right cerebellum. Critically, both semantic distance and surprisal explained unique variation in bilateral temporal cortex after accounting for the other. These results support the notion that the brain tracks both broad probabilistic prediction as well as semantic integration. More generally, these findings extend previous work on auditory-only speech by demonstrating that surprisal and semantic distance predict meaningful neural variation even within a rich audiovisual context.
items.authors: O'Leary, R. M.; Smith, H. C.; Myers, E. B.; Reilly, J.; Peelle, J. E.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，在自然语言理解中，大脑同时跟踪惊讶度和语义距离，这两者在神经活动中各自提供独特的信息，有助于理解语言的预测和语义整合。
items.l2_summary:
在理解语言的过程中，听者需要将接收到的信息与先前的语言和主题知识相结合，以获取意义，而这一过程在很大程度上依赖于预测能力。研究中探讨了惊讶度（surprisal）及其相关现象（如下一个词预测）与语义距离（semantic distance）在自然主义电影观看中的神经追踪。惊讶度通常与语言区域的广泛激活相关，但其解释的一个主要挑战在于词汇预期受到句法和语义信息的限制。相比之下，语义距离提供了一种更纯粹的度量，反映了一个语言成分（如单词、短语或n-gram）与另一个成分在高维语义空间中的相关性。

本研究对20名讲英语的成年人在观看完整电影《500 Days of Summer》时的fMRI扫描进行了分析，重点关注大脑对惊讶度或语义距离的敏感性，随着语言逐字展开。为此，研究者实施了一系列分层体素编码模型。在控制低级听觉和视觉特征后，惊讶度或语义距离的加入均提高了双侧上颞回（superior temporal gyrus, STG）、左侧下额回（inferior frontal gyrus）和右侧小脑的预测能力。重要的是，在控制了彼此的影响后，语义距离和惊讶度在双侧颞皮层（temporal cortex）中解释了独特的变异性。这些结果支持了大脑同时追踪广泛的概率预测和语义整合的观点。更一般而言，这些发现扩展了以往对仅听觉语言的研究，表明即使在丰富的视听环境中，惊讶度和语义距离也能预测有意义的神经变异。
items.title_zh: 自然电影观看中的惊讶感与语义距离的神经追踪
items.summary_zh: 理解语言需要听众将输入与先前的语言和主题知识结合，以获取意义，这一过程受到预测的极大帮助。惊讶感与相关现象（如下一个词预测）通常与听觉过程中语言区域的广泛激活相关。我们对20名英语母语者在观看电影《500天的夏天》时的fMRI扫描进行了分析，重点关注大脑对惊讶感或语义距离的敏感性。通过实施一系列分层体素编码模型，我们发现，在控制低级听觉和视觉特征后，惊讶感或语义距离的加入提高了双侧上颞回、左侧下额回和右侧小脑的预测能力。关键是，语义距离和惊讶感在双侧大脑区域中解释了独特的变异。

items.title: From Geometry to Hierarchy: Charting the Dominant Modes of Human Cortical Function Through Development
items.abstract: Cortical function in the human cortex is spatially patterned along a macroscale information processing hierarchy. This hierarchy tracks a sensory-association axis anchored at one end by unimodal sensory regions and at the other by transmodal association areas. Biophysical models of brain dynamics suggest that this axis should align with the dominant, resonant modes of cortical anatomy and geometry, but they do not. Instead, the dominant anatomical modes correspond to simple spatial gradients extending along rostro-caudal, medio-lateral, and dorso-ventral axes. How does this divergence between anatomical and functional modes of the cortex arise? Here, using four independent functional magnetic resonance imaging datasets spanning infancy to young adulthood (n=1,512, aged 0-21 years), we show that this spatial divergence is attributable to the maturation of long-range cortico-cortical inter-regional functional coupling. Specifically, we find that the dominant functional mode of the human cortex during the first 3 to 4 years of life closely resembles the rostro-caudal mode of cortical geometry, then shifts to a rudimentary sensory-association-like mode between 4 and 6 years of age and ultimately matures into a prototypical sensory-association mode by age 13. In infancy and early childhood, a linear model predicting the topography of the dominant functional mode from modes of cortical geometry substantially outperforms a model relying on the adult sensory-association mode, whereas the reverse is true in later stages of development. Furthermore, targeted removal of long-range connections causes the adult functional mode to regress from a sensory-association topography to an infant-like rostro-caudal mode. Our findings indicate that the maturation of long-range cortico-cortical coupling supports the gradual emergence of hierarchical modes of cortical function from an organization initially dominated by geometric constraints.
items.authors: Holmes, A.; Pavlovich, K.; Qian, X.; Zhou, J. H.; Chong, Y. S.; Tan, A. P.; Meaney, M. J.; Eriksson, J. G.; Margulies, D. S.; Pang, J. C.; Fornito, A.
items.l1_lead: 人类皮层功能的成熟过程显示，从几何约束主导的初始模式逐渐演变为层次化的感官-关联模式，主要归因于长程皮层间功能耦合的发展。
items.l2_summary:
人类大脑皮层的功能在空间上呈现出一种宏观的信息处理层次结构，这一层次结构沿着感官-联想轴展开，轴的一端是单模态感官区域，另一端则是跨模态联想区域。生物物理模型表明，这一轴线应与皮层解剖和几何的主导共振模式相一致，但实际上并非如此。相反，主导的解剖模式对应于沿着前后、内外和背腹轴的简单空间梯度。那么，这种解剖模式与功能模式之间的差异是如何产生的呢？本研究利用四个独立的功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）数据集，涵盖从婴儿期到年轻成人（样本量n=1,512，年龄范围0-21岁），显示这种空间差异归因于长程皮层-皮层区域功能耦合的成熟。

具体而言，我们发现人类皮层在生命的前三到四年内的主导功能模式与皮层几何的前后模式密切相似，随后在4到6岁之间转变为一种初步的感官-联想模式，并最终在13岁时成熟为典型的感官-联想模式。在婴儿和幼儿期，基于皮层几何模式预测主导功能模式的线性模型显著优于依赖于成人感官-联想模式的模型，而在发展后期则正好相反。此外，针对长程连接的有针对性移除会导致成人功能模式从感官-联想拓扑回归到婴儿期的前后模式。这些发现表明，长程皮层-皮层耦合的成熟支持了从最初受几何约束主导的组织中逐渐出现的层次化皮层功能模式。
items.title_zh: 从几何到层级：人类皮层功能主导模式的发展图谱
items.summary_zh: 人类皮层功能在宏观信息处理层级上呈现空间模式。该层级沿着感官-联想轴展开，一端为单模态感官区域，另一端为跨模态联想区。脑动力学的生物物理模型表明，该轴应与皮层解剖和几何的主导共振模式对齐，但实际上并不一致。我们使用四个独立的功能性磁共振成像数据集（涵盖0至21岁，共1512名参与者）显示，这种空间偏差源于长程皮层间区域功能耦合的成熟。具体而言，我们发现人类皮层在生命的前三到四年内的主导功能模式与皮层几何的 rostro-caudal 模式相似，随后在4至6岁之间转变为初步的感官-联想模式，并最终在13岁时成熟为典型的感官-联想模式。

items.title: Reward expectation signals in the superior colliculus during associative learning
items.abstract: Predicting future rewards allows neutral sensory cues to acquire motivational significance and guide goal-directed actions that maximise reward acquisition. These reward predictions are updated when outcomes differ from expectations resulting in an error in prediction. Midbrain dopamine neurons provide a canonical neural correlate of reward prediction error signal that are broadcast to multiple brain areas. These learned reward predictions ultimately influence neural processes that enable animals to select, prepare and execute actions towards expected rewards. Reward expectation signals have been observed across sensory and motor circuits where they can modulate sensory processing and action selection and vigor. This raises the question of how integrative sensorimotor circuits represent information about reward expectation alongside sensory and motor variables that drive reward-seeking actions. The superior colliculus (SC), a sensorimotor area in the midbrain traditionally associated with orienting and action selection, is strongly influenced by reward context. Expected reward modulates visual and premotor activity, learned object values shape sensory responses, and recent reward alters visual processing in the mouse SC. The SC also provides input to midbrain dopamine neurons and can relay or acquire conditioned sensory responses that influence dopaminergic activity. However, SC projections can also drive orienting movements without supporting reinforcement, raising the possibility that cue-related activity reflects salience or motor preparation rather than reward prediction itself. Here, using an associative-learning task in which auditory cues predicted distinct reward probabilities, together with longitudinal monitoring of intermediate SC population activity across learning, we asked whether the SC acquires signals related to reward probability, whether these signals can be dissociated from anticipatory licking, and whether outcome responses exhibit the hallmarks of reward-prediction errors. We found that cue-evoked SC activity progressively differentiated reward probabilities across learning, and that cue-associated reward probability explained neural activity beyond anticipatory licking. Thus, the intermediate SC carries a learned reward-expectation signal that is multiplexed with, but not reducible to, motor preparation. By contrast, outcome responses did not exhibit a consistent population-level signature of reward-prediction errors. Together, these findings identify the SC as a site where predicted reward is integrated with anticipatory action during associative learning.
items.authors: Mutlu, S.; Das, A.; Tripodi, M.
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，鼠类的上丘在联想学习中能够逐渐区分奖励概率，并携带与奖励期望相关的信号，这些信号与运动准备相互交织，但不完全等同于预测错误的标志。
items.l2_summary:
在一项关于奖励期望信号的研究中，科学家们探讨了在联想学习过程中，位于中脑的上丘（superior colliculus, SC）如何处理与奖励概率相关的信息。研究表明，预测未来奖励使得中性感官线索获得了动机意义，从而指导动物进行目标导向的行为，以最大化奖励的获取。当结果与期望不符时，奖励预测会被更新，形成预测误差信号。中脑多巴胺神经元被认为是这一奖励预测误差信号的经典神经相关物，并向多个脑区传递信息。

在感官和运动回路中，已经观察到奖励期望信号的存在，这些信号能够调节感官处理和动作选择的活力。这引发了一个问题：整合感官运动回路如何同时表示与奖励期望相关的信息以及驱动寻求奖励行为的感官和运动变量。上丘作为一个传统上与定向和动作选择相关的感官运动区域，受到奖励背景的强烈影响。研究发现，预期奖励能够调节视觉和运动前活动，学习到的物体价值会影响感官反应，而近期奖励则改变小鼠上丘的视觉处理。

此外，上丘还向中脑多巴胺神经元提供输入，并能够传递或获取条件化的感官反应，从而影响多巴胺活性。然而，上丘的投射也可以驱动定向运动，而不支持强化，这使得与线索相关的活动可能反映的是显著性或运动准备，而非奖励预测本身。在这项研究中，研究者使用了一种联想学习任务，其中听觉线索预测不同的奖励概率，并对学习过程中的上丘中间群体活动进行了纵向监测。研究的主要问题是上丘是否获得与奖励概率相关的信号，这些信号是否可以与预期舔舐行为区分开，以及结果反应是否表现出奖励预测误差的特征。

研究结果显示，随着学习的进行，线索引发的上丘活动逐渐区分了奖励概率，并且线索相关的奖励概率解释了超出预期舔舐的神经活动。因此，上丘中间区域携带了一种学习到的奖励期望信号，该信号与运动准备信号相互交织，但并不完全可归结为运动准备。相对而言，结果反应并未表现出一致的人群水平的奖励预测误差特征。这些发现为理解上丘在奖励期望信号中的作用提供了新的视角。
items.title_zh: 上丘在联想学习中的奖励预期信号研究
items.summary_zh: 预测未来奖励使得中性感官线索获得动机意义，并指导以最大化奖励获取为目标的行为。这些奖励预测在结果与预期不符时会更新，导致预测误差。中脑多巴胺神经元提供了奖励预测误差信号的经典神经相关性，并向多个脑区广播。这些学习到的奖励预测最终影响神经过程，使动物能够选择、准备和执行针对预期奖励的行为。奖励预期信号已在感官和运动回路中观察到，能够调节感官处理和行为选择及活力。上丘作为中脑中的感官运动区域，受到奖励背景的强烈影响。预期奖励调节视觉和运动前活动，学习到的物体价值塑造感官反应，近期奖励改变小鼠上丘的视觉处理。上丘还向中脑多巴胺神经元提供输入，并能够传递或获取影响多巴胺活性的条件感官反应。

items.title: ESCRT-I Inhibition Protects against NMDAR Hypofunction and Restores Synaptic Homeostasis in a Cellular Model of Schizophrenia
items.abstract: N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) hypofunction is a central pathophysiological mechanism in schizophrenia, yet direct NMDAR potentiation has shown limited clinical benefit, potentially because it fails to address deficits in receptor trafficking and surface stability. The endosomal sorting complexes required for transport (ESCRT) machinery governs the lysosomal fate of internalised membrane proteins, but its role in synaptic receptor homeostasis during glutamatergic dysfunction remains unclear. Phencyclidine (PCP), a non-competitive NMDAR antagonist, is widely used to model NMDAR hypofunction and schizophrenia-like phenotypes. Here, we show that sub-chronic PCP exposure induced persistent NMDAR hypofunction, impaired GABAergic transmission, and collapsed of excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance in primary hippocampal neurons. Genetic inhibition of the ESCRT-I component TSG101 prevented these deficits, enabled functional recovery following PCP washout, and increased surface expression of functional NMDARs and GABAA receptors without altering receptor pharmacology or biophysical properties. At the network level, TSG101 knockdown restored inhibitory tone, normalised excitatory activity, and stabilised E/I balance. Moreover, TSG101 knockdown rescued PCP-induced reductions in PSD-95 and BDNF, restored ERK1/2 signalling, and re-established activity-dependent nuclear translocation of Fos-like (Fos-L), consistent with reactivation of transcriptional plasticity. These findings identify ESCRT-I as a regulator of synaptic stability, positioning endosomal sorting pathways as a potential therapeutic target for schizophrenia.
items.authors: Shalaby, M.; Prato, V.; Elies, J. G.; Gamper, N.; Mclean, S. L.; Kantamneni, S.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，抑制ESCRT-I可以防止NMDAR功能低下，恢复突触稳态，提示其在精神分裂症治疗中的潜在应用。
items.l2_summary: N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体（NMDAR）功能低下是精神分裂症的一个核心病理机制，但直接增强NMDAR功能的临床效果有限，可能是因为未能解决受体运输和表面稳定性方面的缺陷。内源性排序复合体（ESCRT）在内化膜蛋白的溶酶体命运中起着重要作用，但其在谷氨酸能功能障碍期间对突触受体稳态的作用尚不清楚。非竞争性NMDAR拮抗剂氟氯噻吨（PCP）被广泛用于模拟NMDAR功能低下及精神分裂症样表型。本研究表明，亚慢性PCP暴露导致持久的NMDAR功能低下，抑制了GABA能传递，并破坏了兴奋/抑制（E/I）平衡。在小鼠原代海马神经元中，基因抑制ESCRT-I成分TSG101能够防止这些缺陷的发生，使得在PCP洗脱后功能得以恢复，并增加了功能性NMDAR和GABAA受体的表面表达，而未改变受体的药理特性或生物物理特性。在网络水平上，TSG101的敲低恢复了抑制性信号，正常化了兴奋性活动，并稳定了E/I平衡。此外，TSG101的敲低还挽救了PCP诱导的PSD-95和BDNF的减少，恢复了ERK1/2信号通路，并重新建立了依赖于活动的Fos样（Fos-L）核转位，表明转录可塑性的再激活。这些发现表明ESCRT-I作为突触稳定性的调节因子，为内源性排序通路作为精神分裂症潜在治疗靶点提供了新的视角。
items.title_zh: 抑制ESCRT-I保护NMDAR功能并恢复精神分裂症模型中的突触稳态
items.summary_zh: N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体（NMDAR）功能低下是精神分裂症的核心病理机制，但直接增强NMDAR功能的临床效果有限，可能是因为未能解决受体运输和表面稳定性的问题。内涵体排序复合物（ESCRT）负责内化膜蛋白的溶酶体命运，但其在谷氨酸功能障碍中的突触受体稳态中的作用尚不明确。我们使用非竞争性NMDAR拮抗剂氟环啶（PCP）模型研究NMDAR功能低下及精神分裂症表型。研究表明，亚慢性PCP暴露导致持久的NMDAR功能低下、GABA能传递受损及兴奋/抑制（E/I）平衡崩溃。基因抑制ESCRT-I成分TSG101可防止这些缺陷，促进PCP洗脱后的功能恢复，并增加功能性NMDAR和GABAA受体的表面表达。TSG101敲低恢复了抑制性信号、正常化了兴奋性活动并稳定了E/I平衡。

items.title: Ancestree: unified likelihood inference of ancestral alleles under supplied or inferred genealogies
items.abstract: Inferring ancestral states--determining, at each polymorphic site, which allele is ancestral and which derived--underpins many downstream population-genetic analyses, from selection scans and the unfolded site-frequency spectrum to demographic inference. However, no existing tool uniformly supports the full range of relevant inputs: plain variant data or ancestral recombination graphs (ARGs), with or without outgroups, while accommodating poly-allelic and recurrently-mutated sites. Here we present Ancestree, a likelihood-based engine that unifies these inputs within a single framework and returns full posteriors over the four nucleotide states at every site. It runs in three modes: a fixed-tree mode that assumes a single topology across sites and co-infers the per-branch substitution rates by maximum likelihood; an ARG mode that reads a different local tree at each site directly from a supplied ancestral recombination graph; and a local-tree mode that instead samples those local trees from the genotype data via a pairwise-coalescent HMM, needing no pre-existing ARG. On simulated data, the genealogy-based modes (ARG and local-tree) are more accurate and scale better, and remain robust under outgroup configurations that violate the fixed-tree assumption. Outgroups themselves remain difficult to replace: per-site inference accuracy on ingroup-polymorphic sites is markedly limited without them, and improves substantially with a single outgroup. The hardest sites are those fixed for the derived allele within the ingroup, which carry no within-ingroup signal and so need several sufficiently deep outgroups to recover, yet these are also highly informative downstream, carrying the high-frequency divergence signal on which selection and adaptation analyses often depend. Ancestree is available at github.com/Sendrowski/Ancestree.
items.authors: Sendrowski, J.; Bataillon, T.
items.l1_lead: Ancestree是一种统一的似然推断工具，能够在多种输入条件下准确推断祖先等位基因，为人口遗传学分析提供了强大的支持。
items.l2_summary:
在遗传学研究中，推断祖先状态，即确定每个多态位点的祖先等位基因和衍生等位基因，是许多后续种群遗传分析的基础，包括选择扫描、未展开的位点频率谱以及人口推断等。然而，目前尚无工具能够统一支持所有相关输入，包括简单的变异数据或祖先重组图（ARGs），同时兼顾多等位基因和重复突变位点。为此，研究团队推出了Ancestree，这是一种基于似然（likelihood）的引擎，能够在一个统一的框架内处理这些输入，并返回每个位点四种核苷酸状态的完整后验分布。

Ancestree具有三种运行模式：固定树模式（fixed-tree mode），假设所有位点共享同一拓扑结构，并通过最大似然法共同推断每条分支的替代率；ARG模式，直接从提供的祖先重组图中读取每个位点的不同局部树；以及局部树模式（local-tree mode），通过成对共祖隐马尔可夫模型（pairwise-coalescent HMM）从基因型数据中抽样局部树，无需预先存在的ARG。在模拟数据上，基于谱系的模式（ARG和局部树）表现出更高的准确性和更好的扩展性，并且在违反固定树假设的外群配置下仍然保持稳健性。

然而，外群的替代仍然是一个挑战：在没有外群的情况下，内群多态位点的逐位推断准确性显著受限，而引入一个外群后准确性大幅提高。尤其是那些在内群中固定为衍生等位基因的位点，因缺乏内群信号而难以恢复，需要多个足够深的外群来进行推断，但这些位点在后续分析中极具信息量，承载着选择和适应性分析所依赖的高频分歧信号。Ancestree的代码可在github.com/Sendrowski/Ancestree获取，为遗传学研究提供了一个强有力的工具。
items.title_zh: Ancestree：统一的祖先等位基因似然推断方法
items.summary_zh: 推断祖先状态，即确定每个多态位点的祖先等位基因和衍生等位基因，是许多下游群体遗传分析的基础。然而，现有工具无法统一支持所有相关输入，包括普通变异数据或祖先重组图（ARG），且需兼容多等位基因和重复突变位点。本文介绍了Ancestree，一个基于似然的引擎，将这些输入统一在一个框架内，并返回每个位点四种核苷酸状态的完整后验分布。它有三种运行模式：固定树模式、ARG模式和局部树模式。模拟数据表明，基于谱系的模式（ARG和局部树）更准确且扩展性更好，并在违反固定树假设的外群配置下保持稳健。

items.title: Towards reconstruction of the human interactome from positive and negative experimental evidence
items.abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) have been detected and reported in the millions, but while they are used in many different contexts for better understanding cellular processes in health and disease, the knowledge of the human PPI network is far from complete, containing many false positive measurements and being highly biased. Both to chart the extent of those problems and to solve them requires not just a knowledge of high-confidence positive interactions, but also likely non-interacting protein pairs. However, this information is typically not reported in PPI studies. We developed a methodology to reconstruct this knowledge from existing PPI data. We reconstruct the experimental search space in which PPI screens have been performed and then create a model that informs how likely a PPI is real given its testing and observation frequency. We argue that negative protein pairs allow us to estimate the error rates of experimental and computational screens. We show how this knowledge could be incorporated for calibration. Finally, we evaluate a simple machine learning approach to PPI prediction and propose how such negative data can be used for training instead of random protein pairs. Together, our results show that reconstructing the experimental search space recovers a largely overlooked layer of information from existing PPI data that can help guide a more accurate and complete mapping of the human interactome.
items.authors: As, J.; Pelz, K.; Bernett, J.; Battini, F.; List, M.; Blumenthal, D. B.; Schaefer, M. H.
items.l1_lead: 通过重建实验搜索空间并利用负交互蛋白对的信息，我们的方法能够提高人类蛋白质相互作用网络的准确性和完整性，从而更好地理解细胞过程。
items.l2_summary:
蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）在科学研究中被广泛检测和报告，数量已达数百万。然而，尽管这些相互作用在理解健康和疾病中的细胞过程方面具有重要意义，但人类PPI网络的知识仍然远未完整，存在许多假阳性测量，并且高度偏倚。为了解决这些问题，除了需要高置信度的正相互作用知识外，还需要了解可能不相互作用的蛋白质对。然而，这类信息在PPI研究中通常未被报告。为此，我们开发了一种方法论，以从现有的PPI数据中重建这一知识。

我们首先重建了进行PPI筛选实验的实验搜索空间，然后创建了一个模型，该模型能够根据测试和观察频率来评估某一PPI是否真实的可能性。我们认为，负向蛋白质对可以帮助我们估算实验和计算筛选的错误率。通过这一方法，我们展示了如何将这些知识纳入校准过程。最后，我们评估了一种简单的机器学习方法用于PPI预测，并提出如何利用负向数据进行训练，而不是随机选择蛋白质对。

我们的研究结果表明，重建实验搜索空间能够从现有的PPI数据中恢复出一个被忽视的重要信息层，这将有助于更准确和全面地绘制人类相互作用组（interactome）。通过整合正负相互作用的数据，我们能够提高PPI预测的准确性，为未来的生物医学研究提供更可靠的基础。
items.title_zh: 从实验证据重建人类相互作用组的研究
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）已被检测并报告数百万次，但人类PPI网络的知识仍不完整，存在许多假阳性测量且高度偏倚。为了解决这些问题，需要了解高置信度的正相互作用以及可能不相互作用的蛋白质对。然而，这些信息通常在PPI研究中未被报告。我们开发了一种方法，从现有PPI数据中重建这些知识。我们重建了进行PPI筛选的实验搜索空间，并创建了一个模型，用于评估PPI的真实性。我们认为，负蛋白质对可以帮助我们估计实验和计算筛选的错误率。最后，我们评估了一种简单的机器学习方法用于PPI预测，并提出如何利用负数据进行训练。我们的结果表明，重建实验搜索空间能够从现有PPI数据中恢复被忽视的信息层，有助于指导更准确的PPI预测。

items.title: Delta rhythm and voice familiarity organize neural entrainment in the infant brain
items.abstract: The delta frequency band (~0.5-3.5 Hz) represents a phylogenetically conserved tempo of biological communication, and neural entrainment to this timescale would be a key mechanism through which the brain might generate temporal predictions. While entrainment at different levels has been characterized in adults, the mechanisms of auditory temporal prediction remain poorly studied across developmental trajectories, particularly regarding the roles of stimulus rhythmicity, frequency specificity, and voice familiarity. Using high-density EEG, we examined neural entrainment in thirty 6-month-old infants exposed to vocally rhythmic syllables produced by their mother or a stranger at delta (2 Hz) or theta (4 Hz) rates, as well as a non-rhythmic control. Auditory temporal regularity elicited a broad frontotemporal entrainment response. Critically, delta-band entrainment was frequency-specific across frontal and temporal clusters, with right-frontal selectivity progressively strengthening throughout the entrainment period as expected if this region actively refines a temporal model of the input rather than passively resonating to it; no significant theta-band specificity was observed. Entrainment was further shaped by voice familiarity: the left temporal cortex entrained selectively to the mother's voice, whereas the right frontal cluster responded selectively to the stranger's voice. This is consistent with an implementation in which familiarity-based processing within mid-temporal language-related regions interfaces with novelty-sensitive frontal mechanisms, and reflects the ongoing updating of internal predictive models rather than passive sensory registration. The co-occurrence of frequency-specific delta entrainment and experience-dependent hemispheric asymmetries reveals a neural functional network for hierarchical temporal predictions, shaped by early auditory experience and already in place at 6 months.
items.authors: Rambosson, I.; Benis, D.; Barcos-Munoz, F.; Kabdebon, C.; Ceravolo, L.; Grandjean, D.; Filippa, M.
items.l1_lead: 婴儿大脑中的δ波节律与声音熟悉度共同影响神经同步，揭示了早期听觉经验在时间预测模型更新中的重要作用。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了δ波（delta rhythm，频率约为0.5-3.5 Hz）在婴儿大脑中如何通过声音熟悉度组织神经同步（neural entrainment）。δ波作为一种生物交流的节奏，可能是大脑生成时间预测的关键机制。尽管成年人在不同层次的同步机制已有研究，但在发展过程中，尤其是刺激的节奏性、频率特异性和声音熟悉度等方面的听觉时间预测机制尚未得到充分研究。研究使用高密度脑电图（EEG）对30名6个月大的婴儿进行实验，观察他们在接触母亲或陌生人发出的有节奏音节时的神经同步反应，刺激频率为δ波（2 Hz）或θ波（theta rhythm，4 Hz），同时设有非节奏控制组。

结果显示，听觉时间规律性引发了广泛的前颞叶同步反应。特别地，δ波同步在前额和颞叶区域表现出频率特异性，右前额区的选择性在同步期间逐渐增强，这表明该区域可能在积极地细化输入的时间模型，而非被动共振；而未观察到显著的θ波特异性。此外，声音熟悉度进一步影响了同步反应：左侧颞叶对母亲的声音表现出选择性同步，而右侧前额区则对陌生人的声音产生选择性反应。这与一种模型相一致，即在中颞叶语言相关区域的熟悉度处理与对新奇刺激敏感的前额机制相互作用，反映了内部预测模型的持续更新，而非被动的感官注册。

频率特异性的δ波同步与基于经验的半球不对称性共同出现，揭示了一个用于层次时间预测的神经功能网络，该网络受到早期听觉经验的影响，并在6个月时已初步形成。研究结果强调了声音熟悉度在婴儿听觉处理中的重要性，并为理解婴儿如何通过声音进行时间预测提供了新的视角。
items.title_zh: 婴儿大脑中的δ节律与声音熟悉度对神经同步的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了δ频率带（~0.5-3.5 Hz）在婴儿大脑中的神经同步机制，特别关注刺激的节奏性、频率特异性和声音熟悉度对听觉时间预测的影响。我们使用高密度脑电图（EEG）对30名6个月大的婴儿进行实验，观察他们在听到母亲或陌生人以δ（2 Hz）或θ（4 Hz）速率发出的有节奏音节时的神经同步反应。结果显示，听觉时间规律引发了广泛的额前颞部同步反应。重要的是，δ波段同步在额部和颞部区域表现出频率特异性，右额部的选择性在同步期间逐渐增强，表明该区域积极调整输入的时间模型。声音熟悉度进一步影响同步反应：左颞皮层对母亲的声音表现出选择性同步，而右额部对陌生人的声音则表现出选择性反应。

items.title: Cortical high frequency oscillations reflect encoding and retrieval of specific word concepts
items.abstract: High gamma and ripple frequency oscillations are engaged in encoding and recall of memory traces. Tracking specific traces with their signature neural activities across time and various tasks remains a major challenge. Using intracranial electrode recordings from epilepsy patients, we detected bursts of high-frequency oscillations in response to viewing and remembering the same common nouns in two different tasks repeated on subsequent days. We found the lowest word response selectivity of approximately 40% in the visual sensory areas and increasingly higher selectivity in the more anterior associational regions. The same word sets identified as preferred in a screening task triggered selective responses in another task during visual presentation or free recall with no sensory stimulation in the same session, and on the following day. We demonstrate that persistent reactivation of large-scale neuronal assemblies underlying particular concepts is reflected in bursts of high-frequency oscillations in the human cortex.
items.authors: Cimbalnik, J.; Prathapagiri, S.; Sarmiento-Rivera, L. F.; Jurkovicova, L.; Kojan, M.; Daniel, P.; Roman, R.; Czyzewski, A.; Brazdil, M.; Kucewicz, M. T.
items.l1_lead: 高频振荡在大脑皮层中反映了特定词汇概念的编码与提取，显示出神经元集群的持续重激活。
items.l2_summary: 本研究探讨了高伽马（high gamma）和涟漪（ripple）频率振荡在记忆编码和回忆特定词汇概念中的作用。通过对癫痫患者进行颅内电极记录，我们能够检测到在不同任务中观看和记忆相同名词时产生的高频振荡突发。这些任务在不同的日子重复进行。研究发现，在视觉感知区域，词汇反应选择性最低，约为40%；而在更前面的联想区域，选择性则显著提高。相同的词汇集合在筛选任务中被识别为偏好词汇，并在视觉呈现或自由回忆的任务中触发了选择性反应，这些反应在同一会话中没有感官刺激，并且在第二天也得到了验证。我们的研究表明，特定概念背后的大规模神经元集合的持续再激活通过人类皮层中高频振荡的突发得以反映。这一发现为理解记忆的神经机制提供了重要的证据，强调了高频振荡在记忆过程中的关键角色。
items.title_zh: 皮层高频振荡反映特定词概念的编码与提取
items.summary_zh: 高伽马和涟漪频率振荡参与记忆痕迹的编码与回忆。通过对癫痫患者的颅内电极记录，我们检测到在不同任务中观看和记忆相同名词时的高频振荡突发。我们发现视觉感知区域的最低词响应选择性约为40%，而在更前部的联想区域选择性逐渐提高。相同的词组在筛选任务中被识别为优选词，在视觉呈现或自由回忆的另一任务中触发选择性反应，且在同一会话中没有感官刺激，第二天也能重复出现。我们证明了特定概念下大规模神经元集合的持续再激活在人的皮层中以高频振荡突发的形式反映出来。

items.title: An updated roadmap for brain-mental health associations in the UK Biobank
items.abstract: The UK Biobank offers an unprecedented opportunity to examine associations between brain imaging and mental health at scale, but their magnitude and replicability remain unclear. We correlated 17,580 imaging-derived phenotypes across seven MRI modalities with 309 mental health phenotypes in 8,415 participants, split into discovery and validation subsets. Associations were generally small (median |r| = 0.018; top 1% of 0.108), and they replicated poorly: only 9.0% of significant discovery associations were significant in validation. Eating disorders showed the largest effects of any mental disorders but replicated in only 6.0% of cases, whereas substance use showed the highest replication (14.5%). Susceptibility-weighted imaging produced the most replicable imaging associations. Longitudinal changes in brain and mental health measures were weakly related. We provide an interactive dashboard that returns the effect-size and replicability benchmarks for any combination of mental health category and imaging modality, supporting variable selection and study design in UK Biobank research.
items.authors: Li, X.; Khalife, S.; Oestreich, L. K. L.
items.l1_lead: UK Biobank研究显示，脑成像与心理健康之间的关联普遍较小且复制性差，尤其是饮食失调的影响最大，但仅有6%的案例能够复制。
items.l2_summary: UK生物库（UK Biobank）为大规模研究脑成像与心理健康之间的关联提供了前所未有的机会，但这些关联的强度和可重复性仍不明确。本研究分析了17,580种基于成像的表型（phenotypes）与309种心理健康表型在8,415名参与者中的关联，这些参与者被分为发现组和验证组。结果显示，关联通常较小（中位数|r| = 0.018；前1%的关联为0.108），且可重复性较差：在发现组中显著的关联中，仅有9.0%在验证组中也显著。饮食失调（eating disorders）在所有心理障碍中表现出最大的效应，但在验证中仅有6.0%的案例得以重复，而物质使用（substance use）的重复率最高，达14.5%。此外，采用易感性加权成像（susceptibility-weighted imaging）的方法产生了最具可重复性的成像关联。纵向研究显示，脑部和心理健康指标的变化之间关系较弱。为了支持UK生物库研究中的变量选择和研究设计，我们提供了一个互动仪表板，能够返回任何心理健康类别与成像模式组合的效应大小和可重复性基准。这项研究为理解脑成像与心理健康之间的复杂关系提供了重要的基础数据，但也提示了在此领域内进行更深入研究的必要性。
items.title_zh: 英国生物库中脑与心理健康关联的更新路线图
items.summary_zh: 英国生物库提供了一个前所未有的机会，以大规模研究脑成像与心理健康之间的关联，但其强度和可重复性仍不明确。我们在8,415名参与者中，分析了17,580个成像衍生表型与309个心理健康表型的相关性，分为发现和验证子集。结果显示，关联通常较小（中位数|r| = 0.018；前1%为0.108），且重复性差：仅9.0%的显著发现关联在验证中显著。饮食失调表现出最大的影响，但仅在6.0%的案例中重复，而物质使用的重复性最高（14.5%）。加权成像产生了最具可重复性的成像关联。脑与心理健康指标的纵向变化关系较弱。我们提供了一个互动仪表板，返回任何心理健康类别与成像模式组合的效应大小和可重复性基准，支持英国生物库研究中的变量选择和研究设计。

items.title: Active Bed Microclimate Regulation Modulates Sleep Architecture, Autonomic, and Central Nervous System Activity during Sleep
items.abstract: Skin temperature and bed microclimate are established modulators of human sleep, but most prior work has relied on passive thermal materials. We used a smart bed capable of heating or cooling the microclimate to investigate how six temperature settings affect sleep architecture, autonomic activity, and electroencephalographic (EEG) activity. Eighteen adults (9 male, 9 female; mean age 44.5 years) completed two overnight polysomnography sessions with bed temperature assigned via Latin-square counterbalancing across three-hour segments of high cooling, medium cooling, low cooling, off, low heating, and medium heating. Mixed-effects regression models evaluated manipulation checks on induced thermal changes, the probability of sleep versus wake, and the probability of each sleep stage (N1, N2, N3, REM), while secondary analyses assessed sleep deepening, heart rate, and EEG spectral power. Temperature manipulations significantly affected sleep and physiological outcomes. All five active settings shifted sleep toward greater depth, increasing the odds of slow-wave sleep (odds ratios 1.21 to 3.65, largest for high cooling) and reducing the odds of light non-rapid eye movement sleep relative to off. Heating accelerated early sleep deepening relative to cooling without significantly altering sleep onset latency, whereas cooling produced a graded reduction in heart rate. EEG analyses revealed distinct cortical signatures for heating and cooling conditions. These findings demonstrate that active bed microclimate regulation modulates sleep architecture, autonomic activity, and cortical activity during sleep. The nonlinear pattern of effects suggests thermal "sweet spots" that may vary across the night and individuals, supporting the development of individualized programmable temperature-regulation strategies for sleep optimization.
items.authors: Garcia Molina, G. N.; Rao, M. R.; Winger, T.; Chernega, P.; Shcherbakov, Y.; Veneros, E.; Reid, K. J.; Grimaldi, D.; Van Someren, E.; Zee, P.
items.l1_lead: 主动调节床铺微气候显著影响睡眠结构、自主神经系统和大脑活动，表明个性化温度调节策略可优化睡眠质量。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了床铺微气候对人类睡眠的影响，特别是通过主动调节床铺温度来研究其对睡眠结构、自主神经系统活动和脑电图（EEG）活动的调节作用。以18名成年人（9名男性和9名女性，平均年龄44.5岁）为研究对象，参与者完成了两次过夜多导睡眠监测（polysomnography）实验，床铺温度通过拉丁方平衡法在六种设置下进行调节：高冷却、中冷却、低冷却、关闭、低加热和中加热，每种设置持续三个小时。研究采用混合效应回归模型评估温度变化的影响、清醒与睡眠的概率以及各个睡眠阶段（N1、N2、N3、REM）的概率，同时进行次要分析以评估睡眠加深、心率和EEG频谱功率。

结果显示，温度调节显著影响了睡眠及生理结果。所有五种主动设置均使睡眠更深，增加了慢波睡眠的发生概率（比值比从1.21到3.65，最高为高冷却），同时相较于关闭状态，轻度非快速眼动睡眠的发生概率则降低。加热条件下，早期睡眠加深的速度较冷却条件更快，但对入睡潜伏期没有显著影响，而冷却则导致心率逐渐降低。EEG分析显示，加热和冷却条件下的皮层活动具有明显的特征差异。

这些发现表明，主动调节床铺微气候能够有效调节睡眠结构、自主神经活动和皮层活动。研究结果呈现出非线性的影响模式，暗示存在不同个体和夜间时段的“最佳温度区”，为个性化的可编程温度调节策略在睡眠优化中的应用提供了支持。
items.title_zh: 主动床垫微气候调节影响睡眠结构与神经系统活动
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了床垫微气候对睡眠的影响，使用一款智能床具调节温度，研究对象为18名成年人（9名男性，9名女性，平均年龄44.5岁）。参与者在两次过夜多导睡眠监测中，床温通过拉丁方设计在高冷、中冷、低冷、关闭、低热和中热六种设置中轮换。混合效应回归模型评估了温度变化对睡眠与清醒状态及各睡眠阶段（N1、N2、N3、REM）的影响。结果显示，所有五种主动设置均显著加深睡眠，增加慢波睡眠的几率（几率比1.21至3.65，以高冷为最大），并降低轻度非快速眼动睡眠的几率。加热相较于冷却加速了早期睡眠的深化，而心率则随着冷却呈现逐步下降。

items.title: Profile of the digestive and absorptive functions in the intestine of fish with different dietary habits and in response to increased dietary carbohydrate or protein.
items.abstract: Global aquaculture has grown significantly, but to maintain current consumption, supply must double over the next 20 years. Here, we characterised the digestive and absorptive capacities in the intestines of three commercially important, farmed fish species with varying natural diets: Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), common carp (Cyprinus carpio ), and rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss). Disaccharidase activity (maltase, sucrase) and sodium-dependent D-glucose absorption were highest in Nile tilapia, followed by common carp, and lowest in rainbow trout. We found regional intestinal differences in disaccharidase activity and SGLT1 expression in the three species. Aminopeptidase A (APA) and aminopeptidase N (APN) activities were typically highest in Nile tilapia. Intestinal expression of the neutral amino acid transporter B0AT1 was approx. double in tilapia and carp compared to trout. We also assessed common carp, zebrafish and Rainbow trout's digestion profile when fed low-carbohydrate/high protein and high-carbohydrate/low-protein diets. Common carp and zebrafish adapted to high-carbohydrate diets by up-regulating both digestive enzymes and SGLT1. Common carp increased SGLT1 protein abundance 2.7-fold in the foregut and 4.6-fold in the hindgut. Rainbow trout increased disaccharidase activity but not SGLT1 expression in response to a high-carbohydrate diet. Both Rainbow trout and common carp down-regulated their APN activity but upregulated their B0AT1 expression 2-fold in response to increased dietary protein. These physiological limitations are critical considerations for formulating sustainable plant-based aquafeeds.
items.authors: Moran, A. W.; Al-rammahi, M.; Bristow, R. L.; Magee, K.; Shirazi-Beechey, S. P.
items.l1_lead: 不同饮食习惯的鱼类在肠道消化和吸收功能上存在显著差异，尤其在应对高碳水化合物或高蛋白饮食时，影响可持续水产饲料的配方。
items.l2_summary:
全球水产养殖业发展迅速，但为了维持当前的消费水平，未来20年内供应量必须翻倍。本研究对三种重要的养殖鱼类——尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）、普通鲤鱼（Cyprinus carpio）和虹鳟鱼（Oncorhynchus mykiss）的肠道消化和吸收能力进行了表征，这三种鱼类在自然饮食上存在差异。研究发现，尼罗罗非鱼的双糖酶活性（如麦芽糖酶和蔗糖酶）和钠依赖性D-葡萄糖吸收能力最高，其次是普通鲤鱼，而虹鳟鱼则最低。此外，三种鱼类在肠道不同区域的双糖酶活性和SGLT1（钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白1）表达也存在区域差异。氨肽酶A（APA）和氨肽酶N（APN）的活性通常在尼罗罗非鱼中最高，而中性氨基酸转运蛋白B0AT1的肠道表达在罗非鱼和鲤鱼中约为虹鳟鱼的两倍。

研究还评估了普通鲤鱼、斑马鱼和虹鳟鱼在低碳水化合物/高蛋白和高碳水化合物/低蛋白饮食下的消化特征。普通鲤鱼和斑马鱼在高碳水化合物饮食中通过上调消化酶和SGLT1来适应，普通鲤鱼在前肠和后肠中SGLT1蛋白丰度分别增加了2.7倍和4.6倍。相比之下，虹鳟鱼在高碳水化合物饮食下增加了双糖酶活性，但未增加SGLT1的表达。在应对增加的饮食蛋白时，虹鳟鱼和普通鲤鱼均下调了APN活性，但B0AT1的表达则上调了两倍。这些生理限制在制定可持续植物基水产饲料时是重要的考虑因素。通过对不同饮食习惯的鱼类消化吸收功能的研究，为未来水产养殖的饲料配方提供了科学依据。
items.title_zh: 不同饮食习惯鱼类肠道消化吸收功能特征研究
items.summary_zh: 全球水产养殖显著增长，但未来20年需将供应量翻倍以维持消费水平。本研究对三种重要养殖鱼类（尼罗罗非鱼、鲤鱼和虹鳟鱼）的肠道消化和吸收能力进行了表征。结果显示，尼罗罗非鱼的双糖酶活性（麦芽糖酶、蔗糖酶）和钠依赖性D-葡萄糖吸收能力最高，其次是鲤鱼，虹鳟鱼最低。三种鱼类在肠道不同区域的双糖酶活性和SGLT1表达存在差异。氨肽酶A（APA）和氨肽酶N（APN）活性在尼罗罗非鱼中通常最高。尼罗罗非鱼和鲤鱼的中性氨基酸转运蛋白B0AT1的肠道表达约为虹鳟鱼的两倍。此外，鲤鱼和斑马鱼在高碳水化合物饮食中通过上调消化酶和SGLT1适应，而虹鳟鱼则在高碳水化合物饮食中增加了双糖酶活性，但未增加SGLT1表达。

items.title: DiffDose: Differentiable Programming for Personalized Dose-Regimen Optimal Control
items.abstract: Dose-regimen design requires choosing how much drug to give, when to give it, and how treatment should vary across patients. Mechanistic pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) and quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) models can predict treatment responses, but optimizing dosing inputs depends on model-specific sensitivity derivations or derivative-free search. Here, we introduce DiffDose, a differentiable programming framework for mechanistic open-loop dose-regimen optimization that uses automatic differentiation (AD) to handle clinically interpretable dose amounts and administration times as differentiable controls. We evaluate our method in three settings: fixed-schedule dose-amplitude optimization in OptiDose PK/PD benchmarks; dose-timing optimization in a chemotherapy-induced neutropenia model with state-dependent delay; and individualized mosunetuzumab dosing in a QSP virtual population. Across these examples, AD produced gradients consistent with references, reduced model-specific derivative work, and shortened benchmark time to solution. DiffDose thereby turns mechanistic PK/PD and QSP models from tools that evaluate prespecified regimens into gradient-based engines for individualized regimen design.
items.authors: Hajhashemi, S.; Emad, A.; Craig, M.
items.l1_lead: DiffDose是一种可微编程框架，通过自动微分优化个性化给药方案，使药物剂量和给药时间的选择更加高效和精准。
items.l2_summary:
在药物剂量方案设计中，如何选择给药量、给药时间以及如何根据患者的差异调整治疗方案是一个复杂的任务。传统的机制性药代动力学-药效学（PK/PD）模型和定量系统药理学（QSP）模型能够预测治疗反应，但优化给药输入通常依赖于特定模型的灵敏度推导或无导数搜索。为此，研究者们提出了DiffDose，这是一个用于机制性开放式剂量方案优化的可微编程框架。DiffDose利用自动微分（AD）技术，将临床可解释的给药量和给药时间视为可微控制变量，从而简化了优化过程。

在三个不同的应用场景中评估了该方法的有效性：首先是在OptiDose PK/PD基准测试中进行固定时间表的剂量幅度优化；其次是在化疗引起的中性粒细胞减少症模型中进行剂量时机优化，该模型具有状态依赖延迟；最后是在QSP虚拟人群中进行个性化的mosunetuzumab给药优化。在这些示例中，自动微分产生的梯度与参考结果一致，显著减少了模型特定的导数计算工作，并缩短了基准测试的解决时间。通过这些成果，DiffDose将机制性PK/PD和QSP模型从评估预设方案的工具转变为基于梯度的个性化方案设计引擎，展示了其在个性化医疗中的潜力和应用价值。
items.title_zh: DiffDose：个性化给药方案的可微编程优化控制
items.summary_zh: 给药方案设计需要选择药物剂量、给药时间以及治疗在不同患者间的变化。机制性药代动力学-药效学（PK/PD）和定量系统药理学（QSP）模型能够预测治疗反应，但优化给药输入依赖于特定模型的灵敏度推导或无导数搜索。本文介绍了DiffDose，一个用于机制性开环给药方案优化的可微编程框架，利用自动微分（AD）处理临床可解释的剂量和给药时间作为可微控制变量。我们在三个场景中评估了该方法：在OptiDose PK/PD基准中的固定时间表剂量幅度优化；在具有状态依赖延迟的化疗诱导中性粒细胞减少症模型中的给药时机优化；以及在QSP虚拟人群中的个性化mosunetuzumab给药。通过这些例子，AD生成的梯度与参考结果一致，减少了模型特定的导数工作，并缩短了基准求解时间。因此，DiffDose将机制性PK/PD和QSP模型从评估预设方案的工具转变为基于梯度的个性化方案设计引擎。

items.title: A single-cell view of human tissue aging reveals architectural decline beyond cellular composition
items.abstract: Aging reshapes the human body at the cellular level, yet how cell identity, morphology, and spatial organization remodel across organs and the adult lifespan remains poorly mapped, at a scale and lifespan coverage that molecular spatial assays cannot yet reach. Treating the GTEx histopathology archive as a population-scale, lifespan-resolved resource for spatial biology, we detected over 3.5 billion single cells across 16 human organs from nearly one thousand individuals. Cell density declined pervasively but organ-specifically, and vision-language phenotyping resolved epithelial cells into nine subtypes with divergent aging trajectories, including loss of ovarian granulosa cells at ~45% per decade. Community detection on spatial cell graphs identified functional tissue units, over a quarter of which remodeled with age along a shared trajectory from dense, specialized units toward sparser, stromal- and immune-enriched structures. Critically, this architectural remodeling was largely decoupled from cell composition (R2=0.07), showing that human tissues age along two partly independent axes, a pervasive loss of cells and a distinct remodeling of the architecture they form, with structural decline exceeding what cellular composition alone predicts.
items.authors: Abila, E.; Zheng, Y.; Bago-Horvath, Z.; Rendeiro, A. F.
items.l1_lead: 人类组织在衰老过程中经历细胞数量减少和结构重塑，这种结构性衰退超出了细胞组成的变化，显示出衰老的复杂性。
items.l2_summary: 研究表明，衰老在细胞层面重塑了人类身体，但细胞身份、形态和空间组织在不同器官及成年生命周期中的变化仍未得到充分的映射。为了解这一现象，研究团队利用GTEx组织病理学档案作为一个涵盖人群规模和生命周期的空间生物学资源，检测了近千名个体的16个人体器官中超过35亿个单细胞。结果显示，细胞密度在各个器官中普遍下降，但这种下降具有器官特异性。通过视觉-语言表型分析，研究将上皮细胞分为九个亚型，这些亚型在衰老过程中表现出不同的轨迹，其中卵巢颗粒细胞的损失约为每十年45%。此外，基于空间细胞图的社区检测识别出功能性组织单元，其中超过四分之一的单元随着年龄的增长而重塑，呈现出从密集、专业化单元向稀疏、富含基质和免疫细胞的结构转变。重要的是，这种建筑结构的重塑与细胞组成的变化在很大程度上是解耦的（R²=0.07），这表明人类组织的衰老沿着两个部分独立的轴线进行：一方面是细胞的普遍损失，另一方面是它们所形成的建筑结构的独特重塑，且结构的衰退程度超出了仅凭细胞组成所能预测的范围。通过这一研究，揭示了衰老过程中人类组织的复杂变化，强调了细胞组成与组织架构之间的独立性及其对衰老理解的重要性。
items.title_zh: 单细胞视角下的人体组织衰老揭示超越细胞组成的结构性衰退
items.summary_zh: 衰老在细胞层面重塑人体，但细胞身份、形态及空间组织如何在不同器官和成人生命周期中变化尚不明确。我们将GTEx组织病理档案视为一个涵盖人群规模和生命周期的空间生物学资源，检测到近千名个体的16个人体器官中超过35亿个单细胞。细胞密度普遍下降，但具有器官特异性。视觉-语言表型分析将上皮细胞分为九个亚型，显示出不同的衰老轨迹，包括卵巢颗粒细胞在每十年约减少45%。空间细胞图上的社区检测识别出功能性组织单元，其中超过四分之一随着年龄沿着共享轨迹重塑，从密集的专门单元转向稀疏的基质和免疫富集结构。重要的是，这种结构重塑与细胞组成大体解耦，显示人类组织沿着两个部分独立的轴线衰老：细胞的普遍丧失和它们形成的结构的显著重塑，结构性衰退超出了细胞组成的预测。

items.title: The evaluation of the SumiOne™ spatial emanators against wild Anopheles funestus in experimental huts in Siaya County, western Kenya
items.abstract: Background Spatial Emanators (SEs) are a promising tool for complementing existing malaria vector control interventions. In 2025, the World Health Organization (WHO) issued a conditional recommendation for SEs, and two transfluthrin-based products were added to the WHO Prequalification List. As SEs are scaled up, additional products are needed to ensure reliable supply, competitive pricing, and continued innovation. Methods This study evaluated the efficacy of SumiOne SE, containing 10% metofluthrin, in experimental huts in Siaya County, western Kenya. SumiOne SE efficacy was evaluated in six experimental huts, three intervention and three control, using human landing catches (HLCs) and aspiration. Collections were conducted in two 12-night phases, alternating between HLC and aspiration every six nights. Outcomes included reductions in human landing rates, density, exophily and blood feeding inhibition of Anopheles mosquitoes. Results SumiOne SE significantly reduced indoor densities of An. funestus with 63% protective effect (IRR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.20-0.69, p = 0.0087). Overall An. funestus density (indoor and outdoor combined) was reduced by 58% (IRR=0.42, 95% CI: 0.22-0.79; p=0.0222). The rate of exophily of An. funestus exiting was 34% (95% CI: 27-42) in the intervention huts compared to 2% (95% CI: 1-4) in the control huts (p< 0.0001). Blood feeding inhibition for An. funestus was 46% with 44% (95% CI: 36-51) of the collected mosquitoes being blood fed in the intervention huts compared to 81% (95% CI: 76-86) blood fed in the control huts, (p<0.0001). Conclusion These findings support SumiOne SEs potential as a complementary vector control tool, alongside existing core interventions such as Insecticide Treated Nets and Indoor Residual Spraying, particularly in contexts where additional protection is needed.
items.authors: Omondi, S.; Agumba, S.; Kipsum, M.; Moshi, V.; Muchoki, M.; Abongo, B.; Polo, B.; Kosgei, J.; Hudson, A.; Achee, N.; Lukhoba, C. W.; Mukabana, W. R.; Ochomo, E.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，SumiOne空间发射器在肯尼亚西部有效减少了疟疾传播蚊虫Anopheles funestus的密度和吸血率，显示出作为补充防控工具的潜力。
items.l2_summary:
本研究评估了SumiOne™空间释放器（Spatial Emanators, SEs）在肯尼亚西部Siaya县对野生恶性疟蚊（Anopheles funestus）的效果。空间释放器作为一种新兴的疟疾媒介控制工具，得到了世界卫生组织（WHO）在2025年的有条件推荐，并且两种基于氟氯氰菊酯（transfluthrin）的产品被列入WHO预认证名单。随着空间释放器的推广，亟需更多产品以确保可靠供应、竞争定价和持续创新。

在本研究中，研究团队在Siaya县的六个实验小屋中评估了含有10%美氟氯菊酯（metofluthrin）的SumiOne SE的有效性。实验设计包括三个干预小屋和三个对照小屋，采用人类捕蚊（Human Landing Catches, HLCs）和吸引法进行蚊虫采集，分为两个12晚的阶段，每六晚交替进行HLC和吸引法。研究结果显示，SumiOne SE显著降低了室内恶性疟蚊的密度，保护效果达到63%（发病率比IRR = 0.37，95%置信区间CI: 0.20-0.69，p = 0.0087）。总体上，室内外结合的恶性疟蚊密度降低了58%（IRR=0.42，95% CI: 0.22-0.79；p=0.0222）。在干预小屋中，恶性疟蚊的外逃率为34%（95% CI: 27-42），而对照小屋仅为2%（95% CI: 1-4）（p< 0.0001）。此外，恶性疟蚊的吸血抑制率为46%，在干预小屋中收集的蚊虫中有44%（95% CI: 36-51）为吸血蚊，而对照小屋中吸血蚊的比例高达81%（95% CI: 76-86）（p<0.0001）。

综上所述，这些发现支持SumiOne SE作为一种补充的媒介控制工具的潜力，尤其是在需要额外保护的环境中，可以与现有的核心干预措施如杀虫剂处理网（Insecticide Treated Nets）和室内残留喷洒（Indoor Residual Spraying）相结合使用。
items.title_zh: SumiOne™空间发散器对安opheles funestus的评估研究
items.summary_zh: 背景 空间发散器（SEs）是一种有前景的工具，用于补充现有的疟疾媒介控制干预措施。本研究评估了含10%美托氟虫腈的SumiOne SE在肯尼亚西部Siaya县实验小屋中的有效性。方法 在六个实验小屋中进行评估，其中三个为干预组，三个为对照组，采用人类捕虫（HLC）和吸引法进行数据收集。研究分为两个12夜阶段，每六夜交替进行HLC和吸引法。结果 SumiOne SE显著降低了室内安. funestus的密度，保护效果为63%（IRR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.20-0.69, p = 0.0087）。总体安. funestus密度（室内和室外合计）降低了58%（IRR=0.42, 95% CI: 0.22-0.79; p=0.0222）。干预小屋中安. funestus的外逃率为34%（95% CI: 27-42），对照小屋为2%（95% CI: 1-4）（p< 0.0001）。

items.title: Losses outlast gains in Northern Hemisphere tree growth under climate change
items.abstract: Under climate change, will forests grow more or less? The answer differs from place to place, obscuring the overall direction. Here we trace it by learning nonlinear climate--tree-growth relationships from 4110 Northern Hemisphere tree-ring chronologies recorded since 1902, spanning more than 12 million ring-width measurements, and projecting them through the twenty-first century under CMIP6 scenarios. Projected growth declines, and gains and losses are temporally asymmetric: once losses emerge, they are rarely reversed (90% retained), whereas gains fade (56% retained). This asymmetry holds in every well-sampled region and strengthens under higher forcing. The decline itself is driven by warming and rising atmospheric water demand, whose broadly negative contribution outweighs precipitation-driven gains. Across the Northern Hemisphere, growth does not just move between gains and losses; it is drawn steadily downward.
items.authors: Feuer, E.; Klesse, S.; Amir, G.; Peleg, N.; Mau, Y.
items.l1_lead: 在气候变化的影响下，北半球森林的生长呈现出非对称性，损失一旦出现难以逆转，而增长则容易减弱，整体趋势是持续下降。
items.l2_summary:
在气候变化的背景下，北半球的森林生长趋势呈现出复杂的地域差异，难以明确判断其整体走向。为了解这一问题，研究者分析了自1902年以来记录的4110个北半球树木年轮（tree-ring）年表，涵盖超过1200万次年轮宽度测量数据，并在CMIP6（气候模型比较计划第六阶段）情景下对未来21世纪的树木生长进行了预测。研究结果显示，预计树木生长将出现下降趋势，且增长与损失之间的时间不对称性明显：一旦出现生长损失，这种损失很少会被逆转，保留率高达90%；而生长收益的保留率仅为56%。这种不对称性在每个样本充分的区域中均得到了验证，并且在更高的气候强迫下更加显著。

树木生长的下降主要受到气温升高和大气水分需求增加的驱动，这两者的负面影响显著超过了降水带来的正面效应。总体而言，北半球的树木生长并不仅仅是在收益与损失之间波动，而是呈现出持续向下的趋势。这一发现强调了气候变化对森林生态系统的深远影响，提示我们在应对气候变化时需更加关注树木生长的长期变化及其潜在后果。
items.title_zh: 气候变化下北半球树木生长的损失超过收益
items.summary_zh: 在气候变化的背景下，北半球森林的生长趋势因地区而异，整体方向不明。本文通过分析自1902年以来记录的4110个北半球树木年轮年表，涵盖超过1200万次年轮宽度测量，学习非线性气候与树木生长的关系，并在CMIP6情景下预测其在21世纪的发展。结果显示，预计生长将下降，收益和损失在时间上不对称：一旦出现损失，几乎无法逆转（保留率90%），而收益则会减弱（保留率56%）。这种不对称在每个样本充分的区域均存在，并在更高的强迫下加剧。生长下降主要受气温上升和大气水分需求增加的驱动，其负面影响超过了降水带来的收益。整体来看，北半球的树木生长趋势是持续向下的。

items.title: A De Novo, Intragenic Modifier in Cis Rescues Scn8a-N1768D Epilepsy and Defines a Therapeutic Window Bounded by Gain- and Loss-of-Function
items.abstract: Gain-of-function variants in SCN8A, encoding NaV1.6, cause developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with early-onset, drug-resistant seizures. SCN8A is a Goldilocks gene: both excess and deficit of NaV1.6 are deleterious, so therapies that lower NaV1.6 must operate within a narrow window. Here we characterize a congenic C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J colony carrying Scn8a-N1768D and identify a tightly linked, cis-acting modifier (L) that converts a severe phenotype into graded outcomes. Among N1768D homozygotes on a 98.4% C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J background, three phenotypes segregate: short-lived (SL) mice with early lethal tonic-clonic seizures (TCS), long-lived (LL) mice with delayed onset and reduced seizure burden, and hindlimb-paralysis (HP) mice with early death. Heterozygotes separate into D/+ SL mice, which develop spontaneous TCS and die of epilepsy, and D/+ LL mice, which lack spontaneous TCS and epilepsy-related death. Genetic analysis places a second locus (L) tightly linked to Scn8a and co-segregating with phenotype. Hippocampal RNA-seq shows dose-dependent Scn8a mRNA reduction: none in SL (D+/D+), 30% in LL (DL/D+), and 70% in HP (DL/DL). Long-read trio DNA sequencing identifies a de novo 2-bp frameshift in coding exon 15 of Scn8a, in cis with N1768D, that introduces a premature stop codon ~26 kb upstream of the exon--exon junction, predicted to trigger nonsense-mediated decay. Allele-specific read counting confirms selective, cis-acting loss of DL transcripts with preserved D+ output. Thus, a de novo, intragenic frameshift variant titrates NaV1.6 through a Goldilocks window in which intermediate reduction rescues Gain-of-function epilepsy, whereas insufficient or excessive reduction remains lethal, validating Scn8a-lowering and its therapeutic dose window.
items.authors: Bahramnejad, E.; Hammer, M. F.; Hiller, V. J.
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，SCN8A基因内的一个新型变异能够在特定范围内调节NaV1.6的表达，从而缓解由Gain-of-function引起的癫痫症状，验证了治疗的剂量窗口。
items.l2_summary:
SCN8A基因编码的NaV1.6通道的功能变异与早发性、药物抗性癫痫及发育性脑病密切相关。该基因被称为“金发姑娘基因”，因为NaV1.6的过量或不足均会导致有害后果，因此降低NaV1.6的治疗策略必须在一个狭窄的窗口内进行。本研究对携带Scn8a-N1768D突变的C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J小鼠进行了表型分析，发现一个紧密相关的顺式调节因子（L）能够将严重表型转变为不同程度的结果。在98.4% C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J背景下的N1768D纯合子小鼠中，观察到三种表型：短命小鼠（SL）表现出早期致命的强直-阵挛性癫痫发作（TCS），长命小鼠（LL）则表现出发作延迟和减轻的癫痫负担，而后肢瘫痪小鼠（HP）则早期死亡。杂合子小鼠分为D/+ SL小鼠，表现出自发性TCS并因癫痫死亡，以及D/+ LL小鼠，未出现自发性TCS和与癫痫相关的死亡。

通过遗传分析，研究发现第二个与Scn8a紧密相关的位点（L）与表型共分离。海马体RNA测序显示Scn8a mRNA的剂量依赖性减少：SL小鼠（D+/D+）没有表达，LL小鼠（DL/D+）减少30%，而HP小鼠（DL/DL）减少70%。长读长三重DNA测序鉴定出一个新的2-bp框移位突变，位于Scn8a的编码外显子15中，与N1768D顺式共存，预计会在外显子-外显子连接处引入一个提前终止密码子，导致无义介导降解。等位基因特异性读取计数确认了DL转录本的选择性顺式丧失，同时保留了D+的输出。因此，这一新的、基因内的框移位变异通过调节NaV1.6的表达，在一个“金发姑娘窗口”内实现了对Gain-of-function癫痫的拯救，而不足或过量的降低则会致命，从而验证了降低Scn8a的治疗潜力及其治疗剂量窗口。
items.title_zh: 新型顺式修饰因子拯救Scn8a-N1768D癫痫并界定治疗窗口
items.summary_zh: SCN8A基因编码NaV1.6，其功能变异导致早发性、耐药性癫痫及发育性脑病。研究表明，NaV1.6的过量或不足均有害，因此降低NaV1.6的治疗需在狭窄窗口内进行。我们对携带Scn8a-N1768D的C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J同系群进行表征，发现一个紧密连锁的顺式修饰因子(L)，将严重表型转变为分级结果。在98.4% C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J背景下的N1768D纯合子中，分离出三种表型：短命(SL)小鼠、长命(LL)小鼠和后肢瘫痪(HP)小鼠。遗传分析显示第二个位点(L)与Scn8a紧密连锁并共分离。海马RNA-seq结果显示Scn8a mRNA呈剂量依赖性减少：SL组无表达，LL组减少30%，HP组减少70%。长读长三重DNA测序发现Scn8a编码外显子15中存在一个新型2-bp移码突变，导致提前终止密码子，预计会触发无义介导降解。

items.title: Genomic evidence for Z-W differentiation in Pacific saury (Cololabis saira) and sex-chromosome diversity in Beloniformes
items.abstract: Genetic sex-determination mechanisms evolve rapidly in teleost fishes and are diverse within Beloniformes. In the present study, the sex-determination system of Pacific saury (Cololabis saira) was confirmed using double-digest, restriction-site-associated DNA sequencing (ddRAD-seq) and pooled whole-genome sequencing (Pool-seq), and a DNA marker was developed for inferring genetic sex. DNA sequence analysis detected numerous markers occurring predominantly or exclusively in phenotypic females suggesting a ZZ/ZW sex-determination system. Mapping of ddRAD-seq loci showed that these markers were concentrated within a 3-19 Mb region of chromosome 17 (Chr17). Pool-seq analyses also revealed elevated FST, sex-specific differences in sequencing depth, and nucleotide diversity within this region, supporting a ZZ/ZW sex-determination system involving Chr17. A PCR marker designated female-specific 1 (FS1), developed from a female-associated ddRAD sequence unmapped from the male-derived reference genome, was detected in all 43 phenotypic females and none of the 50 phenotypic males collected in 2025. In an independent sample collected in 2026, FS1 was detected in all 19 phenotypic females and one of the 29 phenotypic males, resulting in 97.9% concordance with phenotypic sex. The FS1-positive male may represent a genotypic-phenotypic sex mismatch or reflect recombination between FS1 and the causal sex-determining region; the linkage of FS1 to the W chromosome remains unconfirmed. Chromosome-scale synteny analysis showed that Pacific saury Chr17 and the sex chromosomes of Hyporhamphus sajori and Oryzias latipes are nonhomologous to one another. These findings reveal substantial sex-chromosome diversity among beloniform fishes and establish a basis for investigating genetic sex determination and genotypic-phenotypic sex concordance in wild Pacific saury.
items.authors: Ujiie, K.; Kato, T.; Sawayama, E.; Yamamoto, Y.
items.l1_lead: 太平洋秋刀鱼的性别决定系统为ZZ/ZW型，发现特定DNA标记与雌性相关，揭示了细鳞鱼类中性染色体的多样性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了太平洋秋刀鱼（Cololabis saira）的性别决定机制，发现其具有ZZ/ZW性别决定系统。研究采用双消化限制位点关联DNA测序（ddRAD-seq）和全基因组池测序（Pool-seq）技术，开发了一种用于推断遗传性别的DNA标记。通过DNA序列分析，研究人员检测到许多标记主要或专门出现在表型雌性个体中，进一步支持了ZZ/ZW性别决定系统的存在。ddRAD-seq位点的定位显示，这些标记集中在17号染色体（Chr17）的3-19 Mb区域内。Pool-seq分析还揭示了该区域内的FST值升高、性别特异性的测序深度差异以及核苷酸多样性，进一步证实了Chr17在ZZ/ZW性别决定系统中的作用。

研究中开发的PCR标记“雌性特异性1”（FS1）源自于未映射于雄性参考基因组的雌性相关ddRAD序列，在2025年收集的43个表型雌性样本中均检测到，而在50个表型雄性样本中未发现。2026年独立样本的检测结果显示，FS1在19个表型雌性样本中全部呈阳性，而在29个表型雄性样本中仅有1个呈阳性，表明与表型性别的一致性高达97.9%。FS1阳性的雄性个体可能代表基因型与表型的性别不匹配，或反映了FS1与性别决定区域之间的重组；FS1与W染色体的关联尚未得到确认。

此外，染色体规模的同源性分析显示，太平洋秋刀鱼的Chr17与其他细鳞鱼类如Hyporhamphus sajori和Oryzias latipes的性染色体之间并不具同源性。这些发现揭示了细鳞鱼类之间显著的性染色体多样性，为进一步研究野生太平洋秋刀鱼的遗传性别决定及基因型与表型性别的一致性奠定了基础。
items.title_zh: 太平洋秋刀鱼性别决定机制及其性染色体多样性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究确认了太平洋秋刀鱼（Cololabis saira）的性别决定系统，采用双消化限制位点关联DNA测序（ddRAD-seq）和全基因组池测序（Pool-seq）。DNA序列分析发现多种标记主要或仅在表型雌性中出现，表明存在ZZ/ZW性别决定系统。ddRAD-seq位点的定位显示这些标记集中在17号染色体（Chr17）的3-19 Mb区域内。Pool-seq分析也揭示了该区域内的FST升高、性别特异的测序深度差异和核苷酸多样性，进一步支持了涉及Chr17的ZZ/ZW性别决定系统。开发的女性特异性PCR标记FS1在2025年收集的43个表型雌性中均被检测到，而在50个表型雄性中未发现。在2026年独立样本中，FS1在19个表型雌性和29个表型雄性中检测到1个阳性雄性，表明与表型性别的符合率为97.9%。该FS1阳性雄性可能代表基因型与表型的性别不匹配或反映了FS1与其他基因的重组。

items.title: Molecular characterization of required for killing-2: a gene required for spore killing by Neurospora Sk-3.
items.abstract: The Sk-3 selfish genetic element in Neurospora fungi is transmitted to offspring in a biased manner through spore killing. In crosses between an Sk-3 strain and a Spore killing-sensitive (Sk-S) strain, nearly all offspring that fail to inherit Sk-3 are killed. Although a mutation called rfk-2UV, which disrupts spore killing by Sk-3, was isolated in an earlier work, its precise location within the Sk-3 element was not identified. Here, we demonstrate that rfk-2UV is a T>G transversion mutation within a protein coding gene called rfk-2. The rfk-2 gene is located on Chromosome III, and it encodes a transcript that undergoes RNA splicing and at least two RNA editing events. One of these editing events changes a UAG stop codon to a UGG tryptophan codon and allows for production of a 102 amino acid protein. Additionally, while our results demonstrate that rfk-2 is required for spore killing, they also show that it is insufficient for the process. Sk-3 is thus more complex than previously anticipated. Rather than using a single gene to produce its killer, Sk-3 requires multiple genes to kill spores and break the rules of Mendelian Inheritance.
items.authors: Sultana, S.; Mahmud, S.; Jazireian, P.; Lohmar, J.; Brown, D.; Hammond, T. M.; Rhoades, N.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，Neurospora Sk-3的rfk-2基因是孢子杀伤所必需的，但仅靠该基因不足以完成杀伤，表明Sk-3的机制比预期更复杂。
items.l2_summary: 在神经孢子菌（Neurospora）中，Sk-3自私遗传因子通过孢子杀死（spore killing）以偏向的方式传递给后代。在Sk-3菌株与孢子杀死敏感（Sk-S）菌株的交配中，几乎所有未能继承Sk-3的后代都会被杀死。早期研究中发现了一种名为rfk-2UV的突变，该突变破坏了Sk-3的孢子杀死能力，但其在Sk-3元素中的确切位置尚未确定。本研究表明，rfk-2UV是一个T>G的转变突变，位于一个名为rfk-2的蛋白编码基因内。rfk-2基因位于第三染色体上，编码的转录本经历了RNA剪接和至少两个RNA编辑事件。其中一个编辑事件将UAG终止密码子转变为UGG色氨酸密码子，从而允许产生一个由102个氨基酸组成的蛋白质。此外，研究结果表明，rfk-2基因对于孢子杀死是必需的，但仅有rfk-2基因并不足以完成这一过程。因此，Sk-3的机制比之前预期的要复杂，Sk-3并不是通过单一基因来实现其杀死功能，而是需要多个基因共同作用，以打破孟德尔遗传法则。
items.title_zh: 神经孢子Sk-3中必需杀菌基因rfk-2的分子特征
items.summary_zh: 神经孢子真菌中的Sk-3自私遗传因子通过孢子杀灭以偏向的方式传递给后代。在Sk-3菌株与孢子杀敏感（Sk-S）菌株的交配中，几乎所有未继承Sk-3的后代都会被杀死。我们发现，导致Sk-3杀菌功能失效的突变rfk-2UV是位于rfk-2基因内的T>G转变突变。rfk-2基因位于第三染色体上，编码的转录本经历了RNA剪接和至少两次RNA编辑事件，其中一次将UAG终止密码子转变为UGG色氨酸密码子，从而产生一个102个氨基酸的蛋白质。我们的研究表明，rfk-2对孢子杀灭是必需的，但不足以单独完成该过程，表明Sk-3的机制比之前预想的更为复杂。

items.title: Multigenerational machine learning-based genomic prediction for dermo resistance in eastern oyster Crassostrea virginica
items.abstract: Dermo disease caused by the protist Perkinsus marinus poses a major threat to Eastern oyster aquaculture. We previously conducted genomic selection for dermo resistance and found increased effectiveness over phenotypic selection. Here, we report improved genomic predictions using combined data from three successive generations. We evaluated nine different genomic selection models, including three supervised machine learning architectures: gradient boosting, logistic regression, and random forest. Combining data across multiple generations did not, by itself, substantially improve the accuracy of most models, but the increased sample size provided genotyping confidence of loci with rare alleles. Correlation accuracy of all models significantly increased with the inclusion of low-frequency variants and strong-effect markers identified through a genome-wide association study. Gradient boosting machine learning models outperformed other genomic selection models across all training scenarios, suggesting enhanced capacity to learn generalizable genomic signals associated with dermo resistance. The best gradient boosting model achieved a peak correlation accuracy of 0.410, a substantial improvement over the previous peak accuracy of 0.274 from traditional models. Together, our results highlight the potential of machine learning for genomic selection and the significance of rare variants in determining dermo resistance.
items.authors: Sun, H.; Coyne, P.; Wang, Z.; Casas, S.; La Peyre, J.; Williams, M. L.; Rikard, S.; Bushek, D.; Wong, J.; Guo, X.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，结合多代数据的机器学习模型在东海岸牡蛎抗病性基因组预测中表现优越，尤其是梯度提升模型显著提高了预测准确性。
items.l2_summary:
东海岸牡蛎（Crassostrea virginica）养殖面临着由原生生物Perkinsus marinus引起的皮肤病（dermo disease）的重大威胁。为了应对这一挑战，研究团队之前开展了针对皮肤病抗性（dermo resistance）的基因组选择（genomic selection），并发现其效果优于表型选择（phenotypic selection）。在本研究中，团队进一步报告了通过结合三代连续数据来改进基因组预测的结果。研究评估了九种不同的基因组选择模型，其中包括三种监督式机器学习架构：梯度提升（gradient boosting）、逻辑回归（logistic regression）和随机森林（random forest）。尽管仅仅通过跨代数据的结合并未显著提高大多数模型的准确性，但样本量的增加为稀有等位基因（rare alleles）位点的基因分型提供了更高的信心。

通过全基因组关联研究（genome-wide association study）识别的低频变异（low-frequency variants）和强效标记（strong-effect markers）的纳入，所有模型的相关性准确性显著提高。梯度提升机器学习模型在所有训练场景中表现优于其他基因组选择模型，显示出其在学习与皮肤病抗性相关的可泛化基因组信号方面的增强能力。最佳的梯度提升模型达到了0.410的峰值相关性准确性，相较于传统模型之前的峰值准确性0.274有了显著提升。这些结果突显了机器学习在基因组选择中的潜力，以及稀有变异在决定皮肤病抗性方面的重要性。
items.title_zh: 基于机器学习的东海岸牡蛎抗病性多代基因组预测
items.summary_zh: 由原生动物Perkinsus marinus引起的Dermo病对东海岸牡蛎养殖构成重大威胁。我们之前进行了抗Dermo性状的基因组选择，发现其效果优于表型选择。本研究报告了利用三代数据改进的基因组预测。我们评估了九种不同的基因组选择模型，包括三种监督机器学习架构：梯度提升、逻辑回归和随机森林。跨代数据的结合并未显著提高大多数模型的准确性，但增加的样本量提高了稀有等位基因位点的基因分型信心。所有模型的相关性准确度在纳入低频变异和通过全基因组关联研究识别的强效标记后显著提高。梯度提升机器学习模型在所有训练场景中表现优于其他基因组选择模型，显示出更强的学习与Dermo抗性相关的可推广基因组信号的能力。最佳梯度提升模型的峰值相关性准确度达到0.410，较传统模型的0.274有显著提升。我们的结果强调了机器学习在基因组选择中的潜力及稀有变异的重要性。

items.title: Demography and selection shape gene loss in freshwater sticklebacks - A pangenomic perspective
items.abstract: The extent of within-species variation in genome assembly size, and the relative contributions of neutral vs. adaptive processes to it, remains poorly understood. We assembled the pangenome for the nine-spined stickleback (Pungitius pungitius) from whole-genome resequencing data obtained from range-wide sampling of 1,478 individuals across 47 populations. Our analysis recovered approximately 234.15 Mb of novel sequence and identified 11,151 protein-coding genes annotated in non-reference-represented regions, which accounted for 28.8% of all annotated pangenomic genes, corresponding to a 40.6% expansion relative to the 27,450 protein-coding genes annotated in the updated v8 reference genome. The identified presence/absence variation (PAV) genes exhibited a higher incidence of deleterious and non-synonymous mutations than core genes. Freshwater populations with smaller effective population sizes had lost more genes and had smaller assembly sizes relative to larger marine populations. Larger genome sizes of marine populations were primarily associated with higher transposable element content. Across gene categories, patterns of molecular variation were consistent with weaker purifying selection in freshwater populations than in marine populations, while recurrent freshwater-biased loss of a subset of PAV genes suggested that gene loss is not entirely random. Together, these results indicate that demographic history explains the overall pattern of gene loss, whereas negative natural selection may contribute to repeated loss of a subset of genes.
items.authors: Wang, H.; Zhang, C.; Wang, D.; Reid, K.; Merila, J.
items.l1_lead: 淡水刺鱼的基因丢失模式受人口历史和选择压力影响，淡水种群因有效种群规模小而基因丢失更为显著，且负向选择在特定基因的丢失中起作用。
items.l2_summary: 本研究聚焦于九刺鱼（Pungitius pungitius）的基因组变异，探讨了种内基因组组装大小的变化及其背后的中性与适应性过程的相对贡献。研究团队通过对1,478个个体的全基因组重测序数据进行范围广泛的采样，构建了该物种的泛基因组（pangenome）。分析结果显示，研究共发现约234.15 Mb的新序列，并在未被参考基因组覆盖的区域中鉴定出11,151个蛋白编码基因，这些基因占所有注释的泛基因组基因的28.8%，相较于更新的v8参考基因组中的27,450个蛋白编码基因，扩展了40.6%。在基因缺失（presence/absence variation, PAV）方面，研究发现这些基因的有害突变和非同义突变的发生率高于核心基因。进一步分析表明，具有较小有效种群规模的淡水种群相较于较大海洋种群，丧失了更多基因，并且基因组组装大小也较小。海洋种群的较大基因组大小主要与更高的转座元件（transposable element）含量相关。不同基因类别的分子变异模式显示，淡水种群的净化选择（purifying selection）强度弱于海洋种群，而淡水种群中某些PAV基因的重复性丧失则表明基因丧失并非完全随机。综合这些结果，研究表明，种群的历史人口动态解释了基因丧失的总体模式，而负向自然选择可能促成了某些基因的重复丧失。这一发现为理解淡水与海洋环境中基因组的适应性变化提供了新的视角。
items.title_zh: 淡水刺鳚基因丢失的种群与选择影响 - 泛基因组视角
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了淡水刺鳚（Pungitius pungitius）基因组组装大小的种内变异及其中中性与适应性过程的相对贡献。我们基于对1,478个个体的全基因组重测序数据，组装了九刺鳚的泛基因组，涵盖47个种群。分析结果显示，发现约234.15 Mb的新序列，并在非参考区域鉴定出11,151个蛋白编码基因，占所有注释泛基因组基因的28.8%，相较于更新的v8参考基因组的27,450个蛋白编码基因扩展了40.6%。有效种群规模较小的淡水种群丢失了更多基因，组装大小也较大海洋种群小。海洋种群较大的基因组大小主要与转座元件含量较高相关。不同基因类别的分子变异模式表明，淡水种群的净化选择较弱，而淡水偏向的PAV基因丢失则提示基因丢失并非完全随机。

items.title: Paired exposure to blue light and nutrient alters subsequent photo-avoidance in Physarum polycephalum
items.abstract: Whilst forms of non-associative learning such as habituation are widely reported in single-celled organisms, whether associative learning is possible in systems without a nervous system is contested. In this study, we implemented a classical conditioning paradigm in the acellular slime mould Physarum polycephalum through repeated pairings of nutrients with an aversive blue light stimulus. We first established that blue light is aversive under our conditioning protocol, slowing migration and producing broader, less directed growth, confirming its well documented effect on behaviour. Subjects were then trained in up to four training sessions by placing an oat stimulus inside a blue light region and tested with the light presented alone. Trained subjects entered were more likely to reach the blue light region compared to untrained controls, with shorter latency, suggesting that Physarum weakens its avoidance of blue light after the region has repeatedly coincided with a nutrient. However, engagement did not strengthen with additional pairings, a pattern that admits multiple competing explanations in which associative and non-associative processes plausibly contribute to more transient associative-like effects. We conclude that a history of co-presentation is sufficient to relax an aversive response in Physarum but cannot, within the present study, attribute that change to associative learning.
items.authors: Wang, Q.; Gaspers, N.; Sims, M.; Schlicht, T.; Severs, L.
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，反复将营养与厌恶的蓝光刺激配对，可以减弱变形虫对蓝光的回避反应，但无法确定这种变化是否源于联想学习。
items.l2_summary:
在单细胞生物中，非联结学习（non-associative learning）如习惯化（habituation）现象已被广泛报道，但在没有神经系统的生物中是否存在联结学习（associative learning）仍存在争议。本研究针对无细胞粘菌（Physarum polycephalum）实施了经典条件反射（classical conditioning）实验，通过将营养物质与厌恶的蓝光刺激反复配对，探讨其学习能力。研究首先确认在我们的条件反射协议下，蓝光确实具有厌恶性，表现为迁移速度减缓和生长方向性降低，这与已有文献中对其行为影响的描述一致。

在实验中，研究对象经历了最多四次训练，每次训练中将燕麦刺激物放置在蓝光区域内，随后仅用蓝光进行测试。结果显示，经过训练的粘菌进入蓝光区域的概率显著高于未训练的对照组，且反应延迟时间更短，这表明在营养物质与蓝光区域反复重合后，粘菌对蓝光的回避反应减弱。然而，随着额外配对的增加，参与度并未增强，这一现象可能有多种竞争性解释，表明联结和非联结过程可能共同导致了更为短暂的类联结效应。

综上所述，研究得出结论：在无细胞粘菌中，经历过的共同呈现历史足以减弱其厌恶反应，但在本研究中无法将这一变化明确归因于联结学习。
items.title_zh: 蓝光与营养物质的配对暴露影响变形虫的光避性反应
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在没有神经系统的生物中，关联学习的可能性。我们在无细胞变形虫（Physarum polycephalum）中实施了经典条件反射实验，通过将营养物质与厌恶的蓝光刺激反复配对。首先确认蓝光在我们的条件下具有厌恶性，导致迁移减缓和生长方向性降低。实验对象经过多次训练后，进入蓝光区域的概率显著高于未训练对照组，且反应延迟更短，表明变形虫在蓝光区域与营养物质反复重合后减弱了对蓝光的回避。然而，随着配对次数的增加，参与度并未增强，这一现象可能由多种竞争性解释引起，表明关联和非关联过程可能共同导致短暂的类关联效应。我们得出结论，历史上的共同呈现足以放松变形虫的厌恶反应，但在本研究中无法将这种变化归因于关联学习。

items.title: Detection-Guided Beamforming for Efficient Bat Localisation
items.abstract: Passive acoustic monitoring is widely used to study wildlife, but current approaches provide limited insight into the spatial behaviour of animals. In bat ecology, reconstructing flight trajectories is essential for studying habitat use, movement patterns, and interactions, yet it remains difficult to achieve under field conditions. Acoustic cameras offer a potential solution by enabling sound source localisation, but their practical application is limited by the computational cost of beamforming and by the non-stationary, broadband, and transient nature of echolocation calls. In particular, exhaustive beamforming over wide ultrasonic bandwidths and dense spatial grids becomes infeasible for continuous monitoring. In this work, we propose a detection-guided beamforming framework for efficient localisation of free-flying bats. The method exploits the sparsity of echolocation signals by restricting beamforming to detector-identified time-frequency regions and combines this with physically consistent short-time analysis parameters and dense spatial sampling. The framework is evaluated on field recordings acquired with a Sorama CAM iV64s acoustic camera. Results show that detection-guided processing reduces the number of beamformer evaluations by approximately 77 times, corresponding to a reduction of about 98.7 % in computational effort, while preserving spatial resolution. At the same time, the proposed parameter configuration improves the stability and sharpness of reconstructed trajectories by avoiding artefacts associated with temporal averaging. These findings demonstrate that high-resolution acoustic localisation can be achieved under realistic computational constraints, supporting the integration of acoustic cameras into ecological monitoring workflows. The proposed framework enables the extraction of spatial trajectories from passive acoustic monitoring data, facilitating spatially resolved analyses of bat behaviour in field conditions.
items.authors: Alessandri, R.; Gilmour, L.; Tan, J. J.; Osses, A.; Stowell, D.
items.l1_lead: 提出的检测引导波束形成框架显著提高了自由飞行蝙蝠的定位效率，减少了计算成本，同时保持了高空间分辨率，推动了声学监测在生态研究中的应用。
items.l2_summary:
被动声学监测在野生动物研究中被广泛应用，但现有方法对动物的空间行为提供的洞察有限。在蝙蝠生态学中，重建飞行轨迹对于研究栖息地使用、运动模式和相互作用至关重要，但在实际野外条件下实现这一目标仍然困难。声学相机为声音源定位提供了潜在解决方案，但其实际应用受到波束形成（beamforming）的计算成本以及回声定位信号的非平稳性、宽带性和瞬态特性的限制。尤其是在进行连续监测时，针对宽超声带宽和密集空间网格的全面波束形成变得不可行。

为此，本研究提出了一种检测引导的波束形成框架，以高效定位自由飞行的蝙蝠。该方法利用回声定位信号的稀疏性，通过将波束形成限制在检测器识别的时间-频率区域内，并结合物理一致的短时分析参数和密集的空间采样，从而提高了定位效率。该框架在使用Sorama CAM iV64s声学相机获取的野外录音上进行了评估。结果表明，检测引导处理将波束形成评估的次数减少了约77倍，相应地计算工作量减少了约98.7%，同时保持了空间分辨率。此外，所提出的参数配置通过避免与时间平均相关的伪影，改善了重建轨迹的稳定性和清晰度。这些发现表明，在现实的计算约束下，可以实现高分辨率的声学定位，支持声学相机在生态监测工作流程中的整合。该框架使得从被动声学监测数据中提取空间轨迹成为可能，促进了在野外条件下对蝙蝠行为的空间解析分析。
items.title_zh: 基于检测引导的波束形成实现高效蝙蝠定位
items.summary_zh: 被动声学监测广泛用于研究野生动物，但现有方法对动物空间行为的洞察有限。在蝙蝠生态学中，重建飞行轨迹对研究栖息地使用、运动模式和相互作用至关重要，但在野外条件下仍然困难。声学相机通过实现声源定位提供了潜在解决方案，但其实际应用受到波束形成计算成本和回声定位信号非平稳、宽带和瞬态特性的限制。本文提出了一种检测引导的波束形成框架，以高效定位自由飞行的蝙蝠。该方法通过将波束形成限制在检测器识别的时频区域，结合物理一致的短时分析参数和密集空间采样，利用回声定位信号的稀疏性。通过对使用Sorama CAM iV64s声学相机获取的现场录音进行评估，结果表明，检测引导处理将波束形成评估次数减少约77倍，计算工作量减少约98.7%，同时保持空间分辨率。

items.title: pydreg: a fast Python package for identifying active cis-regulatory elements from nascent transcription
items.abstract: Background: Active promoters and enhancers generate characteristic patterns of RNA transcription that can be measured through nascent RNA sequencing. dREG is a leading method that uses these patterns to identify active cis-regulatory elements across the genome, allowing regulatory activity and gene transcription to be profiled in the same experiment. However, its reference implementation was developed around an R-based workflow and a legacy GPU-accelerated support vector machine library that have become increasingly difficult to maintain and deploy. Findings: To improve future usability of dREG, we developed pydreg, a Python port of dREG. pydreg preserves the original pretrained models and peak calling procedure from dREG while using contemporary numerical libraries for CPU and GPU computation. pydreg achieves 4.5 and 5.4-fold reductions in runtime and peak host memory, respectively, compared to dREG while producing near identical peak calls. Conclusions: pydreg reduces practical barriers to running dREG locally, improves runtime and memory usage, integrates readily with Python-based genomics workflows, and provides a maintainable foundation on modern computing infrastructure. Availability and Implementation: pydreg is implemented in Python 3.11+ and is freely available under the GPL-3 license at https://github.com/adamyhe/pydreg and from PyPI via pip install pydreg[gpu] (for CUDA acceleration) or pip install pydreg[mlx] (for Apple Metal acceleration).
items.authors: He, A. Y.; Danko, C. G.
items.l1_lead: pydreg是一个快速的Python包，能够高效识别活跃的顺式调控元件，显著提升了运行速度和内存使用，便于与现代基因组学工作流程集成。
items.l2_summary: pydreg是一个快速的Python软件包，旨在从新生转录（nascent transcription）中识别活跃的顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements）。活跃的启动子和增强子会产生特征性的RNA转录模式，这些模式可以通过新生RNA测序进行测量。dREG是一个领先的方法，利用这些转录模式在基因组中识别活跃的顺式调控元件，从而在同一实验中对调控活性和基因转录进行分析。然而，dREG的参考实现是基于R语言的工作流程，并依赖于一个逐渐难以维护和部署的旧版GPU加速支持向量机（SVM）库。为了提高dREG的未来可用性，研究团队开发了pydreg，这是dREG的Python移植版本。pydreg保留了dREG原有的预训练模型和峰值调用（peak calling）程序，同时采用现代数值库进行CPU和GPU计算。与dREG相比，pydreg在运行时间和峰值主机内存方面分别实现了4.5倍和5.4倍的减少，同时生成的峰值调用几乎完全相同。这表明pydreg降低了在本地运行dREG的实际障碍，改善了运行时间和内存使用，能够与基于Python的基因组学工作流程无缝集成，并为现代计算基础设施提供了可维护的基础。pydreg的实现基于Python 3.11及以上版本，遵循GPL-3许可证，用户可以在https://github.com/adamyhe/pydreg上免费下载，或通过pip install pydreg[gpu]（用于CUDA加速）或pip install pydreg[mlx]（用于Apple Metal加速）从PyPI获取。
items.title_zh: pydreg：快速识别新生转录活性顺式调控元件的Python包
items.summary_zh: 背景：活性启动子和增强子通过新生RNA测序生成特征性RNA转录模式。dREG是识别基因组中活性顺式调控元件的领先方法，但其参考实现基于R语言，维护和部署日益困难。发现：为提高dREG的可用性，我们开发了pydreg，一个dREG的Python移植版。pydreg保留了dREG的预训练模型和峰值调用程序，同时使用现代数值库进行CPU和GPU计算。与dREG相比，pydreg在运行时间和峰值主机内存上分别减少了4.5倍和5.4倍，同时生成几乎相同的峰值调用。结论：pydreg降低了本地运行dREG的实际障碍，改善了运行时间和内存使用，易于与基于Python的基因组工作流程集成，并为现代计算基础设施提供了可维护的基础。可用性与实现：pydreg在Python 3.11+中实现，遵循GPL-3许可证，免费提供于https://github.com/adamyhe/pydreg和通过pip install pydreg[gpu]从PyPI获取。

items.title: A transitional senescence program drives inflammatory monocyte state expansion in aging humans
items.abstract: Dysfunctional monocyte states contribute to age-related pathologies and systemic inflammation. However, the gene regulatory networks governing the transition to these states remain unknown.
