items.authors: Pertile, A.; Dotto, L.; Prado, M. C.; Pilecco, R. O.; Agostini, B. A.; Pereira, G. K. R.; Sarkis-Onofre, R.
items.l1_lead: 巴西健康研究者对预印本的使用主要受到快速分享研究成果和获取反馈的动机驱动，但缺乏存档意愿是限制其使用的主要原因。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在评估巴西健康研究者对预印本（preprint）使用的动机和顾虑。研究采用混合方法，通过在线调查对1596名持有CNPq研究生产力资助的研究者进行问卷调查，涵盖七个健康领域。问卷参考了bioRxiv作者的调查，经过翻译成葡萄牙语并进行试点测试。最终，共有178名研究者访问了调查（11.2%），其中143名回答了有关预印本的问题，并纳入最终分析（有效响应率为9.0%）。参与者的平均年龄为55.9岁，88.0%隶属于公立机构。在过去五年中，62.2%的受访者未提交任何预印本，而37.8%至少提交过一个。对于提交预印本的研究者，79.2%同意提交是作者自由决定的。主要动机包括快速分享研究结果（69.8%）和获取反馈（49.1%），而在引用（17.3%）或在线传播（16.9%）方面的好处则较少。未提交预印本的受访者中，57.6%表示不想提交，35.3%则表示对这一选项不知情。在22条自由文本回复中，有19条反映出研究者经过深思熟虑后选择不提交，最常见的原因是认为在公开传播之前需要经过同行评审。总体来看，预印本的使用主要受到缺乏提交意愿的限制，而非缺乏意识。快速传播和反馈是使用预印本的主要动机。
items.title_zh: 巴西健康研究者对预印本使用的动机与顾虑调查
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估巴西健康研究者对预印本使用的动机与顾虑。2025年，对1596名CNPq研究生产力奖获得者进行了混合方法的在线调查，涵盖七个健康领域。问卷基于bioRxiv作者的调查进行调整，翻译成葡萄牙语并进行了试点测试。共178名研究者访问了调查（11.2%），143名回答了关于预印本的问题并纳入最终分析（有效响应率9.0%）。受访者平均年龄为55.9岁，88.0%隶属于公立机构。在过去五年中，62.2%的受访者未提交预印本，37.8%至少提交了一份。预印本用户中，79.2%同意提交由作者自由决定。主要动机为快速分享研究结果（69.8%）和获取反馈（49.1%）。仅有少数人报告在引用（17.3%）或在线传播（16.9%）方面的好处。未提交预印本的主要原因是不想提交（57.6%），其次是对该选项不知情（35.3%）。在22条自由文本回复中，19条反映了知情后不提交的决定，最常见原因是同行评审的顾虑。

items.title: Hit hardest, healed least: disruption and incomplete recovery of public mental-health outpatient services across two COVID-19 waves in India, 2017-2022
items.abstract: Background: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted healthcare worldwide, but whether mental health was affected differently from physical healthcare, and whether it recovered following successive waves, has not been described from routine administrative data in a low- or middle-income country. Methods: Interrupted time-series analysis of India's routine Health Management Information System (HMIS), April 2017 to March 2022. We extracted monthly counts of mental-illness outpatient visits and adolescent counseling sessions across ~700 districts, projected expected monthly counts from a log-linear model fitted to pre-pandemic trends, and compared disruption and recovery against an index of routine physical-health services. Results: Mental-illness outpatient visits fell to 31.2% of expected in April 2020 during the national lockdown, a collapse deeper than that observed for routine immunisation (48.3%) or institutional delivery (72.1%). During the Delta wave (April-June 2021), mental-health outpatient visits dropped again to 57.8% of expected. In the post-Delta recovery period (July 2021-March 2022), while immunisation and delivery volumes returned to >95% of expected, mental-illness outpatient visits reached only 58.4% of expected, representing a cumulative two-year deficit of 41.6% (~5.8 million missed outpatient visits). Deficits were widespread across states. Conclusion: Public mental-health outpatient services in India were hit harder than physical-health services by the pandemic and showed essentially no post-Delta volume recovery. As India implements its national digital mental health initiative (Tele-MANAS), these data define the large, quantified outpatient deficit that digital and facility-based services must urgently address.
items.authors: Mishra, V.; Parihar, K. S.
items.l1_lead: 印度的公共心理健康门诊服务在疫情中受到的冲击远大于身体健康服务，且在后续恢复中几乎没有改善，亟需采取措施弥补缺口。
items.l2_summary:
在COVID-19疫情期间，印度的公共心理健康门诊服务遭受了前所未有的冲击，且恢复情况远不及身体健康服务。研究通过对2017年至2022年间印度常规健康管理信息系统（Health Management Information System, HMIS）的中断时间序列分析，探讨了心理健康服务与身体健康服务在疫情波动中的不同影响。研究提取了约700个地区的心理疾病门诊就诊和青少年咨询的每月数据，并根据疫情前的趋势建立了对照模型。

结果显示，在2020年4月的全国封锁期间，心理疾病门诊就诊量降至预期的31.2%，这一降幅显著高于常规免疫接种（48.3%）和住院分娩（72.1%）的下降幅度。在德尔塔变异株波（2021年4月至6月）期间，心理健康门诊就诊量再次下降至57.8%的预期水平。进入德尔塔后的恢复期（2021年7月至2022年3月），尽管免疫接种和分娩量恢复至预期的95%以上，心理疾病门诊就诊量仅达到58.4%的预期，累计两年缺口达到41.6%，即约580万次门诊就诊未能实现。这一缺口在各州普遍存在，显示出心理健康服务的恢复情况极为不理想。

综上所述，印度的公共心理健康门诊服务在疫情中受到的打击远超身体健康服务，并且在德尔塔波后几乎没有恢复的迹象。随着印度实施国家数字心理健康倡议（Tele-MANAS），这些数据突显了心理健康门诊服务亟需解决的巨大缺口，强调了数字和机构服务在填补这一缺口中的重要性。
items.title_zh: 疫情影响下印度心理健康门诊服务的恢复情况研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：COVID-19疫情对全球医疗服务造成了干扰，但心理健康是否受到的影响与身体健康不同，以及其在后续疫情波浪中的恢复情况，在低收入或中等收入国家的常规行政数据中尚未描述。方法：对印度2017年4月至2022年3月的常规健康管理信息系统（HMIS）进行中断时间序列分析。我们提取了约700个地区的心理疾病门诊就诊和青少年咨询的月度数据，基于疫情前趋势拟合的对数线性模型预测预期月度数据，并与常规身体健康服务的指数进行比较。结果：在2020年4月的全国封锁期间，心理疾病门诊就诊降至预期的31.2%，这一降幅超过了常规免疫接种（48.3%）和住院分娩（72.1%）。在德尔塔变种波（2021年4月至6月）期间，心理健康门诊就诊再次降至57.8%。在德尔塔后的恢复期（2021年7月至2022年3月），尽管免疫接种和分娩量恢复至预期的95%以上，心理疾病门诊就诊仅达到预期的58.4%，累计两年缺口为41.6%（约580万次未就诊）。缺口在各州普遍存在。结论：公共心理健康服务的恢复情况不容乐观。

items.title: Health workforce preparedness for sepsis care in Bahrain: a cross-sectional survey of guideline knowledge, attitudes, and practices
items.abstract: Sepsis and septic shock remain critical medical emergencies that require timely and effective interventions. This study evaluates the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of healthcare professionals in Bahrain concerning the management of sepsis and septic shock. A cross-sectional survey was conducted among a sample of 260 healthcare professionals who consented to participate out of 310 approached, yielding a response rate of 83.9%. Data were collected using a structured, self-administered questionnaire designed to ensure anonymity and consistency in responses. Data were analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics via IBM SPSS version 29. Most participants demonstrated sound general knowledge of sepsis, with 90.7% correctly identifying broad-spectrum antibiotics as the first-line treatment. However, awareness of certain clinical tools was lower--only 44.6% recognized the qSOFA score and 60% understood the use of capillary refill time. Knowledge levels were significantly higher among males (77.4%) than females (70.6%, p = 0.043), and among those with advanced degrees (p < 0.001), especially doctorate holders (84.5%). Physicians had the highest average knowledge scores (91.0%), followed by PharmD holders (82.2%). Positive attitudes toward early sepsis recognition were reported by 82.2% of participants, particularly among those with doctoral education and over 21 years of experience. In practice, 72.7% routinely assessed for organ dysfunction, and 51.9% initiated antibiotic therapy within the first hour of diagnosis. The study identified significant gaps in diagnostic tool familiarity and clinical practice consistency. These findings underscore the importance of initiatives to enhance adherence to sepsis management protocols in Bahrain.
items.authors: Ebrahim, K. A. O.; Jaber, A. A.; Mirza, R. B.
items.l1_lead: 巴林医疗专业人员在脓毒症管理方面知识良好，但对某些临床工具的认知不足，需加强培训以提高遵循治疗规范的能力。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在评估巴林医疗专业人员对脓毒症（sepsis）及脓毒性休克（septic shock）管理的知识、态度和实践（KAP）。通过对310名医疗专业人员进行调查，最终260人参与，响应率为83.9%。研究采用结构化的自填问卷，确保参与者的匿名性和回答的一致性，数据分析使用IBM SPSS版本29进行描述性和推论性统计分析。结果显示，大多数参与者对脓毒症有较为扎实的基础知识，其中90.7%的人正确识别广谱抗生素为一线治疗。然而，某些临床工具的认知度较低，仅44.6%的人认识到qSOFA评分，60%的人理解毛细血管充盈时间的使用。知识水平在性别和学历上存在显著差异，男性的知识水平为77.4%，女性为70.6%（p = 0.043），而拥有高级学位的人员知识水平更高（p < 0.001），尤其是博士学位持有者达到84.5%。在不同职业角色中，医生的平均知识得分最高（91.0%），其次是药学博士（PharmD）持有者（82.2%）。在态度方面，82.2%的参与者对早期识别脓毒症持积极态度，尤其是那些拥有博士学位和超过21年经验的专业人员。在实际操作中，72.7%的参与者定期评估器官功能障碍，51.9%的人在诊断后的第一小时内开始抗生素治疗。研究还发现，在诊断工具的熟悉度和临床实践的一致性方面存在显著差距。这些发现强调了在巴林加强脓毒症管理协议遵循的必要性，以提升医疗工作者的应对能力。
items.title_zh: 巴林医疗工作者对脓毒症护理的准备情况调查
items.summary_zh: 脓毒症及脓毒性休克仍然是需要及时有效干预的重大医疗紧急情况。本研究评估了巴林医疗专业人员对脓毒症和脓毒性休克管理的知识、态度和实践（KAP）。在310名被接触的医疗工作者中，有260名同意参与，响应率为83.9%。使用结构化的自填问卷收集数据，以确保匿名性和回答的一致性。数据通过IBM SPSS版本29进行描述性和推断性统计分析。大多数参与者对脓毒症有良好的基本知识，90.7%正确识别广谱抗生素为一线治疗。然而，对某些临床工具的认识较低，仅44.6%的人了解qSOFA评分，60%理解毛细血管再充盈时间的使用。男性（77.4%）的知识水平显著高于女性（70.6%，p = 0.043），而拥有高级学位者（p < 0.001）知识水平更高，尤其是博士学位持有者（84.5%）。医生的平均知识得分最高（91.0%），其次是药学博士（82.2%）。82.2%的参与者对早期识别脓毒症持积极态度，尤其是在博士教育背景和21年以上工作经验者中。

items.title: Epigenetic Effects of HIV and Childhood Maltreatment in Women
items.abstract: Introduction: People with HIV have disproportionately higher rates of adverse childhood experiences compared to the general population. This, in turn, is linked to long-term physical and mental health consequences. DNA methylation - a heritable, reasonably stable and quantifiable epigenetic mechanism implicated in gene silencing - may offer a useful lens that helps understand how HIV and childhood trauma become biologically embedded and affect disease risk profiles. Methods: This study aimed to identify regional and network level methylomic signatures associated with HIV and childhood maltreatment scores in South African women who bear the highest dual burden. DNA methylation profiling using the Illumina Infinium EPIC V2 kit was performed on DNA extracted from blood samples of 238 women with or without HIV with varying levels of childhood maltreatment. Regional DNA methylation analyses, composed of correlation tests on specific CpG sites and on genetic regions, were conducted for each of HIV and childhood maltreatment scores. Thereafter, a weighted gene Co-Expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) was conducted on HIV and childhood maltreatment scores to determine co-expression modules associated with the variable of interest. Finally, causal mediation analysis of the most significant network module was conducted to clarify the direction of association. Results: Neither HIV status nor childhood maltreatment was associated with DNA methylation at site-specific or regional levels. Network methylation effects were, however, observed, with three out of four network modules that were differentially methylated in HIV, implicating genes involved in immune pathways. One network module, composed of an abundance of genes relating to neurotransmitter functioning, was associated with childhood maltreatment. Both causal analyses implied that HIV and childhood maltreatment preceded the epigenetic effects. Conclusions: The findings suggest that DNA methylation in immune pathways may partially explain the immune and neurologic effects of HIV. The link between childhood maltreatment and neuronal processes warrants further investigation.
items.authors: Roomaney, A. A.; Hemmings, S. M. J.; Spies, G.; Letendre, S. L.; Seedat, S.; Womersley, J. S.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，HIV和儿童虐待经历可能通过影响免疫通路的DNA甲基化，部分解释其对健康的长期影响，且两者在表观遗传层面存在关联。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了HIV与儿童虐待经历对女性的表观遗传学影响，尤其是在南非女性中，这一群体面临着双重负担。研究发现，HIV感染者在儿童时期经历不良事件的比例显著高于普通人群，这种经历与长期的身心健康后果密切相关。DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）作为一种可遗传、相对稳定且可量化的表观遗传机制，可能有助于理解HIV与儿童创伤如何在生物层面上嵌入个体，并影响疾病风险。

本研究对238名南非女性的血液样本进行了DNA甲基化分析，使用Illumina Infinium EPIC V2试剂盒，旨在识别与HIV和儿童虐待评分相关的区域和网络水平的甲基组特征。研究通过对特定CpG位点和基因区域进行相关性测试，分析了HIV和儿童虐待评分的区域DNA甲基化情况。随后，研究采用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）来确定与HIV和儿童虐待评分相关的共表达模块。最后，针对最显著的网络模块进行了因果中介分析，以明确关联的方向。

结果显示，HIV状态和儿童虐待经历在特定位点或区域水平上与DNA甲基化并无显著关联。然而，网络甲基化效应得到了观察，其中四个网络模块中有三个在HIV感染者中表现出差异甲基化，涉及免疫通路的基因。另一个网络模块则与儿童虐待相关，包含大量与神经递质功能相关的基因。因果分析表明，HIV和儿童虐待经历在表观遗传效应之前发生。

研究结果提示，免疫通路中的DNA甲基化可能部分解释HIV的免疫和神经效应，而儿童虐待与神经过程之间的联系则值得进一步研究。这些发现为理解HIV与儿童创伤的生物学机制提供了新的视角，强调了表观遗传学在疾病风险评估中的潜在作用。
items.title_zh: HIV与儿童虐待对女性表观遗传影响研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：HIV感染者经历不良儿童经历的比例显著高于普通人群，这与长期的身心健康后果相关。DNA甲基化作为一种可遗传、相对稳定且可量化的表观遗传机制，可能有助于理解HIV和儿童创伤如何在生物上嵌入并影响疾病风险。方法：本研究旨在识别与HIV和儿童虐待评分相关的甲基组特征，研究对象为南非女性。对238名女性的血样进行DNA甲基化分析，使用Illumina Infinium EPIC V2试剂盒。对HIV和儿童虐待评分进行区域DNA甲基化分析，并进行加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），以确定相关的共表达模块。最后，对最显著的网络模块进行因果中介分析以澄清关联方向。结果：HIV状态与儿童虐待评分之间的关系尚未完全明确。

items.title: Determinants of Anticipated Video-Supported Treatment Acceptability in Drug-Susceptible Pulmonary Tuberculosis
items.abstract: Setting: Twenty-three urban healthcare facilities across five geographic jurisdictions of Metropolitan Lima, Peru. Objective: To identify determinants of anticipated video-supported treatment (VST) acceptability among persons with drug-susceptible pulmonary tuberculosis. Design: Observational, cross-sectional study (August-December 2025). Anticipated acceptability was assessed across two domains: acceptability of use (desire to use VST) and willingness to comply (confidence in fulfilling VST requirements). Adjusted prevalence ratios (aPR) with 95% confidence intervals (95%CI) were estimated using robust Poisson regression with Liang-Zeger cluster-robust standard errors. Results: Among 473 participants (median age 35 years; 51.5% male), 61.3% (95%CI: 57.0%-65.9%) reported acceptability of use and 42.3% (95%CI 36.2%-49.4%) willingness to comply with VST. Educational attainment was the strongest predictor of both outcomes. The ability to record and send videos using a mobile phone and continuity of technology access were associated with acceptability of use and willingness to comply with VST, respectively. Diabetes mellitus, illicit drug use, and intention to abandon treatment were associated with reduced willingness to comply with VST. Conclusions: VST acceptability is shaped by educational attainment, digital competency, structural conditions, and clinical and behavioural profile. VST implementation should prioritise digital skills training and incorporate pre-enrolment screening for clinical vulnerability.
items.authors: Lama, J. A.; Seas, C. R.; Peinado Rodriguez, J.; Tovar, M.; Lama, J. R.
items.l1_lead: 视频支持治疗的可接受性受教育水平、数字能力、结构性条件及临床行为特征影响，实施时应优先考虑数字技能培训和临床脆弱性筛查。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨在秘鲁利马大都会区23个城市医疗机构中，药物敏感性肺结核患者对视频支持治疗（Video-Supported Treatment, VST）接受度的决定因素。研究采用观察性横断面设计，数据收集时间为2025年8月至12月。研究评估了两方面的预期接受度：使用接受度（对使用VST的愿望）和遵从意愿（对满足VST要求的信心）。在473名参与者中，年龄中位数为35岁，其中男性占51.5%。结果显示，61.3%（95%CI: 57.0%-65.9%）的参与者表示愿意使用VST，而42.3%（95%CI: 36.2%-49.4%）的参与者愿意遵守VST要求。

教育水平被发现是影响这两项结果的最强预测因素。此外，能够使用手机录制和发送视频的能力与使用接受度相关，而持续的技术接入则与遵从意愿相关。研究还发现，糖尿病、非法药物使用以及放弃治疗的意图与降低遵从意愿相关。综上所述，VST的接受度受到教育水平、数字能力、结构性条件以及临床和行为特征的影响。因此，VST的实施应优先考虑数字技能培训，并在入组前进行临床脆弱性筛查，以提高患者的接受度和遵从性。
items.title_zh: 药物敏感性肺结核患者视频支持治疗接受度的影响因素
items.summary_zh: 研究地点：秘鲁利马大都会五个地理区域的23个城市医疗机构。研究目的：识别药物敏感性肺结核患者对视频支持治疗（VST）接受度的影响因素。研究设计：观察性横断面研究（2025年8月至12月）。接受度评估涵盖两个领域：使用接受度（使用VST的愿望）和遵从意愿（完成VST要求的信心）。使用稳健的Poisson回归估计调整后的流行率比（aPR）及其95%置信区间（95%CI）。结果：在473名参与者中（中位年龄35岁；51.5%为男性），61.3%（95%CI：57.0%-65.9%）报告了使用接受度，42.3%（95%CI 36.2%-49.4%）表示愿意遵从VST。教育程度是两个结果的最强预测因素。能够使用手机录制和发送视频以及技术访问的持续性与使用接受度和遵从意愿相关。糖尿病、非法药物使用和放弃治疗的意图与遵从意愿降低相关。结论：VST的接受度受教育程度、数字能力、结构条件及临床和行为特征的影响。

items.title: ACE2 Polymorphisms rs2285666 and rs147311723 Are Clinically Relevant Variants in SARS-CoV-2 and Mycobacterium tuberculosis Co-infection.
items.abstract: Background: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) enters host cells primarily through the angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) receptor. Genetic variation in the ACE2 gene may influence host inflammatory responses and clinical outcomes during COVID-19. Tuberculosis (TB) on the other hand increases the level of ACE2 expression through interferon stimulation. The objective of this study was to investigate the association between specific single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) in the ACE2 gene and their impact on susceptibility to and severity of SARS-CoV-2 and Mycobacterium tuberculosis Co-infection. Methods: This retrospective cross-sectional study included 120 symptomatic individuals recruited between September 2020 and December 2023 from four hospitals in Yaounde, Cameroon. Participants were classified into four groups: COVID-19, TB, TB/COVID-19 co-infection, and infection-negative controls. Diagnoses were confirmed using RT-PCR and standard microbiological methods. Serum biochemical markers and cytokines were quantified, and genotyping of ACE2 polymorphisms was performed using TaqMan assays. Results: Statistical analysis showed a significant association between ACE2 expression and inflammatory or biochemical markers, particularly for rs147311723. Several ACE2 polymorphisms (rs6632677, rs147311723, rs4646140, rs2285666, and rs4646142) were significantly associated with increased pro-inflammatory cytokine levels. Selected biochemical parameters demonstrated suggestive associations with ACE2 variants, including creatinine (rs147311723, p = 0.0522), AST (rs2285666, p = 0.0536), and ALT (rs4646142, p = 0.0582), indicating potential renal and hepatic involvement. Principal component analysis identified distinct immunometabolic profiles across patient groups, with co-infected individuals exhibiting heightened inflammatory and metabolic perturbations. Conclusions: These findings suggest that ACE2 genetic variability is associated with modulation of inflammatory responses and may contribute to organ-specific dysfunction in COVID-19 and TB across different populations. This highlights the potential role of host genetics in shaping disease severity and underscore the need for larger studies to validate these associations in diverse populations. Keywords: ACE2 polymorphisms; COVID-19; tuberculosis; co-infection; cytokines; biomarkers; genetic susceptibility;
items.authors: Kameni, M. N.; Jean Paul, A. A.; Berenger Tchoupe, E.; Toyim Albert, N.; Maxime Tchoutang, A.; Franklin, M.; Svetlana Carel, T. V.; Georgette Njila, K.; Neba, F. R.; Donald Kamdem, S.; Masumbe Netongo, P.
items.l1_lead: ACE2基因多态性与SARS-CoV-2和结核病的共感染相关，可能影响炎症反应和器官功能，提示宿主遗传因素在疾病严重性中的作用。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了ACE2（血管紧张素转化酶2）基因中的特定单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与SARS-CoV-2（严重急性呼吸综合症冠状病毒2型）和结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis）共同感染的易感性及严重性之间的关系。SARS-CoV-2主要通过ACE2受体进入宿主细胞，而结核病则通过干扰素刺激提高ACE2的表达水平。研究对象为2020年9月至2023年12月间在喀麦隆雅温得四家医院招募的120名有症状的个体，参与者被分为四组：COVID-19组、结核病组、结核病/COVID-19共同感染组和感染阴性对照组。所有参与者的诊断均通过RT-PCR和标准微生物学方法确认。

研究结果显示，ACE2的表达与炎症或生化标志物之间存在显著关联，尤其是rs147311723多态性。多项ACE2多态性（rs6632677、rs147311723、rs4646140、rs2285666和rs4646142）与促炎细胞因子水平的增加显著相关。特定生化参数与ACE2变异体之间也显示出潜在的关联，包括肌酐（rs147311723，p = 0.0522）、天冬氨酸转氨酶（AST，rs2285666，p = 0.0536）和丙氨酸转氨酶（ALT，rs4646142，p = 0.0582），提示可能存在肾脏和肝脏的损伤。主成分分析显示，不同患者组之间存在明显的免疫代谢特征，尤其是共同感染者表现出更高的炎症和代谢紊乱。

综上所述，研究结果表明ACE2基因的遗传变异与炎症反应的调节相关，可能导致COVID-19和结核病患者的器官特异性功能障碍。这一发现强调了宿主遗传学在影响疾病严重性方面的潜在作用，并指出需要更大规模的研究来验证这些关联在不同人群中的适用性。
items.title_zh: ACE2多态性rs2285666和rs147311723在SARS-CoV-2与结核共感染中的临床相关性
items.summary_zh: 背景：严重急性呼吸综合症冠状病毒2型（SARS-CoV-2）主要通过血管紧张素转化酶2（ACE2）受体进入宿主细胞。ACE2基因的遗传变异可能影响COVID-19期间宿主的炎症反应和临床结果。结核病（TB）则通过干扰素刺激提高ACE2表达水平。本研究旨在探讨ACE2基因中特定单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与SARS-CoV-2和结核分枝杆菌共感染的易感性及严重性之间的关系。方法：本回顾性横断面研究纳入了2020年9月至2023年12月在喀麦隆雅温得四家医院招募的120名有症状个体。参与者分为四组：COVID-19、TB、TB/COVID-19共感染及感染阴性对照。通过RT-PCR和标准微生物学方法确认诊断。定量测定血清生化标志物和细胞因子，并使用TaqMan检测ACE2多态性。结果：统计分析显示ACE2表达与炎症或生化标志物之间存在显著关联，尤其是rs147311723。多个ACE2多态性（rs6632677、rs147311723、rs4646140、rs2285666和rs4646142）显著相关。

items.title: Using Routine Ventilator Data to Visualize and Quantify Dynamic Compliance Trends Post-Surfactant Therapy in Preterm Infants: A Proof-of-Concept Study
items.abstract: Using routinely recorded ventilator data from 16 preterm infants with respiratory distress syndrome, dynamic compliance trajectories after surfactant administration were smoothed with a moving-median filter and characterized with a four-parameter logistic model; 10 infants showed sigmoidal improvement, and among 11 infants who received a second surfactant dose, 6 showed subsequent improvement, suggesting that this approach can visualize and quantify individual compliance recovery as a complementary tool to conventional clinical indicators.
items.authors: Higashiyama, H.
items.category_raw: intensive care and critical care medicine
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，通过常规呼吸机数据可视化和量化早产儿在肺表面活性剂治疗后的动态顺应性变化，为评估个体恢复提供了补充工具。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在利用常规记录的呼吸机数据，探讨早产儿在接受表面活性剂治疗后的动态顺应性（dynamic compliance）变化趋势。研究对象为16名患有呼吸窘迫综合症的早产儿，通过对呼吸机记录的数据进行处理，采用移动中位数滤波器对动态顺应性轨迹进行平滑，并使用四参数逻辑模型进行特征化分析。结果显示，10名婴儿的顺应性改善呈现出S型曲线（sigmoidal improvement），而在接受第二剂表面活性剂的11名婴儿中，有6名表现出后续的改善。这些结果表明，该方法能够有效地可视化和量化个体的顺应性恢复，作为传统临床指标的补充工具。研究结果为早产儿呼吸窘迫的治疗提供了新的数据分析视角，强调了动态顺应性在评估治疗效果中的潜在价值。
items.title_zh: 利用常规呼吸机数据可视化早产儿表面活性剂治疗后动态顺应性趋势
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用16名患有呼吸窘迫综合征的早产儿的常规呼吸机数据，采用移动中位数滤波器平滑表面活性剂给药后的动态顺应性轨迹，并使用四参数逻辑模型进行特征分析。结果显示，10名婴儿的顺应性呈现S型改善。在接受第二剂表面活性剂的11名婴儿中，有6名显示出后续改善。这表明该方法可以可视化和量化个体的顺应性恢复，作为传统临床指标的补充工具。

items.title: "Mortality Prediction in Heart Failure using Explainable AI: Development and Validation of the EXACT-HF Model in a Nationwide Multi-Ethnic Asian Cohort"
items.abstract: Background: Established heart-failure (HF) risk scores were developed largely in Western cohorts, assume linear predictor effects, and stop at prognosis without indicating action. We developed and externally validated machine-learning (ML) models for 30-day and 1-year mortality in a multi-ethnic Asian HF population, benchmarked against three established scores, and tested whether they localised correctable guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) gaps. Methods: We analysed 9,050 adults hospitalised with HF across eight Singapore hospitals (November 2016?March 2023). Gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost, primary) and elastic-net logistic regression were developed on three hospitals (n=4,034) and validated on five independent hospitals (n=5,016), without patient or site overlap. Comparators (MAGGIC, Singapore HF Score, OPTIMIZE-HF-Asia) were logistically recalibrated on development data. Results: On external validation XGBoost achieved AUROCs of 0.862 (95% CI 0.833?0.890) for 30-day and 0.749 (0.734?0.764) for 1-year mortality, versus 0.711?0.754 and 0.682?0.699 for the three recalibrated scores; logistic regression performed near-identically (0.864, 0.757) and was better calibrated at 1 year. Superiority held under temporal validation, multiple imputation and optimism correction, although the 30-day advantage was no longer distinguishable from MAGGIC once medications were removed. Among predicted-high-risk patients with reduced ejection fraction, mean GDMT exposure was 0.92 of four pillars versus 1.87 across all HFrEF patients, and 36.3% received none of the four versus 2.0% of low-risk patients. Ten variables reproduced full-model 30-day discrimination (AUROC 0.865). Conclusions: In external validation, interpretable models substantially outperformed established HF risk scores for short- and long-term mortality and simultaneously localised correctable therapeutic gaps, supporting a prediction-to-action tool deployable with ten bedside variables.
items.authors: Jauhari, S. M.; Yeung, W. L.; Li, T.; Chua, J.; Zhang, A. A.; Lim, E.-H.; Cherian, R.; Sim, D.; Lee Shao Guang, S.; Soon, D. K. N.; Chan, P. F.; Loh, S. Y.; Jaufeerally, F. R.; Chan, S.-P.; Chan, M. Y.-Y.; Lin, W.; Wong, R. C. C.
items.l1_lead: 可解释的机器学习模型在多民族亚洲心力衰竭人群中显著优于传统风险评分，能够有效预测短期和长期死亡风险，并识别可纠正的治疗缺口。
items.l2_summary:
心力衰竭（HF）是一种严重的心血管疾病，现有的HF风险评分主要基于西方人群，通常假设线性预测效应，并仅提供预后信息而不指明具体的治疗措施。为此，本研究开发并外部验证了一种基于机器学习（ML）的模型——EXACT-HF，用于预测多民族亚洲人群中HF患者的30天和1年死亡率，并与三种已建立的风险评分进行比较，同时评估其是否能够识别可纠正的指南推荐医疗治疗（GDMT）缺口。

研究分析了2016年11月至2023年3月期间在新加坡八家医院住院的9,050名HF成人患者。研究采用了梯度提升树（XGBoost，作为主要模型）和弹性网逻辑回归模型，在三家医院的4,034名患者中进行开发，并在五家独立医院的5,016名患者中进行验证，确保患者和医院之间没有重叠。对比模型（MAGGIC、Singapore HF Score、OPTIMIZE-HF-Asia）在开发数据上进行了逻辑再校准。

外部验证结果显示，XGBoost模型在30天和1年死亡率的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）分别达到了0.862（95% CI 0.833-0.890）和0.749（0.734-0.764），而三种再校准评分的AUROC分别为0.711-0.754和0.682-0.699；逻辑回归模型的表现接近XGBoost（0.864和0.757），且在1年时的校准效果更佳。即使在时间验证、多重插补和乐观校正下，模型的优越性依然保持，尽管在去除药物后，30天的优势与MAGGIC模型不再明显。在预测的高风险患者中，射血分数降低的患者的GDMT平均暴露为四个支柱中的0.92，而所有HFrEF患者的平均暴露为1.87，且36.3%的高风险患者未接受任何四个支柱的治疗，而低风险患者中这一比例仅为2.0%。

总之，在外部验证中，EXACT-HF模型在短期和长期死亡率预测方面显著优于现有的HF风险评分，并同时识别出可纠正的治疗缺口，支持其作为一种可在临床床边使用的预测到行动的工具，且仅需十个变量即可实现。
items.title_zh: 心力衰竭死亡预测的可解释人工智能：EXACT-HF模型的开发与验证
items.summary_zh: 背景：现有心力衰竭（HF）风险评分主要基于西方人群，假设线性预测效应，且仅提供预后而不指示行动。我们在多民族亚洲HF人群中开发并外部验证了机器学习（ML）模型，用于预测30天和1年死亡率，并与三种已建立的评分进行基准比较，测试其是否能够定位可纠正的指南导向医疗治疗（GDMT）缺口。方法：我们分析了2016年11月至2023年3月在新加坡八家医院住院的9,050名HF成人。采用梯度提升树（XGBoost，主要）和弹性网逻辑回归在三家医院（n=4,034）开发，并在五家独立医院（n=5,016）验证，患者和地点无重叠。比较评分（MAGGIC、新加坡HF评分、OPTIMIZE-HF-Asia）在开发数据上进行了逻辑重新校准。结果：在外部验证中，XGBoost在30天和1年死亡率的AUROC分别为0.862（95% CI 0.833-0.890）和0.749（0.734-0.764），而三种重新校准评分的AUROC为0.711-0.754和0.682-0.699；逻辑回归表现相近（0.864, 0.757），且在1年时校准更好。尽管在时间验证、多重插补和乐观校正下保持优越性，但一旦去除药物，30天的优势与MAGGIC不再可区分。

items.title: Digital readiness for cardiovascular care in high-burden US communities with cardiology workforce constraints
items.abstract: Digital health may extend cardiovascular care in communities with limited specialist access, but its effectiveness depends on whether communities have the infrastructure, devices, affordability, and capacity needed to use digital services. We linked national data on cardiometabolic burden, cardiology workforce, and digital readiness across 82,999 US census tracts to identify communities where digital cardiovascular care could be deployed and those where enabling investment may be needed first. Among 49,948 tracts in 2,582 counties with no cardiologist or declining per-capita cardiologist supply, 26,517 had above-average cardiometabolic burden. Of these, 4,765 had digital readiness at or above the national median and were classified as deployment-priority tracts, whereas 21,752 had lower readiness and were classified as investment-priority tracts. Investment-priority tracts clustered in the rural Southwest, Deep South, Mississippi Delta, and Gulf and Florida metropolitan areas, whereas deployment-priority tracts were dispersed across urban counties nationwide. Contrasting classifications frequently occurred among neighboring census tracts within the same metropolitan area, highlighting geographic variation not captured by county-level targeting. Findings were broadly consistent across eight additional analyses varying measures of readiness, workforce access, and classification thresholds. We also developed public interactive dashboards that allow users to examine local patterns and modify classification thresholds. These findings provide a national framework for distinguishing communities where digital cardiovascular care may be deployed from those where infrastructure and adoption support may be needed to enable equitable implementation.
items.authors: Perera, S.; Dhingra, L. S.; Batinica, B.; Pedroso, A.; Khera, R.
items.l1_lead: 数字健康可以在心脏病专科资源有限的美国高负担社区扩展心血管护理，但其有效性依赖于社区的基础设施、设备、可负担性和使用数字服务的能力。
items.l2_summary: 数字健康（Digital health）可能在心血管护理领域为那些专业医生资源有限的社区提供延伸服务，但其有效性依赖于社区是否具备必要的基础设施、设备、经济承受能力和使用数字服务的能力。研究者通过将美国82,999个普查区的心脏代谢负担（cardiometabolic burden）、心脏病学工作力量（cardiology workforce）和数字准备度（digital readiness）进行关联，识别出可以部署数字心血管护理的社区，以及那些需要优先投资的社区。在2,582个县的49,948个普查区中，存在无心脏病专家或人均心脏病专家数量下降的情况，其中26,517个普查区的心脏代谢负担高于平均水平。在这些高负担区中，有4,765个普查区的数字准备度达到或超过全国中位数，被归类为优先部署区，而21,752个普查区的准备度较低，被归类为优先投资区。优先投资区主要集中在美国西南部的农村地区、深南部、密西西比三角洲以及墨西哥湾和佛罗里达的都市区，而优先部署区则分布在全国各大城市县。值得注意的是，相邻的普查区在同一都市区内常常出现不同的分类，显示出县级目标未能捕捉到的地理差异。研究结果在八项额外分析中也表现出一致性，这些分析采用了不同的准备度、工作力量获取和分类阈值的衡量标准。此外，研究团队还开发了公共互动仪表板，允许用户查看当地模式并调整分类阈值。这些发现为区分可以部署数字心血管护理的社区与那些需要基础设施和采纳支持以实现公平实施的社区提供了全国性框架。
items.title_zh: 美国高负担社区心血管护理的数字化准备情况
items.summary_zh: 数字健康可能在专业医生有限的社区扩展心血管护理，但其有效性取决于社区是否具备使用数字服务所需的基础设施、设备、经济能力和能力。我们将美国82,999个普查区的心脏代谢负担、心脏病学工作力量和数字准备情况的国家数据进行了关联，以识别可部署数字心血管护理的社区及需优先投资的社区。在2,582个县的49,948个普查区中，没有心脏病专家或人均心脏病专家供应下降的地区，有26,517个普查区的心脏代谢负担高于平均水平。其中，4,765个普查区的数字准备情况达到或超过全国中位数，被归类为优先部署区，而21,752个普查区的准备情况较低，被归类为优先投资区。优先投资区主要集中在西南部农村、深南部、密西西比三角洲以及墨西哥湾和佛罗里达大都市区，而优先部署区则分布在全国的城市县。相邻的普查区在同一大都市区内常常出现不同的分类，突显了县级目标未能捕捉的地理差异。

items.title: Aortic Haemodynamics Are Independent Longitudinal Determinants of Left Ventricular Function in Repaired Tetralogy of Fallot
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) independently predicts mortality in repaired tetralogy of Fallot (ToF), but the causes of LV dysfunction are incompletely understood. The intrinsic aortopathy of ToF increases pulsatile afterload, yet whether this contributes to LV dysfunction is unknown. We sought to determine whether aortic dimensions and flow-derived afterload act as cross-sectional markers of LV dysfunction, dynamic contributors to change in LV function over time, or both. METHODS: Retrospective longitudinal study of 554 patients with repaired ToF (1,448 serial cardiovascular magnetic resonance examinations, 2003-2026). Aortic root dimensions, total arterial compliance (TAC: aortic forward flow volume/pulse pressure), and systemic vascular resistance (SVR) were derived, and a within-between decomposition separated between-patient from within-patient associations with LVEF in mixed-effects models. RESULTS: In the analytic sample (1,053 observations, 521 patients), aortic sinus diameter predicted LVEF at both levels (within:{beta} = -0.23, p<0.001; between: {beta} = -0.20, p=0.003). Associations were reproduced at the sinotubular junction but absent at the ascending aorta, localising the effect to the root. TAC predicted LVEF within patients ({beta}=0.90 per mL/mmHg, p=0.014) but not between patients (p=0.62), indicating that pulsatile afterload is a dynamic contributor to LV function. SVR predicted LVEF at both levels (within: {beta} = -0.23; between: {beta} = -0.25; both p<0.001). Blood pressure components alone, expressed as systolic and diastolic or as mean arterial and pulse pressure, did not predict LVEF and fitted the data less well. Adjustment for right ventricular ejection fraction attenuated the within-patient compliance association by 35%, suggesting a component shared with right ventricular function. CONCLUSIONS: Aortic root dimensions, TAC and SVR are independent longitudinal determinants of LVEF in repaired ToF, establishing an important role for aortic haemodynamics in LV function and identifying the systemic vasculature as a potentially modifiable contributor to LV dysfunction.
items.authors: Chowdhury, S.; Mitropoulou, P.; Fernandes, P.; Cheung, L. T. Y.; Taylor, A.; Muthurangu, V.; Quail, M. A.
items.l1_lead: 主动脉根部尺寸、总动脉顺应性和全身血管阻力是修复型法洛四联症患者左心室功能的独立纵向决定因素，强调了主动脉血流动力学在左心室功能中的重要作用。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨修复型法洛四联症（Tetralogy of Fallot, ToF）患者的主动脉血流动力学与左心室功能之间的关系。左心室射血分数（LVEF）被认为是修复型ToF患者死亡率的独立预测因子，但其功能障碍的具体原因尚不完全明确。ToF的内源性主动脉病变会增加脉动后负荷，但这种变化是否会导致左心室功能障碍仍不清楚。因此，研究者希望确定主动脉尺寸和流动衍生的后负荷是否作为横断面标志物影响左心室功能，或在时间上动态地影响左心室功能的变化，或两者兼而有之。

本研究为一项回顾性纵向研究，纳入了554名修复型ToF患者，进行了1,448次心血管磁共振检查（2003-2026年）。研究分析了主动脉根部尺寸、总动脉顺应性（TAC：主动脉前向血流量/脉压）和全身血管阻力（SVR），并通过混合效应模型将患者间和患者内的LVEF关联进行分解。在分析样本中（1,053次观察，521名患者），主动脉窦直径在患者内和患者间均能预测LVEF（患者内：β = -0.23，p<0.001；患者间：β = -0.20，p=0.003）。这种关联在窦管交界处得到了重复，但在升主动脉处未见，表明影响主要集中在主动脉根部。TAC在患者内预测LVEF（β=0.90每mL/mmHg，p=0.014），但在患者间未能预测（p=0.62），这表明脉动后负荷是左心室功能的动态贡献因素。SVR在患者内和患者间均能预测LVEF（患者内：β = -0.23；患者间：β = -0.25；均p<0.001）。单独考虑血压成分（收缩压和舒张压或平均动脉压和脉压）并未能有效预测LVEF，且拟合效果较差。调整右心室射血分数后，患者内的顺应性关联减弱了35%，提示与右心室功能存在共享成分。

综上所述，主动脉根部尺寸、TAC和SVR是修复型ToF患者LVEF的独立纵向决定因素，确立了主动脉血流动力学在左心室功能中的重要作用，并指出全身血管可能是导致左心室功能障碍的可调节因素。
items.title_zh: 主动脉血流动力学是修复法洛四联症左心室功能的独立纵向决定因素
items.summary_zh: 背景：左心室射血分数（LVEF）在修复法洛四联症（ToF）中独立预测死亡率，但左心室功能障碍的原因尚不完全清楚。ToF的内源性主动脉病变增加了脉动后负荷，但其是否导致左心室功能障碍尚不明确。本研究旨在确定主动脉尺寸和流动衍生的后负荷是否作为左心室功能障碍的横断面标志、随时间变化的动态贡献者，或两者兼具。方法：对554名修复ToF患者进行回顾性纵向研究（2003-2026年，共1448次心血管磁共振检查）。分析主动脉根部尺寸、总动脉顺应性（TAC）和全身血管阻力（SVR），并使用混合效应模型分离患者间和患者内的LVEF关联。结果：在分析样本中（1053个观察，521名患者），主动脉窦直径在患者内（β = -0.23, p<0.001）和患者间（β = -0.20, p=0.003）均能预测LVEF。该关联在窦管连接处得到重复，但在升主动脉处缺失，表明影响局限于根部。TAC在患者内预测LVEF（β=0.90每mL/mmHg, p=0.014），但在患者间不显著（p=0.62），表明脉动后负荷是动态因素。

items.title: A First-Visit Clinical Score to Distinguish Immunoglobulin Light-Chain from Wild-Type Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis: Derivation and Internal Validation
items.abstract: Background: Delayed diagnosis of immunoglobulin light-chain cardiac amyloidosis (AL-CA) worsens prognosis, partly because AL-CA and wild-type transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTRwt-CA) are difficult to distinguish at the initial cardiology visit. We developed and validated a practical score to triage AL-CA from ATTRwt-CA. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 541 consecutive patients with cardiac amyloidosis (91 AL-CA, 450 ATTRwt-CA) at our institution's amyloidosis center, randomly divided into derivation (n=378) and validation (n=163) cohorts. Candidate first-visit variables underwent LASSO selection after multiple imputation, with estimates pooled by Rubin's rules. Performance was assessed by bootstrap validation, calibration, and decision curve analysis. The model was converted into a simplified point-based score. Results: Seven variables were retained: age, absence of atrial fibrillation, absence of carpal tunnel syndrome, low serum albumin, proteinuria ([ ]1+), low voltage, and thinner left ventricular posterior wall thickness. Areas under the curve (AUC) were 0.97 in the derivation cohort and 0.99 in the validation cohort; the bootstrap optimism-corrected AUC was 0.96. The model provided net benefit across threshold probabilities of 0.01-0.50. Risk tiering categorized the validation cohort into low (0-5 points; AL-CA 0%), intermediate (6?9 points; 26%), and high (10-13 points; 95%) probability groups. Discrimination remained high for AL-CA versus monoclonal protein-positive ATTRwt-CA at a cutoff of [ ]8 points (AUC 0.90). Adding this score to monoclonal protein testing significantly improved diagnostic performance compared with monoclonal protein testing alone. Conclusions: This simple first-visit score may help cardiologists rapidly triage suspected AL-CA and prioritize urgent hematology referral and subtype-specific confirmatory testing.
items.authors: Matsumoto, Y.; Izumiya, Y.; Kawano, Y.; Kuyama, N.; Morikawa, K.; Tabira, A.; Yamamoto, M.; Hirakawa, K.; Ishii, M.; Hanatani, S.; Matsuzawa, Y.; Usuku, H.; Yamamoto, E.; Soejima, H.; Tsujita, K.
items.l1_lead: 我们开发了一种简便的评分系统，能够在首次就诊时有效区分免疫球蛋白轻链心脏淀粉样变性与野生型转甲状腺素心脏淀粉样变性，从而改善诊断效率和预后。
items.l2_summary:
在心脏淀粉样变性（cardiac amyloidosis）患者中，免疫球蛋白轻链心脏淀粉样变性（AL-CA）与野生型转甲状腺素心脏淀粉样变性（ATTRwt-CA）在初诊时难以区分，延误诊断会导致预后恶化。为此，研究团队开发并验证了一种实用的评分系统，以帮助在初次心脏科就诊时快速识别AL-CA与ATTRwt-CA。研究回顾性分析了541名连续就诊于淀粉样变性中心的心脏淀粉样变性患者，其中91例为AL-CA，450例为ATTRwt-CA。这些患者被随机分为衍生组（378例）和验证组（163例）。研究通过LASSO选择法对候选变量进行筛选，并采用Rubin规则进行多重插补后汇总估计。模型的性能通过自助法验证、校准和决策曲线分析进行评估，最终将模型转化为简化的积分评分系统。

研究保留了七个关键变量：年龄、无房颤、无腕管综合症、低血清白蛋白、蛋白尿（[ ]1+）、低电压以及左心室后壁厚度较薄。衍生组的曲线下面积（AUC）为0.97，验证组为0.99，经过自助法校正后的AUC为0.96。该模型在0.01-0.50的阈值概率范围内提供了净收益。风险分层将验证组分为低风险（0-5分；AL-CA 0%）、中风险（6-9分；26%）和高风险（10-13分；95%）三组。在与单克隆蛋白阳性ATTRwt-CA的比较中，AL-CA的区分能力在8分的临界值下仍然较高（AUC 0.90）。将该评分系统与单克隆蛋白检测结合使用，显著提高了诊断性能。

综上所述，这一简单的初诊评分系统能够帮助心脏科医生快速识别疑似AL-CA患者，并优先安排紧急的血液学转诊和亚型特异性的确认检测，从而改善患者的诊断和治疗时机。
items.title_zh: 区分免疫球蛋白轻链与野生型转甲状腺素心脏淀粉样变的首次就诊评分
items.summary_zh: 背景：免疫球蛋白轻链心脏淀粉样变（AL-CA）的延迟诊断会恶化预后，部分原因是AL-CA与野生型转甲状腺素心脏淀粉样变（ATTRwt-CA）在初次心脏病就诊时难以区分。我们开发并验证了一种实用评分以区分AL-CA与ATTRwt-CA。方法：我们回顾性分析了541名心脏淀粉样变患者（91例AL-CA，450例ATTRwt-CA），随机分为开发组（n=378）和验证组（n=163）。候选变量经过LASSO选择，采用Rubin规则进行估计汇总。通过自助法验证、校准和决策曲线分析评估模型性能，并将其转化为简化的积分评分。结果：保留了七个变量：年龄、无房颤、无腕管综合症、低血清白蛋白、蛋白尿（[ ]1+）、低电压及左心室后壁厚度较薄。开发组和验证组的曲线下面积（AUC）分别为0.97和0.99；自助法校正后的AUC为0.96。模型在0.01-0.50的阈值概率范围内提供了净收益。风险分层将验证组分类为低（0-5分；AL-CA 0%）、中（6-9分；26%）和高（10-13分）风险。

items.title: ACTH-independent hypercortisolism across the cardiometabolic spectrum
items.abstract: Background: Accumulating evidence suggests that the prevalence of hypercortisolism in patients with cardiometabolic risk factors is much higher than previously thought. This study aimed to evaluate the prevalence of ACTH-independent hypercortisolism across the spectrum of cardiometabolic risk. Methods: Participants were prospectively recruited into three cohorts to undergo protocolized assessment of adrenal physiology:1) normotensive participants; 2) participants with hypertension and obesity, but without diabetes; 3) participants with diabetes and overweight/obesity. All participants (n=216) underwent overnight 1 mg dexamethasone suppression testing followed by cosyntropin stimulation test, and 24-hour urine free cortisol (UFC) testing. ACTH-independent hypercortisolism was defined as post-dexamethasone serum cortisol >1.8 g/dL (50 nmol/L) with a concomitant post-dexamethasone ACTH [ ]10 pg/mL (2.2 pmol/L). Result: 16 of 216 (7.4%) participants were found to have ACTH-independent hypercortisolism, including 5.6% (4/71) in the normotensive cohort, 6.2% (5/81) in the hypertension-obesity cohort and 10.9% (7/64) in the diabetes-obesity cohort. Age, body mass index, hemoglobin A1c, blood pressure, renal function, morning ACTH, and 24-hour UFC were similar among those with and without ACTH-independent hypercortisolism. Following cosyntropin stimulation, those with ACTH-independent hypercortisolism had higher stimulated cortisol levels (greater ACTH-dependent responses) when compared to those without ACTH-independent hypercortisolism: 25.8 +/- 4.5 versus 20.6 +/- 4.1 g/dL (711 +/- 124 v. 568 +/- 113 nmol/L) (P<0.001). Conclusions: In this prospective study, the prevalence of ACTH-independent hypercortisolism paralleled the burden of cardiometabolic risk features. ACTH-independent hypercortisolism was associated with greater ACTH-stimulable cortisol production, identifying a unique biochemical phenotype. These findings reveal new insights into cortisol pathophysiology as a function of ACTH and cardiometabolic risk profiles.
items.authors: Newman, A. J.; Mahrokhian, S.; Hanna, I.; Tsai, C.-H.; Parisien-La Salle, S.; Auchus, R. J.; Brown, J. M.; Vaidya, A.
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症在心脏代谢风险患者中的发生率显著高于预期，并与更高的ACTH刺激性皮质醇产生相关。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在评估在心脏代谢风险谱中，ACTH（促肾上腺皮质激素）独立性高皮质醇血症的流行率。随着越来越多的证据表明，患有心脏代谢风险因素的患者中，高皮质醇血症的发生率远高于以往的认识，研究者招募了216名参与者，分为三组进行前瞻性评估：1）正常血压参与者；2）有高血压和肥胖但无糖尿病的参与者；3）有糖尿病且超重/肥胖的参与者。所有参与者均接受了过夜1毫克地塞米松抑制试验，随后进行促肾上腺皮质激素刺激试验和24小时尿游离皮质醇（UFC）测试。研究将ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症定义为地塞米松后血清皮质醇水平超过1.8 g/dL（50 nmol/L），同时地塞米松后ACTH水平低于10 pg/mL（2.2 pmol/L）。

结果显示，在216名参与者中，有16名（7.4%）被发现存在ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症，其中正常血压组为5.6%（4/71），高血压-肥胖组为6.2%（5/81），而糖尿病-肥胖组则为10.9%（7/64）。在年龄、体重指数、糖化血红蛋白、血压、肾功能、晨间ACTH及24小时UFC等指标上，存在和不存在ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症的参与者相似。然而，在促肾上腺皮质激素刺激后，ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症患者的刺激性皮质醇水平显著高于无此病症的患者，分别为25.8 ± 4.5 g/dL（711 ± 124 nmol/L）与20.6 ± 4.1 g/dL（568 ± 113 nmol/L），差异具有统计学意义（P<0.001）。

综上所述，本研究表明，ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症的流行率与心脏代谢风险特征的负担呈正相关，并且这种病症与更高的ACTH刺激性皮质醇生成相关，揭示了一种独特的生化表型。这些发现为理解皮质醇的病理生理机制提供了新的视角，强调了ACTH与心脏代谢风险谱之间的关系。
items.title_zh: 心血管代谢谱中ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症的研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：越来越多的证据表明，心血管代谢风险因素患者中高皮质醇血症的发生率远高于以往认为。本研究旨在评估心血管代谢风险谱中ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症的流行情况。方法：参与者被前瞻性招募为三组，接受肾上腺生理的规范评估：1）正常血压参与者；2）高血压和肥胖但无糖尿病的参与者；3）糖尿病及超重/肥胖参与者。所有参与者（n=216）接受了过夜1 mg地塞米松抑制测试、促肾上腺皮质激素刺激测试和24小时尿游离皮质醇测试。ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症定义为地塞米松后血清皮质醇>1.8 g/dL（50 nmol/L），同时地塞米松后ACTH<10 pg/mL（2.2 pmol/L）。结果：216名参与者中有16名（7.4%）被发现有ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症，其中正常血压组5.6%（4/71），高血压-肥胖组6.2%（5/81），糖尿病-肥胖组10.9%（7/64）。年龄、体重指数、糖化血红蛋白、血压、肾功能、晨间ACTH和24小时尿游离皮质醇在有无ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症者之间相似。

items.title: Assessing and refining a metabolite-based distress score for use in different populations within three US cohorts
items.abstract: Introduction: Psychological distress is associated with metabolic alterations that contribute to adverse cardiometabolic outcomes across diverse populations. We previously developed a metabolite-based distress score (MDS) in predominantly White women. Because men and Black individuals suffer high rates of cardiometabolic disease, we evaluated whether the MDS is similarly associated with depression in these populations, and derived a multi-ethnic MDS (MDS-ME) among Black individuals with replications in independent samples. Methods: Data were from three U.S. cohorts, the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA), Women's Health Initiative (WHI), and Nurses' Health Study (NHS), evaluated in 4 stages. Stages 1-3 included 2,477 White and 1,625 Black MESA participants with depression status data and plasma metabolomics assessed at baseline. Stage 1: We calculated the MDS and examined its association with depression status. Stage 2: We conducted an agnostic analysis among a 70% random subset of Black participants to identify additional relevant metabolites. Stage 3: We derived an MDS-ME in Black participants. Stage 4: We evaluated the MDS-ME using independent samples from all three cohorts. Results: The previously validated 20-metabolite MDS showed stronger associations with prevalent depression in White (OR: 1.93, 95% CI: 1.71, 2.19) versus Black (OR: 1.13, 95% CI: 0.97, 1.33) MESA participants. Associations were generally similar in men and women. The MDS-ME comprised 33 metabolites, and relative to the MDS was more strongly associated with depression in Black participants (OR: 1.45; 95% CI: 1.04, 2.03), with associations also evident in White participants (OR: 1.81; 95% CI: 1.60, 2.04). The MDS-ME was similarly associated with depression in Black women in WHI and NHS. Conclusion: Results suggest that incorporating metabolites identified in Black participants enhances the utility and generalizability of the MDS across more diverse populations.
items.authors: Huang, T.; Zhu, Y.; Balasubramanian, R.; Roberts, A.; Clish, C. B.; Pacheco, J. A.; Rotter, J.; Guo, X.; Yao, J.; Chen, Y.-D. I.; Rich, S.; Taylor, K.; Wood, A.; Johnson, W. C.; Shutta, K. H.; Rexrode, K.; Shadyab, A. H.; Jung, S. Y.; Manson, J. E.; Hankinson, S. E.; Kubzansky, L. D.
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，结合黑人群体中识别的代谢物可以增强代谢基础心理痛苦评分的有效性和适用性，从而更好地适用于不同种族人群。
items.l2_summary:
心理困扰与代谢变化密切相关，这些变化可能导致不同人群中不良的心脏代谢结果。研究团队之前在以白人女性为主的群体中开发了基于代谢物的困扰评分（Metabolite-Based Distress Score, MDS）。鉴于男性和黑人个体面临更高的心脏代谢疾病风险，本研究旨在评估MDS在这些人群中的适用性，并在黑人个体中推导出多民族代谢物困扰评分（Multi-Ethnic Distress Score, MDS-ME），并在独立样本中进行验证。

本研究的数据来源于美国的三个队列：动脉粥样硬化多民族研究（Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis, MESA）、女性健康倡议（Women's Health Initiative, WHI）和护士健康研究（Nurses' Health Study, NHS），共分为四个阶段进行评估。第一至第三阶段包括2,477名白人和1,625名黑人MESA参与者的抑郁状态数据及基线血浆代谢组学评估。在第一阶段，研究团队计算了MDS并考察其与抑郁状态的关联。第二阶段中，随机选取70%的黑人参与者进行无偏分析，以识别其他相关代谢物。第三阶段则在黑人参与者中推导出MDS-ME。第四阶段使用来自三个队列的独立样本评估MDS-ME。

结果显示，之前验证的20种代谢物构成的MDS在白人MESA参与者中与抑郁的相关性更强（优势比OR: 1.93，95%置信区间CI: 1.71, 2.19），而在黑人参与者中则较弱（OR: 1.13，95% CI: 0.97, 1.33）。男性和女性的关联性总体相似。MDS-ME由33种代谢物组成，相较于MDS在黑人参与者中与抑郁的相关性更强（OR: 1.45；95% CI: 1.04, 2.03），在白人参与者中也显现出相关性（OR: 1.81；95% CI: 1.60, 2.04）。MDS-ME在WHI和NHS的黑人女性中同样与抑郁相关。

综上所述，研究结果表明，纳入黑人参与者识别的代谢物能够增强MDS在更广泛人群中的适用性和普遍性，提示在多样化人群中使用代谢物评分的重要性。
items.title_zh: 评估和完善代谢物基础的心理压力评分在不同人群中的应用
items.summary_zh: 引言：心理压力与代谢变化相关，这些变化会导致不同人群中不良的心脏代谢结果。我们之前在主要为白人女性的研究中开发了代谢物基础的心理压力评分（MDS）。由于男性和黑人个体的心脏代谢疾病发生率较高，我们评估了MDS在这些人群中与抑郁的关联，并在黑人个体中推导出多民族MDS（MDS-ME），并在独立样本中进行了验证。方法：数据来自三个美国队列，包括动脉粥样硬化多民族研究（MESA）、女性健康倡议（WHI）和护士健康研究（NHS），分四个阶段进行评估。结果：之前验证的20种代谢物MDS在白人（OR: 1.93, 95% CI: 1.71, 2.19）与黑人（OR: 1.13, 95% CI: 0.97, 1.33）中与抑郁的关联更强。

items.title: Trends in Lyme disease incidence in England, 2013 to 2024
items.abstract: Official Lyme disease incidence figures for England are based on the number of cases with a laboratory-confirmed diagnosis from the national reference laboratory. However, these figures underestimate the true incidence of acute cases since patients can also be diagnosed clinically without the need for laboratory testing. The use of a multiplication factor has been proposed to estimate total Lyme disease incidence from the number of laboratory-confirmed cases. The current multiplication factor is derived from data spanning 1998 to 2016 and is thought to be outdated, in part due to the introduction of new national Lyme disease management guidance in 2018. The aim of this study was to analyse more recent laboratory and primary care data to identify trends in case numbers and to derive updated estimates of the total annual number of acute Lyme disease cases in England. Data spanning 2013 to 2024 from the national reference laboratory and a primary care data source were analysed using seasonal time series models. The presence of structural breaks was investigated using the PELT or BinSeg methods, and annual multiplication factors were estimated using a Poisson regression model. No substantial change was found in the number of laboratory-confirmed Lyme cases from 2013 to 2024 in England, whereas the number of cases diagnosed in primary care increased significantly over the same period, with an average of an additional 498 cases per year. This has increased our best estimate of the multiplication factor from 2.35 (95% confidence interval, 1.81 - 2.88) to 6.20 (6.17 - 6.24), which is the average for the years 2020 - 2024. Use of this updated multiplication factor should improve the accuracy of annual symptomatic Lyme disease case estimates for England.
items.authors: Olver, J. C.; Burdon, M. G.; Emanuel, E.; Datoo, A.; FermorDunman, V.; Ferguson, M.; I'Anson, J.; Vivancos, R.; Petridou, C.; Semper, A.
items.l1_lead: 2013至2024年间，英格兰的莱姆病实验室确认病例数未显著变化，但初级医疗诊断病例显著增加，更新的乘数因子提高至6.20，有助于更准确估计莱姆病年发病率。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在分析2013年至2024年间英格兰莱姆病（Lyme disease）的发病趋势，并更新莱姆病的总年发病估计。官方的莱姆病发病数据是基于国家参考实验室确认的实验室诊断病例，但这些数据低估了急性病例的真实发病率，因为患者也可以通过临床诊断而无需实验室检测。为此，研究提出了一种乘数因子（multiplication factor）来估算总的莱姆病发病率，该乘数因子基于1998年至2016年的数据，但由于2018年新国家莱姆病管理指南的引入，这一因子可能已经过时。

通过分析来自国家参考实验室和初级医疗数据源的2013年至2024年的数据，研究采用季节性时间序列模型进行分析，并使用PELT或BinSeg方法调查结构性变化的存在，同时利用泊松回归模型（Poisson regression model）估算年度乘数因子。研究发现，从2013年至2024年，英格兰的实验室确认的莱姆病病例数量没有显著变化，而在初级医疗中诊断的病例数量则显著增加，年均增加498例。这一变化使得我们对乘数因子的最佳估计从2.35（95%置信区间为1.81 - 2.88）提高到6.20（95%置信区间为6.17 - 6.24），这是2020年至2024年的平均值。使用这一更新的乘数因子将有助于提高英格兰年度莱姆病症状病例估计的准确性。通过本研究，能够更全面地了解莱姆病的流行趋势，为公共卫生政策的制定提供更为可靠的数据支持。
items.title_zh: 2013至2024年英格兰莱姆病发病率趋势研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了2013至2024年英格兰的莱姆病发病率，基于国家参考实验室的实验室确诊病例数据和初级医疗数据。由于患者可通过临床诊断而无需实验室检测，官方数据可能低估了急性病例的真实发病率。研究采用季节性时间序列模型分析数据，并使用PELT或BinSeg方法检查结构性变化，利用泊松回归模型估算年度乘数因子。结果显示，2013至2024年间，实验室确诊的莱姆病例数量没有显著变化，而初级医疗诊断的病例数量在同一时期显著增加。这表明需要更新莱姆病的发病率估算方法。

items.title: Capturing Social Prescribing in Primary Care Health Records: A Study of Coding Practices in England
items.abstract: Background: Social prescribing has expanded rapidly in England and internationally. However, the collection of consistent data to monitor and evaluate its reach and impact remains to be challenging. Methods: This study used routine data from the Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Aurum in England. UpSet plots were used to describe intersections among different social prescribing codes, and between social prescribing and other non-clinical interventions. After identifying potential problematic intersections, we fitted multilevel regression models to examine variation between general practices and to understand factors associated with potentially problematic coding. Findings: Between 2019 and 2025, approximately 3.8 million consultations involving social prescribing codes were recorded in CPRD Aurum. Social prescribing codes were most often recorded individually (38.1%), but intersections existed both among different social prescribing codes, and between social prescribing and related non-clinical support. Many intersections reflect plausible stages and scenarios within the social prescribing pathway. However, some coding patterns appeared ambiguous or potentially inconsistent, particularly those related to social prescribing being offered and referrals being made. Results from the multilevel regression models suggested that 28.4-34.6% of variation in these codes was attributable to differences between practices, and problematic coding varied by region and year of recording. Interpretation: Our findings highlight opportunities to improve the quality and consistency of social prescribing coding in primary care, thereby strengthening service monitoring and evaluation both in England and internationally. They also provide important insights for researchers using CPRD data to investigate social prescribing.
items.authors: Bu, F.; Fancourt, D.
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了英格兰初级医疗中社会处方编码的一致性问题，强调了改善编码质量的重要性，以增强服务监测和评估的有效性。
items.l2_summary:
社会处方（social prescribing）在英格兰及国际上迅速发展，但在监测和评估其影响及覆盖范围时，数据收集的一致性仍然面临挑战。本研究利用英格兰的临床实践研究数据链接（Clinical Practice Research Datalink, CPRD）Aurum的常规数据，分析了社会处方编码的实践情况。研究采用UpSet图来描述不同社会处方编码之间的交集，以及社会处方与其他非临床干预措施之间的关系。通过识别潜在的问题交集，研究者使用多层次回归模型来考察不同全科医疗实践之间的变异性，并理解与潜在问题编码相关的因素。

在2019年至2025年间，CPRD Aurum记录了约380万次涉及社会处方编码的咨询。数据显示，社会处方编码最常以单独形式记录，占38.1%，但不同社会处方编码之间以及社会处方与相关非临床支持之间存在交集。这些交集反映了社会处方路径中的合理阶段和情境。然而，某些编码模式显得模糊或可能不一致，尤其是与社会处方的提供和转诊相关的编码。多层次回归模型的结果表明，28.4%至34.6%的编码变异性可归因于不同医疗实践之间的差异，且问题编码在不同地区和记录年份之间存在变化。

研究结果强调了改善初级医疗中社会处方编码质量和一致性的机会，从而增强英格兰及国际上服务监测和评估的能力。此外，这些发现为使用CPRD数据研究社会处方的研究者提供了重要的见解。
items.title_zh: 初级医疗记录中社会处方的编码实践研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：社会处方在英格兰及国际上迅速发展，但收集一致的数据以监测和评估其影响仍然具有挑战性。方法：本研究使用了来自英格兰临床实践研究数据链接（CPRD）Aurum的常规数据。通过UpSet图描述不同社会处方编码之间的交集，以及社会处方与其他非临床干预之间的关系。在识别潜在问题交集后，采用多层回归模型分析不同全科诊所之间的变异，并理解与潜在编码问题相关的因素。发现：2019年至2025年间，CPRD Aurum记录了约380万次涉及社会处方编码的咨询。社会处方编码大多单独记录（38.1%），但不同编码之间及与相关非临床支持之间存在交集。这些交集反映了社会处方路径中的合理阶段和情境。然而，一些编码模式显得模糊或可能不一致，特别是与社会处方的提供和转诊相关的编码。多层回归模型的结果表明，这些编码的变异中有28.4%-34.6%是由于属性造成的。

items.title: Meningococcal epidemiology in Ethiopia after MenAfriVac: A situational analysis of surveillance gaps and national meningococcal vaccine policy.
items.abstract: Abstract Ethiopia introduced the MenAfriVac vaccine to control epidemics of serogroup A meningococcal disease (MenA) between 2013 and 2015. Since the campaign, no MenA epidemics have been reported. However, lacking a follow-up strategy, two critical questions remained unanswered: (1) is protection against MenA waning to a point where epidemics could re-emerge and (2) are non-A serogroups, known to cause outbreaks elsewhere in the meningitis belt, currently circulating in Ethiopia? To inform future policy, this situational analysis draws on historical records, post-2015 surveillance data, MenAfriVac campaign reports, and the current policy landscape to assess meningococcal epidemiology in Ethiopia. Available national data cannot answer either question. Disease notification relies on sentinel surveillance at three hospitals; none located in the epidemic risk western regions and none with a defined catchment population. Cases are rarely laboratory-confirmed, almost never serogrouped, and the resulting data are not reported in a timely manner. Primary carriage and serosurvey studies remain limited, and their methodological heterogeneity including diverse populations, sampling techniques and laboratory assays restricts their generalisability for population-level policy decisions. In the absence of quality primary data, indirect risk estimation based on campaign coverage and regional waning models indicates that population protection dropped from 85% in 2015 to 24% in 2024 and will fall further to 11% by 2030 without intervention. Despite this, the current E-NITAG prioritisation exercise relies on this sparse evidence base, excludes MenAfriVac from the candidate list, and does not incorporate costing or serogroup-coverage data. Addressing the meningococcal evidence gap requires rebuilding national surveillance into a tiered system. Under this structure, primary facilities manage clinical case detection, regional and zonal hospitals perform confirmatory testing, and representative tertiary hospitals conduct serogrouping and genomic characterization with national laboratory support. Until this longitudinal surveillance yields sufficient data for policy decisions, supplementary carriage and seroepidemiological studies remain necessary to assess circulating serogroups and population immunity.
items.authors: Regassa, L. D.; Trotter, C.; Assefa, N.; Scott, J. A. G.
items.l1_lead: 埃塞俄比亚在MenAfriVac疫苗接种后，尽管未再报告MenA疫情，但缺乏有效的监测和数据支持，导致对免疫保护和非A血清群流行情况的评估存在重大空白。
items.l2_summary:
埃塞俄比亚于2013年至2015年间引入了MenAfriVac疫苗，以控制A群脑膜炎球菌病（MenA）的流行。自疫苗接种活动以来，未报告MenA疫情。然而，由于缺乏后续监测策略，仍有两个关键问题未得到解答：一是对MenA的保护是否正在减弱到可能重新出现疫情的程度，二是其他已知在脑膜炎带引发疫情的非A群脑膜炎球菌是否在埃塞俄比亚传播。为此，本研究通过分析历史记录、2015年后的监测数据、MenAfriVac疫苗接种活动报告及当前政策环境，评估埃塞俄比亚的脑膜炎球菌流行病学。

现有的国家数据无法回答上述问题。疾病报告主要依赖于三家医院的哨点监测，这些医院均不位于疫情风险较高的西部地区，且没有明确的服务人群。病例的实验室确认率极低，几乎没有进行血清分型，导致数据报告不及时。初级携带率和血清调查研究数量有限，且由于不同人群、采样技术和实验室检测方法的异质性，限制了其在群体政策决策中的普遍适用性。在缺乏高质量的初级数据的情况下，基于疫苗接种覆盖率和区域保护减弱模型的间接风险估计显示，人口保护率从2015年的85%下降至2024年的24%，并预计到2030年将进一步降至11%。尽管如此，目前的埃塞俄比亚国家免疫技术咨询小组（E-NITAG）优先级评估依赖于这一稀缺的证据基础，排除了MenAfriVac疫苗候选名单，并未纳入成本或血清群覆盖数据。

为了解决脑膜炎球菌的证据缺口，需要重建国家监测体系，建立分层结构。在这一结构下，初级医疗机构负责临床病例的检测，区域和区域医院进行确认检测，具有代表性的三级医院则进行血清分型和基因组特征分析，并提供国家实验室支持。在这一长期监测体系产生足够的数据以支持政策决策之前，补充的携带率和血清流行病学研究仍然是必要的，以评估当前流行的血清群和人群免疫状况。
items.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚MenAfriVac后脑膜炎球菌流行病学分析
items.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚于2013至2015年间引入MenAfriVac疫苗以控制A群脑膜炎球菌病（MenA）疫情。自此以来未报告MenA疫情。然而，由于缺乏后续策略，仍有两个关键问题未解答：（1）对MenA的保护是否正在减弱，可能导致疫情重新出现？（2）在脑膜炎带其他地区已知会引发疫情的非A群脑膜炎球菌目前是否在埃塞俄比亚传播？本研究通过历史记录、2015年后的监测数据、MenAfriVac活动报告及当前政策环境进行情境分析，评估埃塞俄比亚的脑膜炎球菌流行病学。现有国家数据无法回答这两个问题，疾病报告依赖于三家医院的哨点监测，均位于疫情风险较低的地区，且病例很少经过实验室确认，几乎从未进行血清分型，数据报告不及时。主要的携带率和血清调查研究有限，方法学异质性限制了其对人口政策决策的普遍适用性。

items.title: Magnetic Resonance Elastography of Regional Aortic Mechanics and True- and False-Lumen Stiffness in Aortic Dissection: A Feasibility Study
items.abstract: Objective Regional aortic mechanics and the mechanical environments of the true and false lumens are not represented by maximal diameter alone. We evaluated whether magnetic resonance elastography (MRE) could provide paired descending thoracic and abdominal aorta stiffness estimates and separate true- and false-lumen estimates in thoracic aortic dissection. Methods We acquired 60-Hz descending thoracic and abdominal aortic MRE data in 10 healthy subjects and in 2 patients with chronic type B aortic dissections. Three motion-encoding directions and four temporal offsets were reduced to first-harmonic complex wave fields. After directional filtering, we traced a curved centerline through the aortic mask. Local spatial frequency was estimated along arc length and converted to effective shear stiffness. The primary regional outcome was the mean effective stiffness over the central 20%-90% of the path from the quality-ranked slice in each region. In dissection, the whole-aorta mask and flap were defined on a registered sagittal scout; a vascular surgeon assigned the true and false lumens, and separate, manually centered lumen paths followed one union-mask phase correction and unwrapping step. We compared regional values with paired tests. Results All 10 regional datasets and all 56 available slices were processed without failure. The 10 healthy volunteers (mean age, 26.6 +/- 4.6 years; 6 men) had descending thoracic stiffness of 15.43 +/- 3.30 kPa and abdominal stiffness of 19.20 +/- 3.14 kPa. The mean thoracic-minus-abdominal difference was -3.77 +/- 3.40 kPa (95% confidence interval, -6.20 to -1.34 kPa; paired t-test, P=.007; exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test, P=.010). Eight participants had a higher abdominal value, and two had a higher thoracic value. In Subject A with a chronic aortic dissection, slice-averaged true- and false-lumen stiffness was 21.62 and 19.07 kPa, respectively (false-minus-true, -2.54 kPa; absolute percentage difference, 12.5%). In Subject B with a chronic aortic dissection, corresponding values were 12.17 and 17.40 kPa (false-minus-true, +5.22 kPa; 35.3%). Conclusions We demonstrated the feasibility of MRE to provide paired regional analysis of the aorta in healthy people and to separate stiffness profiles of the true and false lumens in Type B thoracic dissection cases. Abdominal effective stiffness exceeded descending thoracic stiffness in the volunteer cohort. Opposite true- and false-lumen contrast in the two subjects with chronic Tye B aortic dissections demonstrates measurement feasibility but does not establish a consistent compartment pattern, disease threshold, or intrinsic wall material property.
items.authors: Hirad, A. A.; Dong, H.; Nanjappa, M.; Kedwai, B.; Thompson, K.; Kruger, J.; Chen, J.; Kolipaka, A.; Mix, D.
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，磁共振弹性成像可有效分析健康人群和胸主动脉夹层患者的主动脉区域机械特性及真、假腔的刚度差异。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨磁共振弹性成像（Magnetic Resonance Elastography, MRE）在评估主动脉夹层中区域主动脉机械特性及真腔和假腔刚度方面的可行性。研究表明，单靠最大直径并不能全面反映区域主动脉的机械特性及真、假腔的机械环境。研究中，我们对10名健康志愿者和2名慢性B型主动脉夹层患者进行了60赫兹的胸降主动脉和腹主动脉MRE数据采集。通过三种运动编码方向和四个时间偏移量，我们将数据简化为一阶谐波复数波场，并在经过方向过滤后，沿主动脉掩膜追踪出一条曲线中心线。局部空间频率沿弧长进行估算，并转换为有效剪切刚度。主要的区域结果是从每个区域的质量排名切片中，计算出路径中心20%-90%范围内的平均有效刚度。

在主动脉夹层的分析中，我们在注册的矢状面扫描图上定义了整个主动脉掩膜和瓣膜，由血管外科医生分配真腔和假腔，并在经过一次联合掩膜相位校正和展开步骤后，手动中心化各自的腔道路径。通过配对测试比较区域值。结果显示，所有10个区域数据集和56个可用切片均成功处理。10名健康志愿者（平均年龄26.6 ± 4.6岁；6名男性）的胸降主动脉刚度为15.43 ± 3.30 kPa，腹主动脉刚度为19.20 ± 3.14 kPa。胸降与腹部的平均差异为-3.77 ± 3.40 kPa（95%置信区间为-6.20至-1.34 kPa；配对t检验P=0.007；确切Wilcoxon符号秩检验P=0.010）。其中8名参与者的腹部值较高，2名的胸部值较高。

在慢性主动脉夹层的患者A中，真腔和假腔的切片平均刚度分别为21.62 kPa和19.07 kPa（假腔与真腔差值为-2.54 kPa；绝对百分比差为12.5%）。在患者B中，相应的值为12.17 kPa和17.40 kPa（假腔与真腔差值为+5.22 kPa；35.3%）。综上所述，本研究展示了MRE在健康人群中进行主动脉区域分析的可行性，并能够在B型胸主动脉夹层病例中区分真腔和假腔的刚度特征。志愿者组中，腹部有效刚度超过了胸降主动脉刚度，而在两名慢性主动脉夹层患者中，真腔和假腔的刚度表现出相反的趋势。
items.title_zh: 主动脉夹层区域机械特性及腔体刚度的磁共振弹性成像研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：区域主动脉机械特性及真腔与假腔的机械环境不能仅通过最大直径表示。本研究评估磁共振弹性成像（MRE）在胸主动脉夹层中提供降主动脉刚度估计及区分真腔与假腔的可行性。方法：在10名健康受试者及2名慢性B型主动脉夹层患者中获取60Hz的降主动脉MRE数据。通过三种运动编码方向和四个时间偏移量生成一阶谐波复合波场。经过方向滤波后，沿主动脉掩膜追踪曲线中心线。局部空间频率沿弧长估计并转换为有效剪切刚度。主要区域结果为每个区域质量排名切片的中心20%-90%路径的平均有效刚度。在夹层中，整个主动脉掩膜和瓣膜在注册的矢状面上定义；血管外科医生分配真腔与假腔，分别手动中心化腔体路径。结果：所有10个区域数据集及56个可用切片均成功处理。10名健康志愿者的平均年龄为26.6±4.6岁。

items.title: Cerebrovascular Reactivity to Hypoxic and Hypercapnic Gas Challenges Using 7T BOLD fMRI
items.abstract: Background. Cerebrovascular reactivity (CVR) is a sensitive marker of vascular health, most commonly measured with BOLD fMRI during hypercapnic gas challenges. Hypoxia is a complementary but under-characterized vasoactive stimulus. We characterize a combined hypercapnic-hypoxic gas-challenge paradigm at 7 Tesla BOLD fMRI and its cross-session reproducibility. Methods. Eleven healthy adults were scanned twice at 7 Tesla during an 18-minute multi-echo, multiband BOLD acquisition, receiving fixed-inspired hypercapnic (5% CO2) and hypoxic (10% O2) gas boluses separated by medical-air recovery periods, with end-tidal gas and peripheral saturation monitoring. Hypercapnic and hypoxic CVR were estimated using three trace-based general linear models: end-tidal gas, peripheral saturation, and Severinghaus-derived arterial saturation; and a finite impulse response model. Cross-session reproducibility was assessed by region-of-interest intraclass correlation. Results. The paradigm produced robust, condition-specific gray-matter BOLD responses that reproduced across sessions. The Severinghaus-derived saturation regressor generalized significantly better than end-tidal and peripheral regressors under cross-session validation and outperformed the finite impulse response benchmark in 58% of gray-matter voxels. Reproducibility across cortical, subcortical, and brainstem atlases was moderate-to-high (median cortical intraclass correlation 0.71). Conclusion. A combined hypercapnic-hypoxic paradigm yields reproducible voxelwise cerebrovascular reactivity maps at 7 Tesla; Severinghaus-derived arterial saturation is the most generalizable regressor for hypoxic reactivity.
items.authors: LoParco, S.; Miedema, M.; Choi, G.-Y.; Sayeh, M.; Wang, J.; Boudrias, M. H.; Mitsis, G.; Hoge, R.
items.l1_lead: 结合高碳酸血症和缺氧的气体挑战在7特斯拉BOLD fMRI下产生可重复的脑血管反应图谱，Severinghaus推导的动脉饱和度是缺氧反应中最具普适性的回归变量。
items.l2_summary:
脑血管反应性（Cerebrovascular Reactivity, CVR）是评估血管健康的重要指标，通常通过在高二氧化碳（hypercapnic）气体刺激下进行的BOLD（血氧水平依赖）功能磁共振成像（fMRI）来测量。尽管缺氧（hypoxia）作为一种补充的血管活性刺激尚未得到充分研究，本研究旨在利用7特斯拉（7T）BOLD fMRI技术，探讨一种结合高二氧化碳和缺氧气体挑战的实验范式，并评估其跨会话的可重复性。

研究中，11名健康成年人在7T设备上进行了两次扫描，每次扫描持续18分钟，采用多回声、多带宽的BOLD采集技术。参与者在实验中吸入固定浓度的高二氧化碳（5% CO2）和缺氧（10% O2）气体，期间穿插医疗空气的恢复期，并监测呼气末气体和外周血氧饱和度。通过三种基于时间序列的广义线性模型（包括呼气末气体、外周饱和度和Severinghaus推导的动脉饱和度）以及有限脉冲响应模型，估算高二氧化碳和缺氧的CVR。跨会话的可重复性通过感兴趣区域的组内相关系数进行评估。

结果显示，该实验范式能够产生强烈且特定于条件的灰质BOLD反应，并在不同会话中表现出良好的可重复性。Severinghaus推导的饱和度回归因子在跨会话验证中表现出显著优于呼气末和外周回归因子的能力，并在58%的灰质体素中超越了有限脉冲响应基准。研究还发现，皮层、皮层下结构和脑干的可重复性中等至高，皮层的组内相关系数中位数为0.71。

综上所述，结合高二氧化碳和缺氧的实验范式在7T BOLD fMRI中能够生成可重复的体素级脑血管反应性图谱，而Severinghaus推导的动脉饱和度是评估缺氧反应的最具普适性的回归因子。
items.title_zh: 7T BOLD fMRI下脑血管反应对缺氧与高碳酸气体挑战的研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：脑血管反应（CVR）是血管健康的敏感标志，通常通过BOLD fMRI在高碳酸气体挑战中测量。缺氧是一个补充但未充分表征的血管活性刺激。我们在7特斯拉BOLD fMRI下表征了一种结合高碳酸-缺氧气体挑战的范式及其跨会话重现性。方法：对11名健康成年人进行两次扫描，采用18分钟的多回声、多带宽BOLD采集，接受固定吸入的高碳酸（5% CO2）和缺氧（10% O2）气体冲击，期间有医疗空气恢复期，并监测呼气末气体和外周饱和度。使用三种基于痕迹的广义线性模型估计高碳酸和缺氧的CVR，并采用有限脉冲响应模型。跨会话重现性通过感兴趣区域的类内相关性进行评估。结果：该范式产生了稳健的、特定条件的灰质BOLD反应，并在会话间重现。Severinghaus衍生的饱和度回归器在跨会话验证中显著优于呼气末和外周回归器，并在58%的灰质体素中超越了有限脉冲响应基准。皮层、皮层下和脑干图谱的重现性为中等至良好。

items.title: Clinical and Decisional Trajectories Preceding Early Postprocedural Death Among Patients with Preexisting Code-Status Limitations
items.abstract: Objective: To develop a typology of recurrent clinical and decisional trajectories preceding early postprocedural death among patients with preexisting code-status limitations. Background: Patients with do-not-resuscitate orders experience higher postoperative mortality, but the clinical and decisional processes underlying early deaths are poorly understood. Mortality and code status alone cannot determine whether these deaths reflect constrained rescue, unsuccessful treatment, progression of terminal illness, or reassessment-driven redirection of care. Methods: We conducted a retrospective qualitative trajectory analysis of electronic health record documentation across five academic and community hospitals from March 2024 through June 2025. Eligible adults had an active preprocedural code-status limitation and died within 3 calendar days of a procedure requiring anesthesia, before hospital discharge. Using an adapted sequence-based composite approach, 2 reviewers independently reconstructed cases as ordered clinical and decisional sequences and reached consensus on recurrent trajectory families; illustrative composites were then generated. A third reviewer independently classified cases while blinded to the consensus assignments; agreement was assessed using unweighted Cohen kappa. Results: Among 2,833 patients with preexisting code-status limitations who underwent a procedure, 44 (1.6%) died within 3 days; the 42 who died before hospital discharge were included. Four trajectory families were identified: established terminal trajectory (5 [12%]), abrupt terminal event (5 [12%]), comfort-focused redirection after reassessment (29 [69%]), and sustained rescue attempt (3 [7%]). Redirection followed progressive deterioration or persistent critical illness despite treatment in 20 cases and a discrete event or finding in 9; rescue-oriented treatment frequently continued or escalated before reassessment and redirection. In sustained-rescue trajectories, intensive treatment continued through death, including in 2 patients whose limitations on CPR remained in effect. The independent reviewer agreed with the consensus classification for 39 of 42 cases (92.9%; {kappa}, 0.86; 95% CI, 0.70-1.00). Conclusions: Early postprocedural deaths among patients with preexisting code-status limitations followed distinct clinical and decisional trajectories. Mortality and code status alone could not distinguish an established terminal trajectory, abrupt death, reassessment-driven redirection, or sustained but unsuccessful rescue. A longitudinal approach that considers procedural intent, evolving prognosis, treatment, and reassessment provides a more clinically meaningful basis for interpreting mortality and structuring perioperative decision making.
items.authors: Allen, M. B.; Streid, J. L.; Lilley, E. J.; Ritchie, C. S.; Cauley, C. E.; Batten, J. N.; Bernacki, R. E.; Reich, A. J.; John, P. R.; Hepner, D. L.; Bader, A. M.; Shah, S. J.
items.l1_lead: 早期术后死亡的患者在既往有医疗限制的情况下，经历了不同的临床和决策轨迹，仅凭死亡率和医疗状态无法明确其死亡原因。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨在具有既往代码状态限制的患者中，早期术后死亡前的临床和决策轨迹类型。背景显示，持有不复苏（do-not-resuscitate, DNR）指令的患者在术后死亡率较高，但导致早期死亡的临床和决策过程尚不清楚。单纯依靠死亡率和代码状态无法判断这些死亡是否反映了救治受限、治疗失败、终末期疾病进展或基于重新评估的护理方向调整。

研究采用回顾性定性轨迹分析方法，分析了2024年3月至2025年6月期间五家学术和社区医院的电子健康记录。符合条件的成年人需在手术前有活跃的代码状态限制，并在接受麻醉的手术后3天内死亡，且在出院前去世。研究者使用改编的序列基础复合方法，独立重建病例的临床和决策序列，并达成共识，识别出重复出现的轨迹家族，随后生成了示例复合体。第三位评审者在不知情共识分类的情况下独立对病例进行分类，使用未加权的Cohen kappa评估一致性。

在2833名具有既往代码状态限制的患者中，44人（1.6%）在3天内去世，其中42人在出院前死亡并被纳入分析。研究识别出四种轨迹家族：既定终末期轨迹（5人，12%）、突发终末事件（5人，12%）、重新评估后的舒适导向重定向（29人，69%）和持续救治尝试（3人，7%）。在20例中，重定向发生在逐渐恶化或尽管治疗仍持续危重的情况下，而在9例中则是由于特定事件或发现。救治导向的治疗在重新评估和重定向前通常会继续或升级。在持续救治轨迹中，尽管有2名患者的心肺复苏（CPR）限制仍然有效，强烈治疗仍持续至死亡。独立评审者对42例中的39例（92.9%）的共识分类表示一致（kappa值为0.86，95% CI为0.70-1.00）。

结论指出，具有既往代码状态限制的患者在术后早期死亡的临床和决策轨迹具有明显的特征，仅依靠死亡率和代码状态无法区分既定终末期轨迹、突发死亡或基于重新评估的护理方向调整。
items.title_zh: 既往有代码状态限制患者术后早期死亡的临床与决策轨迹
items.summary_zh: 目的：开发既往有代码状态限制患者术后早期死亡的临床与决策轨迹类型。背景：不进行心肺复苏的患者术后死亡率较高，但早期死亡的临床与决策过程尚不清楚。仅凭死亡率和代码状态无法判断这些死亡是否反映了救治受限、治疗失败、疾病进展或基于重新评估的护理方向调整。方法：我们对2024年3月至2025年6月期间五家学术和社区医院的电子健康记录进行了回顾性定性轨迹分析。符合条件的成年人在接受麻醉的手术前有活跃的代码状态限制，并在手术后3天内去世。通过适应的序列基础复合方法，2名评审员独立重建病例的临床与决策序列，并就重复轨迹家族达成共识；随后生成了示例复合体。第三名评审员在不知情的情况下独立分类病例；使用未加权的Cohen kappa评估一致性。结果：在2833名既往有代码状态限制的患者中，接受了手术。

items.title: Continuous Diagnostic Indices from BanffNET Automated Lesion Scores for Kidney Transplant Pathology: Development and Evaluation of a Diagnostic Prediction Model
items.abstract: Background: Histopathological diagnoses in kidney transplant biopsies, as described by the Banff classification, suffer from substantial inter-observer variability and misinterpretation, making them prone to diagnostic errors. Continuous indices based on BanffNET automated lesion scores are proposed to quantify the continuous phenotypic spectrum of kidney transplant biopsies, complementary to pathologist assessment of biopsies. Methods: The BanffNET model was used to obtain continuous lesion scoring for a training cohort of 2544 biopsies, a large validation cohort of 3863 biopsies, and a multi-reader cohort of 36 biopsies scored by 67 pathologists. A penalized regression approach was used to condense 17 automated lesion scores into four indices, representing the most important dimensions of graft injury: a TCMR/TI Index, an AMR/MVI Index, an Activity Index and a Chronicity Index. The BanffNET Indices were evaluated against Banff diagnoses and histological indices in the training cohort and validation cohort. Since pathologist-assigned Banff lesions and diagnoses suffer from inter-observer variability, associations were also assessed with diagnoses in a multi-reader study, with time to kidney graft failure in the training and validation cohort and with biopsy-based molecular signatures in the validation cohort. Results: The BanffNET TCMR/TI Index, AMR/MVI Index and Activity Index showed excellent discrimination of Banff TCMR, Banff MVI and Banff Any Diagnosis respectively, with validation AUCs ranging from 0.80 to 0.92. In addition, the BanffNET Indices explained large amounts of variability in multi-observer reference standards, time to graft failure and molecular biopsy-based diagnostics. In the large majority of cases, variability explained by BanffNET Indices matched or exceeded the variability explained by pathologist-assigned diagnoses and histological indices. Conclusions: BanffNET Indices are reproducible descriptors of whole slide images that could complement and augment kidney transplant biopsy evaluation by pathologists. Associations of BanffNET Indices with multi-observer diagnoses and related outcomes suggest that they capture additional information on tissue injury type and severity on top of pathologist-assigned Banff diagnoses and histological indices.
