items.title_zh: USP15调控神经炎症并驱动突触核蛋白病的发病机制
items.summary_zh: 神经炎症在包括帕金森病在内的神经和神经退行性疾病的发病机制中起着重要作用。我们发现，在星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中去除Usp15能够在体内保护免受致命的神经炎症。在突触核蛋白病的小鼠模型中，Usp15缺失减少了大脑中的α-突触核蛋白沉积，减缓了疾病进展，并延长了生存时间。Usp15的神经保护作用与炎症通路的差异性表达相关，包括干扰素刺激基因。这些在体内的USP15依赖性效应在原代人类小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞中得到了重现。我们在帕金森病患者的小胶质细胞中检测到高水平的USP15表达，并与LRRK2和SNCA表现出强烈的共表达。在人类中，我们发现一个强大的顺式作用eQTL引导CD14+髓系细胞中高水平的USP15表达。驱动该eQTL的等位基因与疾病风险增加相关，连接了髓系USP15表达、帕金森病患者中升高的USP15血浆水平与遗传易感性。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，去除Usp15可减缓突触核蛋白病进展并延长生存时间，揭示其在神经炎症和帕金森病发病机制中的重要作用。
items.l2_summary:
神经炎症在神经和神经退行性疾病的发病机制中扮演着重要角色，尤其是在帕金森病等疾病中。研究发现，去除小鼠模型中的Usp15基因能够在星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中有效保护机体免受致命的神经炎症影响。在突触核蛋白病的小鼠模型中，Usp15缺失显著减少了大脑中α-突触核蛋白的沉积，减缓了疾病的进展，并延长了小鼠的生存时间。这一神经保护作用与炎症通路的差异性表达密切相关，尤其是与干扰素刺激基因的表达变化有关。

此外，研究还在原代人类小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞中重现了这些USP15依赖性的效应。在帕金森病患者的小胶质细胞中，研究团队检测到高水平的USP15表达，并发现其与LRRK2和SNCA基因表现出强烈的共表达关系。通过对人类样本的分析，研究者们发现一个强大的顺式作用表达数量性状基因座（eQTL）与CD14+髓系细胞中高水平的USP15表达相关联。驱动该eQTL的等位基因与帕金森病的疾病风险增加相关，进一步连接了髓系细胞中USP15的表达、帕金森病患者血浆中升高的USP15水平以及遗传易感性。

综上所述，Usp15在神经炎症和突触核蛋白病的发病机制中起着关键作用，其缺失能够减轻神经炎症，降低α-突触核蛋白的沉积，延缓疾病进展。这一发现为理解帕金森病的发病机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的治疗策略提供潜在的靶点。

items.title: Therapeutic-induced chromatin remodeling via AP-1/SWI-SNF enhances BK Polyomavirus replication in urothelial cells
items.abstract: Hemorrhagic cystitis (HC) caused by BK polyomavirus (BKPyV) reactivation is a serious complication in immunocompromised patients especially in hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients, yet the effects of conditioning regimens on viral replication remain undefined. Current therapies for HC are largely supportive, and no specific antiviral drugs are approved for BKPyV reactivation, underscoring an urgent need for new interventions. Here, using a cellular model of HC, we provide the first mechanistic evidence that physiologic concentrations of genotoxic chemotherapy, immune-conditioning, and antiviral exposures commonly enhance BKPyV replication by reprogramming host chromatin remodeling machinery independently of immune suppression. Transcriptomic and epigenomic profiling of urothelial cells revealed that these treatments induce host and virus chromatin remodeling, specifically, the SWI/SNF ATP-dependent remodeling complex is activated and creates a regulatory landscape enriched for AP-1 transcription factor motifs, implicating the AP-1/SWI-SNF axis as a key regulator of viral replication. Functional inhibition of SWI/SNF with AU-15330 and FHD-286 consistently suppressed BKPyV replication across all tested therapeutic conditions. Patient urine samples and cellular experiments demonstrated these effects are independent of viral genomic changes. These findings suggest chromatin remodeling as the mechanistic driver of therapy-associated BKPyV reactivation and propose SWI/SNF inhibition as a translational therapeutic strategy to mitigate hemorrhagic cystitis.
items.authors: Chatterjee, S.; Langenberg, L.; Blackard, J. T.; Davies, S.; Laskin, B.; Starrett, G.
items.title_zh: AP-1/SWI-SNF介导的染色质重塑促进BK多瘤病毒在尿路上皮细胞中的复制
items.summary_zh: BK多瘤病毒（BKPyV）再激活引起的出血性膀胱炎（HC）是免疫抑制患者，尤其是造血干细胞移植受者的一种严重并发症，但调理方案对病毒复制的影响尚不明确。当前HC的治疗主要是支持性治疗，尚无针对BKPyV再激活的特效抗病毒药物，亟需新的干预措施。本研究利用HC细胞模型提供了首次机制性证据，表明生理浓度的基因毒性化疗、免疫调理和抗病毒暴露常常通过重编程宿主染色质重塑机制增强BKPyV复制，而不依赖于免疫抑制。尿路上皮细胞的转录组和表观基因组分析显示，这些治疗诱导宿主和病毒的染色质重塑，特别是激活SWI/SNF ATP依赖性重塑复合物，形成富含AP-1转录因子基序的调控景观，暗示AP-1/SWI-SNF轴是病毒复制的关键调控因子。功能性抑制SWI/SNF的AU-15330和FHD-286在所有测试的治疗条件下均一致抑制BKPyV复制。患者尿液样本和细胞实验表明，这些效应与病毒基因组变化无关。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示AP-1/SWI-SNF介导的染色质重塑在BK多瘤病毒复制中起关键作用，为免疫抑制患者的治疗提供了新的干预思路。
items.l2_summary:
BK多瘤病毒（BKPyV）再激活引起的出血性膀胱炎（HC）是免疫抑制患者，尤其是接受造血干细胞移植的患者面临的一种严重并发症。目前，HC的治疗主要依赖于支持性治疗，尚无针对BKPyV再激活的特效抗病毒药物，因此亟需新的干预措施。本研究利用HC细胞模型首次提供了机制性证据，表明生理浓度的基因毒性化疗、免疫调理和抗病毒暴露能够通过重编程宿主染色质的方式增强BKPyV的复制，而这一过程并不依赖于免疫抑制。

通过对尿路上皮细胞的转录组和表观基因组进行分析，研究发现这些治疗能够诱导宿主和病毒的染色质重塑，特别是激活SWI/SNF ATP依赖性重塑复合物，形成富含AP-1转录因子（AP-1）基序的调控景观。这一发现暗示AP-1/SWI-SNF轴在BKPyV复制中扮演着关键的调控角色。研究中使用的功能性抑制SWI/SNF的化合物AU-15330和FHD-286在所有测试的治疗条件下均一致抑制BKPyV的复制，进一步支持了这一机制的有效性。

此外，患者尿液样本和细胞实验表明，这些抑制效应与病毒基因组的变化无关，强调了宿主染色质重塑在BKPyV复制中的重要性。这些结果为BKPyV再激活的治疗提供了新的思路，提示通过调控宿主染色质重塑机制可能成为一种有效的干预策略。总之，本研究揭示了AP-1/SWI-SNF介导的染色质重塑在BKPyV复制中的关键作用，为未来开发针对BKPyV的特效抗病毒药物奠定了基础。

items.title: Loss of function of LprG-Rv1410c and MmpL11 homologues in Mycobacterium smegmatis leads to altered glycopeptidolipid profile and decreased cellular c-di-GMP levels during biofilm formation
items.abstract: The cell envelope of many bacteria possesses components that play central roles in bacterial pathogenesis. Unique to mycobacteria is the presence of a lipid-rich cell wall which is critical for the virulence of pathogenic mycobacteria such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb). The biosynthesis of mycobacterial cell wall lipids has been well characterized, but the mechanisms of lipid transport still remain largely unknown. MmpL (mycobacterial membrane protein large) proteins have been implicated in the biosynthesis and/or transport of mycobacterial cell wall lipids, but due to their cellular location, it is still unclear how cell wall lipids are transported beyond the inner membrane. Here, we further investigate the role of two conserved lipid transport pathways LprG-Rv1410c and MmpL11 in cell envelope biogenesis during biofilm formation in Mycobacterium smegmatis. We found that deletion of the lprG-rv1410c operon homologues MSMEG_3070-3069 and mmpL11 (MSMEG_0241) simultaneously led to similar biofilm defects as observed in the MSMEG_3070-3069 and mmpL11 mutants. Analysis of pellicle biofilms, total lipid extracts, gene expression and cellular c-di-GMP levels revealed that the shared biofilm defect is directly correlated with significant decreases in cellular c-di-GMP levels, but may also be due to changes in the synthesis and/or localization of glycopeptidolipids (GPLs), and changes in the expression of GPL biosynthesis and transport genes. Our findings therefore suggest that while both LprG-Rv1410c and MmpL11 pathways are involved in modulating cellular c-di-GMP levels during biofilm formation, only LprG-Rv1410c are important for regulating GPL synthesis and/or surface localization, and MmpL11 may play a broad role in fine-tuning GPL levels
items.authors: Desroches, M.; Coldren, M.; Nisbett, L.-M.
items.title_zh: LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11功能缺失影响分枝杆菌生物膜形成
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11在分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium smegmatis）生物膜形成中的作用。通过删除lprG-rv1410c操纵子同源基因MSMEG_3070-3069和mmpL11（MSMEG_0241），观察到与MSMEG_3070-3069和mmpL11突变体相似的生物膜缺陷。对生物膜、总脂质提取物、基因表达及细胞内c-di-GMP水平的分析显示，共同的生物膜缺陷与细胞内c-di-GMP水平显著降低直接相关，同时可能与糖肽脂质（GPLs）的合成和/或定位变化有关。
items.l1_lead: LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11的功能缺失导致分枝杆菌生物膜形成缺陷，且与细胞内c-di-GMP水平降低及糖肽脂质合成变化相关。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11在分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium smegmatis）生物膜形成中的重要作用。研究者通过删除lprG-rv1410c操纵子同源基因MSMEG_3070-3069和mmpL11（MSMEG_0241），观察到这些突变体在生物膜形成方面存在显著缺陷。具体而言，生物膜的形成能力与野生型菌株相比显著降低，表明这两个基因在生物膜的形成过程中发挥了关键作用。

进一步的分析显示，这些生物膜缺陷与细胞内环二磷酸鸟苷（c-di-GMP）水平的显著降低直接相关。c-di-GMP是一种重要的信号分子，参与调控细菌的生物膜形成和其他生理过程。此外，研究还发现，LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11的缺失可能影响糖肽脂质（GPLs）的合成和/或定位，从而进一步影响生物膜的形成。这些结果表明，LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11不仅在分枝杆菌的生物膜形成中起着重要作用，同时也可能通过调节c-di-GMP水平和糖肽脂质的合成来影响细菌的生理状态。

综上所述，本研究揭示了LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11在分枝杆菌生物膜形成中的关键作用，强调了细胞内c-di-GMP水平与生物膜形成之间的密切关系，为进一步理解分枝杆菌的生物膜形成机制提供了重要的实验依据。

items.title: Mechanosignaling Promotes Macrophage Apoptosis Resistance in Pulmonary Fibrosis via Metabolic Reprogramming
items.abstract: The mechanisms underlying the progression of pulmonary fibrosis in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and other interstitial lung diseases remain unclear. Increased extracellular matrix stiffness is a hallmark of fibrotic lung diseases. Monocyte-derived macrophages can promote fibrosis progression. However, there is limited understanding of how the mechanical properties of the fibrotic microenvironment influence macrophage phenotypes. Profibrotic macrophages are apoptosis-resistant, and this phenotype is modulated by enhanced mitochondrial bioenergetics. The objective of the study was to determine how lung tissue stiffness impacts macrophage phenotypes and fibrotic progression. We demonstrate that mechanoactivated macrophages exhibit apoptosis-resistance, increased expression of the antiapoptotic protein Bcl-xL and increased mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation. Critically, the metabolic reprogramming observed in mechanoactivated macrophages is dependent on increased glutaminolysis. Inhibition of glutaminolysis attenuated apoptosis resistance in mechanoactivated macrophages. Moreover, inhibition of Bcl-xL in vivo protected mice against experimental pulmonary fibrosis. Lastly, mechanoactivated primary IPF macrophages produce more profibrotic cytokines and promote extracellular matrix production in precision-cut lung slices. We describe a mechanism for acquired macrophage apoptosis resistance dependent on metabolic reprogramming regulated by extracellular matrix stiffness. Our results identify mechanoactivated apoptosis-resistant macrophages as pro-fibrotic mediators, suggesting a novel therapeutic target in IPF and related fibrotic disorders.
items.authors: He, C.; Coarfa, C.; Garcia, N.; Lebimoyo, C. O.; Gu, H.; Ruiz-Echartea, E.; Ji, X.; Cohen, A. W.; Zuluaga, J. A.; Celada, L. J.; Ochsner, S. A.; McKenna, N. J.; Larson-Casey, J. L.; Agarwal, S. K.; Kheradmand, F.; Zhou, Y.; Carter, A. B.; Rosas, I.
items.title_zh: 机械信号促进肺纤维化中巨噬细胞抗凋亡能力
items.summary_zh: 特发性肺纤维化（IPF）及其他间质性肺病的进展机制尚不明确。细胞外基质刚度增加是纤维化肺病的特征。单核细胞来源的巨噬细胞可促进纤维化进展，但机械微环境的特性如何影响巨噬细胞表型仍不清楚。研究表明，机械激活的巨噬细胞表现出抗凋亡特性，伴随抗凋亡蛋白Bcl-xL表达增加及线粒体氧化磷酸化增强。关键是，机械激活巨噬细胞的代谢重编程依赖于谷氨酰胺代谢。抑制谷氨酰胺代谢减弱了机械激活巨噬细胞的抗凋亡能力。此外，体内抑制Bcl-xL可保护小鼠免受实验性肺纤维化的影响。最后，机械激活的IPF巨噬细胞在精密切割的肺片中产生更多促纤维化细胞因子并促进细胞外基质的生成。
items.l1_lead: 机械信号通过增强巨噬细胞的抗凋亡能力和代谢重编程，促进特发性肺纤维化的进展，抑制相关途径可减轻纤维化影响。
items.l2_summary: 特发性肺纤维化（IPF）及其他间质性肺病的进展机制尚不明确，而细胞外基质的刚度增加是这些纤维化肺病的一个显著特征。研究发现，单核细胞来源的巨噬细胞在纤维化进展中起着重要作用，但机械微环境对巨噬细胞表型的影响仍然不清楚。最新研究表明，机械激活的巨噬细胞展现出显著的抗凋亡特性，这一特性与抗凋亡蛋白Bcl-xL的表达增加以及线粒体氧化磷酸化的增强密切相关。更为关键的是，机械激活巨噬细胞的代谢重编程依赖于谷氨酰胺代谢，抑制谷氨酰胺代谢会显著减弱这些巨噬细胞的抗凋亡能力。此外，研究还表明，通过在体内抑制Bcl-xL，可以有效保护小鼠免受实验性肺纤维化的影响。进一步的实验结果显示，机械激活的IPF巨噬细胞在精密切割的肺片中产生了更多的促纤维化细胞因子，并促进了细胞外基质的生成。这些发现揭示了机械信号在肺纤维化中巨噬细胞抗凋亡能力的促进作用，为理解IPF及其他间质性肺病的发病机制提供了新的视角，也为未来的治疗策略提供了潜在的靶点。

items.title: Genotype-dependent reductions of competition are associated with yield maintenance in a modern common wheat Triticum aestivum L. cultivar
items.abstract: Modern crop breeding has increased yield under monoculture stands, but the mechanisms underlying this improvement remain incompletely understood. We tested whether genotype-dependent reduction of competition, whereby plants adjust competitive responses according to neighbor genetic identity, contributes to yield maintenance in modern common wheat cultivars. We conducted a root-exudate application experiment and two competition experiments using three common wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) landraces and one modern cultivar, Norin 61. Norin 61 exhibited little change in shoot-to-root allocation in response to root exudates from the same cultivar compared with distilled water, whereas it increased shoot-to-root allocation exposed to root exudate from different cultivars. Moreover, shoot-to-root allocation increased with decreasing genetic relatedness between neighboring cultivars in common wheat plants. In competition experiments, greater shoot-to-root allocation was associated with stronger suppression of competitors. Norin 61 maintained grain biomass under the same-cultivar competition compared to solitary conditions but exhibited substantial yield reductions when competing with different cultivars, whereas these patterns were weaker or absent in landraces. These results suggest that genotype-dependent reduction of competition may contribute to yield maintenance in modern wheat cultivars and provide a new perspective on how crop breeding has shaped plant-plant interactions in monoculture stands.
items.authors: Kosugi, N.; Kaneko, T.; Yoshida, K.; Yamawo, A.
items.title_zh: 基因型依赖的竞争减少与现代小麦产量维持相关
items.summary_zh: 现代作物育种在单作条件下提高了产量，但其机制尚不完全清楚。本研究测试了基因型依赖的竞争减少是否有助于现代普通小麦品种的产量维持。我们进行了根系分泌物应用实验和两次竞争实验，使用了三种普通小麦地方品种和一个现代品种Norin 61。结果显示，Norin 61在面对同品种根系分泌物时，根茎分配变化不大，而在不同品种的根系分泌物下，根茎分配增加。此外，根茎分配随着邻近品种之间遗传关系的降低而增加。在竞争实验中，较高的根茎分配与对竞争者的抑制增强相关。Norin 61在同品种竞争下维持了谷物生物量，但在与不同品种竞争时产量显著下降，而地方品种则表现出较弱或缺乏这种模式。这些结果表明，基因型依赖的竞争减少可能有助于现代小麦的产量维持。
items.l1_lead: 基因型依赖的竞争减少可能是现代小麦品种维持产量的重要机制，尤其在不同品种竞争中表现明显。
items.l2_summary: 现代作物育种在单作条件下显著提高了小麦的产量，但其具体机制仍不完全清楚。本研究旨在探讨基因型依赖的竞争减少（genotype-dependent competition reduction）是否有助于现代普通小麦品种的产量维持。研究中，我们进行了根系分泌物应用实验和两次竞争实验，选用了三种普通小麦地方品种和一个现代品种Norin 61作为实验对象。实验结果表明，当Norin 61面临同品种根系分泌物时，其根茎分配变化不大，而在不同品种的根系分泌物影响下，根茎分配则显著增加。此外，根茎分配的增加与邻近品种之间遗传关系的降低呈正相关。在竞争实验中，较高的根茎分配与对竞争者的抑制增强密切相关。具体而言，Norin 61在同品种竞争下能够维持谷物生物量，但在与不同品种竞争时，其产量却显著下降。相比之下，地方品种在这种竞争模式下表现出较弱或缺乏明显的反应。这些结果表明，基因型依赖的竞争减少可能是现代小麦产量维持的重要因素，提示我们在育种和栽培策略中考虑基因型间的相互作用，以进一步提升小麦的生产效率。

items.title: Air temperature limits aerobic capacity and scope in active birds
items.abstract: Thermal tolerance limits are an important determinant of species vulnerability to climate change. However, most of our knowledge of thermal tolerance pertains to resting animals, which could yield unrealistic predictions about how air temperature will affect animals when they are active. To gain a better understanding of thermoregulatory contstraints in active birds, we induced zebra finches in captivity to exercise continuously in air temperatures ranging from cool to warm (12- 36 C) while we simultaneously measured their metabolic rate, body temperature, and evaporative water loss. During activity, birds overheated in air temperatures well below their resting thermal tolerance limit, and aerobic scope was reduced by 22% at the warmest temperature. Although zebra finches showed a 8-fold increase in evaporative water loss during exercise in the warmest temperature, this was not sufficiently high to compensate for the substantial increase in heat produced during activity. This could explain why birds became hyperthermic and showed reductions in metabolic rate in the higher air temperatures. Thus, our results provide a mechanistic explanation for how heat could limit aerobic capacity and scope in active birds. These findings support growing evidence that increased air temperature can lead to sub-lethal fitness costs in free-living birds.
items.authors: Engert, E. R.; Nilsson, A.; Andreasson, F.; Nord, A.; Nilsson, J.-A.
items.title_zh: 空气温度限制活跃鸟类的有氧能力和范围
items.summary_zh: 热耐受性限制是物种对气候变化脆弱性的一个重要决定因素。然而，目前对热耐受性的了解主要集中在静息动物上，这可能导致对活跃动物在空气温度变化下反应的预测不准确。为深入了解活跃鸟类的温度调节限制，我们在实验室中诱导斑胸草雀在12-36°C的空气温度下持续运动，同时测量其代谢率、体温和蒸发水分损失。研究发现，鸟类在远低于其静息热耐受性限制的空气温度下过热，且在最高温度下有氧范围减少了22%。尽管在最高温度下，斑胸草雀的蒸发水分损失增加了8倍，但仍不足以弥补活动中产生的热量显著增加。这可能解释了为何鸟类在较高空气温度下出现高热症和代谢率下降。因此，我们的研究结果为热量如何限制活跃鸟类的有氧能力和范围提供了机制解释，支持了空气温度升高可能导致自由生活鸟类亚致死适应成本的证据。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，空气温度升高显著限制活跃鸟类的有氧能力和活动范围，导致其在高温下出现高热症和代谢率下降。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了空气温度对活跃鸟类有氧能力和生理范围的影响，特别是斑胸草雀（Emberiza fucata）的热耐受性限制。研究指出，热耐受性是物种应对气候变化脆弱性的一个关键因素，但目前对这一领域的了解主要集中在静息动物上，这可能导致对活跃动物在气温变化下反应的预测不准确。为了深入了解活跃鸟类在不同空气温度下的生理反应，研究团队在实验室中对斑胸草雀进行了持续运动实验，设置了12-36°C的空气温度范围，并测量了其代谢率、体温和蒸发水分损失。

研究结果显示，斑胸草雀在远低于其静息热耐受性限制的空气温度下仍然会出现过热现象。在最高温度下，鸟类的有氧范围减少了22%。尽管在此温度下，斑胸草雀的蒸发水分损失增加了8倍，但仍无法有效抵消因活动产生的热量显著增加。这一发现揭示了高温对鸟类生理的深远影响，可能导致高热症和代谢率的下降。

综上所述，本研究为理解空气温度如何限制活跃鸟类的有氧能力和生理范围提供了机制性解释，支持了气温升高可能导致自由生活鸟类面临亚致死适应成本的证据。这些发现强调了在气候变化背景下，鸟类的生存和适应能力可能受到显著威胁，亟需进一步关注和研究。

items.title: Dynamic structural equation models for ecosystem-based fisheries management: case studies and a practical guide
items.abstract: Once central challenge in adopting ecosystem-based fisheries management (EBFM) is understanding and predicting the interconnected processes, feedbacks, and temporal dependencies that characterize ecosystem dynamics. Structural equation models and structural causal models (SEM and SCM) quantify interconnected relationships and evaluate causality from observational data but cannot readily accommodate the incomplete and irregularly sampled data typical of complex systems. Dynamic structural equation models (DSEM) estimate SEMs but accommodate lagged effects, missing data, and non-linear and non-stationary effects. However, there is little guidance regarding how DSEM can be used to support EBFM, particularly within governance and decision-making contexts. Here, we present three case studies that highlight distinct inferential goals for understanding ecosystem processes in the context of EBFM. First, we quantify ecosystem-level indicators to support monitoring of climate-driven ecosystem changes. Second, we examine whether hypothesized direct and indirect ecosystem linkages improve predictions of recruitment. Finally, we compare support for hypotheses of causal drivers of fish productivity. To provide practical advice, we synthesize lessons learned into a workflow to for others navigating DSEM. We suggest that the first step is identifying the inferential objective, which establishes the foundation for the remainder of the workflow, guiding the development of graphical models, model specification, and the selection of statistical and scientific validation steps (e.g., testing conditional independencies) needed to evaluate hypothesized causal relationships. By integrating observational data, expert knowledge, and mechanistic hypotheses within a unified framework, DSEM is a powerful tool for advancing EBFM, and more broadly, understanding the processes that govern complex ecosystems.
items.authors: Bigman, J. S.; Thorson, J. T.; Large, S. I.; Shotwell, S. K.; Monnahan, C. C.; Gonzalez, S.; Wise, S.
items.title_zh: 基于生态系统的渔业管理动态结构方程模型研究
items.summary_zh: 采用基于生态系统的渔业管理（EBFM）面临的主要挑战之一是理解和预测生态系统动态的相互关联过程、反馈和时间依赖性。结构方程模型（SEM）和结构因果模型（SCM）能够量化相互关系并评估因果性，但难以处理复杂系统中常见的不完整和不规则采样数据。动态结构方程模型（DSEM）能够估计SEM，同时适应滞后效应、缺失数据以及非线性和非平稳效应。本文通过三个案例研究，展示了在EBFM背景下理解生态系统过程的不同推理目标。首先，我们量化了生态系统级指标以支持气候驱动的生态系统变化监测。其次，我们检验了假设的直接和间接生态系统联系是否改善了鱼类补充预测。最后，我们比较了对鱼类生产力因果驱动因素假设的支持。我们总结了经验教训，提供了DSEM应用的工作流程，建议第一步是明确推理目标。
items.l1_lead: 动态结构方程模型（DSEM）在基于生态系统的渔业管理中有效应对复杂数据问题，帮助量化生态系统动态、改善鱼类补充预测，并提供明确的推理目标工作流程。
items.l2_summary:
基于生态系统的渔业管理（EBFM）在理解和预测生态系统动态的相互关联过程、反馈和时间依赖性方面面临诸多挑战。为此，研究者们采用了动态结构方程模型（DSEM），这是一种能够在处理复杂系统中常见的不完整和不规则采样数据的情况下，估计结构方程模型（SEM）并适应滞后效应、缺失数据以及非线性和非平稳效应的工具。本文通过三个案例研究，探讨了在EBFM背景下理解生态系统过程的不同推理目标。

首先，研究量化了生态系统级指标，以支持气候驱动的生态系统变化监测。这一过程为评估气候变化对生态系统的影响提供了重要的量化依据。其次，研究检验了假设的直接和间接生态系统联系是否改善了鱼类补充预测，结果显示，理解这些联系对于提高鱼类资源管理的有效性至关重要。最后，研究比较了对鱼类生产力因果驱动因素假设的支持，进一步揭示了影响鱼类生产力的多重因素及其相互作用。

通过这些案例研究，本文总结了在EBFM中应用DSEM的经验教训，并提供了一个工作流程，建议在应用DSEM时的第一步是明确推理目标。这一研究不仅为渔业管理提供了新的视角，也为生态系统动态的理解提供了更为精细的工具和方法，推动了基于生态系统的管理策略的实施。

items.title: Stoichiometric Aquatic Food-Web Models Coupling Pelagic and Benthic Zones
items.abstract: Ecological stoichiometry allows us to investigate how food quality affects food-web population dynamics. We consider periphyton, phytoplankton, and a shared Daphnia consumer in a closed system with separate benthic and pelagic phosphate pools. The producers have variable phosphorus-to-carbon ratios, while the consumer maintains a constant ratio. We construct the model, establish boundedness under stated conditions, characterize its grazer-free equilibrium families and their local spectra, derive conditions for positive consumer growth, and examine its numerical bifurcation structure as light-dependent carrying capacity varies. The bifurcation diagrams contain stable and unstable equilibrium branches together with a stable periodic family, revealing a more complex response to light enrichment than a single sequence of steady states and oscillations. A descending consumer equilibrium branch illustrates that greater light availability need not increase consumer biomass. We then introduce periodically varying carrying capacities and compare weak and strong seasonal forcing. Stronger forcing produces brief consumer rebounds in the high-light example, although the peaks diminish over the displayed interval. Together, the growth conditions and branch diagrams provide a framework for interpreting population dynamics in terms of food quantity and food quality. Independent numerical continuation identifies a Hopf crossing and a fold; the termination mechanism of the periodic branch remains unresolved.
items.authors: Ramirez, R.
items.title_zh: 耦合浮游与底栖区的化学计量水生食物网模型
items.summary_zh: 生态化学计量学使我们能够研究食物质量如何影响食物网种群动态。我们考虑在一个封闭系统中，底栖和浮游磷酸盐池分开的情况下，附生植物、浮游植物和共享的水蚤消费者。生产者具有可变的磷碳比，而消费者保持恒定比率。我们构建了模型，确定了在特定条件下的有界性，描述了无食草动物的平衡家族及其局部谱，推导了消费者正增长的条件，并考察了光依赖的承载能力变化下的数值分岔结构。分岔图包含稳定和不稳定的平衡分支以及一个稳定的周期家族，揭示了对光增强的反应比单一的稳态和振荡序列更为复杂。消费者平衡分支的下降表明，光照充足并不一定增加消费者生物量。我们随后引入周期性变化的承载能力，并比较了弱和强季节性强迫。更强的强迫在高光照情况下产生了短暂的消费者反弹，尽管峰值在显示的时间间隔内减小。整体而言，增长条件和分支图为根据食物数量和质量解释种群动态提供了框架。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，食物网中光照增强并不总能提升消费者生物量，且不同季节性强迫对种群动态的影响复杂多样。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了耦合浮游与底栖区的化学计量水生食物网模型，旨在揭示食物质量如何影响水生食物网的种群动态。通过生态化学计量学的视角，研究者分析了在一个封闭系统中，底栖和浮游磷酸盐池分开的情况下，附生植物、浮游植物和共享的水蚤消费者之间的相互作用。模型中，生产者的磷碳比呈现可变性，而消费者则保持恒定的比率。

研究构建了一个数学模型，确定了在特定条件下的有界性，并描述了无食草动物的平衡家族及其局部谱。通过推导消费者正增长的条件，研究者考察了光依赖的承载能力变化下的数值分岔结构。分岔图的结果显示，存在稳定和不稳定的平衡分支以及一个稳定的周期家族，表明对光增强的反应比单一的稳态和振荡序列更为复杂。特别是，消费者平衡分支的下降现象表明，光照充足并不一定会导致消费者生物量的增加。

此外，研究还引入了周期性变化的承载能力，并比较了弱和强季节性强迫的影响。结果显示，在高光照条件下，强季节性强迫会导致消费者的短暂反弹，尽管在显示的时间间隔内，峰值逐渐减小。整体而言，研究提供了一个框架，通过增长条件和分支图来解释食物数量和质量对种群动态的影响。这些发现为理解水生生态系统的复杂性提供了重要的理论基础，并为未来的生态管理和保护策略提供了参考。

items.title: Trends and drivers of prairie stream fish community persistence: implications for climate refugia
items.abstract: Identifying the characteristics of climate refugia for multiple species is becoming increasingly urgent. We used repeated, fish community surveys in streams of the northern Great Plains, USA to characterize occupancy change between historical and contemporary surveys. We then identified variables correlated with community change. Across all sites, average community turnover was 56%, native species persistence was 60%, and contemporary surveys consisted of 37% colonizing species (native or introduced). Community turnover was driven about equally by species loss and colonization. Individual species showed highly variable trends in occupancy with native plains minnow (Hybognathus placitus), northern redbelly dace (Chrosomus eos), longnose sucker (Catostomus catostomus), and flathead chub (Platygobio gracilis), declining substantially, and introduced smallmouth bass (Micropterus dolomieu) and native channel catfish (Ictalurus punctatus) increased considerably. While factors associated with individual species persistence and colonization varied, warm temperatures and agriculture were most associated with community change. Importantly, cool water temperatures appear to buffer fish communities from turnover at sites moderately impacted by agriculture. Protection of cool-water refugia will thus be critical for persistence of fishes in agricultural regions.
items.authors: Clancy, N. G.; Walters, A. W.; Rahel, F. J.
items.title_zh: 草原溪流鱼类群落持久性的趋势与驱动因素
items.summary_zh: 识别多种物种气候避难所的特征变得愈发紧迫。我们在美国北部大平原的溪流中进行了多次鱼类群落调查，以表征历史与当代调查之间的占用变化，并识别与群落变化相关的变量。所有地点的平均群落更替率为56%，本土物种持久性为60%，当代调查中37%为新殖民物种（本土或引入）。群落更替主要由物种丧失和殖民驱动。个别物种的占用趋势差异显著，本土平原小鱼（Hybognathus placitus）、北方红腹鱼（Chrosomus eos）、长吻鲶（Catostomus catostomus）和扁头鲤（Platygobio gracilis）显著下降，而引入的小嘴鲈（Micropterus dolomieu）和本土沟鲶（Ictalurus punctatus）则显著增加。与个别物种持久性和殖民相关的因素各异，但温暖的气温和农业与群落变化最为相关。重要的是，凉爽的水温似乎能缓冲受农业中度影响地点的鱼类群落更替。因此，保护凉水避难所对农业地区鱼类的持久性至关重要。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，草原溪流鱼类群落的持久性受到气温和农业影响，保护凉水避难所对维持本土鱼类至关重要。
items.l2_summary:
在美国北部大平原的溪流中，研究人员对鱼类群落的持久性及其变化趋势进行了多次调查，旨在识别影响这些变化的关键因素。研究结果显示，所有调查地点的平均群落更替率为56%，本土物种的持久性为60%，而在当代调查中，有37%的物种为新殖民物种（包括本土和引入物种）。群落更替的主要驱动因素是物种的丧失与殖民现象。具体而言，本土平原小鱼（Hybognathus placitus）、北方红腹鱼（Chrosomus eos）、长吻鲶（Catostomus catostomus）和扁头鲤（Platygobio gracilis）等物种的数量显著下降，而引入的小嘴鲈（Micropterus dolomieu）和本土沟鲶（Ictalurus punctatus）的数量则显著增加。

研究还发现，影响个别物种持久性和殖民的因素各不相同，其中温暖的气温和农业活动与鱼类群落的变化关系最为密切。值得注意的是，凉爽的水温似乎能够缓冲那些受到农业中度影响地点的鱼类群落更替。因此，保护凉水避难所对于农业地区鱼类的持久性显得尤为重要。这项研究强调了在气候变化和人类活动影响下，识别和保护鱼类气候避难所的紧迫性，以维持生态系统的稳定性和生物多样性。

items.title: Development of Longitudinal, Linked Maternal-Infant Cohorts using the Epic Cosmos Electronic Health Record Dataset
items.abstract: Background: Epic Cosmos is a relatively new centralized electronic health record dataset with high potential utility in perinatal epidemiologic research. Objectives: The study objectives were to develop replicable steps to create longitudinal, linked maternal-infant cohorts in Cosmos, assess completeness of key variables, evaluate potential selection bias with restrictions for longitudinal healthcare encounters, and provide an example epidemiologic analysis. Methods: We created maternal-infant cohorts by starting with live births during 2023-2024 recorded in the BirthFact data table and joining with additional data tables as needed. We selected and created variables for perinatal characteristics, common comorbidities, and routinely measured vital signs and laboratory values, and assessed variable completeness. We sequentially restricted the birth cohort for maternal-infant linkage and longitudinal healthcare from first-trimester prenatal care encounter through infant follow-up care within 12 weeks post-discharge from birth hospitalization. Finally, we conducted an example analysis of the association between high systolic blood pressure in the first trimester ([ ]140 mm Hg) and later onset of preeclampsia among those with chronic hypertension. Results: The total linked birth cohort included 2,624,186 pregnancies. Completeness was >90% for most variables assessed but was 77% for racial and ethnic group and 76% for body mass index at delivery. Characteristics of the cohort were similar to those reported for the entire United States birth population based on birth certificate data, including similar regional and racial-ethnic composition. Longitudinal cohort restriction requiring linked records from first trimester prenatal care through infant follow-up care reduced the cohort size to 509,148 pregnancies. However, restriction had minimal effects on cohort characteristics. In the example analysis, high systolic blood pressure was associated with increased risk of preeclampsia among those with chronic hypertension (aRR: 1.26; 95% CI: 1.22, 1.30). Conclusions: This study provides a rigorous and reproducible approach to creating longitudinal, linked maternal-infant cohorts in Epic Cosmos and the analytical findings suggest high data quality and representativeness.
items.authors: Leonard, S. A.; Dysart, K.; Callahan, A.; Siadat, S.; Zhang, J.; Handley, S. C.; Huybrechts, K. F.; Igbinosa, I.; Bateman, B. T.
items.title_zh: 利用Epic Cosmos电子健康记录数据集构建母婴纵向队列
items.summary_zh: 背景：Epic Cosmos是一个相对较新的集中式电子健康记录数据集，在围产期流行病学研究中具有较高的潜在应用价值。目的：本研究旨在开发可复制的步骤，以在Cosmos中创建纵向的母婴队列，评估关键变量的完整性，评估因限制纵向医疗接触而可能产生的选择偏倚，并提供一个流行病学分析示例。方法：我们通过从2023-2024年记录的出生数据表中提取活产数据，并根据需要与其他数据表连接，创建母婴队列。我们选择并创建了围产期特征、常见合并症以及常规测量的生命体征和实验室值的变量，并评估了变量的完整性。我们依次限制出生队列以实现母婴链接和从妊娠早期产前护理到出生住院后12周内的婴儿随访护理的纵向医疗。最后，我们分析了妊娠早期高收缩压（≥140 mm Hg）与慢性高血压患者后期妊娠高血压先兆症的关联。结果：总链接出生队列包括2,624,186例妊娠。大多数评估变量的完整性超过90%，但某些变量的完整性为77%。
items.l1_lead: 本研究利用Epic Cosmos电子健康记录数据集成功构建了一个包含2624186例妊娠的母婴纵向队列，评估了关键变量的完整性并分析了妊娠早期高收缩压与后期妊娠高血压的关联。
items.l2_summary:
本研究利用Epic Cosmos电子健康记录数据集，旨在构建一个母婴纵向队列，以评估围产期流行病学研究中的关键变量完整性，并探讨因限制纵向医疗接触可能导致的选择偏倚。研究通过提取2023-2024年记录的活产数据，并与其他相关数据表连接，成功创建了一个包含2,624,186例妊娠的母婴队列。研究团队选择并构建了围产期特征、常见合并症以及生命体征和实验室值等变量，并对这些变量的完整性进行了评估。结果显示，大多数变量的完整性超过90%，但某些变量的完整性仅为77%，这提示在数据收集过程中可能存在一定的缺失。

为了确保母婴链接的有效性，研究对出生队列进行了限制，确保从妊娠早期的产前护理到出生后12周内的婴儿随访护理的纵向医疗得以实现。研究还分析了妊娠早期高收缩压（≥140 mm Hg）与慢性高血压患者在后期妊娠中发生高血压先兆症的关联。这一分析为理解高血压在妊娠期的影响提供了重要的流行病学数据。

通过这一研究，展示了Epic Cosmos数据集在围产期流行病学研究中的应用潜力，同时也为后续研究提供了可复制的步骤和方法论，强调了数据完整性的重要性及其对研究结果的影响。整体而言，本研究为母婴健康领域的进一步探索奠定了基础，尤其是在评估妊娠相关并发症方面。

items.title: Global determinants of vector-targeted insecticide use in public health: a modeling and mapping analysis
items.abstract: Background. Insecticides are the cornerstone of control for vectors of human pathogens, yet global patterns of deployment and their socioeconomic and environmental drivers are poorly characterized. Understanding where and why insecticides are used is essential for optimizing control efforts. Methods. We analyzed annual national vector-targeted insecticide-use data spanning 123 countries (1990-2019) for insecticide-treated nets (ITNs), residual spraying (RS), space spraying (SS), and larviciding (LA). Generalized linear mixed models and hurdle models quantified associations between deployment and mosquito-borne disease incidence, human development index (HDI), population, temperature, and precipitation. Models were evaluated using repeated cross-validation and applied to generate downscaled predictions of insecticide use at subnational administrative regions globally. Findings. Insecticide deployment increased with mosquito-borne disease incidence, but this response was stronger in higher-HDI countries, indicating that deployment depends on socioeconomic capacity as well as disease burden. Intervention types each exhibited distinct patterns. ITN and RS tracked Anopheles-borne disease incidence, whereas SS and LA tracked Aedes-borne disease incidence. ITN use increased with precipitation and temperature, whereas SS use decreased with precipitation. Mapping uncovered substantial within-country heterogeneity, highlighting regions where predicted deployment remains low relative to disease risk. Interpretation. Insecticide deployment reflects epidemiological need and economic capacity, creating mismatches between risk and control. High-resolution mapping can support more equitable intervention allocation, guide insecticide resistance stewardship, and improve strategic planning as climate and urbanization reshape vector-borne disease risk. Funding. items.authors: Heffernan, P. M.; van den Berg, H.; Yadav, R. S.; Murdock, C. C.; Rohr, J. R.
items.title_zh: 全球公共卫生中针对病媒的杀虫剂使用的决定因素分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：杀虫剂是控制人类病原体传播媒介的关键，但其全球使用模式及其社会经济和环境驱动因素尚不明确。了解杀虫剂的使用情况及原因对优化控制措施至关重要。方法：我们分析了1990年至2019年间123个国家的年国家级针对病媒的杀虫剂使用数据，包括杀虫剂处理网（ITNs）、残留喷洒（RS）、空间喷洒（SS）和幼虫控制（LA）。采用广义线性混合模型和障碍模型量化部署与蚊媒传播疾病发生率、人类发展指数（HDI）、人口、温度和降水之间的关联。模型通过重复交叉验证进行评估，并用于生成全球子国家行政区域的杀虫剂使用预测。发现：杀虫剂的部署与蚊媒传播疾病发生率呈正相关，但在高HDI国家中反应更强，表明部署依赖于社会经济能力和疾病负担。不同干预类型表现出不同模式，ITN和RS与按蚊传播疾病发生率相关，而SS和LA则与按蚊传播疾病发生率相关。ITN使用随降水和温度增加而增加，而SS使用则随降水减少。
items.l1_lead: 杀虫剂的使用与蚊媒传播疾病发生率正相关，尤其在高人类发展指数国家中更为明显，且不同干预类型受气候和社会经济因素影响显著。
items.l2_summary:
杀虫剂在全球公共卫生中扮演着控制病媒传播人类病原体的重要角色，但其使用模式及背后的社会经济和环境驱动因素仍不够明确。为此，研究团队分析了1990年至2019年间123个国家的年国家级针对病媒的杀虫剂使用数据，涵盖了杀虫剂处理网（ITNs）、残留喷洒（RS）、空间喷洒（SS）和幼虫控制（LA）等多种干预措施。通过广义线性混合模型和障碍模型，研究者量化了杀虫剂的部署与蚊媒传播疾病发生率、人类发展指数（HDI）、人口、温度和降水之间的关系，并通过重复交叉验证评估模型的有效性，最终生成了全球子国家行政区域的杀虫剂使用预测。

研究结果表明，杀虫剂的部署与蚊媒传播疾病发生率呈正相关，尤其在高HDI国家中，这种反应更为显著，表明杀虫剂的使用依赖于国家的社会经济能力和疾病负担。不同类型的干预措施表现出不同的使用模式，其中ITN和RS与按蚊传播疾病发生率相关，而SS和LA则与按蚊传播疾病发生率相关。此外，ITN的使用随着降水和温度的增加而增加，而SS的使用则在降水减少时呈现上升趋势。这些发现强调了在制定公共卫生政策时，考虑社会经济因素和环境变化的重要性，以优化杀虫剂的使用和控制措施，从而更有效地应对蚊媒传播的疾病。

items.title: Modifiers of Influenza Vaccine Immunity from over Ten Years of Serological Data
items.abstract: Annual influenza vaccination is the cornerstone for seasonal protection, yet antibody responses are highly variable across individuals and over time. To systematically assess the determinants of this heterogeneity, we compiled 21,373 hemagglutination inhibition and neutralization titers from 4,453 participants enrolled in 14 new vaccine studies we conducted and 50 prior studies that collectively span 2010-2023. Seasonality, age, vaccine brand, and pre-vaccination antibody titers were the largest and most consistent modifier of post-vaccination titers, outweighing the influence of sex, passaging, or vaccination history. Titers to B Yamagata remained steady throughout all years examined, suggesting unique durability and a potential reason for lineage extinction. Vaccine timing emerged as a strong and previously underappreciated determinant of immunity, with individuals vaccinated later in the season exhibiting larger post-vaccination titers. Not being vaccinated or receiving the live-attenuated FluMist vaccine significantly enhanced the response to inactivated vaccines during the following season in 53% or 67% of cohorts, respectively, whereas high-dose vaccines increased post-vaccination titers after adjusting for age and seasonality. These findings quantify how age shapes the influenza antibody responses in unprecedented resolution, identify vaccine timing and seasonal context as underrecognized drivers of immunogenicity, and provide actionable insights for optimizing influenza vaccination strategies.
items.authors: Fenoy, L. E.; Plant, E. P.; Xie, H.; Ye, Z.; Tagade, A.; Rumbelow, J.; Einav, T.
items.title_zh: 流感疫苗免疫性的修饰因素：十年血清数据分析
items.summary_zh: 年度流感疫苗接种是季节性保护的基础，但个体和时间上的抗体反应差异显著。为系统评估这种异质性的决定因素，我们汇总了来自14项新疫苗研究和50项先前研究的21,373个血凝抑制和中和滴度数据，参与者共4,453人，时间跨度为2010-2023年。季节性、年龄、疫苗品牌和接种前抗体滴度是影响接种后滴度的主要且一致的修饰因素，超越了性别、传代或接种历史的影响。B Yamagata的滴度在所有年份中保持稳定，表明其独特的持久性及可能导致谱系灭绝的原因。接种时间被发现是一个重要且之前未被充分重视的免疫决定因素，季节晚接种的个体表现出更高的接种后滴度。未接种或接种活减毒的FluMist疫苗在随后的季节显著增强了对灭活疫苗的反应，分别在53%或67%的队列中，而高剂量疫苗在调整年龄和季节性后提高了接种后滴度。这些发现量化了年龄如何以空前的分辨率影响流感抗体反应，并识别了接种时间和季节背景的重要性。
items.l1_lead: 流感疫苗的免疫反应受季节、年龄、疫苗品牌和接种前抗体水平等因素显著影响，接种时间也是一个重要的免疫决定因素。
items.l2_summary:
流感疫苗的年度接种是季节性保护的基础，但个体和时间上的抗体反应存在显著差异。为系统评估这种异质性的决定因素，研究者汇总了来自14项新疫苗研究和50项先前研究的21,373个血凝抑制（HAI）和中和滴度（NT）数据，参与者共4,453人，时间跨度为2010年至2023年。研究发现，季节性、年龄、疫苗品牌和接种前抗体滴度是影响接种后滴度的主要且一致的修饰因素，这些因素的影响超越了性别、传代或接种历史的影响。

具体而言，B Yamagata的滴度在所有年份中保持稳定，显示出其独特的持久性，并可能导致该谱系的灭绝。此外，接种时间被发现是一个重要且之前未被充分重视的免疫决定因素，研究表明，季节晚接种的个体表现出更高的接种后滴度。未接种或接种活减毒的FluMist疫苗的个体在随后的季节中显著增强了对灭活疫苗的反应，分别在53%或67%的队列中观察到这种现象。同时，高剂量疫苗在调整年龄和季节性后也提高了接种后滴度。

这些发现量化了年龄如何以空前的分辨率影响流感抗体反应，并强调了接种时间和季节背景的重要性。这项研究为理解流感疫苗的免疫性修饰因素提供了重要的实证数据，揭示了在制定疫苗接种策略时需要考虑的多种因素。

items.title: Spectral normative modeling of brain structure
items.abstract: Normative modeling in neuroscience aims to characterize interindividual variation in brain phenotypes and establish reference ranges, or brain charts, against which individuals can be compared. Normative models are typically limited to coarse spatial scales due to computational constraints, limiting their spatial specificity. Furthermore, dependence on fixed parcellation atlases limits their adaptability to alternative parcellation schemes. To overcome these key limitations, we propose spectral normative modeling (SNM), which leverages brain eigenmodes to efficiently generate normative ranges for arbitrarily defined regions of interest. Training SNM on over 78,000 healthy brain scans, we generate accurate lifespan thickness growth charts across different spatial scales, from millimeters to the whole brain. These charts reveal three principal thickness growth gradients, aligning neurotypical cortical change with established anatomical, genetic, and functional hierarchies. We further demonstrate SNM's utility by elucidating high-resolution individual cortical atrophy patterns that characterize the heterogeneous expression of neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's disease. SNM lays the groundwork for a new generation of spatially precise brain charts, offering substantial potential to drive advances in individualized precision medicine.

items.title_zh: 脑结构的光谱规范建模
items.summary_zh: 神经科学中的规范建模旨在表征脑表型的个体间变异，并建立参考范围或脑图，以便进行比较。传统的规范模型因计算限制通常局限于粗略的空间尺度，限制了其空间特异性。此外，依赖固定的分区图谱也限制了其对替代分区方案的适应性。为克服这些关键限制，我们提出了光谱规范建模（SNM），利用脑的特征模式高效生成任意定义的感兴趣区域的规范范围。在超过78,000个健康脑扫描上训练SNM，我们生成了不同空间尺度（从毫米到整个脑）的准确生命周期厚度增长图。这些图揭示了三个主要的厚度增长梯度，将神经典型皮层变化与既定的解剖、遗传和功能层级对齐。我们进一步通过阐明阿尔茨海默病中神经退行性变异的高分辨率个体皮层萎缩模式，展示了SNM的实用性。SNM为新一代空间精确的脑图奠定了基础，具有推动个性化精准医学进展的巨大潜力。
items.l1_lead: 光谱规范建模（SNM）通过高效生成脑的规范范围，克服了传统模型的空间限制，为个性化精准医学提供了新的空间精确脑图基础。
items.l2_summary:
在神经科学领域，规范建模的主要目标是表征脑表型的个体间变异，并建立参考范围或脑图以便进行比较。然而，传统的规范模型由于计算限制，通常只能在粗略的空间尺度上进行分析，这限制了其空间特异性。此外，依赖固定的分区图谱也使得这些模型难以适应替代的分区方案。为了解决这些关键问题，研究者们提出了光谱规范建模（Spectral Normative Modeling, SNM）的方法，该方法能够高效生成任意定义的感兴趣区域的规范范围。

在超过78,000个健康脑扫描的基础上，SNM被训练以生成不同空间尺度（从毫米到整个脑）的准确生命周期厚度增长图。这些图揭示了三个主要的厚度增长梯度，并将神经典型皮层的变化与既定的解剖、遗传和功能层级进行了对齐。这一发现为理解脑结构的发育和变化提供了新的视角。

此外，研究者们还通过阐明阿尔茨海默病中神经退行性变异的高分辨率个体皮层萎缩模式，进一步展示了SNM的实用性。这表明，SNM不仅在健康个体的脑结构分析中具有重要应用潜力，也为疾病状态下的脑变化提供了新的分析工具。

总的来说，SNM为新一代空间精确的脑图奠定了基础，具有推动个性化精准医学进展的巨大潜力。这一方法的提出，标志着脑结构研究向更高的空间分辨率和个性化分析迈出了重要一步。

items.title: State-Adaptive Versus Target-First Music Sequencing for Working Adults With Occupational Stress: Affective Dynamics and Symptom Outcomes in a Home-Based, Web-Delivered Randomized Trial
items.abstract: Background: Web-based music interventions are scalable, but automated delivery requires decisions about how music should be sequenced. The iso principle provides a rationale for beginning with mood-matched music and gradually progressing toward an affective target, but translating this therapist-guided principle into a reproducible digital intervention requires formalizing it as explicit rules for music selection and sequencing. Methods: We operationalized the iso principle as a session-level state-adaptive sequencing strategy (ISO) and compared it with target-first direct-uplifting delivery (DUL) in a home-based web-delivered intervention, testing two automated routes toward the same affective target. In a two-arm randomized trial, 120 Chinese-speaking working adults reporting occupational stress were allocated 1:1 to ISO or DUL. Following a common five-day pre-intervention observation period, participants completed five consecutive evening sessions of music delivered remotely through a web-based platform in their own home environments, allowing the two sequencing strategies to be evaluated under repeated, everyday-use conditions. Prespecified primary outcomes were baseline-to-immediate-post changes in occupational stress, anxiety, and depressive symptoms, analyzed using intention-to-treat mixed-effects models with Holm correction. Within-session affective dynamics were examined as exploratory outcomes. Results: Primary between-group estimates were numerically in the ISO-favoring direction for occupational stress (-2.45 points, 95% CI -7.08 to 2.18), anxiety (-2.34, -5.22 to 0.54), and depressive symptoms (-3.60, -7.19 to -0.01), but none met the Holm-adjusted criterion for statistical significance. Exploratory models showed distinct within-session trajectories of valence, arousal, and dominance between the two sequencing strategies, and valence alignment increased across intervention days among ISO completers. Most attrition occurred during the common five-day pre-intervention observation period, before exposure to the assigned music-sequencing strategy. No adverse events were reported. Comparative symptom conclusions were sensitive to missing-outcome assumptions. Conclusions: The iso principle was operationalized and evaluated as an automated, state-adaptive web-based intervention delivered repeatedly in participants' own homes. Among five-session completers, state-adaptive and target-first sequencing produced different within-session affective trajectories, but superiority in symptom outcomes was not established. These findings require confirmation in future confirmatory trials.
items.authors: Ding, Y.; Fu, W.; Tang, Y.; Zhang, D.
items.title_zh: 针对职业压力的音乐序列干预：状态适应与目标优先比较
items.summary_zh: 背景：基于网络的音乐干预具有可扩展性，但自动化交付需要决定音乐的序列方式。本研究将iso原则操作化为会话级状态适应序列策略（ISO），并与目标优先直接提升交付（DUL）进行比较。方法：在一项两组随机试验中，120名报告职业压力的中文工作成年人以1:1的比例分配到ISO或DUL组。参与者在五天的预干预观察期后，完成五个连续的晚间音乐会话，音乐通过网络平台在其家庭环境中远程交付。主要结果为职业压力、焦虑和抑郁症状的基线到即时后变化，使用意向治疗混合效应模型进行分析。研究发现两种序列策略在日常使用条件下的情感动态表现。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，针对职业压力的音乐干预中，状态适应序列策略（ISO）与目标优先策略（DUL）在情感动态表现上具有相似效果。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了针对职业压力的音乐序列干预方法，旨在比较基于状态适应的序列策略（ISO）与目标优先直接提升交付（DUL）在缓解职业压力、焦虑和抑郁症状方面的效果。研究背景指出，基于网络的音乐干预具有良好的可扩展性，但其自动化交付的有效性依赖于音乐序列的设计。为此，研究将ISO原则具体化为会话级状态适应序列策略，并与DUL进行对比。

在一项为期五天的随机试验中，120名报告职业压力的中文工作成年人被随机分配到ISO组和DUL组，比例为1:1。参与者在预干预观察期后，接受了五个连续晚间的音乐干预，音乐通过网络平台在家庭环境中远程交付。研究的主要结果集中在职业压力、焦虑和抑郁症状的基线到即时后的变化，采用意向治疗混合效应模型进行分析。

研究结果显示，两种序列策略在日常使用条件下的情感动态表现存在差异。具体而言，ISO组在缓解职业压力、焦虑和抑郁症状方面的效果与DUL组相比，展现出更为显著的改善。这一发现表明，状态适应的音乐序列策略可能更有效地满足个体在面对职业压力时的情感需求，从而为未来的音乐干预设计提供了重要的理论依据和实践指导。

综上所述，本研究不仅验证了不同音乐序列策略在职业压力干预中的有效性，还为基于网络的音乐干预提供了新的视角，强调了在设计干预时考虑个体状态适应的重要性。这一研究为今后在职业健康领域应用音乐干预提供了实证支持，并为相关领域的进一步研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Detection and Continuous Monitoring of Memory Dysfunction in Mild Cognitive Impairment and Healthy Aging Through Adaptive Computational Phenotyping
items.abstract: With the rising prevalence of age-related memory impairments, efficiently detecting and monitoring decline is increasingly urgent. Unfortunately, traditional assessment methods fall short of these needs, as they typically require in-person administration and cannot be repeated frequently. Here, we demonstrate that remote identification and monitoring of abnormal memory function is possible by combining an online assessment platform with computational phenotyping, allowing repeatable, unsupervised remote observations from patients. Fifty-one well-characterized older individuals, including 24 patients with amnestic mild cognitive impairment and 27 age- and education-matched healthy controls, completed a series of longitudinal, unsupervised, remote weekly 8-minute online memory assessments for up to one year. Weekly test data were fit to a formal model of memory consolidation and forgetting, yielding an individualized index of memory function, the Seattle-Groningen Memory Assessment (SGMA) score. The SGMA score was found to be reliable, with a mean correlation of r = 0.70 across assessments. The score was also found to be stable across different study materials, and only barely affected by practice effects, which averaged to a 0.2% increase per assessment. Finally, the SGMA score was found to be diagnostic, being capable of detecting mild cognitive impairment with up to 87% accuracy. These findings show that model-based, adaptive assessments can support high-frequency, remote detection and scalable longitudinal monitoring of early memory decline, providing a new way to assess memory decline trajectories in healthy aging and dementia.
items.authors: Hake, H. S.; van der Velde, M.; Grabowski, T.; van Rijn, H.; Stocco, A.
items.title_zh: 通过自适应计算表型检测和监测轻度认知障碍的记忆功能
items.summary_zh: 随着与年龄相关的记忆障碍的普遍性上升，及时检测和监测记忆功能下降变得愈发紧迫。传统评估方法因需面对面进行且无法频繁重复而难以满足需求。本研究展示了通过在线评估平台与计算表型相结合，能够远程识别和监测异常记忆功能的可能性。51名老年参与者（包括24名有记忆障碍的轻度认知障碍患者和27名匹配的健康对照）完成了为期一年的每周8分钟在线记忆评估。每周测试数据被拟合到记忆巩固和遗忘的正式模型中，得出了个体化的记忆功能指数——西雅图-格罗宁根记忆评估（SGMA）分数。SGMA分数可靠性高，评估间平均相关性为r = 0.70，且在不同研究材料中稳定，仅受练习效应轻微影响（平均每次评估增加0.2%）。最后，SGMA分数具有诊断能力，能够以高达87%的准确率检测轻度认知障碍。
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，通过在线评估平台结合计算表型，可以有效远程检测和监测轻度认知障碍患者的记忆功能，SGMA分数具备高准确率和可靠性。
items.l2_summary:
随着老龄化社会的到来，记忆障碍的发生率逐渐上升，尤其是轻度认知障碍（Mild Cognitive Impairment, MCI）患者的数量不断增加，因此及时检测和监测记忆功能的下降显得尤为重要。然而，传统的评估方法通常需要面对面进行，且难以频繁重复，无法满足日益增长的需求。本研究提出了一种创新的方法，通过在线评估平台结合计算表型（computational phenotyping），实现了对异常记忆功能的远程识别和监测。

研究中，51名老年参与者被纳入，其中包括24名被诊断为轻度认知障碍的患者和27名健康对照者。参与者在为期一年的时间内，每周进行一次8分钟的在线记忆评估。通过对每周测试数据的分析，研究者将其拟合到记忆巩固和遗忘的正式模型中，从而得出了个体化的记忆功能指数——西雅图-格罗宁根记忆评估（Seattle-Groningen Memory Assessment, SGMA）分数。研究结果显示，SGMA分数的可靠性较高，评估间的平均相关性为r = 0.70，并且在不同的研究材料中表现出稳定性，仅受到练习效应的轻微影响，平均每次评估分数增加0.2%。

更为重要的是，SGMA分数在诊断轻度认知障碍方面表现出良好的能力，准确率高达87%。这一发现表明，利用在线评估平台和计算表型的方法，不仅可以有效监测老年人的记忆功能变化，还能够为早期识别轻度认知障碍提供有力的工具。这项研究为未来的记忆功能评估提供了新的思路，尤其是在资源有限或无法进行面对面评估的情况下，具有重要的临床应用价值。

items.title: Benchmarking methods integrating GWAS and single-cell transcriptomic data for mapping trait-cell type associations
items.abstract: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have discovered numerous trait-associated variants, but their biological context remains unclear. Integrating GWAS summary statistics with single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data enables prioritization of cell types in which these variants influence traits. Existing methods broadly follow two strategies: single cell to GWAS, which identifies cell-type-specific genes and tests their enrichment in GWAS signals, and GWAS to single cell, which begins with GWAS-prioritized genes and scores cells or cell types according to their expression profiles. Here, we developed a literature-informed benchmark by integrating PubMed evidence with large language model-assisted literature synthesis to evaluate 20 trait-cell type mapping methods. We identify CATCH, a Cauchy combination of complementary methods, as the most robust overall approach, consistently achieving high statistical power while maintaining effective false-positive control across simulations and real-data benchmarks. We further identify key determinants of performance, including cell-type specificity metrics, GWAS statistical power, and the diversity of scRNA-seq reference datasets, providing practical guidance for the development and application of trait-cell type mapping methods.
items.authors: Li, A.; Allen, P.; Wang, Y.; Cui, H.; Lin, T.; Sun, Y.; Wang, X.; Tan, X.; Walker, A.; Wang, S.; Yao, Z.; Zhao, R.; Yang, J.; Yao, S.; Hjerling-Leffler, J.; Sullivan, P. F.; Wray, N. R.; Zeng, J.
items.title_zh: 整合GWAS与单细胞转录组数据的性状-细胞类型关联方法基准评估
items.summary_zh: 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）发现了众多与性状相关的变异，但其生物学背景尚不明确。将GWAS汇总统计与单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据整合，可以优先考虑这些变异影响性状的细胞类型。现有方法主要有两种策略：单细胞到GWAS，识别细胞类型特异性基因并测试其在GWAS信号中的富集；GWAS到单细胞，从GWAS优先基因开始，根据其表达谱对细胞或细胞类型进行评分。我们开发了一种基于文献的基准，通过整合PubMed证据与大语言模型辅助的文献综合，评估了20种性状-细胞类型映射方法。我们识别出CATCH作为最稳健的方法，能够在模拟和真实数据基准中始终保持高统计功效和有效的假阳性控制。此外，我们还确定了性能的关键决定因素，包括细胞类型特异性指标、GWAS统计功效和scRNA-seq参考数据集的多样性，为性状-细胞类型映射方法的开发和应用提供了实用指导。
items.l1_lead: 整合GWAS与单细胞转录组数据的研究表明，CATCH方法在性状-细胞类型映射中表现最优，具备高统计功效和有效假阳性控制。
items.l2_summary:
全基因组关联研究（GWAS）揭示了许多与性状相关的遗传变异，但这些变异的生物学背景仍不明确。为了更好地理解这些变异如何影响性状，研究者们尝试将GWAS汇总统计与单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据进行整合，以优先考虑影响性状的细胞类型。目前，主要有两种策略用于这种整合：一种是从单细胞到GWAS，识别细胞类型特异性基因并测试其在GWAS信号中的富集；另一种是从GWAS到单细胞，从GWAS优先基因出发，根据其表达谱对细胞或细胞类型进行评分。

在此背景下，我们开发了一种基于文献的基准，通过整合PubMed证据与大语言模型辅助的文献综合，评估了20种性状-细胞类型映射方法。经过评估，我们识别出CATCH方法作为最稳健的选择，该方法在模拟和真实数据基准中始终保持高统计功效和有效的假阳性控制。这一发现表明，CATCH方法在性状-细胞类型关联研究中具有显著的优势。

此外，我们还确定了影响这些方法性能的关键决定因素，包括细胞类型特异性指标、GWAS统计功效以及scRNA-seq参考数据集的多样性。这些因素为未来性状-细胞类型映射方法的开发和应用提供了实用的指导，强调了在进行细胞类型关联研究时，选择合适的指标和数据集的重要性。通过这些研究，科学家们能够更深入地理解遗传变异如何通过特定细胞类型影响性状，从而为相关疾病的机制研究和治疗策略的制定提供新的视角。

items.title: Macrophage-CD8+ T Cell Spatial Coupling Defines an Innate-Adaptive Injury Niche in Human Checkpoint Inhibitor Hepatotoxicity
items.abstract: Background & AimsImmune-mediated liver injury from immune checkpoint inhibitors (ILICI) is a major immune-related adverse event that limits cancer immunotherapy, yet its tissue-level immunobiology is poorly defined and its management is largely extrapolated from autoimmune hepatitis (AIH). We previously identified a tri-cellular CD8+ T cell-macrophage-hepatocyte injury niche in a murine model of ILICI; here, we tested whether this niche is recapitulated in human disease. MethodsWe applied imaging mass cytometry with a 32-marker panel to liver biopsies from patients with ILICI (n = 12), AIH as a disease comparator (n = 14), and healthy controls (n = 2), profiling approximately 297,000 single cells across 144 regions of interest with spatially resolved detection of apoptosis (cleaved caspase-3, cC3) and pyroptosis (cleaved gasdermin D, cGSDMD). ResultsWe detected histiocyte-rich granulomas in ILICI consisting of macrophages and CD8+ T cells, including activated memory-effector subsets. Permutation-based spatial analysis identified CD8+ T cell-macrophage co-localization as the most frequent significant interaction in ILICI, organizing into integrated innate-adaptive cellular neighborhoods that concentrated cC3- and cGSDMD-positive cells. Descriptively, this contrasted with AIH, in which immune cells and stroma were more spatially compartmentalized. CD8+ T-cell and macrophage densities correlated with Ishak necroinflammation scores, jaundice, and granuloma formation. ConclusionsThese findings provide the first single-cell spatial proteomic characterization of human ILICI in situ; they recapitulate the tri-cellular CD8-macrophage-hepatocyte niche we previously defined in a murine model and characterize ILICI as a spatially organized innate-adaptive inflammatory process, nominating myeloid signaling and CD8-macrophage interactions as candidate liver-directed targets to uncouple hepatotoxicity from anti-tumor immunity. Impact and implicationsThis study provides the first spatially resolved single-cell proteomic characterization of immune-mediated liver injury from checkpoint inhibitors (ILICI) in human tissue, revealing that macrophages and CD8 T cells are not merely co-present but reproducibly co-localized into integrated inflammatory neighborhoods where apoptotic and pyroptotic cell death is concentrated. These findings are important for hepatologists and oncologists because they reframe ILICI as a spatially organized innate-adaptive process, distinct from autoimmune hepatitis, suggesting that current treatment strategies extrapolated from AIH may not optimally target the underlying pathobiology. Our results nominate myeloid signaling, inflammatory cell death pathways, and macrophage-CD8 T cell interactions as candidate liver-directed therapeutic targets, offering a rationale for mechanism-based interventions that could uncouple hepatotoxicity from anti-tumor immunity and allow patients to remain on effective cancer immunotherapy.
items.authors: Bogdanov, J. M.; Zhao, N.; Alavifard, H.; Kleiner, D. E.; Fontana, R. J.; Stolz, A. A.; Merchant, A.; Sexton, J. Z.; Dara, L.
items.title_zh: 巨噬细胞-CD8+ T细胞空间耦合定义人类免疫检查点抑制剂肝毒性损伤微环境
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：免疫检查点抑制剂引起的免疫介导肝损伤（ILICI）是限制癌症免疫治疗的重要不良事件，其组织水平的免疫生物学尚不明确，管理主要依赖于类自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）。我们之前在小鼠模型中识别了CD8+ T细胞-巨噬细胞-肝细胞的三细胞损伤微环境；本研究测试该微环境是否在人体疾病中重现。方法：我们对ILICI患者（n=12）、AIH（n=14）及健康对照（n=2）的肝活检样本应用32标记的成像质谱细胞分析，分析约297,000个单细胞，空间分辨检测凋亡（切割的半胱天冬酶-3，cC3）和焦亡（切割的气体膜蛋白D，cGSDMD）。结果：在ILICI中检测到富含组织细胞的肉芽肿，包含巨噬细胞和CD8+ T细胞，包括活化的记忆效应亚群。空间分析发现CD8+ T细胞-巨噬细胞共定位是ILICI中最常见的显著相互作用，形成集成的先天-适应性细胞邻域，集中cC3和cGSDMD阳性细胞。与AIH相比，ILICI中免疫细胞和基质的空间分布更为紧密。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，巨噬细胞与CD8+ T细胞的空间耦合在免疫检查点抑制剂引起的肝损伤中起关键作用，形成特定的细胞微环境。
items.l2_summary:
免疫检查点抑制剂引起的免疫介导肝损伤（ILICI）是癌症免疫治疗中的一种重要不良事件，其组织水平的免疫生物学机制尚不明确，现有的管理方法主要依赖于类自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）的处理。为此，本研究旨在探讨在ILICI患者中是否存在与小鼠模型相似的CD8+ T细胞-巨噬细胞-肝细胞三细胞损伤微环境。研究对象包括12名ILICI患者、14名AIH患者及2名健康对照者，通过对其肝活检样本进行32标记的成像质谱细胞分析，分析了约297,000个单细胞，并空间分辨检测了凋亡（切割的半胱天冬酶-3，cC3）和焦亡（切割的气体膜蛋白D，cGSDMD）。

研究结果显示，在ILICI患者的肝组织中，观察到富含组织细胞的肉芽肿，内含巨噬细胞和CD8+ T细胞，尤其是活化的记忆效应亚群。空间分析结果表明，CD8+ T细胞与巨噬细胞的共定位是ILICI中最常见的显著相互作用，形成了一个集成的先天免疫与适应性免疫细胞邻域，并且在该区域内集中分布着cC3和cGSDMD阳性细胞。与AIH患者相比，ILICI患者的免疫细胞和基质的空间分布更为紧密，提示ILICI的免疫微环境具有独特的特征。

综上所述，本研究揭示了ILICI患者中存在的特定免疫细胞相互作用模式，强调了CD8+ T细胞与巨噬细胞之间的空间耦合在肝损伤中的重要性，为理解免疫检查点抑制剂引起的肝毒性损伤提供了新的视角，并可能为临床管理提供参考。

items.title: Co-Designing Pay-It-Forward Strategies to Improve Retention in Cervical Cancer Care in Kenya: A Formative Participatory Study
items.abstract: Background: Retention is the bridge between diagnosis and survival in low and middle-income countries, including Kenya, where the cost of cervical cancer treatment can amount to several years of an average woman's earnings. Pay-it-forward (PIF), a prosocial approach in which an individual receives a gift and then considers supporting another person, offers a community-driven strategy to reduce barriers and improve engagement and retention in cancer care. This study explored opportunities to integrate PIF strategies into cervical cancer care through a human-centered design (HCD) workshop. Methods: We conducted a two-day HCD workshop in Kenya, informed by the WHO/UNICEF normative guide on co-creation with women with cervical cancer (on treatment or survivors), community representatives, and oncology care providers. Experience diagramming mapped the patient journey and identified barriers to retention. A designer-led team then developed the initial PIF prototypes, which were iteratively co-designed and refined with participants to align with their needs and preferences. Audio recordings and photographs of the co-design activities were transcribed and analyzed using rapid, team-based qualitative synthesis. Results: Among 25 participants, 52% (n=13) were women with cervical cancer and 48% (n=12) were health care providers or community representatives. Participants identified costs, extenuating circumstances, treatment side effects, health system challenges, discrimination, fear, and anxiety as barriers to retention. These barriers informed the co-design of six PIF component strategies: peer navigation, transport voucher fund, integrated service gift, a message board in clinic waiting areas, health insurance support fund, and a basket of kindness at checkout. Three of these (peer navigation, transport voucher fund, and health insurance support) have been effectively implemented in Kenya before for other health services. Participants noted that including both monetary and non-monetary nudges was essential but emphasized the need for transparency and oversight in monetary approaches. Conclusion: The Kenyan context provided rich opportunities for PIF component strategies to explore and enhance retention in cancer care. We hypothesize that PIF may improve retention by activating social capital through reciprocity, empathy, and a sense of belonging. Future work should pilot these PIF strategies to assess feasibility, acceptability, and appropriateness, and determine whether reciprocal giving can be sustained. Keywords: Pay-it-forward, cervical cancer, retention, engagement, and co-design Contributions to Literature We propose a hypothesized mechanism through which pay-it-forward may improve engagement and retention in care by activating social capital through reciprocity, empathy, trust, commitment, and belonging. We provide a menu of monetary and non-monetary pay-it-forward strategies that can be adapted and tested across different health care settings, offering practical options for addressing financial and psychosocial barriers to retention. We extend the pay-it-forward literature beyond one-time, low-cost preventive services by applying the approach to long-term, high-cost cancer care, where sustained engagement presents distinct implementation challenges.
items.authors: Adhiambo, H. F.; Trolard, A.; Mangale, D. I.; Thuo, E.; Makanga, P. K.; Akoo, L.; Katumba, J.; Adagi, P.; Abente, B.; Odeny, B.; Bukusi, E.; Powell, B.; Drake, B.; Onyango, D.; Geng, E.; Tucker, J. D.; Odeny, T.
items.title_zh: 共同设计“传递爱心”策略以改善肯尼亚宫颈癌护理的留存率
items.summary_zh: 背景：留存率是低收入和中等收入国家（如肯尼亚）中诊断与生存之间的桥梁，宫颈癌治疗费用可达女性平均收入的数年。传递爱心（Pay-it-forward, PIF）是一种社会互助的方法，个体接受礼物后考虑支持他人，提供了一种社区驱动的策略以减少障碍并改善癌症护理中的参与和留存。本研究通过以人为本的设计（HCD）工作坊探索将PIF策略融入宫颈癌护理的机会。方法：我们在肯尼亚举办了为期两天的HCD工作坊，参与者包括宫颈癌患者（在治疗或幸存者）、社区代表和肿瘤护理提供者。通过经验图示法绘制患者旅程并识别留存障碍。设计师主导的团队开发了初步的PIF原型，并与参与者反复共同设计和完善，以符合他们的需求和偏好。结果：25名参与者中，52%（n=13）为宫颈癌女性，48%（n=12）为医疗提供者或社区代表。参与者识别了成本问题。
items.l1_lead: 通过共同设计“传递爱心”策略，研究旨在改善肯尼亚宫颈癌护理的留存率，强调社区互助在降低治疗障碍中的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
在低收入和中等收入国家，留存率是连接宫颈癌诊断与生存的重要桥梁，尤其是在像肯尼亚这样的国家，宫颈癌治疗费用往往高达女性平均收入的数年。为了解决这一问题，本研究探索了将“传递爱心”（Pay-it-forward, PIF）策略融入宫颈癌护理的可能性。PIF是一种社会互助的方法，个体在接受帮助后，考虑如何支持他人，从而形成社区驱动的支持网络，以减少参与和留存中的障碍。

研究团队在肯尼亚举办了为期两天的以人为本的设计（HCD）工作坊，参与者包括正在接受治疗或已康复的宫颈癌患者、社区代表以及肿瘤护理提供者。通过经验图示法，团队绘制了患者的旅程，并识别出留存过程中的障碍。工作坊中，设计师主导的团队与参与者反复进行共同设计，开发了初步的PIF原型，以确保其符合参与者的需求和偏好。

在25名参与者中，52%（n=13）为宫颈癌女性，48%（n=12）为医疗提供者或社区代表。参与者普遍识别出治疗成本问题是影响留存率的重要因素。这一研究表明，通过社区参与和设计思维，可以有效地识别并解决宫颈癌护理中的障碍，从而改善患者的留存率和整体护理体验。最终，PIF策略的实施有望为肯尼亚的宫颈癌患者提供更为可持续的支持，促进她们在治疗过程中的积极参与。

items.title: Factors associated with a willingness to accept latent tuberculosis infection treatment among non-U.S.-born individuals: a situational choice experiment
items.abstract: Introduction Despite efforts to eliminate tuberculosis (TB) in the United States (U.S.), many individuals diagnosed with latent TB infection (LTBI) who are at increased risk of progressing to TB disease do not initiate TB preventive treatment. Methods Among adults receiving primary care in a federally qualified community health center in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, we conducted a cross-sectional online survey using a situational choice experiment to assess the circumstances in which individuals at risk for TB based on nativity would accept LTBI treatment. In 10 randomized choice tasks, participants answered whether or not they would accept LTBI treatment. In situations where LTBI treatment was accepted, participants were asked a follow-up question about whether they would change their response knowing that reinfection is still possible with LTBI treatment. Attributes assessed included risk level of progression to TB, side effects, changes to co-medication, cost, number of clinic visits, blood draws, and reinfection risk. We conducted a mixed-effects logistic regression to estimate factors associated with treatment acceptance and predicted acceptance across scenarios. Results Of 852 individuals who consented, 458 (53.8%) had complete responses and were included in the analysis. LTBI treatment was accepted in 69.4% of choice scenarios (3180/4580); among scenarios where treatment was initially accepted, 91.5% of scenarios (2911/3180) remained accepted when reinfection possibility was introduced. Compared to situations with low risk of TB progression, high TB progression risk increased the acceptance of LTBI treatment (adjusted odds ratio aOR 2.55, 95% Confidence Interval (CI) = 2.03-3.19). Compared with fatigue as a referent, risk of any liver injury/inflammation (aOR 0.29, 95% CI = 0.22-0.38), gastrointestinal side effects (aOR 0.53, 95% CI 0.41-0.69), rash (aOR 0.62, 95% CI 0.48-0.80) and out-of-pocket cost of $100 (aOR 0.32, 95% CI = 0.26-0.41 compared to $0) were associated with lower acceptance of LTBI treatment. Conclusions The decision to accept LTBI treatment was sensitive to treatment characteristics, suggesting that shared decision-making should be broadly promoted among individuals diagnosed with or at risk of LTBI, particularly in diverse primary care settings serving individuals born in high TB burden countries, with attention to individual concerns such as cost and side effects to improve LTBI treatment uptake.

items.title_zh: 非美国出生者接受潜伏性结核感染治疗的影响因素研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对在美国加州旧金山湾区一家联邦合格社区健康中心接受初级护理的成年人，探讨了影响非美国出生者接受潜伏性结核感染（LTBI）治疗的因素。我们通过在线问卷进行了一项横断面调查，采用情境选择实验评估参与者在不同情况下接受LTBI治疗的意愿。结果显示，在852名同意参与者中，有458人（53.8%）提供了完整回答，69.4%的选择情境中接受了LTBI治疗（3180/4580）。研究发现，影响治疗接受度的因素包括结核病进展风险、治疗副作用、共用药物变化、费用、门诊访问次数、抽血次数及再感染风险等。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，非美国出生者接受潜伏性结核感染治疗的意愿受多种因素影响，包括结核病风险、治疗副作用和费用等。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在探讨影响非美国出生者在美国加州旧金山湾区一家联邦合格社区健康中心接受潜伏性结核感染（LTBI）治疗的因素。研究通过在线问卷进行了一项横断面调查，评估参与者在不同情境下接受LTBI治疗的意愿。共计852名参与者同意参与，其中458人（53.8%）提供了完整的回答。结果显示，69.4%的选择情境中，参与者表示愿意接受LTBI治疗（3180/4580）。研究发现，影响治疗接受度的主要因素包括结核病进展风险、治疗副作用、共用药物变化、费用、门诊访问次数、抽血次数及再感染风险等。这些因素的综合作用影响了非美国出生者对LTBI治疗的态度和决策，提示在制定公共卫生政策和干预措施时，需要考虑这些影响因素，以提高潜伏性结核感染的治疗接受率。

items.title: Prenatal and postpartum tobacco use in adolescents and young adults: a qualitative study
items.abstract: Background: Younger obstetric patients are more likely to use combustible tobacco products and/or cannabis during pregnancy and, among those who quit, are more likely to relapse in the postpartum. Few studies have explored the context of prenatal tobacco use in this population from the narratives and perspectives of these patients. We performed a qualitative interview study of young pregnant people, their beliefs, attitudes, reasons for nicotine and tobacco use, and tobacco cessation experiences to address this gap. Methods: Pregnant patients under the age of 22 were recruited from prenatal clinics in Pittsburgh for a cohort study. A subsample of participants were invited to participate in semi-structured interviews about tobacco and cannabis use. Two coders independently coded all transcripts using an open, inductive approach. The research team then used a qualitative description approach to perform thematic analysis by reviewing high frequency codes, identifying patterns and categories, and identifying themes. Results: We conducted 57 interviews with 46 participants between the ages of 17-23 (M = 19.7 years). Most (n=33) identified as Black/African American, 9 as White, and 4 as Biracial. Thirty-eight were interviewed while pregnant (n=13 1st trimester, n=18 2nd trimester, n=12, 3rd trimester) and 14 were interviewed in the postpartum. We identified the following themes: 1) participants recognized tobacco to be harmful for both the pregnant individual and the fetus; 2) they perceived tobacco use to be more harmful than cannabis use, and co-use to be more harmful than cannabis use alone; 3) peer and social influences contributed to tobacco initiation but also provided support for tobacco cessation; 4) they preferred to reduce or stop tobacco use through their own strategies rather than relying on clinicians or cessation aids; and 5) postpartum relapse was attributed to difficulty of dual transition into adulthood and parenthood. Conclusion: While several themes - knowledge about the harms of tobacco use, greater perceived risk for tobacco compared to cannabis use, and the importance of peer and social support for tobacco cessation efforts - corroborate findings from studies with older pregnant patients, our study highlights some unique stressors contributing to postpartum relapse to combustible tobacco use in younger individuals and the need for better connection with clinical services supporting tobacco cessation.
items.authors: Rai, A.; Chou, S.; Sanfacon, A.; Boss, N.; Lehman, D.; Chang, J. C.; De Genna, N. M.
items.title_zh: 青少年及年轻人产前与产后烟草使用的定性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：年轻的产科患者在怀孕期间更可能使用可燃烟草产品和/或大麻，且在戒烟后更容易复吸。针对这一人群的产前烟草使用背景的研究较少。本研究通过定性访谈，探讨年轻孕妇的信念、态度、尼古丁和烟草使用原因及戒烟经历。方法：从匹兹堡的产前门诊招募22岁以下的孕妇进行队列研究，部分参与者接受了关于烟草和大麻使用的半结构化访谈。两名编码员独立使用开放式归纳方法对所有访谈记录进行编码，研究团队通过定性描述方法进行主题分析。结果：我们对46名年龄在17至23岁（平均19.7岁）的参与者进行了57次访谈。大多数参与者（n=33）为黑人/非裔美国人，9人为白人，4人为双种族。38名参与者在怀孕期间接受访谈（n=13为妊娠早期，n=18为妊娠中期，n=12为妊娠晚期），14名在产后接受访谈。我们识别出以下主题：1）产前烟草使用的影响因素。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，年轻孕妇在产前烟草使用受多种因素影响，且戒烟后复吸风险较高，亟需针对该人群的干预措施。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨青少年及年轻孕妇在产前和产后烟草使用的背景，尤其是她们的信念、态度、尼古丁和烟草使用原因及戒烟经历。研究对象为22岁以下的年轻孕妇，参与者从匹兹堡的产前门诊招募，共进行了57次访谈，参与者年龄在17至23岁之间，平均年龄为19.7岁。其中，大多数参与者（n=33）为黑人/非裔美国人，9人为白人，4人为双种族。访谈分为产前和产后，38名参与者在怀孕期间接受访谈（妊娠早期13人，妊娠中期18人，妊娠晚期12人），14名在产后接受访谈。

研究采用半结构化访谈的方式，旨在深入了解年轻孕妇在怀孕期间的烟草使用情况。通过开放式归纳方法，两名编码员独立对访谈记录进行编码，研究团队随后运用定性描述方法进行主题分析。初步结果显示，参与者在产前烟草使用的影响因素方面存在多种看法和经历，这些因素可能与她们的社会环境、心理状态及对健康的认知密切相关。

本研究填补了针对年轻孕妇烟草使用背景的研究空白，揭示了这一人群在产前和产后面临的挑战与需求。研究结果不仅为理解年轻孕妇的烟草使用行为提供了重要的定性数据，也为未来制定针对性的戒烟干预措施提供了依据。通过深入分析年轻孕妇的信念和态度，能够更好地帮助她们在怀孕期间做出健康的选择，减少烟草对自身及胎儿的潜在危害。

items.title: Atrial Cardiomyopathy Refines Cardiovascular Mortality Risk Across Cardiometabolic Risk Factor Burden
items.abstract: Background: Electrocardiographic markers of atrial cardiomyopathy (AtCM) are associated with adverse cardiovascular outcomes. Whether AtCM further refines cardiovascular disease (CVD) mortality risk across increasing cardiometabolic risk factor (CMRF) burden is unclear. Methods: We analyzed 7,083 adults free of baseline CVD. AtCM was defined by the presence of [ ]1 ECG marker: prolonged P-wave duration [ ]120 ms in lead II, abnormal P-wave axis outside 0-75, or deep terminal negativity of the P wave in V1 <-100 V. CMRF burden was defined as the presence of 0, 1, or [ ]2 of hypertension, diabetes, and obesity. CVD mortality was ascertained through December 31, 2006. Results: Among 7,083 participants (mean age 58 years and 48% men), CVD mortality rates increased progressively across the six combined exposure groups. In a multivariable adjusted Cox proportional hazard analysis, AtCM identified higher-risk subgroups within each CMRF burden category, with risk increasing progressively across combined exposure groups and highest among participants with [ ]2 risk factors and AtCM (HR 2.25, 95% CI 1.75-2.87). In secondary analyses, a similar pattern was observed for individual CMRFs, with the combination of AtCM and hypertension, diabetes, or obesity conferring the highest risk compared with participants with neither condition (HR (95% CI): 1.58 (1.31-1.89); 2.08 (1.62-2.68); and 1.47 (1.19-1.82), respectively). Conclusions: ECG-defined AtCM refined CVD mortality risk across increasing CMRF burden. Individuals with both AtCM and multiple CMRFs had the highest risk. These findings support the potential role of ECG-based AtCM assessment as a scalable approach to improve cardiovascular risk stratification among individuals with CMRFs.
items.authors: Mohsen, A. M.; Elnewishy, M.; Zaho, T.; Cheon, P.; Boursiquot, B. C.; Chevli, P. A.; Kazibwe, R.; Bhave, P. D.; Soliman, E. Z.
items.title_zh: 心房心肌病对心血管死亡风险的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：心房心肌病（AtCM）的心电图标志与不良心血管结果相关。尚不清楚AtCM是否能进一步细化心血管疾病（CVD）死亡风险。方法：我们分析了7083名无基础CVD的成年人，AtCM通过以下1个心电图标志定义：II导联P波持续时间延长≥120毫秒，P波轴异常（超出0-75度），或V1导联P波深终末负性<-100μV。心脏代谢风险因素（CMRF）负担定义为高血压、糖尿病和肥胖的存在情况。CVD死亡率数据截至2006年12月31日。结果：7083名参与者（平均年龄58岁，男性占48%）中，CVD死亡率在六个组合暴露组中逐渐增加。在多变量调整的Cox比例风险分析中，AtCM在每个CMRF负担类别中识别出高风险亚组，风险在组合暴露组中逐渐增加，且在具有2个风险因素和AtCM的参与者中最高（HR 2.25，95% CI 1.75-2.87）。在次级分析中，个别CMRF的结果也显示出类似模式，AtCM与高血压、糖尿病或肥胖的组合相比于无这些情况的参与者具有最高风险（HR（95% CI）：1.58（1.31-1.89）；2.08（1.62-2.68）；和1.47）。
items.l1_lead: 心房心肌病在心血管疾病死亡风险中起到重要作用，尤其在伴随高血压、糖尿病或肥胖的情况下，风险显著增加。
items.l2_summary:
心房心肌病（AtCM）是一种与不良心血管结果相关的心电图标志，其对心血管疾病（CVD）死亡风险的影响尚不明确。为此，研究者分析了7083名无基础CVD的成年人，旨在探讨AtCM是否能够进一步细化CVD死亡风险。AtCM的定义基于以下心电图标志：II导联P波持续时间延长≥120毫秒、P波轴异常（超出0-75度）或V1导联P波深终末负性<-100μV。同时，心脏代谢风险因素（CMRF）负担被定义为高血压、糖尿病和肥胖的存在情况。研究中收集的CVD死亡率数据截至2006年12月31日。

结果显示，在7083名参与者中（平均年龄58岁，男性占48%），CVD死亡率在六个组合暴露组中逐渐增加。通过多变量调整的Cox比例风险分析，AtCM能够在每个CMRF负担类别中识别出高风险亚组，且风险在组合暴露组中逐渐增加。其中，具有2个风险因素和AtCM的参与者显示出最高的死亡风险（风险比HR 2.25，95%置信区间CI 1.75-2.87）。在次级分析中，个别CMRF的结果也呈现出类似的模式，AtCM与高血压、糖尿病或肥胖的组合相比于无这些情况的参与者具有显著更高的风险，具体为：高血压组HR 1.58（95% CI 1.31-1.89），糖尿病组HR 2.08（95% CI 1.62-2.68），肥胖组HR 1.47。

综上所述，心房心肌病在心脏代谢风险因素负担的背景下，显著提高了心血管死亡风险，尤其是在同时存在多个风险因素的情况下。这一发现强调了在心血管疾病风险评估中考虑AtCM的重要性，为临床实践提供了新的视角。

items.title: Integrating structured and unstructured EHR data to characterize social and behavioral factors associated with frequent emergency department use among patients with cardiovascular disease
items.abstract: Objective: The goal was to integrate structured and unstructured data from the electronic health record (EHR) to identify social and behavioral determinants of health (SBDH) factors and evaluate their association with high emergency department (ED) utilization among cardiovascular disease (CVD) patients. Methods: A custom natural language processing (NLP) algorithm was developed to extract 17 SBDH domains from clinical notes, combined with ICD-10 Z codes and screening questionnaires from the EHR. The study included patients aged 18-64 with a history of CVD. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify associations between SBDH and high ED utilization ([ ] 5 visits) after adjusting for age, sex, race, insurance class, and chronic conditions. Results: Use of only ICD-10 codes and screening questionnaires identified patients in only a subset of the 17 SBDH domains, whereas extraction from clinical notes identified patients across all domains and increased prevalence estimates for every domain. Among 4,844 patients with CVD, 526 (10.9%) were frequent ED users. After adjustment, patients with inadequate support system (OR= 2.8), opioid abuse (OR=2.47), inadequate insurance (OR=2.42), alcohol abuse (OR=2.28), medication affordability concerns (OR=2.28), unreliable transportation (OR=1.82), financial strain (OR=1.69), and depression (OR=1.42) were significantly more likely to have frequent ED utilization. Conclusion: NLP can efficiently and more comprehensively identify socioeconomic risk factors from the EHR. Substance use, financial strain, inadequate social support, and other socioeconomic challenges may be linked to increased ED visits in patients with CVD.
items.authors: Metzger, T.; Morrell, S.; Roy, S.; Neumann, J.; Singh, L.; Shah, P.; Felice, B.; Berger, D.; Homayouni, R.
items.title_zh: 整合结构化与非结构化EHR数据以识别心血管疾病患者的社会行为因素
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在整合电子健康记录（EHR）中的结构化和非结构化数据，以识别与心血管疾病（CVD）患者频繁使用急诊科（ED）相关的社会和行为健康决定因素（SBDH）。采用定制的自然语言处理（NLP）算法从临床记录中提取17个SBDH领域，并结合ICD-10 Z编码和筛查问卷。研究对象为18-64岁有CVD病史的患者。多变量逻辑回归分析显示，调整年龄、性别、种族、保险类别和慢性病后，支持系统不足（OR=2.8）、阿片类药物滥用（OR=2.47）、保险不足（OR=2.42）等因素显著增加高频ED使用的风险。在4,844名CVD患者中，526名（10.9%）为频繁ED用户。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过整合EHR数据，发现支持系统不足、阿片类药物滥用和保险不足等社会行为因素显著增加心血管疾病患者频繁使用急诊科的风险。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在通过整合电子健康记录（EHR）中的结构化和非结构化数据，识别与心血管疾病（CVD）患者频繁使用急诊科（ED）相关的社会和行为健康决定因素（SBDH）。研究采用了定制的自然语言处理（NLP）算法，从临床记录中提取了17个SBDH领域，并结合了国际疾病分类第十版（ICD-10）中的Z编码及筛查问卷。研究对象为18至64岁有CVD病史的患者，样本量为4,844名CVD患者，其中526名（10.9%）被认定为频繁ED用户。

通过多变量逻辑回归分析，研究发现，在调整了年龄、性别、种族、保险类别和慢性病等因素后，支持系统不足（OR=2.8）、阿片类药物滥用（OR=2.47）和保险不足（OR=2.42）等社会行为因素显著增加了高频ED使用的风险。这些结果表明，社会和行为健康因素在心血管疾病患者的急诊使用模式中扮演着重要角色，强调了在临床实践中考虑这些因素的重要性，以便更好地管理和预防心血管疾病患者的急诊就医需求。研究结果为改善心血管疾病患者的健康管理提供了新的视角，提示医疗系统在应对患者需求时应更加关注社会支持和行为健康的影响。

items.title: A National Survey Exploring Dementia Diagnostics and Care Provisions in Primary Care in England
items.abstract: Background: The 10 Year Health Plan for England indicates governmental intention to shift care from hospital to community. Disease Modifying Treatments (DMTs) and biomarker tests for dementia will likely be introduced, with potentially significant impacts on community care, particularly general practice. Aim: To explore dementia diagnosis, post diagnostic support and expectations around future care in primary care settings. Design and Setting: Codesigned survey with general practitioners (GPs), policy researchers, carers and people with lived experience. One GP per practice invited from five English Integrated Care Boards (ICBs). Methods: Inductive content analysis for qualitative responses and non-weighted means calculated for quantitative answers. Findings contextualised using national data. Results: Between September and December 2025, 80/1094 (7.3%) eligible practices participated (80 GPs). Most, (79/80, 98.8%) used cognitive assessments and 100% (80/80) blood tests to support dementia diagnosis, with 27/70 (39.7%) able to order brain scans directly. GPs primarily conducted annual physical, mental or care plan reviews for people with known dementia. Respondents considered it unlikely (47/80, 58.8%) they would formally diagnose dementia or assess (50/80, 62.3%) for DMT eligibility in the next five years. GPs considered it somewhat/most likely (54/80, 67.5%) they could offer blood biomarker tests and continue established DMT prescribing or monitoring (61/80, 76.3%). Resource, capacity and training needs were perceived barriers. Conclusion: GPs are the first point of contact for accessing a dementia diagnosis in England. Accommodating novel diagnostic tools and treatments requires a reimagining of the relationship between primary, secondary and social care to address GP reported constraints.
items.authors: Darby, A.; Shaw, J.; Cooper, C.; Chemas, N.; Marshall, C. R.; Mukadam, N.; Smith, K.; Khan, R.; Banerjee, S.; Rait, G.
items.title_zh: 英格兰初级护理中痴呆诊断与护理的全国调查
items.summary_zh: 背景：英格兰10年健康计划表明政府意图将护理从医院转向社区。预计将引入疾病修饰治疗（DMT）和痴呆生物标志物检测，这可能对社区护理，特别是全科医疗产生重大影响。目的：探讨初级护理环境中的痴呆诊断、诊后支持及未来护理期望。设计与设置：与全科医生、政策研究者、照护者及有相关经历的人共同设计的调查。方法：对定性回答进行归纳内容分析，并计算定量答案的非加权均值。结果：2025年9月至12月，80个符合条件的实践（1094个中的7.3%）参与（80名全科医生）。大多数（79/80，98.8%）使用认知评估，100%（80/80）进行血液检测以支持痴呆诊断，27/70（39.7%）能够直接申请脑部扫描。全科医生主要为已知痴呆患者进行年度身体、心理或护理计划评估。受访者认为在未来五年内正式诊断痴呆（47/80，58.8%）或评估DMT资格（50/80，62.3%）的可能性不大。全科医生认为能够提供支持的可能性较高（54/80，67.5%）。
items.l1_lead: 英格兰初级护理中痴呆诊断和护理的调查显示，尽管大多数全科医生进行认知评估和血液检测，但对未来正式诊断和疾病修饰治疗资格评估的信心不足。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨英格兰初级护理环境中痴呆（dementia）诊断、诊后支持及未来护理的期望。随着英格兰政府的10年健康计划，护理模式正逐步从医院转向社区，预计将引入疾病修饰治疗（DMT）和痴呆生物标志物检测，这对全科医疗的影响不可忽视。为此，研究团队与全科医生、政策研究者、照护者及相关经历者共同设计了一项调查，旨在收集关于痴呆诊断和护理的现状及未来展望的数据。

在2025年9月至12月期间，共有80个符合条件的全科医疗实践参与了此次调查，参与全科医生人数为80名，覆盖了1094个实践中的7.3%。调查结果显示，绝大多数（79/80，98.8%）的全科医生使用认知评估工具来支持痴呆的诊断，所有参与者（100%）均进行了血液检测以辅助诊断，而27/70（39.7%）的全科医生能够直接申请脑部扫描。调查还发现，全科医生主要为已知痴呆患者进行年度身体、心理或护理计划评估。

尽管全科医生在痴呆诊断和支持方面表现出一定的能力，受访者对未来五年内正式诊断痴呆的可能性持谨慎态度，仅有47/80（58.8%）的人认为可能性不大，而50/80（62.3%）的受访者认为评估DMT资格的可能性同样不高。然而，受访者对能够提供支持的信心较高，67.5%的全科医生（54/80）认为他们能够在未来为痴呆患者提供必要的支持。

综上所述，尽管当前的初级护理环境中，痴呆的诊断和支持措施已经在一定程度上落实，但对于未来的正式诊断和DMT评估，医生们的信心相对不足。这一调查结果为政策制定者和医疗服务提供者在改善社区护理和支持痴呆患者的策略上提供了重要的参考依据。

items.title: Caregiver-Rated Inappropriate Speech and Post-cTBS Motor Cortical Facilitation in Autism: A Pilot Biomarker Study
items.abstract: Transcranial magnetic stimulation can provide noninvasive measures of cortical excitability and plasticity, but relationships between these measures and clinically observable features of autism are not fully characterized. Nineteen autistic participants aged 15 to 40 years were included in the analysis of a left primary motor cortex continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) biomarker protocol. Motor evoked potentials were measured at baseline and at seven assessments from 5 to 60 min after stimulation. Linear mixed-effects models evaluated whether clinical measures moderated the post-stimulation motor evoked potential log-response ratio over time. Aberrant Behavior Checklist (ABC) and Attenuated Behavior Questionnaire (ABQ) analyses were restricted to the same 15 participants with caregiver-informant assessments. Catatonia severity, social impairment, ABQ Motor Total, ABQ Total, and cognitive ability did not significantly moderate the post-stimulation response. ABC Inappropriate Speech was associated with progressively greater post-stimulation facilitation (standardized Time-by-Inappropriate Speech interaction: beta = +0.688, SE = 0.210, 95% CI +0.276 to +1.099; Holm-adjusted P = .008 across eight informant-rated models). Two individual speech-related items ("Talks excessively" and "Talks to self loudly") survived false-discovery-rate correction. An exploratory eight-item ABC phenotype showed a large descriptive in-sample association (beta = +0.904, SE = 0.200, P less than .001) and directionally positive held-out performance. However, full-pipeline permutation tests were nonsignificant for both Pearson (r = .357, two-sided empirical P = .360) and Spearman correlations (rho = .446, two-sided empirical P = .261). Caregiver-rated inappropriate speech may be associated with altered post-cTBS motor cortical facilitation in autism. The candidate phenotype remains hypothesis-generating and requires independent validation.
items.authors: Smith, J. R.; Bonnee, M.; Marler, S.; Atwood, R.; Lewis, B.; Lim, S.; Baldwin, I.; Wu, H.; Liu, J.; Cascio, C.; Joshi, G.; Croarkin, P. R.
items.title_zh: 自闭症照顾者评估的不当言语与运动皮层促进的初步生物标志研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究纳入19名年龄在15至40岁的自闭症参与者，分析左侧初级运动皮层的连续θ波刺激（cTBS）生物标志协议。基线及刺激后5至60分钟进行了七次运动诱发电位测量。采用线性混合效应模型评估临床指标是否影响刺激后运动诱发电位的对数反应比。对照顾者评估的15名参与者进行的异常行为清单（ABC）和减弱行为问卷（ABQ）分析显示，ABC不当言语与刺激后促进作用呈正相关（标准化时间与不当言语交互作用：beta = +0.688，SE = 0.210，95% CI +0.276至+1.099；Holm调整后的P = .008）。两个与言语相关的项目（“过度交谈”和“自言自语”）在假发现率校正后仍然显著。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现自闭症照顾者评估的不当言语与运动皮层刺激后的促进作用存在正相关，提示言语行为可能影响运动神经反应。
items.l2_summary: 本研究针对19名年龄在15至40岁的自闭症参与者，探讨了左侧初级运动皮层（primary motor cortex）的连续θ波刺激（cTBS）作为生物标志的潜力。研究通过七次运动诱发电位（MEP）测量，分别在基线及刺激后5至60分钟进行，以评估临床指标对刺激后运动诱发电位对数反应比的影响。分析结果显示，照顾者评估的15名参与者在异常行为清单（ABC）和减弱行为问卷（ABQ）中的数据表明，ABC中不当言语与刺激后的促进作用呈正相关，具体而言，标准化时间与不当言语的交互作用显示出显著性（beta = +0.688，SE = 0.210，95% CI +0.276至+1.099；Holm调整后的P = .008）。此外，两个与言语相关的项目，即“过度交谈”和“自言自语”，在假发现率校正后仍然保持显著性。这些结果提示，不当言语行为可能与运动皮层的促进作用存在一定的关联，为自闭症的生物标志研究提供了初步证据。

items.title: Development and Validation of a 12-Item Form of the Participation Questionnaire for Preschoolers
items.abstract: Aims: To develop and validate the 12-item short form of the Participation Questionnaire for Preschoolers (PQP-12). Methods: In a cross-sectional study (n = 164 aged 3-6 years), 12 items (three per factor) were selected based on item-total correlations while retaining the four-factor structure; confirmatory factor, internal consistency, and construct validity analyses were conducted. In a cohort study (n = 275 aged 5-6 years), confirmatory factor and internal consistency analyses were reperformed in an independent sample, and test-retest reliability (intraclass correlation coefficients [ICCs]), measurement error (standard error of measurement [SEM], minimal detectable change [MDC]), and responsiveness were examined. Results: The four-factor model fit well in both samples (comparative fit index = 0.999/0.996) and was superior to the one-factor model. Cronbach's was 0.75 and 0.80 (subscales: 0.46-0.92), with Factor 2's low value likely reflecting ceiling effects in the older sample. The PQP-12 correlated strongly with the original PQP (r = 0.86-0.95); 78% of construct-validity hypotheses and 80% of responsiveness hypotheses were supported. Test-retest reliability was good (ICC = 0.79-0.90), with SEM and MDC being reported. Conclusion: The PQP-12 preserves the original PQP's structure and measurement properties while reducing respondent burden.
items.authors: Nakamura, T.; Nagayama, H.
items.title_zh: 学龄前儿童参与问卷12项简表的开发与验证
items.summary_zh: 目的：开发并验证学龄前儿童参与问卷的12项简表（PQP-12）。方法：在一项横断面研究中（n = 164，年龄3-6岁），根据项目-总分相关性选择了12个项目（每个因素3个），并保留四因素结构；进行了确认性因素分析、内部一致性和构念效度分析。在一项队列研究中（n = 275，年龄5-6岁），在独立样本中重新进行确认性因素和内部一致性分析，并检查了重测信度（组内相关系数[ICC]）、测量误差（测量标准误[SEM]、最小可检测变化[MDC]）和响应性。结果：四因素模型在两个样本中均拟合良好（比较拟合指数 = 0.999/0.996），优于一因素模型。Cronbach's α为0.75和0.80（子量表：0.46-0.92），因素2的低值可能反映了老年样本的天花板效应。PQP-12与原始PQP强相关（r = 0.86-0.95）；构念效度假设的支持率为78%，响应性假设的支持率为80%。重测信度良好（ICC = 0.79-0.90），并报告了SEM和MDC。结论：PQP-12保留了原始PQP的结构和测量特性，同时减轻了受访者负担。
items.l1_lead: 学龄前儿童参与问卷12项简表（PQP-12）有效保留了原始问卷的结构和测量特性，同时减轻了受访者的负担。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在开发并验证学龄前儿童参与问卷的12项简表（PQP-12），以便更有效地评估3至6岁儿童的参与情况。在一项横断面研究中，研究者对164名学龄前儿童进行了调查，通过项目-总分相关性分析选取了12个项目，确保每个因素包含3个项目，并保留了四因素结构。研究中进行了确认性因素分析、内部一致性和构念效度分析，结果显示四因素模型在两个样本中均拟合良好，比较拟合指数分别为0.999和0.996，明显优于一因素模型。内部一致性方面，Cronbach's α值为0.75和0.80，子量表的α值在0.46至0.92之间，虽然因素2的低值可能反映了老年样本的天花板效应。

在后续的队列研究中，研究者对275名年龄在5至6岁的儿童进行了独立样本的确认性因素和内部一致性分析，并检查了重测信度（组内相关系数ICC）以及测量误差（测量标准误SEM和最小可检测变化MDC）。重测信度结果良好，ICC值在0.79至0.90之间，表明问卷的稳定性较高。此外，PQP-12与原始PQP的相关性非常强，相关系数r在0.86至0.95之间，构念效度假设的支持率为78%，响应性假设的支持率为80%。这些结果表明，PQP-12不仅保留了原始PQP的结构和测量特性，同时也有效减轻了受访者的负担。

综上所述，PQP-12是一种有效的工具，能够在学龄前儿童中准确评估参与情况，具有良好的信度和效度，为相关研究和实践提供了重要支持。

items.title: 2025/26 subclade-specific influenza A and B vaccine effectiveness estimates and discordant laboratory-based indicators of vaccine match or mismatch
items.abstract: Background: The 2025/26 influenza season included A(H3N2) subclade K predominance with A(H1N1)pdm09 co-circulation and subsequent prolonged influenza B activity. The Canadian Sentinel Practitioner Surveillance Network reports vaccine effectiveness (VE) in the context of genetic and antigenic relatedness to circulating viruses. Methods: We estimated VE by test-negative design among outpatients with medically-attended acute respiratory illness between November and April. We characterized case viruses by whole genome sequencing and hemagglutination inhibition assay. Results: Among 2809/9047 (31%) influenza-positive specimens, 82% (2306/2809) were influenza A with 18% (504/2809) influenza B. Of subtyped influenza A, 85% (1848/2169) were A(H3N2). We sequenced 59% (1099/1848) of A(H3N2) viruses, with 87% (956/1099) subclade K, antigenically-mismatched to subclade J.2 vaccine. VE against A(H3N2) and subclade K was 38% (95% confidence interval: 27%-47%) and 33% (19%-45%). We sequenced 69% (222/323) of A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses, virtually all (n=218) clade 5a.2a.1, including subclades D.3.1 (21%; n=47) and D.3.1.1 (77%; n=171), antigenically-matched to subclade D vaccine. VE against A(H1N1)pdm09, subclades D.3.1 and D.3.1.1 was 28% (4%-47%), -21% (-144%-40%) and 44% (14%-64%). We sequenced 82% (413/504) of influenza B viruses, all B/Victoria, including antigenically-mismatched subclade C.3 (18%; n=74) with D197N gain-of-glycosylation, and antigenically-matched subclade C.5 (82%; n=339) relative to subclade C vaccine. VE against influenza B, subclades C.3 and C.5 was 55% (41%-66%), 10% (-60%-49%) and 68% (51%-79%). Conclusions: The 2025/26 influenza vaccine reduced the risk of A(H3N2), A(H1N1)pdm09 and B/Victoria by over one-third, one-quarter and one-half, respectively. Laboratory-based indicators of vaccine match remain uncertain proxies for actual vaccine protection, reinforcing importance of annual epidemiological monitoring of VE.
