At 1.4 M, the 2 mL CFI provided calculated productivities of approximately 572 g day -1 for geranyl ester and 422 g day -1 for citronellyl ester, assuming continuous operation for 24 h. These results establish aqueous-rich segmented flow as an effective strategy for intensifying selective enzymatic transesterification within a compositionally complex terpene feedstock. The combination of selective conversion, enhanced interphase mass transfer and high calculated productivity provides a basis for the continuous valorisation of rose geranium oil and other complex floral oils into high-value fragrance esters.
items.authors: Alisa S Wikaputri, Shyam Rana, Rhea Satpute, Derek J Irvine, Robert A Stockman, Volker Hessel
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，采用水富集分段流技术的微反应器可显著提高玫瑰天竺葵油中酶促转酯化的选择性和生产力，为复杂花油的高值化提供了有效策略。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了利用水相丰富的流动强化技术，在卷曲流动逆转微反应器（coiled flow inverter microreactor）中对玫瑰天竺葵油进行酶促转酯化的过程。传统的批量反应器在处理粗花香油转化为高价值香料酯时，受到质量传递限制和生产率低下的制约。玫瑰天竺葵油是一种复杂的天然多组分原料，主要成分包括香叶醇（geraniol）、香茅醇（citronellol）及其他多种挥发性成分。本研究采用荧光假单胞菌脂肪酶（Pseudomonas fluorescens lipase, PFL），在不需事先分离这些成分的情况下，直接对多组分油中的香叶醇和香茅醇进行选择性转酯化。

研究中开发了一种过程强化策略，使用水相丰富的双相斑点流，水相与有机相的比例为9:1，提供了2319 m²/m³的特定界面面积，使得香叶醇的表观体积质量传递系数（kLa）相较于批量操作提高了约5倍，而香茅醇则提高了约7倍。在60°C和5分钟的停留时间下，微反应器实现了99%的香叶醇转化率和93%的香茅醇转化率，且在1.4 M的玫瑰天竺葵油浓度下，香叶醇和香茅醇的转化率分别保持在91%和71%。将停留时间延长至7分钟，香茅醇在1.4 M浓度下的转化率提高至95%。在1.4 M浓度下，2 mL的微反应器在假设连续操作24小时的情况下，计算出的香叶酯和香茅酯的生产率分别约为572 g/day和422 g/day。

这些结果表明，水相丰富的分段流动是一种有效的策略，可以在成分复杂的萜类原料中强化选择性酶促转酯化。选择性转化、增强的相间质量传递和高计算生产率的结合，为玫瑰天竺葵油及其他复杂花香油的连续增值转化为高价值香料酯奠定了基础。
items.title_zh: 水相富集流动强化玫瑰天竺葵油的酶催化转酯化
items.summary_zh: 酶辅助将粗花油转化为高价值香料酯的过程受到传统批量反应器的传质限制和生产率低的制约。本文选择了含有香叶醇、香茅醇等多种挥发成分的玫瑰天竺葵油，研究了从粗花油中进行连续酶催化转酯化的过程。采用假单胞菌荧光脂肪酶（PFL），在不需事先分离成分的情况下，选择性地转酯化了香叶醇和香茅醇。使用卷曲流动反转微反应器（CFI）开发了一种过程强化策略。在水相与有机相比例为9:1的水相富集双相流动中，提供了2319 m²/m³的特定界面面积，使得香叶醇的表观体积传质系数（kLa）提高了约5倍，香茅醇提高了7倍。在60°C、5分钟的停留时间下，CFI在0.2 M的玫瑰天竺葵油中实现了99%的香叶醇和93%的香茅醇转化，而在1.4 M时分别保持了91%和71%的转化率。将停留时间增加到7分钟，1.4 M下香茅醇的转化率提高至95%。在1.4 M时，2 mL的CFI提供了约572 g/day的香叶酯生产率。

items.title: A computed thermoelectric feature database for 50,992 GNoME materials
items.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials now make it feasible to compute rich physical property sets for very large libraries of hypothetical crystals, but such feature sets are rarely released in analysis-ready form, and thermal-transport descriptors — central to thermoelectric performance — are especially scarce. Here we present a computed feature database for 50,992 novel, thermodynamically plausible crystalline materials drawn from Google DeepMind's Graph Networks for Materials Exploration (GNoME) database and filtered for thermoelectric relevance (non-metallic, finite band gap, energy above the Materials Project convex hull ≤ 0.05 eV/atom). For every material we provide composition and crystallographic descriptors; CHGNet universal- potential energetics, per-site magnetic moments, and a 64-dimensional learned crystal embedding; a full harmonic thermal-transport layer (elastic tensor, Debye temperature, sound velocities, and Cahill/Clarke minimum-conductivity bounds); and an anharmonic layer (Grüneisen parameter from a CHGNet equation-of-state, and a Slack-model lattice thermal conductivity). CHGNet formation energies reproduce the underlying DFT values with a mean absolute error of 0.036 eV/atom (Pearson r = 0.999), and two independently computed bulk moduli agree to a 5.3 % median difference (r = 0.992). To our knowledge this is the first release of a complete lattice-thermal-transport feature layer for the GNoME material set, enabling data-driven thermoelectric screening and machine-learning studies at scale.
items.authors: Akshay Deshpande
items.l1_lead: 我们发布了一个包含50,992种新型晶体材料的热电特性数据库，提供了全面的热传导描述，促进了数据驱动的热电筛选和大规模机器学习研究。
items.l2_summary: 随着机器学习原子间势能的进步，计算大规模假设晶体的丰富物理性质集变得可行。然而，这些特征集通常未以适合分析的形式发布，尤其是与热传导相关的描述符在热电性能中至关重要，且相对稀缺。为此，研究团队基于Google DeepMind的材料探索图网络（Graph Networks for Materials Exploration, GNoME）数据库，推出了一个包含50,992种新型热力学上可行的晶体材料的计算特征数据库，并对其进行了热电相关性筛选（非金属、有限带隙、能量高于材料项目（Materials Project）凸包≤0.05 eV/原子）。该数据库为每种材料提供了组成和晶体学描述符，包括CHGNet通用势能的能量、每个原子的磁矩以及64维的学习晶体嵌入。此外，还包含完整的谐波热传导层（弹性张量、德拜温度、声速和Cahill/Clarke最小导电性界限）以及非谐层（基于CHGNet状态方程的Grüneisen参数和Slack模型的晶格热导率）。CHGNet形成能的计算结果与基础的密度泛函理论（DFT）值的平均绝对误差为0.036 eV/原子（Pearson相关系数r = 0.999），而两种独立计算的体模量的中位差异为5.3%（r = 0.992）。据我们所知，这是首次发布GNoME材料集的完整晶格热传导特征层，为数据驱动的热电筛选和大规模机器学习研究提供了重要基础。
items.title_zh: 50,992种GNoME材料的计算热电特征数据库
items.summary_zh: 本文展示了一个包含50,992种新型热力学合理晶体材料的计算特征数据库，这些材料来自Google DeepMind的材料探索图网络（GNoME）数据库，并经过热电相关性筛选（非金属、有限带隙、能量高于材料项目凸包≤0.05 eV/原子）。我们为每种材料提供了组成和晶体学描述；CHGNet通用势能学、每个原子的磁矩以及64维学习的晶体嵌入；完整的谐波热传导层（弹性张量、德拜温度、声速和Cahill/Clarke最小导电性界限）；以及一个非谐层（来自CHGNet状态方程的Grüneisen参数和Slack模型的晶格热导率）。CHGNet形成能以0.036 eV/原子的平均绝对误差重现了基础的DFT值（Pearson r = 0.999），两个独立计算的体模量的中位差为5.3%（r = 0.992）。这是首次发布完整的晶格热电特征数据库。

items.title: Reliable Structure-Processing-Performance Learning in Organic Photovoltaics: Chemical Generalization, Processing-Aware Prediction and Uncertainty under Domain Shift
items.abstract: Machine-learning models for organic photovoltaics (OPVs) can achieve strong performance under random train-test splits, but such evaluation may overstate prospective generalization when literaturederived datasets contain repeated publications and material systems. Here, two complementary OPV benchmarks were constructed to separate interpolation from chemical extrapolation: a provenanceclean OPV-DB cohort containing 21,590 experimentally reported devices and a processing-rich Wen-Zhang-Ma cohort containing 994 unique physical processing conditions. Random, publication-heldout, donor-acceptor (D:A)-pair-held-out, acceptor-held-out, and donor-held-out validation regimes were compared, together with structure-only, processing-only, and combined structure-processing representations. Extra Trees performance on OPV-DB declined from R2 = 0.813 under random validation to R2 = 0.362 under donor holdout. In the processing-rich benchmark, adding processing information reduced MAE by 19.5% under random validation but by only 1.0-2.4% under chemically grouped validation. This effect was strongly associated with material-system familiarity: processing reduced MAE by 27.1% for test records whose D:A pair was represented in training, compared with 1.8% for completely unseen pairs. Ensemble dispersion was useful for ranking errors under random validation (Spearman rho = 0.462) but lost reliability under donor holdout (rho = 0.047), where the most uncertain 20% of predictions captured only 16.1% of the largest errors. A cross-dataset transfer audit further showed that a common unmodified RDKit representation covered 73.54% of the processing benchmark and only 38.02% of records with PCE = 15%, creating substantial chemicalselection bias. These results show that validation design is central to claims of OPV model reliability, that processing information primarily refines predictions within familiar chemistry, and that both uncertainty estimation and transfer benchmarking require explicit domain-shift and representation audits.
items.authors: DENNIS OBINNA ORJI
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，有机光伏材料的机器学习模型在验证设计上至关重要，处理信息主要在熟悉的化学体系中提高预测精度，同时不确定性估计和转移基准需要明确的领域转移和表示审计。
items.l2_summary:
在有机光伏（OPV）领域，机器学习模型在随机训练-测试分割下能够实现较强的性能，但这种评估可能会高估其潜在的泛化能力，尤其是在文献来源的数据集中存在重复出版物和材料系统的情况下。为了解决这一问题，研究者构建了两个互补的OPV基准，以区分插值（interpolation）与化学外推（chemical extrapolation）。其中，OPV-DB数据集包含21,590个实验报告的设备，经过清理以去除来源偏差；而Wen-Zhang-Ma数据集则包含994种独特的物理处理条件，强调了处理信息的重要性。

在不同的验证机制下，包括随机验证、出版物保留验证、供体-受体（D:A）对保留验证、受体保留验证和供体保留验证，研究比较了仅基于结构、仅基于处理和结合结构-处理的表示方法。结果显示，Extra Trees模型在OPV-DB数据集上的性能在随机验证下的R²为0.813，但在供体保留验证下下降至R²为0.362。在处理丰富的基准中，添加处理信息在随机验证下使平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了19.5%，但在化学分组验证下仅降低了1.0-2.4%。这一效果与材料系统的熟悉度密切相关：对于训练中有代表性的D:A对，处理信息使MAE降低了27.1%，而对于完全未见过的对，仅降低了1.8%。

此外，集成模型的离散性在随机验证中对错误排名有帮助（Spearman相关系数ρ = 0.462），但在供体保留验证中失去了可靠性（ρ = 0.047），最不确定的20%预测仅捕捉到16.1%的最大错误。跨数据集的转移审计进一步表明，常用的未修改RDKit表示覆盖了处理基准的73.54%，但仅覆盖了PCE（光电转换效率）为15%的记录的38.02%，这表明存在显著的化学选择偏差。

这些结果表明，验证设计对于OPV模型可靠性的声明至关重要，处理信息主要在熟悉的化学范围内细化预测，而不确定性估计和转移基准测试则需要明确的领域转移和表示审计。
items.title_zh: 有机光伏中的可靠结构-加工-性能学习研究
items.summary_zh: 有机光伏（OPVs）的机器学习模型在随机训练-测试分割下表现良好，但这种评估可能高估了潜在的泛化能力。本文构建了两个互补的OPV基准，以区分插值与化学外推：一个包含21,590个实验报告设备的干净OPV-DB队列和一个包含994种独特物理加工条件的加工丰富的Wen-Zhang-Ma队列。比较了随机、出版物保留、供体-受体对保留等验证方式，以及仅结构、仅加工和结合结构-加工的表示。在OPV-DB上，Extra Trees的性能在随机验证下为R² = 0.813，但在供体保留下降至R² = 0.362。在加工丰富的基准中，添加加工信息在随机验证下减少了19.5%的平均绝对误差（MAE），但在化学分组验证下仅减少了1.0-2.4%。这一效果与材料系统的熟悉度密切相关。

items.title: Engineering Receptor-Mediated Cell-Surface Mobility with Phage-Inspired DNA Tetrapods
items.abstract: Viruses have long inspired the development of multiligand display systems that engage cell-surface receptors through strong multivalent interactions. However, considerably less attention has been devoted to recapitulating the early stages of infection, during which weak, reversible interactions promote receptor-mediated mobility across cell membranes. Bacteriophages provide a striking example of this behavior, using transient receptor interactions to move across bacterial surfaces in search of favorable binding sites. Inspired by this mechanism, we developed DNA tetrapods targeting bacterial receptors exploited by phages during adsorption and demonstrate that phage-like lateral mobility on living bacterial cells can be achieved by tuning ligand affinity, valency, and spacer length. Furthermore, this platform can be extended to mammalian systems, where the tetrapod architecture similarly governs lateral motion and cell association, enabling selective cancer-cell recognition and improved antisense oligonucleotide uptake. Together, these findings demonstrate receptor-mediated mobility as a programmable property that could be harnessed to enhance cellular targeting and cargo delivery.
items.authors: Gal Raviv, Ilan Edelstein, Tali Dadosh, Inna Goliand, Ziv Porat, Alla H. Falkovich
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，通过调节配体亲和力、价态和间隔长度，可以实现受体介导的细胞表面移动性，从而增强细胞靶向和载荷递送的能力。
items.l2_summary: 病毒长期以来激发了多配体展示系统的发展，这些系统通过强的多价相互作用与细胞表面受体结合。然而，对于感染早期阶段的研究关注较少，而这一阶段的弱可逆相互作用促进了受体介导的细胞膜移动。噬菌体（bacteriophage）是这一行为的典型例子，它们利用瞬时的受体相互作用在细菌表面移动，以寻找有利的结合位点。受到这一机制的启发，我们开发了针对噬菌体在吸附过程中利用的细菌受体的DNA四足体（tetrapod），并展示了通过调节配体亲和力、价态和间隔长度，可以在活细菌细胞上实现类似噬菌体的侧向移动。此外，这一平台还可以扩展到哺乳动物系统，其中四足体结构同样调控侧向运动和细胞结合，从而实现选择性癌细胞识别和改善反义寡核苷酸的摄取。这些发现表明，受体介导的移动性是一种可编程特性，可以被利用来增强细胞靶向和载荷递送的效果。
items.title_zh: 利用噬菌体启发的DNA四足体调控受体介导的细胞表面移动性
items.summary_zh: 本研究以噬菌体为灵感，开发了针对细菌受体的DNA四足体，探讨其在细胞表面移动中的应用。通过调节配体亲和力、价态和间隔长度，我们实现了在活细菌细胞上类似噬菌体的侧向移动。此外，该平台可扩展至哺乳动物系统，四足体结构同样调控侧向运动和细胞结合，从而实现选择性癌细胞识别和改善反义寡核苷酸的摄取。这些发现表明，受体介导的移动性是一种可编程特性，可用于增强细胞靶向和载荷递送。

items.title: Hidden Hypoxanthine Neighborhoods in β-Guanine
items.abstract: Biogenic guanine crystals can incorporate substantial hypoxanthine (Hpx) while retaining the βguanine lattice, but whether the lattice discriminates both dopant identity and local neighborhood remains unresolved. Here, periodic DFT, site-anchored cluster cross-checks, symmetry-complete pair enumeration, and GIPAW 13C calculations connect these two levels of incorporation to experimentally testable observables. In a dry 6.25% fixed-cell model, N7H-Hpx is 21.78 kcal mol ¹ lower in electronic energy than N9H-Hpx; three cluster treatments preserve a 17.40–18.25 ⁻¹ lower in electronic energy than N9H-Hpx; three cluster treatments preserve a 17.40–18.25 kcal mol ¹ preference. A pure-crystal calibration excluding the embedded-Hpx resonance ⁻¹ lower in electronic energy than N9H-Hpx; three cluster treatments preserve a 17.40–18.25 predicts C5 shifts of 115.98 ppm for N7H and 127.94 ppm for N9H, placing N7H-Hpx in the experimentally reported 115–116 ppm region. At 12.5% substitution, 120 site pairs reduce to 13 symmetry-distinct orbits. Fifteen representatives were relaxed, and the corrected orbit means span 2.407 kcal mol ¹, with an adjacent in-plane orbit lowest; independent starts for four low- ⁻¹ lower in electronic energy than N9H-Hpx; three cluster treatments preserve a 17.40–18.25 energy motifs preserve this minimum. Fixed-geometry 700 eV reevaluation in a 4 × 2 × 1 association cycle gives adjacent- and far-pair association energies of −1.2219 and +0.0189 kcal mol ¹. Across four GIPAW pair models, C5 remains comparatively stable, whereas C6/C8 report ⁻¹ lower in electronic energy than N9H-Hpx; three cluster treatments preserve a 17.40–18.25 local arrangement: adjacent and separated motifs yield C8 splittings of 2.854 and 0.037 ppm. Together, the calculations show that the tested β-guanine lattice models discriminate both metabolite identity and relative placement. The resulting ¹³C signatures provide experimentally testable markers of how biologically supplied purine mixtures may become locally organized during biomineralization.
items.authors: He Hu, Li Yi
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，β-鸟嘌呤晶体能够区分不同的代谢物身份及其局部排列，提供了生物矿化过程中嘌呤混合物局部组织的实验可测标记。
items.l2_summary: 生物源性鸟嘌呤（guanine）晶体能够在保持β-鸟嘌呤晶格的同时，显著地掺入次黄嘌呤（hypoxanthine, Hpx），但晶格是否能够区分掺杂物的身份及其局部邻域尚未得到解决。本研究通过周期性密度泛函理论（DFT）、基于位点的簇交叉检查、对称完全对偶枚举以及GIPAW ¹³C计算，将这两种掺入水平与可实验测试的可观测量联系起来。在一个干燥的6.25%固定单元模型中，N7H-Hpx的电子能量比N9H-Hpx低21.78 kcal mol⁻¹；三种簇处理方法保持了N7H-Hpx比N9H-Hpx低17.40–18.25 kcal mol⁻¹的能量偏好。纯晶体校准排除嵌入Hpx的共振，预测N7H和N9H的C5位移分别为115.98 ppm和127.94 ppm，N7H-Hpx位于实验报告的115–116 ppm区域。在12.5%的掺杂下，120个位点对减少为13个具有对称性不同的轨道。对15个代表性轨道进行放松，校正后的轨道均值跨度为2.407 kcal mol⁻¹，且相邻的面内轨道能量最低；四个低能量动机的独立起始保持了这一最小值。在4 × 2 × 1的关联周期中，固定几何结构的700 eV重新评估显示，相邻和远离对的关联能量分别为−1.2219和+0.0189 kcal mol⁻¹。在四个GIPAW对模型中，C5保持相对稳定，而C6/C8报告的能量比N9H-Hpx低17.40–18.25 kcal mol⁻¹；相邻和分离的动机导致C8的分裂分别为2.854和0.037 ppm。综合这些计算结果表明，所测试的β-鸟嘌呤晶格模型能够区分代谢物的身份及其相对位置。由此产生的¹³C信号为生物供应的嘌呤混合物在生物矿化过程中如何局部组织提供了可实验测试的标记。
items.title_zh: β-鸟嘌呤中的隐性次黄嘌呤邻域研究
items.summary_zh: 生物源鸟嘌呤晶体能够在保持β-鸟嘌呤晶格的同时，显著掺入次黄嘌呤（Hpx），但晶格是否能区分掺杂物的身份和局部邻域尚未解决。本文采用周期性密度泛函理论（DFT）、基于位点的簇交叉检查、对称完全对偶枚举和GIPAW 13C计算，将这两种掺入水平与可实验测试的可观测量联系起来。在干燥的6.25%固定单元模型中，N7H-Hpx的电子能量比N9H-Hpx低21.78 kcal mol⁻¹；三种簇处理保持了17.40–18.25 kcal mol⁻¹的能量偏好。纯晶体校准排除嵌入Hpx的共振，预测N7H和N9H的C5位移分别为115.98 ppm和127.94 ppm，N7H-Hpx位于实验报告的115–116 ppm区域。在12.5%替代时，120个位点对减少为13个对称独特轨道。十五个代表性轨道经过放松，校正后的轨道均值跨度为2.407 kcal mol⁻¹，最低的相邻平面轨道保持此最小值。

items.title: Quantitative Cryogenic Orbitrap Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry for structural characterization of lipid nanoparticles
items.authors: Joseph W Roberts, Anna Kotowska, Eduardo Aguilar-Bejarano, Evan Collins, Jacob Witten, Alexandra Howard

items.title: A simple demonstration of the importance of purity in nanotechnology with the example of rapid syntheses of gold nanoparticles in water
items.abstract: A simple and visual demonstration of the importance of purity and the impact of impurities in nanotechnology is described. Stable colloidal gold nanoparticles are simply obtained at room temperature in seconds, adding NaBH4 to HAuCl4 in water without the need for other chemicals. By adjusting the conductivity of the water used, for example by using high purity water, tap water or mixtures of the two in different ratios, the size and stability of the nanoparticles is easily tuned. Size control is easily assessed by the color of the colloids obtained and/or by UV-vis spectroscopy. This undergraduate level demonstration suitable for a wide audience requires only very simple equipment and can be broadly implemented to illustrate the importance of controlled conditions in nanotechnology, raise awareness on the impact of impurities, but also show how to leverage on negative results to turn a drawback into a benefit. Additionally, the concept and the experimental approach proposed integrate well in other pedagogical activities and are a solid foundation to link nanotechnology to other important topics in the education of the chemical sciences.
items.authors: Javier Eiroa Soto, Jonathan Quinson
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过简单的实验展示了在纳米技术中，水的纯度对金纳米颗粒合成的大小和稳定性的重要影响。
items.l2_summary:
本研究通过一个简单而直观的实验，展示了在纳米技术中纯度的重要性及杂质的影响。实验中，研究者在室温下仅需几秒钟即可通过将氯金酸（HAuCl4）与硼氢化钠（NaBH4）混合在水中，快速合成稳定的胶体金纳米颗粒。通过调整所用水的电导率，例如使用高纯度水、自来水或两者的不同混合比例，可以轻松调节纳米颗粒的大小和稳定性。纳米颗粒的大小变化可以通过所获得胶体的颜色或紫外-可见光谱（UV-vis spectroscopy）进行评估。

该实验适合本科生及广泛受众，所需设备非常简单，易于实施，能够有效说明在纳米技术中控制条件的重要性，并提高人们对杂质影响的认识。此外，研究还展示了如何利用负面结果，将缺点转化为优势。这一概念和实验方法与其他教学活动相结合，为将纳米技术与化学科学教育中的其他重要主题建立坚实的基础。通过这样的实验，学生不仅能够直观理解纳米颗粒的合成过程，还能深入思考纯度对实验结果的深远影响，从而在未来的研究和应用中更加注重材料的纯度和实验条件的控制。
items.title_zh: 纳米技术中纯度重要性的简单示范：水中金纳米粒子的快速合成
items.summary_zh: 本文描述了纯度及杂质在纳米技术中重要性的简单直观示范。通过在室温下将NaBH4加入HAuCl4水溶液中，能够在几秒钟内获得稳定的胶体金纳米粒子，无需其他化学品。通过调整所用水的导电性（例如使用高纯度水、自来水或两者的混合物），可以轻松调节纳米粒子的大小和稳定性。纳米粒子的大小可通过获得的胶体颜色和/或紫外-可见光谱法进行评估。该本科水平的示范适合广泛受众，仅需非常简单的设备，能够有效展示控制条件在纳米技术中的重要性，提高对杂质影响的认识，并展示如何利用负面结果将缺点转化为优势。此外，所提概念和实验方法与其他教学活动良好结合，为将纳米技术与化学科学教育中的其他重要主题建立坚实基础。

items.title: On Coupled Cluster Theory and Beyond
items.abstract: Coupled cluster (CC) theory is the “gold standard” of molecular electronic structure theory, yet the full arc of the subject—from its variational origins in Hartree–Fock theory, through the exponential ansatz and its diagrammatic machinery, to its modern reformulation as a system of polynomial equations on an algebraic variety, its multireference generalizations, and its emerging reincarnation as a quantum circuit—is rarely presented as a single connected narrative. This review builds that narrative completely from first principles and carries it through to today’s research frontier. Starting from the electronic Schrödinger equation, we derive Hartree–Fock theory, second quantization, and Wick’s theorem; construct the coupled cluster singles-and-doubles (CCSD) equations via the similarity-transformed Hamiltonian; and show how these same equations reappear, verbatim, as a truncated eigenvalue problem on a projective variety generalizing the Grassmannian, with a computable CC degree controlling the number of solutions. We then develop the perturbative triples correction CCSD(T), the linear-response equationof-motion (EOM-CC) framework for excited, ionized, and electron-attached states, the effective-Hamiltonian formalism underlying multireference coupled cluster theory and its notorious intruder-state problem, and the unitary coupled cluster (UCC) ansatz that restores the variational principle at the cost of an infinite operator expansion—tamed, on a quantum computer, by Trotterization and the variational quantum eigensolver. We close with a synthesis of what is rigorously known about the resulting nonlinear equations, a map of directions deliberately left out of scope, and an assessment of the open question of quantum advantage in this domain. Every claim is stated formally, with a full statement and proof or proof sketch, and cited to its origin; the computational cost of every method is compared explicitly throughout.
items.authors: Mohsen Doust Mohammadi
items.l1_lead: 耦合簇理论是分子电子结构理论的“金标准”，本文系统梳理了其从变分起源到现代量子电路的演变过程，并探讨了其在量子计算中的应用及相关开放问题。
items.l2_summary:
耦合簇（Coupled Cluster, CC）理论被认为是分子电子结构理论的“金标准”，但这一领域的发展历程从哈特里-福克（Hartree–Fock）理论的变分起源，到指数假设及其图示工具，再到现代作为代数多样体上的多项式方程系统的重新表述，以及其多参考态（multireference）推广和作为量子电路的再现，鲜有以连贯的叙述方式呈现。本文综述从基本原理出发，构建了这一连贯的叙述，并将其延续至当今的研究前沿。

文章首先从电子薛定谔方程出发，推导出哈特里-福克理论、二次量子化和威克定理（Wick’s theorem），接着通过相似变换哈密顿量构建耦合簇单体和双体（CCSD）方程，并展示这些方程如何以逐字相同的形式出现在一个推广的格拉斯曼流形（Grassmannian）上的截断特征值问题中，其中可计算的CC度数控制着解的数量。随后，文章发展了微扰三体修正（CCSD(T)）、线性响应运动方程（EOM-CC）框架，用于激发态、离子态和电子附加态，探讨了多参考耦合簇理论的有效哈密顿形式及其著名的入侵态问题，以及单位耦合簇（UCC）假设，该假设在代价是无限算符展开的情况下恢复了变分原理，而在量子计算机上通过特罗特化（Trotterization）和变分量子特征求解器（variational quantum eigensolver）得以控制。

最后，文章总结了关于所得到的非线性方程的严格已知结果，绘制了故意未纳入讨论的研究方向图，并评估了在这一领域量子优势的开放性问题。每一项主张均以正式的方式表述，并附有完整的陈述和证明或证明概要，并引用其来源；文中还明确比较了每种方法的计算成本。
items.title_zh: 耦合簇理论及其发展概述
items.summary_zh: 耦合簇（CC）理论是分子电子结构理论的“金标准”，但其发展历程从哈特里-福克理论的变分起源、指数假设及其图示工具，到现代作为代数多样体上的多项式方程系统的重新表述，以及其多参考态推广和作为量子电路的新兴形式，鲜有完整的叙述。本文从电子薛定谔方程出发，推导出哈特里-福克理论、二次量子化和威克定理；通过相似变换哈密顿量构建耦合簇单体和双体（CCSD）方程，并展示这些方程如何作为截断特征值问题在推广的Grassmannian上重新出现，计算得到的CC度数控制解的数量。接着，我们发展了微扰三体修正CCSD(T)、激发、离子化和电子附加态的线性响应运动方程（EOM-CC）框架，以及支持多参考态耦合簇理论的有效哈密顿量形式和著名的入侵态问题，最后介绍了恢复变分性质的单位耦合簇（UCC）假设。

items.title: From Black Box to Dialogue: An MCP Server for Tanabe–Sugano Diagrams as a Reference Case for Conversational Scientific Tools
items.abstract: Interpreting the d–d electronic spectra of transition-metal complexes is a routine practice in inorganic chemistry, yet the underlying models behind such interpretations are unexpectedly challenging to operate. Rigorous treatments demand specialized software, expert parameterization, and often high-performance computing, while even the standard textbook tool for first-pass intuition takes practice to read. The Tanabe–Sugano (TS) diagram remains the most efficient method for developing that intuition, and the same ligand-field framework is foundational for more advanced spectroscopic analyses. Here we present TanabeSugano, an open-source Python solver for d2–d8 TS diagrams. It is implemented as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, letting a language-model client act as an interactive front end that operates the solver rather than merely describing it. Through natural-language prompts, users can compute term energies, explore and compare configurations, fit measured absorption bands to extract the crystal-field strength (Dq) and Racah B, and interpret B as an indicator of metal–ligand covalency via the nephelauxetic ratio. The solver runs locally, without compilation or high-performance computing. We outline the tools available within the server and the d-orbital concepts they embody, illustrated by a comparison between d5 and d6 configurations that reveals the high-spin/low-spin crossover and the distinction between spin-allowed and spin-forbidden electronic transitions. TanabeSugano is the proof of concept; the contribution is the pattern it demonstrates, which exposes a validated solver through MCP. More specifically, it offers an accessible route to phenomenological understanding and a transferable model for operating other formal chemical models through dialogue. The proposed MCP implementation does not aim to supplant the rigor inherent in ab initio methods and remains fundamentally distinct from it.
items.authors: Anselm W. Hahn
items.l1_lead: 本文介绍了TanabeSugano，一个开源Python求解器，通过对话式界面简化了过渡金属配合物的Tanabe–Sugano图的计算与分析，提供了更直观的化学模型操作方式。
items.l2_summary:
在无机化学中，解释过渡金属配合物的d-d电子光谱是一项常规实践，但其背后的模型却出乎意料地复杂，操作难度较大。严谨的处理需要专业软件、专家参数化，且通常需要高性能计算，而即使是教科书中用于初步直观理解的工具，也需要一定的练习才能掌握。田边-菅野（Tanabe–Sugano，TS）图是发展这种直观理解的最有效方法，其所基于的配体场框架也是更高级光谱分析的基础。为此，研究团队推出了TanabeSugano，这是一个开源的Python求解器，专门用于d2–d8的TS图。该求解器作为模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）服务器实现，使得语言模型客户端可以作为交互式前端来操作求解器，而不仅仅是描述它。

通过自然语言提示，用户可以计算能级、探索和比较不同的构型、拟合测量的吸收带以提取晶体场强度（Dq）和Racah B，并通过内禀比率将B解释为金属-配体共价性的一种指标。该求解器可以在本地运行，无需编译或高性能计算。文中还概述了服务器内可用的工具及其所体现的d轨道概念，通过比较d5和d6构型，揭示了高自旋/低自旋交叉以及自旋允许和自旋禁止电子跃迁之间的区别。TanabeSugano作为概念验证，展示了通过MCP暴露出一个经过验证的求解器的模式。更具体地说，它提供了一条通向现象学理解的可及路径，并为通过对话操作其他形式化化学模型提供了可转移的模型。所提出的MCP实现并不旨在取代从头计算（ab initio）方法所固有的严谨性，且在本质上与之保持明显区别。
items.title_zh: 从黑箱到对话：基于MCP服务器的Tanabe–Sugano图示例研究
items.summary_zh: 过渡金属配合物的d–d电子光谱解释是无机化学中的常规实践，但其背后的模型操作却出乎意料地复杂。传统的解释工具需要专业软件和高性能计算，且即使是教科书中的标准工具也需要练习才能掌握。Tanabe–Sugano（TS）图是发展直觉的最有效方法，且同样的配体场框架是更高级光谱分析的基础。本文介绍了TanabeSugano，一个开源Python求解器，专用于d2–d8 TS图。该求解器作为模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器实现，允许语言模型客户端作为交互前端操作求解器。用户通过自然语言提示可以计算能级、探索和比较构型、拟合测量的吸收带以提取晶体场强度（Dq）和Racah B，并通过nephelauxetic比率解释B作为金属-配体共价性的指示。该求解器在本地运行，无需编译或高性能计算。

items.title: Physical Metallurgy of Lithium and Sodium and its Role in Electrochemical Stability of Solid-State Battery Anodes
items.abstract: Alkali metal negative electrodes in solid-state batteries (SSBs) undergo mechanical deformation during cycling, for which an understanding of their physical metallurgy is critical. Here, we study the link between microstructure and plastic deformation in lithium and sodium. Grain size is controlled through deformation processing, and etching methods are developed to reveal grain boundaries, subgrain boundaries, and dislocation structures. Hall-Petch strengthening with decreasing grain size occurs in both metals. Creep rate in lithium is grain-size-independent above the subgrain size, but increases at small grain sizes where diffusional creep dominates. Oxide dispersion-strengthened behavior is observed in Li. At length scales below the subgrain size, strength increases and creep rates decrease due to dislocation starvation. Solid-state electrochemical cell tests in which lithium of differing foil thickness is stripped under pressure validates length-scale effects. Overall, this work provides a physical metallurgy framework for alkali metal deformation and offers design principles for advanced SSBs.
items.authors: Chiung-Yuan Lo, Vijay D. Veeraraghavan, Cole D. Fincher, Callum J. Campbell, QianQian Yan, David Mitlin
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了锂和钠在固态电池负极中的物理冶金特性与其机械变形之间的关系，为先进固态电池的设计提供了重要原则。
items.l2_summary: 在固态电池（SSBs）中，碱金属负极在充放电循环过程中会经历机械变形，因此理解其物理冶金特性至关重要。本研究探讨了锂（Li）和钠（Na）的微观结构与塑性变形之间的关系。通过变形加工控制晶粒尺寸，并采用蚀刻方法揭示晶界、亚晶界和位错结构。研究发现，随着晶粒尺寸的减小，两种金属均表现出霍尔-佩奇（Hall-Petch）强化效应。锂的蠕变速率在亚晶粒尺寸以上与晶粒尺寸无关，但在小晶粒尺寸下，扩散蠕变主导，蠕变速率则增加。此外，锂表现出氧化物弥散强化行为。在亚晶粒尺寸以下，强度增加而蠕变速率降低，这一现象归因于位错匮乏。通过在不同厚度的锂箔下进行固态电化学电池测试，验证了长度尺度效应的存在。总体而言，本研究为碱金属的变形提供了物理冶金框架，并为先进固态电池的设计原则提供了指导。
items.title_zh: 锂和钠的物理冶金及其在固态电池负极中的电化学稳定性作用
items.summary_zh: 固态电池（SSBs）中的碱金属负极在循环过程中会发生机械变形，因此理解其物理冶金至关重要。本研究探讨了锂和钠的微观结构与塑性变形之间的关系。通过变形加工控制晶粒尺寸，并开发了蚀刻方法以揭示晶界、亚晶界和位错结构。两种金属均表现出随着晶粒尺寸减小而增强的Hall-Petch效应。锂的蠕变速率在亚晶粒尺寸以上与晶粒尺寸无关，但在小晶粒尺寸下，扩散蠕变主导，速率增加。锂表现出氧化物弥散强化行为。在亚晶粒尺寸以下，强度增加而蠕变速率降低，原因是位错匮乏。通过在压力下剥离不同厚度锂箔的固态电化学电池测试验证了长度尺度效应。总体而言，本研究为碱金属变形提供了物理冶金框架，并为先进固态电池的设计原则提供了指导。

items.title: It Takes a Village (or a City): Perceived Economic Strain, Caregiver Ambivalence, and Quality of Life Among Caregiving Grandparents Across Perceived Residential Area Types
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Grandparent caregiving is a common and demanding role, and perceived economic strain is among the more consistent correlates of caregiver well-being. Guided by Hill’s ABC-X family stress model, this study examined whether perceived economic strain was associated with quality of life (QoL) among U.S. caregiving grandparents through two caregiving appraisals, caregiver burden and caregiver ambivalence, and whether perceived residential area type (a single self-classification item, with higher scores indicating a more urban perception) moderated the ambivalence–QoL relation. Methods: Participants included 424 caregiving grandparents recruited through an opt-in online panel. QoL was measured with the two-item WHOQOL-BREF general facet. Storage codes for the health-satisfaction item were verified against the survey instrument; a scoring error affecting them was corrected, and all results reflect the corrected scoring. A serial mediation model (PROCESS Model 6) and a moderated serial mediation model (PROCESS Model 87) were tested, controlling for age, sex, and marital status entered as categorical indicators, with percentile bootstrap confidence intervals (5000 samples). Results: Perceived economic strain was strongly and negatively associated with QoL (total effect B = −4.64, p 0.001; the full QoL regression model explained 38% of the variance, R2 = 0.38). Greater strain was associated with greater burden, and burden with greater ambivalence, but the hypothesized negative serial pathway was not supported, and the serial indirect relation was positive and small (effect = 0.20, 95% CI [0.04, 0.41]). Perceived area type moderated the ambivalence–QoL relation (interaction B = 0.63, p = 0.002). Ambivalence was associated with lower QoL among grandparents who perceived their communities as small towns (B = −3.97) and with higher QoL among those with urban (B = 0.93) or major metropolitan (B = 1.09) perceptions. The moderation held across robustness checks, including an ordinal specification of the outcome, but did not replicate with an objective metropolitan versus nonmetropolitan indicator. Conclusions: The findings are cross-sectional, come from a relatively advantaged and nonrepresentative sample, and rest on brief measures, so causal conclusions are not warranted, and practice implications remain preliminary. Even so, the results support the idea that the meaning of caregiving ambivalence for well-being may depend on the kind of community caregivers believe they live in, and the strong relation between perceived economic strain and QoL supports continued attention to financial hardship in policies and programs serving caregiving grandparents.
items.authors: Danielle Kristen Nadorff, Margaret Ralston, Laura A. Shillingsburg, Amara L. Mason

items.title: Functional Status and Postoperative Outcomes After Left Pancreatectomy for Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumors: An Exploratory Analysis from the Prospective SPANDISPAN Study
items.abstract: Background: Whether tumor functional status influences postoperative outcomes after left pancreatectomy (LP) for pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNETs) remains unknown. We evaluated the association between functional status, perioperative management, and postoperative outcomes in a prospective nationwide cohort of patients undergoing LP for pNET. Methods: This prespecified analysis of the prospective multicenter SPANDISPAN study included consecutive patients undergoing elective LP at 41 Spanish hospitals between February 2022 and January 2023. Of 98 patients with pNET, functional status was available in 88 (14 functioning and 74 non-functioning tumors). Perioperative characteristics, spleen preservation, and postoperative outcomes were compared according to tumor functional status. Results: Spleen preservation was performed in 28.6% of functioning and 18.9% of non-functioning tumors (p = 0.472; risk difference 9.7 percentage points, 95% CI [confidence interval] −15.6 to 34.9). Patients with functioning tumors had lower rates of clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula (7.1% vs. 36.5%; p = 0.032; risk difference −29.3 percentage points, 95% CI −46.7 to −12.0), shorter length of hospital stay (median 4 vs. 7 days; p = 0.036), and no 90-day readmissions (0% vs. 31.1%; p = 0.017; risk difference −31.1 percentage points, 95% CI −41.6 to −20.5). Tumor functional status was not significantly associated with the use of spleen-preserving resection. Conclusions: Functional status is associated with clinically relevant differences in postoperative outcomes after LP for pNET. Patients with functioning tumors experienced lower postoperative morbidity than those with non-functioning tumors, whereas no statistically significant association was detected between tumor functional status and spleen preservation. These exploratory findings suggest that tumor functional status may warrant consideration as an additional factor in perioperative risk stratification and patient counseling, pending confirmation in larger, adequately powered studies; spleen preservation should continue to be guided by established oncological criteria.
items.authors: José Manuel Ramia, Belén Hernández-Roca, Juan Jesús Rubio-García, Daniel Aparicio-López, Juli Busquets, Luis Secanella
items.l1_lead: 肿瘤的功能状态与胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤左侧胰腺切除术后的临床结果显著相关，功能性肿瘤患者的术后并发症发生率较低。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤（pNET）患者在接受左胰腺切除术（LP）后，肿瘤的功能状态是否会影响术后结果。研究基于前瞻性多中心SPANDISPAN研究，纳入了2022年2月至2023年1月期间在41家西班牙医院接受选择性LP的患者，共有98名pNET患者，其中88名患者的功能状态可用（14例为功能性肿瘤，74例为非功能性肿瘤）。研究比较了不同功能状态肿瘤患者的围手术期特征、脾脏保留情况及术后结果。

结果显示，功能性肿瘤患者中有28.6%进行了脾脏保留，而非功能性肿瘤患者中这一比例为18.9%（p = 0.472；风险差异9.7个百分点，95%置信区间[CI]为−15.6至34.9）。在术后并发症方面，功能性肿瘤患者的临床相关胰腺瘘发生率为7.1%，而非功能性肿瘤患者为36.5%（p = 0.032；风险差异−29.3个百分点，95% CI为−46.7至−12.0）。此外，功能性肿瘤患者的住院时间中位数为4天，而非功能性肿瘤患者为7天（p = 0.036），并且功能性肿瘤患者在90天内没有再入院的情况（0% vs. 31.1%；p = 0.017；风险差异−31.1个百分点，95% CI为−41.6至−20.5）。

尽管功能状态与脾脏保留的使用没有显著相关性，但研究结果表明，肿瘤的功能状态与术后结果存在临床相关的差异。功能性肿瘤患者的术后并发症发生率低于非功能性肿瘤患者，这提示在围手术期风险分层和患者咨询中，肿瘤的功能状态可能是一个值得考虑的额外因素。研究建议在更大规模、充分权力的研究中进一步确认这些发现，同时脾脏保留的决策应继续遵循既定的肿瘤学标准。
items.title_zh: 左侧胰腺切除术后胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤功能状态与预后分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：肿瘤功能状态是否影响左侧胰腺切除术（LP）后胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤（pNET）的预后尚不明确。本研究评估了功能状态、围手术期管理与术后结果之间的关联。方法：本研究为前瞻性多中心SPANDISPAN研究的预先指定分析，纳入2022年2月至2023年1月在41家西班牙医院接受选择性LP的患者。98例pNET患者中，88例的功能状态可用（14例为功能性肿瘤，74例为非功能性肿瘤）。根据肿瘤功能状态比较围手术期特征、脾脏保留及术后结果。结果：功能性肿瘤的脾脏保留率为28.6%，非功能性肿瘤为18.9%（p = 0.472）。功能性肿瘤患者术后胰腺瘘发生率较低（7.1% vs. 36.5%；p = 0.032），住院时间较短（中位数4天 vs. 7天；p = 0.036），90天内无再入院（0% vs. 31.1%；p = 0.017）。结论：功能性肿瘤患者在术后表现出更好的预后。

items.title: How Major Events Reconfigure Technology–Energy Risk Spillovers in China: Implications for Energy Security
items.abstract: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence is tightening the interdependence between digital infrastructure and energy systems, making the linkages between technology and energy increasingly important for understanding energy security. This study examines how major events reshape risk spillovers between China’s technology and energy sectors, with particular attention to the asymmetric effects of policy shocks, external technological shocks, and domestic technological breakthroughs. Focusing on four events, namely the announcement of the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, the launch of the East Data and West Computing project, the release of ChatGPT 3.5, and the release of DeepSeek R1, the study explores whether different shocks alter risk transmission between sectors in distinct ways. Using interval data for 16 representative listed firms from 2021 to 2025, the analysis combines firm-level spillover networks with sector-level robustness tests. The results suggest that policy-driven events are associated with stronger systemic connectedness and changes in the direction of predictive spillovers between the technology and energy sectors, although the Dual Carbon result is sensitive to the selected event window, whereas ChatGPT 3.5 is associated with short-term risk decoupling under the baseline specification, although this result also shows some sensitivity to the event horizon. DeepSeek R1 shows the largest baseline increase in overall spillovers and a relatively stable positive pattern across alternative event windows. The precision of the estimated changes also varies across events. The findings suggest that domestic advances in large language models are not only innovation milestones, but also potential sources of persistent pressure on energy security.
items.authors: Li Zeng, Jizhong Hou, Jinghui Huang, Lekang Zhao, Qian Yin

items.title: Association Between Physical Therapy and Mortality in Older Patients with Heart Failure and Chronic Kidney Disease
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Evidence regarding the prognostic impact of outpatient physical therapy (PT) initiated shortly after discharge in older patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) hospitalized for worsening heart failure (HF) is limited. We evaluated the association between outpatient PT initiation within 30 days of discharge and the primary endpoint of all-cause mortality within 1 year after discharge. Methods: In this retrospective multicenter cohort study, we applied a 30-day post-discharge landmark design. Patients who died or were rehospitalized within 30 days after discharge were excluded, and 6359 eligible 30-day event-free survivors were included in the analysis. Of these, 244 (3.8%) underwent outpatient PT within 30 days of discharge, and the remaining patients had no documented outpatient PT within that period. Propensity scores were estimated from prespecified covariates and used for 1:1 matching. We assessed associations with 1-year all-cause mortality, cardiovascular (CV)-related rehospitalization, and their composite using Cox proportional hazards models in the propensity score-matched cohorts and pooled estimates across the 50 imputed and matched datasets using Rubin’s rules. Results: Within 1 year of discharge, 1099 participants died, 1586 were rehospitalized for CV-related reasons, and 2325 experienced either event. In pooled Cox regression analyses, outpatient PT initiation within 30 days was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.46; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.22–0.97; p = 0.042) and the composite outcome (HR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.48–0.94; p = 0.021), but not CV-related rehospitalization alone (HR, 0.78; 95% CI, 0.55–1.10; p = 0.178). Conclusions: Among patients with HF and study-defined CKD who were alive and free from CV rehospitalization at the 30-day landmark, early outpatient PT participation was associated with a lower risk of subsequent all-cause mortality. Given the observational design, treatment selection, and residual confounding, this finding does not establish a causal effect and requires confirmation in prospective controlled studies.
items.authors: Toshimi Sato, Tomoyuki Morisawa, Masakazu Saitoh, Kentaro Iwata, Michitaka Kato, Koji Sakurada
items.l1_lead: 在心力衰竭和慢性肾病患者中，出院后30天内参与物理治疗与降低一年内全因死亡风险相关，但需进一步前瞻性研究确认因果关系。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨在心力衰竭（HF）和慢性肾病（CKD）患者中，出院后30天内开始的门诊物理治疗（PT）与1年内全因死亡率之间的关联。研究采用回顾性多中心队列设计，排除了在出院后30天内死亡或再入院的患者，最终纳入6359名符合条件的30天无事件生存者进行分析。其中，244名患者（占3.8%）在出院后30天内接受了门诊物理治疗，其余患者在此期间没有记录到门诊物理治疗。研究通过预设协变量估算倾向评分，并进行1:1匹配，以评估与1年全因死亡率、心血管（CV）相关再入院及其复合结果的关联。

结果显示，在出院后1年内，共有1099名参与者死亡，1586名因心血管原因再入院，2325名经历了任一事件。在经过倾向评分匹配的队列中，门诊物理治疗的早期参与与较低的全因死亡率相关（风险比[HR]为0.46，95%置信区间[CI]为0.22–0.97，p = 0.042）及复合结果（HR为0.67，95% CI为0.48–0.94，p = 0.021），但与单独的心血管相关再入院并无显著关联（HR为0.78，95% CI为0.55–1.10，p = 0.178）。

综上所述，在本研究中，心力衰竭和慢性肾病患者在30天的关键时间节点存活且未再入院的情况下，早期参与门诊物理治疗与后续全因死亡风险降低相关。然而，由于本研究为观察性设计，治疗选择及残余混杂因素的影响，这一发现并未确立因果关系，需在前瞻性对照研究中进一步确认。
items.title_zh: 老年心衰合并慢性肾病患者物理治疗与死亡率的关联
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：关于在心衰加重住院后短期内启动的门诊物理治疗（PT）对老年慢性肾病（CKD）患者预后影响的证据有限。本研究评估了出院后30天内启动门诊PT与出院后1年内全因死亡率的关联。方法：本回顾性多中心队列研究采用30天出院后标志性设计，排除了在出院后30天内死亡或再住院的患者，共纳入6359名符合条件的30天事件无发生的幸存者。其中244名（3.8%）在出院后30天内接受了门诊PT，其余患者在此期间未记录门诊PT。采用预设协变量估算倾向评分，并进行1:1匹配。通过Cox比例风险模型评估与1年全因死亡率、心血管（CV）相关再住院及其复合事件的关联。结果：出院后1年内，1099名参与者死亡，1586名因CV相关原因再住院，2325名经历了任一事件。

items.title: Innovation and Productivity as Engines of Economic Growth in Ghana
items.abstract: This paper examines the dynamic relationship between innovation, total factor productivity (TFP), and economic growth in Ghana using annual data for the period 1965–2021. Although Ghana has recorded relatively strong economic growth, concerns remain regarding the sustainability of this performance in the absence of consistent productivity improvements. The study combines growth accounting techniques with time-series econometric methods, including the autoregressive distributed lag–unrestricted error correction model (ARDL–UECM), vector error correction modelling (VECM), Granger causality tests, and two-stage least squares estimation. The results provide robust evidence of a stable long-run equilibrium relationship among innovation, productivity, and output. Innovation exerts a positive and statistically significant effect on economic growth, primarily through productivity-enhancing channels, while TFP emerges as the dominant long-run driver of growth. Short-run dynamics reveal feedback effects between innovation, productivity, and economic growth. However, growth accounting results indicate substantial volatility in TFP growth, suggesting that Ghana’s expansion has been driven largely by factor accumulation rather than sustained efficiency gains. The findings offer policy-relevant insights for productivity-centred growth strategies in Sub-Saharan Africa.
items.authors: Hu Xuhua, Ernest Kay Bakpa, Josephine Adwoa Yeboah

items.title: Learning Gravity: An Innately Constrained Bayesian Model of Human Vestibular Development
items.abstract: The vestibular apparatus is substantially organized before birth, whereas human equilibrium emerges only gradually through head control, sitting, standing, and independent walking. We propose an Innately Constrained Bayesian Model of Vestibular Development in which a phylogenetically shaped architecture constrains an initial model space; prenatal and postnatal experience calibrate internal models of self-motion and gravity; and developmentally gated plasticity modulates the rate of updating. We explicitly distinguish established evidence from interpretations and model-derived hypotheses. Recent human and nonhuman primate work on internal models, active self-motion, and multisensory recalibration is integrated with developmental and clinical evidence. The framework is then tested conceptually across congenital and acquired vestibular loss, altered gravity, and aging. Its proposed novelty lies not in Bayesian inference or internal models themselves, but in combining phylogenetic constraints, prenatal calibration, a qualitative transition at birth, time-dependent plasticity, and life-span context switching within a single developmental account. Finally, we operationalize the model through measurable predictions involving VOR adaptation, sensory-weighting coefficients, anticipatory postural responses, context-specific readaptation, and postural stability. The framework is intended as a falsifiable perspective rather than a definitive mechanistic account.
items.authors: Giacinto Asprella Libonati, Fernanda Asprella Libonati

items.title: Effects of Walking Speed and Backward-Directed Resistive Force Applied to the Center of Mass in Young Adults
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: This study evaluated whether walking speed and backward-directed resistive force interact to systematically alter knee joint kinematics and activity of knee flexor and extensor muscles in healthy adults. Methods: Fourteen active young adults (18–35 years) without lower-extremity injuries walked in a randomized order at 0.5 and 1.0 m/s while experiencing backward-directed resistive forces ranging from 0% to 25% of body weight. Knee joint kinematics, stride characteristics, and electromyographic (EMG) activity of the vastus lateralis, vastus medialis, and biceps femoris were collected and quantified. Results: No significant speed × force interactions were observed for step kinematic outcomes (p 0.05). Walking speed significantly affected stride length and stride time (p 0.05), whereas force did not (p 0.05). For knee stance phase kinematics, force significantly affected outcomes (p 0.05), whereas speed and the speed × force interaction did not (p 0.05). For EMG activity, speed and the speed × force interaction was not significant for any muscle (p 0.05). Resistive force significantly affected activation of all three muscles (p 0.05). Conclusions: Backward-directed resistive forces alter knee kinematics and EMG activity, with effects becoming evident at approximately 15% of body weight regardless of walk speed. These findings suggest that posteriorly directed resistance to the center of mass at slower walk speeds may provide a novel approach for modifying knee joint kinematics and lower-extremity muscular activity while walking on a stable, level surface.
items.authors: Kyle Southall, Matthew P. Ithurburn, C. Scott Bickel, Laura Vogtle, Harshvardhan Singh, Stephanie Fowler

items.title: A Reconfigurable Peripheral Interface Controller-Based Test Platform: Co-Design, Analytical Characterization, and Low-Cost Hardware Implementation
items.abstract: Practical training on embedded systems is a very good way to assess the skills of students in firmware development, real-time programming and hardware–software co-design. However, many low- and middle-income institutions still use closed, proprietary boards, such as the Altera DE series, which hide the physical behavior. To address this, a low-cost, fully reconfigurable Microcontroller Test Board (MTB) was designed and technically validated for application in undergraduate laboratories. The MTB is manufactured as a one-sided through-hole PCB via toner transfer and FeCl3 etching, with a PIC18F2550 in-circuit programmer and support for 28- and 40-pin targets including the PIC16F877A. The MTB integrates six functional blocks, providing five canonical input/output modalities on a single regulated 5 V/0.56 A rail: (1) an ICSP programmer; (2) a multiplexed seven-segment display; (3) an 8 × 8 LED matrix; (4) a matrix keypad with LCD calculator; and (5) a 10-bit ADC stage. All subsystems operate with a flicker-free refresh rate 122 Hz. The total board power consumption is 6.72 W at 12 V DC, with the linear regulator dissipating 3.92 W under full load. Probe points allow for signal transparency. Models for regulator dissipation, ADC quantization, multiplex refresh duty cycle, LED current limiting, oscillator timing, matrix-scanning latency, LCD timing, keypad response and Fe3+ with Cu etch kinetics were first-principles. Bench measurements agree with model predictions to less than 3% error, and confirm worst-case design margins. The MTB provides analytical rigor with accessible hardware to enable measurable experiments in microcontroller labs. The platform is cost-effective, with a material cost of less than USD 18. Each signal is routed to probe points, providing significant cost reduction from commercial trainers, and a transparent hands-on laboratory resource for engineering curricula with limited resources.
items.authors: Omolayo Abegunde, Olugbenga Akinade, Sunday B. Ogunjide, Adewuyi Adetayo Adegbite

items.title: Enhanced Grey Wolf Optimisation for Sustainable PV-DG Allocation Under Seasonal Uncertainty
items.abstract: Improving energy efficiency and renewable-energy hosting capacity in distribution networks is essential for sustainable power-system development. Conventional networks face power losses, voltage deviations, thermal stress, and limited flexibility to accommodate increasing renewable penetration. Accordingly, optimal placement and sizing of photovoltaic-based distributed generation (PV-DG) has become an effective approach for enhancing network performance. This study applies the Grey Wolf Optimiser (GWO) to PV-DG allocation considering three objectives: minimisation of active power loss and total voltage deviation, and maximisation of the voltage stability index. To mitigate the premature convergence of standard GWO, Opposition-Based Learning (OBL) is integrated to enhance exploration through opposite candidate solutions. The proposed OBL-GWO framework is evaluated on the IEEE 33-bus system under three PV-DG penetration scenarios using five-year irradiance and load data from Riyadh, including seasonal uncertainty and long-term load growth. Compared with standard GWO, it achieves average additional gains of 11.24, 10.0, 6.79, and 2.74 percentage points in power-loss reduction, TVD reduction, VSI improvement, and minimum-bus-voltage improvement, respectively. Sensitivity analysis confirms limited dependence on moderate changes in objective weights. A persistent cloudy-week case demonstrates robust performance against GWO, PSO, and GA under adverse irradiance. Scalability tests on IEEE 69- and 118-bus systems confirm that OBL-GWO retains its solution-quality and convergence advantages on larger networks.
items.authors: Abdullah Aljumah, Ahmed Darwish

items.title: Visibility-Graph Analysis of Raman Spectra in Chalazion and Lipid Dysregulation: An Exploratory Study
items.abstract: A chalazion is an inflammatory lesion of the eyelid caused by a blockage in the sebaceous glands. To identify subtle biochemical differences in chalazion secretions and patient serum, we apply a graph-theory-based visibility-graph approach to Raman spectra, focusing on its exploratory potential for detecting band-specific spectral differences. As a classical baseline, we also employ Principal Component Analysis (PCA); however, the visibility-graph approach provides complementary, band-localized information that may support interpretation of subtle spectral differences. The study included samples from chalazion patients and control subjects, comprising healthy individuals and patients with lipid disorders. Raman spectra were analyzed by transforming the data into visibility graphs, enabling identification of hidden correlations and signal dynamics. Within the VG representation, group differences were concentrated mainly in the 1100–1300 cm−1 range, with localized extrema near 1177, 1184, and 1260 cm−1 in chalazion secretions and near 1172, 1174, 1219, and 1257 cm−1 in serum. The identified positions overlap regions with possible lipid- and protein-related contributions, including C–C, =CH, and amide III vibrations, and are treated as candidate spectral positions rather than markers of individual molecular compounds. From the perspective of complex-network-based signal analysis, the visibility-graph transformation provides an alternative way of representing Raman spectra and extracting structural information that is not readily apparent in the original spectral domain. This information-oriented approach is consistent with entropy-related studies of complex signals, where nonlinear structure, local organization, and hidden dependencies in data are of central interest. These findings suggest that visibility-graph analysis may be useful as an exploratory tool for identifying candidate lipid-related spectral features, although further validation using larger sample sets is required. Full-range PCA was also examined over 200–2000 cm−1. It revealed global covariance patterns distributed across several spectral regions, whereas VG localized the pairwise differences within the 1100–1300 cm−1 range at specific Raman-shift positions.
items.authors: Renata Wojnarowska-Nowak, Rafał Rak, Kornelia Łach, Aneta Kowal, Kamil Szmuc, Damian Roczkowski

items.title: Please Read Carefully: The Pharmacology of Fiction
items.abstract: This contribution offers a close reading of a painting by Swiss artist Albert Anker (1831–1910). The painting—‘Grandfather’s Devotion’—pictures a reading scene in which a young boy (the grandson) reads aloud to an old man (the grandfather). In Anker’s original conception of the scene, the book that the young boy holds in his hands would in all likelihood have been a religious volume, the reading of which evokes the devotional practice to which the title of the work alludes. In my analysis of the painting, however, I want to shift the scene slightly and imagine that the book is a novel. In doing so, I want to reflect on the relationship between reading and care that underlies many contemporary discussions of the importance of literature to medical and health humanities. By means of a comparison of the scene that Anker pictures with that underlying Marcel Proust’s essay ‘On Reading’, I want to suggest that we see ‘Grandfather’s Devotion’ as the representation of a form of ‘vulnerable reading’ (Arthur Frank). At the same time, I want to suggest that we keep open the possibility that in this case the object of the old man’s devoted attention is a pharmakon and that, therefore, the act of reading may do harm as well as bring relief.
items.authors: Jürgen Pieters

items.title: Beyond Snapshots: Building Methane Measurement-Informed Inventories for Midstream Oil and Gas Sites in the Appalachian Basin
items.abstract: This paper presents the application of a novel methodology to build a comprehensive Measurement-Informed Inventory (MII) by integrating unreported emissions into government inventories. These emissions are often excluded from current regulatory requirements or associated with upset conditions, and are identified through aerial surveys and confirmed by oil and gas (O G) operators. This methodology utilizes the Mechanistic Air Emissions Simulator (MAES) tool to generate spatially and temporally resolved emission estimates for O G sites, using annual inventory data submitted to the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP) and quarterly aerial surveys conducted in 2023 by Bridger Photonics at partner-operated sites in the Appalachian Basin. The analysis is part of the Appalachian Methane Initiative (AMI) coalition efforts to improve methane emissions characterization and mitigation efforts in the Appalachian Basin. On average, results show that emissions from the MII models are 58.9% higher than the emissions reported to the GHGRP for reporting year 2022 (submitted in 2023) for these facilities, which was the most recent inventory available at the time of the 2023 surveys, when the reported total is restricted to normal operation. Measured against the total reported inventory, which includes 479.2 mt/year of operator-reported fugitive emissions, the increase is 40.0%. Site-level methane emission rates exceeding 15 kg/h are estimated to account for 94.9% of total emissions across all midstream sites, while rates above the 95th percentile of the site-level distribution (105 kg/h) contribute 33.4%, highlighting the disproportionate influence of large emitters. These results are based on 19 partner-operated facilities from two operators and are not a representative sample of the Appalachian midstream sector. The simulated average loss rate for the participating companies under analysis was 6.45 × 10−4, lower than the loss rate values reported in the literature for this sector, which span different supply chain scopes. The principal contribution of this work is methodological: it shows how aerial observations, operator-provided information, and a stochastic facility model can be combined to account for the tail end of the emissions distribution that is often absent from conventional bottom-up (BU) estimates, and it indicates that aerial campaigns optimized to detect events from upset conditions can support more accurate MIIs.
items.authors: Arthur Santos, Jacob Mdigo, Anna Hodshire, Daniel Zimmerle, Tecle Rufael, Matthew R. Harrison

items.title: Real-World Analysis of Olanzapine and Functional Outcomes in Outpatient Cancer Rehabilitation
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Cachexia is a multifactorial muscle wasting syndrome driven by inflammation, causing increased catabolism and decreased food intake. Using appetite stimulation as part of multidisciplinary rehabilitation for cachexia is an emerging strategy. Olanzapine was originally developed as an atypical antipsychotic and has since emerged in rehabilitative strategies in patients with brain injury and chemotherapy-induced nausea. In 2023, the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) issued a rapid recommendation for the use of low-dose (2.5–5 mg) olanzapine to improve appetite and weight in adults with advanced cancer cachexia, based on novel evidence of increased appetite and weight gain. Methods: We retrospectively evaluated the impact of olanzapine on a real-world cohort of 45 patients with appetite concerns undergoing cancer-related rehabilitation. Patients were retrospectively evaluated for changes in body composition metrics and physical therapy (PT) related outcomes. Results: While treatment groups were well matched at baseline, there were no statistical differences between group outcomes, including weight gain, contrary to findings in other populations. However, fatigue was a significant predictor of PT goal completion across the cohort (p = 0.017), highlighting the need for future studies to investigate this relationship more deeply. Conclusions: These results indicate that the effects of olanzapine may vary between different clinical populations and suggest that further investigation into adjuvant therapies remains critical for optimizing care for cancer patients with anorexia.
items.authors: Ioanna Karras, Kayla Beck, Addison Barber, Kathryn Abplanalp, Ishan Roy
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，奥氮平对癌症患者的食欲和体重影响可能因临床人群不同而异，需进一步探讨其在改善食欲方面的有效性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在分析奥氮平（Olanzapine）在癌症康复患者中的应用及其对功能结果的影响，特别是在应对恶病质（cachexia）方面的潜力。恶病质是一种由炎症引起的多因素肌肉消耗综合症，导致代谢增加和食欲下降。近年来，利用刺激食欲作为多学科康复的一部分，成为应对恶病质的新兴策略。奥氮平最初作为一种非典型抗精神病药物开发，近年来在脑损伤患者和化疗引起的恶心的康复策略中逐渐被应用。2023年，美国临床肿瘤学会（ASCO）发布了关于低剂量（2.5-5 mg）奥氮平的快速推荐，认为其可以改善晚期癌症患者的食欲和体重，基于新证据显示其能有效增加食欲和体重。

本研究回顾性评估了45名在癌症相关康复中存在食欲问题的患者，探讨奥氮平对其身体成分指标和物理治疗（PT）相关结果的影响。尽管治疗组在基线时匹配良好，但结果显示各组之间在体重增加等方面没有统计学差异，这与其他人群的研究结果相悖。然而，疲劳被发现是影响整个队列PT目标完成的重要预测因素（p = 0.017），这突显了未来研究深入探讨这一关系的必要性。

综上所述，研究结果表明奥氮平的效果可能在不同临床人群中存在差异，提示对辅助治疗的进一步研究对于优化癌症患者的护理至关重要，尤其是那些面临厌食问题的患者。
items.title_zh: 奥氮平在癌症康复中的应用及功能结果分析
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：恶病质是一种由炎症引起的多因素肌肉消耗综合症，导致代谢增加和食物摄入减少。将食欲刺激作为恶病质多学科康复的一部分是一种新兴策略。奥氮平最初作为一种非典型抗精神病药物开发，现已在脑损伤和化疗引起的恶心患者的康复策略中得到应用。2023年，美国临床肿瘤学会（ASCO）基于新证据发布了低剂量（2.5-5 mg）奥氮平改善晚期癌症恶病质患者食欲和体重的快速推荐。方法：我们回顾性评估了45名有食欲问题的癌症相关康复患者中奥氮平的影响。结果：尽管治疗组在基线时匹配良好，但组间结果（包括体重增加）没有统计学差异，与其他人群的发现相反。然而，疲劳是整个队列中物理治疗目标完成的重要预测因素（p = 0.017），强调了未来研究深入探讨这一关系的必要性。结论：这些结果提示需要进一步研究。

items.title: Momentum-Space Path Integral Approach to Non-Hermitian Symmetry Breaking
items.abstract: A quantum-classical correspondence for non-Hermitian symmetry breaking has recently been established using coordinate-space path integrals, providing a semiclassical understanding of spectral transitions at the level of individual eigenstates. Here we develop its dual formulation in momentum space by constructing the corresponding trace formula and quantization condition. We show that the real or complex nature of individual eigenvalues is determined by the symmetry properties of the associated semiclassical orbits, as in the coordinate-space path-integral approach. Moreover, we demonstrate that the topology of semiclassical orbits determines the natural formulation of the quantization condition: the coordinate- and momentum-space formulations are equivalent for contractible periodic orbits in phase space, whereas for noncontractible orbits, the quantization condition along the winding direction remains valid, but its dual form must be corrected by a boundary term. In particular, real-space-winding and Brillouin-zone-winding orbits naturally select coordinate- and momentum-space quantization, respectively. As a nontrivial application, we investigate the boundary-induced spectral transition of Bloch oscillations in a finite non-Hermitian lattice, where Bloch-oscillation orbits winding across the Brillouin zone preserve the relevant symmetry and yield real energy levels, whereas boundary-reflected orbits form symmetry-related pairs and give rise to complex-conjugate eigenvalues. Our work completes the quantum-classical correspondence framework for non-Hermitian symmetry breaking, extending its applicability to a broader class of non-Hermitian problems.
items.authors: Zhuo-Ting Cai, Wei Chen

items.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Semantic Secure Energy Efficiency Optimization in IRS-Assisted UAV Communications
items.abstract: The integration of semantic communication with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and intelligent reflecting surfaces (IRSs) offers a promising approach for next-generation wireless systems. However, jointly optimizing semantic reliability, physical-layer security, and energy efficiency remains challenging. This paper investigates an IRS-assisted UAV semantic secure communication system in the presence of a potential eavesdropper, with the objective of maximizing semantic secure energy efficiency (SSEE). We first introduce a semantic similarity-based secure energy efficiency metric to capture the trade-off among transmission reliability, physical-layer security, and UAV energy consumption. The semantic symbol number, UAV trajectory, transmit power, and IRS phase shifts are jointly considered under mobility, secrecy, and energy constraints. To efficiently solve the resulting mixed discrete-continuous optimization problem, we develop a hierarchical optimization framework: the outer layer exhaustively searches over a finite set of candidate semantic symbol numbers, while the inner layer solves the continuous resource allocation problem using a heuristic-guided soft actor–critic (HG-SAC) algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed framework achieves noticeable SSEE gains over several benchmark schemes.
items.authors: Xiang Ji, Shuomin Sun, Haofei Wang, Peng Liu, Wanming Hao

items.title: Extending Product Lifespans as an Upstream Strategy for Reducing Waste Generation and Resource Dissipation from an LCA Perspective
items.abstract: Waste prevention begins upstream, in decisions made long before a product becomes waste. This article examines product lifetime management as an upstream environmental strategy and asks when longer product use can reduce waste generation, resource consumption and environmental impacts across the life cycle. An integrative literature review combined exploratory searches in Google Scholar and citation tracking with a structured search of Scopus. Records were screened by title, abstract and keywords. Publications in English were considered without a date limit and selected according to their relevance to product lifetime, premature replacement, repair and lifetime extension, consumer and business decisions, regulation, waste prevention and life cycle assessment. The selected studies were supplemented with relevant legal, regulatory, institutional and standardisation documents, producing a final reference base of 240 sources. The review shows that actual product lifetime is shaped not only by technical durability, but also by repairability, access to spare parts and information, continued software and service support, opportunities for upgrading and reuse, business incentives and consumer behaviour. Extending product use can reduce waste and resource demand, but environmental benefits are not automatic. They depend on product characteristics, energy consumption, technological progress and, above all, whether prolonged use genuinely replaces the production and purchase of new products. Product lifetime management should therefore be understood as a coordinated upstream strategy linking design, repair, reuse, business models, regulation and consumption with environmental assessment across the life cycle.
items.authors: Tomasz Zacłona, Anna Kochanek, Iga Pietrucha, Paweł Kupczak

items.title: Research Progress on Bidirectional Regulation of the Microbiota–Gut–Brain Axis in Autism Spectrum Disorder Based on the Immune–Metabolic–Endocrine Interactive Network
items.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a highly heterogeneous neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by core features of social communication deficits and high prevalence of gastrointestinal comorbidities. With its continuously rising global prevalence, current therapeutic modalities remain unable to target and ameliorate the core symptoms of ASD. The microbiota–gut–brain axis (MGBA), a critical pathway mediating crosstalk between the gut microbiota and the brain, has been extensively documented to be deeply involved in the pathological progression of ASD in recent years. However, prior studies have predominantly focused on the unidirectional regulation of the brain by gut microbiota, lacking an integrated account of the bidirectional regulation across immune, metabolic, and endocrine systems. Centered on the immune–metabolic–endocrine interactive network, this review systematically delineates the bidirectional regulatory mechanisms of the MGBA in ASD by integrating recent evidence from microbiota sequencing, animal models, and clinical intervention studies, with the aim of clarifying the bidirectional causal controversy between intestinal microecological disturbance and ASD behavioral abnormalities. This review proposes that in children with ASD, decreased abundance of beneficial intestinal bacteria and disrupted metabolic profiles of short-chain fatty acids synergistically impair intestinal barrier integrity, triggering peripheral chronic inflammation that further drives excessive microglial activation-mediated central neuroinflammation. Subsequently, disturbances in the homeostasis of multiple neurotransmitters including 5-hydroxytryptamine (5-HT), γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA), histamine, and dopamine occur via the vagus nerve and hypothalamic–pituitary–adrenal (HPA) axis, ultimately driving ASD behavioral abnormalities. Conversely, chronic stress and behavioral characteristics associated with ASD reshape the intestinal microecology through neuroendocrine pathways, forming a vicious cycle of “microbiota dysbiosis—immune inflammation—HPA axis hyperactivity—further intestinal microecological imbalance”. This review summarizes the therapeutic efficacy and translational bottlenecks of three types of microecological interventions: fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT), probiotics, and ketogenic diet, and analyzes the current limitations in the field, including pronounced population heterogeneity, unclear cross-talk mechanisms among multiple pathways, and the scarcity of large-sample clinical evidence. Collectively, this review preliminarily elucidates the complete multi-system interactive framework of MGBA regulation in ASD, providing theoretical support for mechanistic research and gut-targeted individualized interventions for ASD.
items.authors: Weiao Kong, Haoke Qiu, Yuhang Jiang, Huanhuan Ge, Wanyi Wu, Lefan Huang
items.l1_lead: 自闭症谱系障碍的微生物-肠道-大脑轴在免疫、代谢和内分泌网络中呈现双向调节机制，揭示了肠道微生态失调与行为异常之间的复杂关系。
items.l2_summary:
自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种高度异质性的神经发育障碍，主要特征为社交沟通缺陷和高发的胃肠道合并症。随着全球ASD患病率的持续上升，目前的治疗方法仍无法有效针对和改善ASD的核心症状。近年来，肠道微生物群-肠道-大脑轴（MGBA）作为一个重要的通路，广泛参与了ASD的病理进程。然而，之前的研究主要集中在肠道微生物对大脑的单向调节，缺乏对免疫、代谢和内分泌系统之间双向调节的综合性探讨。基于免疫-代谢-内分泌互动网络，本综述系统阐述了MGBA在ASD中的双向调节机制，整合了来自微生物组测序、动物模型和临床干预研究的最新证据，旨在澄清肠道微生态失调与ASD行为异常之间的双向因果争议。

研究表明，在ASD儿童中，益生菌的丰度降低和短链脂肪酸的代谢谱紊乱共同损害肠道屏障的完整性，诱发外周慢性炎症，进一步驱动小胶质细胞活化介导的中枢神经炎症。随后，通过迷走神经和下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺（HPA）轴，导致包括5-羟色胺（5-HT）、γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）、组胺和多巴胺等多种神经递质的稳态失调，最终引发ASD的行为异常。相反，慢性压力和与ASD相关的行为特征通过神经内分泌途径重塑肠道微生态，形成“微生物群失调—免疫炎症—HPA轴过度活跃—进一步肠道微生态失衡”的恶性循环。

此外，本综述总结了三种微生态干预的治疗效果及其转化瓶颈，包括粪便微生物移植（FMT）、益生菌和生酮饮食，并分析了该领域当前的局限性，如显著的人群异质性、多条路径之间交互机制不明确，以及缺乏大规模临床试验等问题。这些研究为理解ASD的复杂机制提供了新的视角，并为未来的治疗策略指明了方向。
items.title_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍微生物-肠道-大脑轴双向调节研究进展
items.summary_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种高度异质的神经发育障碍，主要特征为社交沟通缺陷和高发的胃肠道共病。随着全球发病率的持续上升，目前的治疗方法仍无法有效改善ASD的核心症状。微生物-肠道-大脑轴（MGBA）作为介导肠道微生物与大脑之间相互作用的重要通路，近年来被广泛研究与ASD的病理进展密切相关。然而，先前的研究主要集中于肠道微生物对大脑的单向调节，缺乏对免疫、代谢和内分泌系统双向调节的综合探讨。本文基于免疫-代谢-内分泌互动网络，系统阐述了MGBA在ASD中的双向调节机制，整合了微生物测序、动物模型和临床干预研究的最新证据，旨在澄清肠道微生态失调与ASD行为异常之间的双向因果争议。研究提出，在ASD儿童中，益生菌丰度降低和短链脂肪酸代谢特征紊乱共同影响其健康。

items.title: A Data-Driven Parametric Framework for Size-Adaptive Shoe Insole Outline Generation
items.abstract: With the rapid expansion of AR/VR-based digital platforms, there is an increasing demand for the automated generation of size-varied 3D shoe assets. However, conventional CAD-based linear scaling and PCA-based global statistical shape models are limited in their ability to capture the non-uniform and locally non-linear deformations observed in insole contours. This study proposes a size-adaptive insole contour generation framework that integrates image-based contour extraction, B-spline parametric representation, and type-specific SVR-based local displacement regression. By decomposing control-point displacements into tangent–normal components, the proposed method directly models non-linear curvature variations associated with size progression without relying on dimensionality reduction. Quantitative evaluations under an eight-fold leave-one-insole-out (LOIO) protocol show that the proposed method achieves a mean Hausdorff distance of 4.73 mm, a Chamfer distance of 1.76 mm, and an IoU of 0.929. It significantly outperforms the no-clustering ablation in both the Hausdorff distance (6.13 mm; p=0.032) and IoU (p=0.033), as well as the PCA-based kernel ridge regression baseline across all three metrics (p 0.05). No statistically significant differences were observed between the proposed method and the ratio scaling, Gaussian process, or thin plate spline baselines (p 0.05). PCA-Linear showed a small numerical advantage in the Hausdorff distance (4.16 mm), but the difference was not statistically significant (p=0.187). A sensitivity analysis further reveals the existence of a practical control-point density region that balances geometric fidelity and model complexity. This work provides a data-driven parametric approach for standard size-based digital grading automation and establishes a technical foundation for future extension to full 3D shoe mesh generation.
items.authors: Ga Eun Lee, Minjun Kim, Jeong Hyeon Lee, Jiwon Kim, Sukwon Lee, Changgu Kang

items.title: ZMP-Guided Ground Anchoring for Quadrotor Landings Using MRAC-Neural Networks
items.abstract: Landing underactuated quadrotors on inclines is challenging as sudden contact transients convert translational kinetic energy into critical edge-tipping moments. Conventional controllers struggle to mitigate these sub-second impacts without computationally intensive prior terrain models or payload-restricting mechanical shock absorbers. This paper introduces a stabilization approach combining a Zero Moment Point (ZMP)-guided anchoring strategy with an impact-resilient Model Reference Adaptive Control Neural Network (MRAC-NN). The ZMP serves as a proactive geometric threshold. Evaluating overturning moments directly in the body frame before physical tilt occurs triggers immediate asymmetric bidirectional thrust. This artificially augments the surface normal force, thereby securing the vehicle on steep inclines that exceed natural static friction limits. Concurrently, the computationally efficient MRAC-NN suppresses unstructured aerodynamic disturbances and high-frequency impact shocks. To prevent parameter wind-up during sudden kinematic arrest at touchdown, the neuro-adaptive law is structurally augmented with robust bounding and dynamic state-locking mechanisms, mathematically guaranteeing Uniform Ultimate Boundedness (UUB). The framework is validated through high-fidelity simulations that incorporate Linear Complementarity Problem (LCP) rigid-impact constraints and stick–slip friction. Results demonstrate the architecture effectively suppresses post-impact bouncing and transforms critical tipping moments into controlled planar slides, reducing stabilization penalties by up to 47.5% and expanding the survivable flight envelope to 60∘ inclines where classical methods fail.
items.authors: Özgür Altınışık, Seta Bogosyan

items.title: Effect of Heat Input on Microstructure Evolution and High-Cycle Fatigue Behavior of Ti-6Al-4V Fabricated by Wire-Laser Directed Energy Deposition
items.abstract: This work examines the response of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by wire-laser directed energy deposition (DED) to heat inputs between 175 and 350 J/mm. Microstructure, tensile behavior, and rotating-bending fatigue were evaluated. As input increased, the transverse size of columnar prior β grains rose from about 642 to 1079 μm and the mean α-lath width increased from 0.65 to 1.32 μm. The α structure consequently changed from a fine acicular/basketweave form to a coarser lamellar form with clearer colonies. Tensile and yield strengths stayed near 900 and 840 MPa, whereas elongation fell from 14.3% to 10.3%. After a 600 °C, 4 h stress relief, fully reversed fatigue tests were performed at 500 MPa (R = −1). Specimens with 175 J/mm heat input reached about 3 × 107 cycles, while one with 350 J/mm fractured at roughly 1 × 105 cycles. The longer life of H175 coincided with its finer interwoven α structure, closer striations, more secondary cracks, and a more tortuous crack route.
items.authors: Zhe Wang, Xi Chen, Meng Jiang, Zhijian Lu, Yuan Chen, Xuan Su

items.title: Safflower Seed Oil Ameliorates AFL-Induced Epidermal Lipid Loss Partially via the PPARγ Signaling Pathway
items.abstract: Objective: Ablative fractional laser (AFL) therapy impairs epidermal barrier integrity through the disruption of stratum corneum lipids and keratinocyte differentiation, resulting in increased transepidermal water loss (TEWL) and delayed functional recovery. This study aims to develop a more effective barrier repair strategy and evaluate the efficacy of topical safflower seed oil (SSO) in promoting post-AFL barrier restoration. Methods: An optimized murine AFL model (20 W, 0.5 ms pulse delay, and 0.7 mm spot spacing) was established to investigate skin repair mechanisms. SSO composition was characterized by gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC-MS). Epidermal repair was assessed using confocal laser scanning microscopy, while Oil Red O staining and immunofluorescence were employed to evaluate lipid formation and the expression of lipid synthesis-related genes, respectively. Results: GC-MS analysis identified SSO as a rich natural source of linoleic acid (69.1%) and oleic acid (18.7%). Over the 7-day period of AFL exposure alone, TEWL rose by 4–6 fold in mouse skin, accompanied by a near-complete loss of epidermal lipid synthesis. However, upon SSO administration, a marked reduction in TEWL was observed from day 1, and epidermal lipid synthesis recovered by day 7. Moreover, SSO treatment significantly upregulated epidermal PPARγ expression in AFL-injured skin. Pharmacological inhibition of PPARγ (T0070907) largely abrogated the lipid synthesis and barrier repair effects of SSO, while PPARα antagonism (GW6471) showed no obvious interference with SSO’s therapeutic efficacy, suggesting a potential association between PPARγ signaling modulation and SSO-mediated skin barrier restoration. Conclusions: These findings suggest that SSO is a promising natural agent for post-AFL skin care, which improves AFL-impaired skin barrier function by remodeling lipid metabolism, at least in part through PPARγ signaling, and warrants further preclinical and clinical investigation.
items.authors: Jinjin Liu, Qian Wang, Jialin Zhong, Xiaoqing Wang, Haidong Jia, Yushu Wang

items.title: Effects of Sethoxydim on Root Morphology and Rhizosphere Microecology of Foxtail Millet Seedlings
items.abstract: Sethoxydim, a cyclohexanedione herbicide inhibiting acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACCase), is widely used for post-emergence control of graminaceous weeds in foxtail millet (Setaria italica (L.) Beauv.) fields. This study investigated under field conditions the effects of sethoxydim on root morphology and rhizosphere microecology using two cultivars with contrasting tolerance: the relatively tolerant hybrid Zhangzagu 10 and the relatively sensitive conventional Zhonggu 19. Previous studies on sethoxydim in foxtail millet have focused primarily on shoot physiology, whereas integrated assessments of root morphology, soil enzyme activity, and rhizosphere microbiome remain scarce. Sethoxydim was applied at 112.5, 225.0, or 337.5 g a.i./hm2 (0.5×, 1×, and 1.5× the recommended dose), with water as control. Root morphology and rhizosphere enzyme activities were measured at 0, 7, 14, 21, and 28 days after application, and bacterial and fungal communities were analyzed by high-throughput sequencing. Sethoxydim inhibited root growth in both cultivars, but Zhonggu 19 was consistently more sensitive. At 337.5 g a.i./hm2, root length, surface area, diameter, and volume were markedly reduced in Zhonggu 19, whereas Zhangzagu 10 showed milder inhibition and even slight stimulation at lower doses. Rhizosphere urease, sucrase, and catalase activities initially decreased then recovered. Sethoxydim altered α-diversity and community structure of rhizosphere bacteria and fungi. These preliminary findings suggest that sethoxydim may be tentatively applied at or below the recommended dose (≤225.0 g a.i./hm2) under similar field conditions, particularly for tolerant cultivars such as Zhangzagu 10, though confirmation through multi-year trials is required.
items.authors: Qi An, Manqing Luo, Shuo Li, Suqi Shang, Jianhong Ren, Xiaorui Li

items.title: Primary Headache Disorders in Pediatric Irritable Bowel Syndrome: Characterizing IBS-Associated Migraine Highlights
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to determine the prevalence of primary headache disorders in children and adolescents with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), compare the clinical characteristics of IBS-associated and non-IBS headache populations, and identify factors associated with migraine and tension-type headache (TTH) in pediatric IBS. Methods: This retrospective observational study included 100 patients aged 6–18 years diagnosed with IBS according to the Rome IV criteria. All patients underwent systematic headache screening and neurological evaluation using the International Classification of Headache Disorders, 3rd edition. Age- and sex-frequency-matched control groups comprising 30 patients with migraine and 31 with TTH without gastrointestinal disease were included for comparison. Multivariable logistic regression analysis was performed to identify factors independently associated with migraine and TTH. Results: Primary headache disorders were identified in 61% of patients, including migraine in 30% and TTH in 31%. Migraine was significantly associated with female sex, increasing age, and a family history of headache. Compared with patients with migraine without IBS, those with IBS-associated migraine had a significantly higher prevalence of nausea (93.3% vs. 60.0%, p = 0.002), whereas headache frequency, duration, severity, photophobia, phonophobia, and vomiting were similar. No significant clinical differences were observed between IBS-associated and non-IBS TTH. Conclusions: Primary headache disorders, particularly migraine, are highly prevalent in pediatric IBS. The markedly increased frequency of nausea without differences in other headache characteristics represents a hypothesis-generating observation and may reflect an interaction between migraine-associated symptoms and the underlying gastrointestinal susceptibility associated with IBS, rather than evidence of a distinct migraine phenotype. Routine neurological assessment should be considered in children with IBS, particularly in female adolescents and those with a family history of headache.
items.authors: Özben Akıncı Göktaş, Suna Selbuz

items.title: Repassivation of Titanium Surface with Different Disinfectants After Implantoplasty: Effects on Corrosion, Ion Release, Cytotoxicity and Bacterial Behaviour—An In Vitro Study
items.abstract: Objective: Implantoplasty smoothens exposed implant surfaces but disrupts the titanium oxide layer, reducing corrosion resistance, increasing ion release, and facilitating bacterial colonization. Restoring a stable and biologically favorable surface is therefore critical. Chemical agents capable of repassivating titanium may enhance surface integrity and antibacterial performance, yet the optimal agent remains unclear. This study evaluated the repassivation effects of common disinfectants on corrosion resistance, ion release, cytotoxicity, and antibacterial activity. Methods: One hundred twenty-eight discs underwent manual implantoplasty and were treated with citric acid (CA), ethylenediaminetetraace acid (EDTA), hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) or saline (S). Surface topography and wettability were analyzed using white-light interferometry and contact angle measurements. Corrosion behavior was assessed via open-circuit potential monitoring and potentiodynamic polarization in Hank’s solution. Titanium ion release was quantified over 21 days using inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry. Cytotoxicity was evaluated in human fibroblast and osteoblast cultures exposed to sample extracts. Bacterial adhesion and viability of Streptococcus sanguinis and Pseudomonas aeruginosa were analyzed by scanning electron microscopy and confocal laser scanning microscopy after 24 h and 48 h. Results: H2O2 increased surface roughness, while CA and EDTA showed no effect. All agents enhanced hydrophilicity, with CA and H2O2 producing the greatest increase in surface energy. CA showed the highest corrosion resistance and lowest ion release. No treatment exhibited cytotoxicity, and all reduced bacterial adhesion, with CA and H2O2 showing superior bactericidal activity. Conclusions: CA and H2O2 improved surface properties after implantoplasty, with CA providing the most favorable combination of corrosion resistance, minimal ion release and antibacterial effect.
items.authors: Leyre Millas, Javi Vilarrasa, Neus Carrió, Jose Nart, Javier Gil

items.title: Leakage Assessment and Correlation Power Analysis of the MAYO Secret Linear Map on a Cortex-M4: A Reproducible Case Study and a Validated First-Order Countermeasure
items.abstract: This work presents a complete power side-channel evaluation of the MAYO secret linear map on a constrained embedded target, together with a first-order countermeasure evaluated on the same hardware. While MAYO ranks among the most embedded-friendly candidates in the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) additional-signatures call, few countermeasures for it are quantified against an explicit leakage threshold.
